units.source: Battle Brothers is a game mostly about combat. You will fight many various enemies and sometimes have allies.
units.zh: 《战场兄弟》以战斗为核心。你会面对形形色色的敌人，有时也会与盟友并肩作战。

units.source: Including Donkey from their Trading Caravans, and Peasant, a civilian unit.
units.zh: 包括贸易商队中的驴，以及作为平民单位的农民。

units.source: Including Nachzehrer from Beasts faction, because it can spawn with Zombies.
units.zh: 也列出了野兽阵营的食尸鬼，因为它们可能与行尸一同出现。

units.source: Zombies are one of two {#1}Undead{/#1} factions. {#2}Ancient Dead{/#2} are the other, and they unite during the Undead Scourge.
units.zh: 行尸是两支{#1}亡灵{/#1}阵营之一，另一支是{#2}古代亡灵{/#2}。亡灵灾祸期间，两者会联合行动。

units.source: Note: Nachzehrers are from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction. They are here because they can spawn together with Zombies.
units.zh: 注意：食尸鬼属于{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营。这里列出它们，是因为它们可能与行尸一同出现。

units.source: Zombies are slower and clumsier than humans, and easy to hit. But their high HP, ability to rise again from the dead and sheer numbers make them hard to kill. Those who fight them can easily exhaust themselves, and will be only able to use a basic attack once, like Zombies they fight. Zombies inflict extra fatigue with their attacks to make it happen sooner.
units.zh: 行尸比人类迟缓笨拙，很容易命中。然而，它们生命值高、数量多，还能死而复生，因而很难彻底消灭。与它们交战很容易耗尽体力，最后只能像面前的行尸一样发动一次普通攻击。行尸的攻击还会造成额外疲劳，使这种情况更快出现。

units.source: Their melee skill is low, and they compensate it with {#1}Backstabber{/#1}, that works well because they are outnumbering their enemy.
units.zh: 行尸的近战命中很低，但能靠{#1}背刺者{/#1}弥补；它们通常占据人数优势，因而能充分发挥这项特长的作用。

units.source: They have special units: {#1}Geists{/#1} who can {#2}scream{/#2}, trying to scare you, and {#3}Necromancers{/#3} who rise the dead to fight again and empower them to break your defenses.
units.zh: 行尸阵营还有特殊单位：{#1}怨魂{/#1}会用{#2}恐怖尖啸{/#2}吓退敌人；{#3}亡灵法师{/#3}则会复活死者，让它们再次参战，并强化它们来突破你的防线。

units.source: If a human dies to them, he becomes one of them. Necromancers can resurrect dead humans, and during the Undead Scourge they can rise on their own.
units.zh: 人类死在它们手中后，也会变成它们的一员。亡灵法师能够复活人类死者；亡灵灾祸期间，死者也可能自行起身。

units.source: Everybody knows of magic and wizards, dark arts and the like. The Necromancer is just that; a wizard who decided selfish and evil acts suited them more. Wherever you're likely to run into zombies, they'll most likely be serving a master who'll quite gladly raise them over and over again into undeath. And should one of your brothers fall, the Necromancer will take glee in his resurrection...
units.zh: 世人都听说过魔法、巫师和黑暗秘术。亡灵法师正是这样一种巫师，只不过他们觉得自私与邪恶更适合自己。凡是行尸出没之处，多半都有一位主人在驱使它们，不厌其烦地将死者一次次唤回。而一旦你的某个兄弟倒下，亡灵法师也会乐意让他重新站起来……

units.source: Geist (german for spirit/ghost) can make quick work of their enemys resolve and always deal damage to HP rendering armor useless against them. A good Sergeant is very helpful against them.
units.zh: 怨魂的名称 Geist 在德语中意为灵魂或幽灵。它们能迅速击溃敌人的士气，攻击总是直接伤害生命值，护甲在它们面前毫无用处。一名出色的军士能为对抗怨魂提供很大帮助。

units.source: Orcs are one of two Greenskin factions. {#1}Goblins{/#1} are the other, and they unite during the Greenskin Invasion.
units.zh: 兽人是两支绿皮阵营之一，另一支是{#1}地精{/#1}。绿皮入侵期间，两者会联合行动。

units.source: Orcs are all very tough and strong. Their weapons are crude but very heavy, and Orcs also have damage modifiers, dealing even more damage with them. Stronger Orcs are immune to {#1}stun{/#1} and pushback. All Orcs are easy to hit, having low or negative defense values, and their resolve also isn't very high.
units.zh: 所有兽人都十分强壮耐打。它们的武器粗陋而沉重，再加上自身的伤害加成，打击威力更大。较强的兽人免疫{#1}眩晕{/#1}和击退。兽人的防御很低，甚至为负，因此很容易命中；它们的意志也不算很高。

units.source: Orc units either are glass cannons, like {#1}Young{/#1} and {#2}Berserkers{/#2}, or wear heavy armor, like {#3}Warriors{/#3} and {#4}Warlords{/#4}. All their weapons are melee with the exception of {#5}Crude Javelins{/#5} sometimes used by Orc Young.
units.zh: 兽人单位大致分为两类：{#1}兽人青年{/#1}和{#2}兽人狂战士{/#2}攻击凶猛，却缺少防护；{#3}兽人战士{/#3}和{#4}兽人军阀{/#4}则身披重甲。除兽人青年有时携带的{#5}粗制标枪{/#5}外，它们使用的都是近战武器。

units.source: Orcs use their brute force to gain advantage: Young and sometimes Berserkers will {#1}jump onto you and stun{/#1}, and Warriors will {#2}push{/#2} your frontline fighters to reach usually more vulnerable backline.
units.zh: 兽人会凭借蛮力取得优势：兽人青年，有时也包括兽人狂战士，会{#1}冲撞过来并造成眩晕{/#1}；兽人战士则会{#2}推开{/#2}你的前排，攻击通常更脆弱的后排。

units.source: Orcs are large, bulky greenskins with great strength and vitality. Their culture revolves around violence and martial prowess, and their society is structured around the strong taking from the weak. Unlike the closely-related {#1}Goblins{/#1}, they are brutes which see little purpose in blacksmithing or agriculture, preferring to raid and pillage to get what they need.
units.zh: 兽人是身形庞大、肌肉虬结的绿皮生物，力量和生命力都极为惊人。它们的文化围绕暴力与武力展开，社会秩序建立在强者掠夺弱者的规则之上。与亲缘相近的{#1}地精{/#1}不同，兽人是蛮横的暴徒，很少重视锻造或农业，宁愿靠袭掠夺取所需的一切。

units.source: Most Orcs live in nomadic clans, moving and setting up new camps to pillage other civilizations or clans. A typical clan is commanded by a Warlord - the strongest and biggest Orc in the clan. The rest of the Orcs obey him without question - unless someone feels strong enough to challenge him to a fight. Successions are usually in the form of armed combat and are often bloody. Constant small scale skirmishes and clan infighting are seen as the norm. Young Orcs often raid civilized settlements as Orc Marauders to prove themselves and to bring back weapons or tools for their clan.
units.zh: 大多数兽人以游牧氏族的形式生活，不断迁徙、建立新营地，劫掠其他文明或氏族。氏族通常由一名军阀统领，也就是其中最强壮、体形最大的兽人。其他兽人会无条件服从它，除非有人自认强大到足以向它挑战。首领的更替通常通过武装决斗决定，往往十分血腥。小规模冲突和氏族内斗是家常便饭。年轻兽人常以劫掠者的身份袭击文明聚落，借此证明自己，并为氏族带回武器或工具。

units.zh: {#1}兽人军阀驻扎在兽人战争营地，麾下往往有许多兽人战士。小心它的怒火。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Typical Orc Camp. Even in small numbers Orcs are a dangerous enemy.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}典型的兽人营地。即使数量不多，兽人也仍是危险的敌人。{/#1}

units.source: Some really powerful Orcs who gain experience fighting human kingdoms or goblin cities start erecting permanent strongholds. Usually they are made from wood and earth. It's not a rare sight to see slaves grow food or tend to livestock nearby. Sometimes - more often than not - the slaves are livestock themselves as Orcs eat everything.
units.zh: 有些格外强大的兽人在与人类王国或地精城市的战争中积累了经验，开始修建永久据点。这些据点通常由木材和泥土建成，附近经常能看到奴隶种粮或照料牲畜。不过，奴隶自己也常常就是牲畜，因为兽人什么都吃。

units.source: Orcs are not easy neighbors. The state of constant fighting sometimes pushes defeated ones into civilized nations territory. Sometimes they are small band of raiders, sometimes they are a bunch of exiles, sometimes the entire clan moves to slaughter and pillage.
units.zh: 与兽人为邻并不安稳。持续的争斗有时会把战败者赶入文明国度的领土。有时来的是一小群劫掠者，有时是一伙流放者，也有时是整个氏族迁来烧杀抢掠。

units.source: {#1}Orc Camp, erected in the ruins of a human castle.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}建在人类城堡废墟上的兽人营地。{/#1}

units.source: The military structure of Orcs is rather simple: the strong rule and the weak obey. On top resides the Warlord, which is the strongest and most cunning Orc in the clan. Their status permits them to use the best weapons and armor. As war leaders, they can easily intimidate enemies and boost the morale of their forces by the use of their warcry.
units.zh: 兽人的军事组织十分简单：强者统治，弱者服从。军阀高居顶端，是氏族中最强壮、最狡猾的兽人。地位使它有权使用最好的武器和护甲。作为战争首领，它能用战吼轻易震慑敌人，鼓舞麾下部队的士气。

units.source: Orc Warriors are older Orcs that were forged into mighty fighters over their lifespan. They are larger, stronger and more skilled than Orc Young, using better weapons and armor. Able to use both their natural strength and crude yet heavy armor, they are extremely dangerous opponents for an unprepared force. They are the foot soldiers of a clan and make up the main bulk of their forces.
units.zh: 兽人战士是较为年长的兽人，在漫长的厮杀中锤炼成了强大的战士。它们比兽人青年体形更大、力量更强、武艺更高，装备也更好。凭借天生的蛮力和粗陋却厚重的护甲，它们对准备不足的部队极其危险。它们是氏族的步兵，构成军队的主力。

units.source: Berserkers are Orcs who aspire to achieve great status or improve their martial skills. Often excluded from normal orc structure, they form bonds outside their clans with other similar individuals. As they lack resources and status to become Warriors, they concentrate on improving their skills by any means necessary. Their fighting skills are unmatched and they are cunning enemies that are not afraid of death. They often fight with no armor showing off their bodies' scars and marks of defeated enemies.
units.zh: 兽人狂战士渴望取得崇高地位，或进一步磨炼武艺。它们往往游离于正常的兽人组织之外，与其他氏族的同类结成同伴。由于缺乏成为兽人战士所需的资源和地位，它们不择手段地提升战斗技巧。它们武艺出众、狡猾而无畏死亡，经常不穿护甲上阵，炫耀身上的伤疤和象征败敌的印记。

units.source: The rest are called Orc Young - no matter of their true age. The Young ones are the Orcs with the lowest status but there is a big difference within their ranks; the most crafty and skilled often have a good set of armor and weapons while the lowest often have only a tree branch as their equipment (big and heavy tree branches).
units.zh: 其余兽人不论实际年龄多大，都被称为兽人青年。它们的地位最低，但内部差别也很大：较为机灵、能打的个体往往拥有不错的武器和护甲；最底层的则可能只有一根树枝当装备——当然，那是又大又重的树枝。

units.source: Sometimes a Warlord appears who unites a few clans under his command. These legendary leaders take a title of Khan. There are many anecdotes about them pillaging civilized lands. All of them are about the past.
units.zh: 偶尔会有一名军阀将几个氏族统一在自己的麾下。这种传奇领袖会自称可汗。关于它们劫掠文明国度的故事不胜枚举，不过这些故事讲的全是过去的事。

units.source: A battle usually starts with a strong charge of many Orc Young. As they lack discipline they rely on their impetuousness and physical superiority to stun and throw an enemy into disarray. As prolonged melee is often deadly for light armored Orc Young, some smarter Young use Javelins to provide support. They lack other means to fight at range which a smart commander can utilize at his advantage.
units.zh: 战斗通常由大批兽人青年猛烈冲锋拉开序幕。它们缺乏纪律，依靠冲劲与身体优势撞晕敌人，打乱阵势。对护甲薄弱的兽人青年来说，持续的近身混战往往致命，因此较聪明的个体会用标枪提供支援。它们没有其他远程作战手段，精明的指挥官可以利用这一点。

units.source: The Berserkers are often used as flanking troops, trying to attack the enemy's rear or flank. As they are dangerous in melee so they should be countered by mass use of ranged weapons. If not killed quickly, they could inflict heavy casualties. Luckily, they are rarely armored.
units.zh: 兽人狂战士常被用作包抄部队，试图攻击敌人的侧翼或后方。它们近战威胁很大，应集中远程火力对付。若不迅速消灭，它们可能造成惨重伤亡。所幸它们很少穿戴护甲。

units.source: Orc Warriors enter a battle as the last. They lack the impetuousness of young orcs but they have tremendous staying power. Their armor and bulky bodies grant them resistance from many attacks. They also use their big stature to easily push lesser enemies around by breaking enemy defensive formations. The best counter against them are heavy anti-armor weapons like heavy axes, hammers, and billhooks. Beware, however, Orc Warriors can easily kill given their immense strength. Additionally, they are immune to being stunned.
units.zh: 兽人战士通常最后投入战斗。它们没有兽人青年的冲劲，却具备惊人的持续作战能力。厚重护甲和庞大身躯能承受许多攻击，它们还会凭借体形轻易推开较弱的敌人，破坏防御阵形。对付它们最有效的是重斧、战锤和钩镰等重型破甲武器。但务必小心，兽人战士力量惊人，很容易致人死命。此外，它们免疫眩晕。

units.source: The Warlord often supports his forces from the rear, using his voice to terrify the enemy and bolster his subordinates. But make no mistake - in melee he is even more heavily armored and dangerous than Orc Warriors.
units.zh: 兽人军阀经常从后方支援部队，用吼声恐吓敌人、鼓舞下属。但别因此小看它：一旦进入近战，它的护甲比兽人战士更厚，危险程度也更高。

units.source: Goblins are one of two Greenskin factions. {#1}Orcs{/#1} are the other, and they unite during the Greenskin Invasion.
units.zh: 地精是两支绿皮阵营之一，另一支是{#1}兽人{/#1}。绿皮入侵期间，两者会联合行动。

units.source: Goblins are weak but evasive, like ranged combat and deal extra direct damage. Even their melee fighters use {#1}throwing weapons{/#1} a lot, and {#2}Shamans{/#2} have a {#3}spell{/#3} to remove a ranged attackers' weakness, nighttime debuffs.
units.zh: 地精身体孱弱，却很善于闪避，偏爱远程作战，还能造成额外的无视护甲伤害。就连近战地精也经常使用{#1}投掷武器{/#1}，而{#2}地精萨满{/#2}能够用{#3}法术{/#3}消除远程单位在夜间的减益。

units.source: Their strategy in general has one main goal: preventing you from starting a proper melee fight. {#1}Skirmishers{/#1} throw {#2}nets{/#2}, {#3}Ambushers{/#3} reduce your AP with their poison, and Shamans use their magic to {#4}grow vines{/#4} that entangle you. Melee skill is very useful both for hitting evasive Goblins and breaking free from nets and vines.
units.zh: 它们的总体战术只有一个核心目标：阻止你展开正面的近身战。{#1}地精游击兵{/#1}会投掷{#2}投网{/#2}，{#3}地精伏击手{/#3}会用毒素削减你的行动点，萨满则会施展{#4}根须缠缚{/#4}将你困住。较高的近战命中既有助于击中灵活的地精，也有助于挣脱投网和藤蔓。

units.source: {#1}Wolfriders{/#1} are their cavalry. Avoiding direct combat, they try to encircle your squad and strike from behind.
units.zh: {#1}地精狼骑兵{/#1}是它们的骑兵。这些单位会避开正面交锋，尝试绕过你的队伍，从背后发动袭击。

units.source: Goblins' weapons are light and can not penetrate heavy armor, but {#1}Notched Blades{/#1} can {#2}puncture{/#2} right through it. {#3}Overseers{/#3} have {#4}heavy crossbows{/#4} for penetrating it.
units.zh: 地精的轻型武器难以穿透重甲，但{#1}缺口短刃{/#1}可以用{#2}破甲刺击{/#2}直接伤及护甲之下的身体。{#3}地精监工{/#3}则装备了能穿透护甲的{#4}刺桩重弩{/#4}。

source_exception.reason: 原站在受保护的真实图片之后重复输出了同一图片的转义HTML；保留原图片及属性，仅去除纯a/img重复文本。

units.source: Many {#1}Goblins{/#1} and {#2}Orcs{/#2} are known as "Greenskins". Goblins are smaller than humans and appear to be weaker. Instead of brute force they usually ambush their enemies. (Hit-and-run attacks). They use {#3}poisoned{/#3} {#4}arrows{/#4} and {#5}weapons{/#5}.
units.zh: {#1}地精{/#1}和{#2}兽人{/#2}都被称为“绿皮”。地精比人类矮小，看上去也更弱，因此通常会伏击敌人，一击即退，而不是正面硬拼。它们使用涂有{#3}毒素{/#3}的{#4}箭矢{/#4}和{#5}武器{/#5}。

units.source: Goblins live in the lands beyond the reach of human civilization, in small states of their own, often encompassing only a single but heavily populated city. Distant relatives to the Orcs, they don’t have much in common apart from the colour of their skin and hatred for humans. Goblin camps and armor are often adorned with their victims' remains, and prisoners are frequently fed to their wolves.
units.zh: 地精生活在人类文明势力之外的土地上，建立自己的小国；许多国家其实只有一座城市，但人口十分稠密。它们与兽人有着较远的亲缘关系，除肤色和对人类的仇恨外，几乎毫无共同之处。地精常用受害者的遗骸装饰营地和护甲，也经常把俘虏喂给狼。

units.source: Goblins have a complex social structure of different castes, the two most important of which are the lower caste and the political caste. The lower caste is the most populated by far, and members are born into servitude to their state or city, with very little rights other than to work for the benefit of the great Goblin state. They can be drafted into service at any time or otherwise assigned tasks with no say of their own. Although they make up the backbone of any Goblin state, they’re considered somewhat expendable, and their individual lives don’t matter all that much in the pursuit of power for members of the political caste.
units.zh: 地精社会有着复杂的等级制度，其中最重要的是底层阶级和统治阶级。底层地精数量最多，生来就要为国家或城市效劳，几乎没有权利，只能为所谓伟大的地精国家工作。它们随时可能被征入军队或派去执行其他任务，无权过问。虽然底层地精支撑着整个国家，却被视作可以牺牲的消耗品；在统治阶级争权夺势的过程中，个体的性命并不重要。

units.source: Unlike most humans, Goblins are not ruled by a single individual, but a council drawn from the political caste. The council decides on any action the Goblin state should or should not take and may mandate the drafting of Goblins from the lower caste led by a Goblin Overseer to perform any task, such as to attack rival Goblin states. Members of the council often change as individuals bribe, scheme or even assassinate to get rid of their rivals and attempt to secure more power for themselves. Although the council will proclaim that any action is for the betterment of the state, in reality, many decisions are the result of political backstabbing, such as sending a rival council member to oversee an attack knowing full well that he’ll get killed along with all the other Goblins sent there. A political victory, sure, but also an example of Goblin states repeatedly weakening themselves.
units.zh: 与大多数人类不同，地精并不服从单一统治者，而是由统治阶级组成的议会掌权。议会决定国家应当或不应采取哪些行动，也可以征召底层地精，由一名地精监工带队执行任务，例如进攻敌对的地精国家。议员经常通过贿赂、阴谋乃至暗杀排除对手、争夺权力，因此议会成员更替频繁。议会总会声称每个决定都是为了国家，实际上许多决策只是政治倾轧的产物：例如明知某场进攻会全军覆没，仍派政敌去指挥。这样做确实赢得了政治斗争，却也让地精国家一次次削弱自己。

units.source: Goblins do not share a language with Orcs and otherwise have little in common, but they are nevertheless able to communicate with them on some level. To avoid roaming Orc tribes raiding their city states they often pay tribute until they’ve passed, and sometimes fight them if they seem weak enough in numbers. Orcs have also been used in political machinations and sent against rival Goblin states – which backfired more than once. Goblins consider roaming tribes of Orcs almost a force of nature outside of their other rivalries. They’re considered primitive, stupid even. They can be avoided at times, used at other times. But there is no stopping nature in the long run. At times the two Greenskin races have united into great hordes, fighting side by side as they invade human lands to pillage and destroy.
units.zh: 地精与兽人的语言不通，其他共同点也很少，但双方仍能进行有限交流。为了防止游荡的兽人部落劫掠自己的城邦，地精常会缴纳贡物，直到它们离开；若觉得对方人数少、容易对付，有时也会开战。地精还曾利用兽人进行政治算计，把它们引向敌对的地精国家，而这种做法不止一次反噬自身。对地精而言，游荡的兽人部落近乎一种自然灾害，与其他敌对关系不同。它们原始，甚至愚蠢，有时可以躲开，有时可以利用，但从长远看，没有谁能阻挡自然。历史上，两支绿皮种族也曾汇集成庞大部落，并肩侵入人类领土，四处劫掠和破坏。

units.source: The vast majority of goblins seen in Battle Brothers are low-caste footsoldiers, either armed in light armor and equipped with simple melee weapons or given homemade bows and improvised ghillie suits made of local vegetation. These soldiers are often sent on raids or to garrison forward-operating camps by themselves; however, in some cases, members of the overseer caste or priestly order step up and lead attacks themselves. These are the highest priorities in battle; the priests are able to entangle up to seven mercenaries per turn, as opposed to net-wielding infantry that have one opportunity to entangle one soldier, where as the overseers can motivate their charges, bringing them either to confident morale or baseline morale if the goblin is fleeing, and also have stake-launchers that, while slightly less accurate than human crossbows, can knock back their targets and hit just as hard as an arbalest. Though no indications exist in-game, it can be safely assumed, given the traditional status of cavalry, that Wolfriders occupy a social status below the leadership but above the troops walking on their own feet.
units.zh: 游戏中绝大多数地精都是底层步兵：有的穿轻甲、拿简陋的近战武器，有的则携带自制弓，并用当地植物编成伪装服。这些士兵常被单独派去劫掠或驻守前沿营地，但有时也会由监工阶级或祭司亲自带队。作战时，应优先处理这些首领。携网投掷兵只有一次机会困住一名士兵，祭司却能每回合缠住最多七名佣兵。监工可以激励部下，使其斗志昂扬，或让正在逃跑的地精恢复正常士气；它们的刺桩重弩命中略低于人类的弩，却能击退目标，威力也不逊于重弩。游戏中没有直接说明狼骑兵的社会地位，但结合骑兵通常享有的待遇，原文推测其地位低于首领、高于徒步士兵。

units.source: Cruel, cunning, and cowardly, Goblins rely on dirty tricks, debilitating poisons, and overwhelming numbers to defeat their foes, but will quickly flee if a battle turns against them.
units.zh: 地精残忍、狡猾又胆小，依靠阴招、使人虚弱的毒素和压倒性数量击败对手；一旦战局不利，它们就会迅速逃跑。

units.source: An average Goblin is physically weaker than a human and about the size of a large child. Due to their small size they’re unable to wear heavy armor or wield heavy weaponry, and they can’t take a lot of physical punishment before going down. They don’t have the most stamina and they’re also not the bravest, though the latter may be in part due to being essentially forced into arms.
units.zh: 普通地精的体格比人类弱，大致只有大孩子那么高。受体形所限，它们无法穿戴重甲或挥舞重型武器，也承受不了多少打击。它们的体力并不出众，胆量也不大，不过后一点或许部分源于被迫参军。

units.source: On the other hand, Goblins are dexterous little creatures. They use their small weapons with astounding accuracy to go for weak spots in their opponent’s armor, and because of their size and general skittishness are harder to hit reliably than many other opponents. Goblins are also quite cunning and intelligent. They make up for their lack of physical strength by relying on their wits, ambushes, dirty tricks, poisons, and superior numbers to wear their opponents down. Because they’re at an inherent disadvantage in open battle, most of their tactics revolve around the use of ranged weaponry; keeping their opponents pinned-down while flanking them using their Wolf riders.
units.zh: 另一方面，地精十分灵巧。它们能极其精准地使用小型武器，攻击敌人护甲的薄弱处；加上体形小、行动机敏，比许多其他敌人更难命中。地精也颇具智慧，依靠计谋、伏击、阴招、毒素和人数优势消耗对手，弥补力量不足。由于正面交战先天不利，它们的战术大多围绕远程武器展开：先压制对手，再派狼骑兵从侧翼包抄。

units.source: Goblins are quite crafty and intelligent creatures, they have a whole arsenal of deadly tools available to them. Neither their armour nor weapons are particularly sturdy, given the Goblins’ physical limitations, but they’re well made and balanced. Their equipment emphasizes mobility; their armor is predominantly of leather as well as mail and a variety of scale armour. All of their weapons and tools can be looted and used by the player, although they aren’t the most damaging ones. Their armour can’t be looted as it would only fit a child.
units.zh: 地精聪明且善于制造，拥有各式致命工具。受身体条件限制，它们的武器和护甲都不算厚重坚固，却制作精良、配重得当。装备强调机动性，护甲以皮甲为主，也有锁甲和各种鳞甲。玩家能够缴获并使用它们的所有武器和工具，尽管这些武器的伤害算不上最高。它们的护甲则无法缴获，因为尺寸只适合儿童。

units.source: A popular weapon with Goblin infantry is the ‘Spiked Bola’ – small iron balls with metal spikes bound together with rope, to be hurled at a target from a distance. Another specialized tool is the ‘Throwing Net’ – thrown at an opponent, it leaves them unable to move and lowers their ability to defend themselves. The ‘Jagged Pike’ can keep opponents at bay with its long range while inflicting terrible bleeding wounds.
units.zh: 地精步兵常用尖刺投球：将带金属尖刺的小铁球用绳索相连，远远掷向目标。另一种专门工具是投网，能使被网住的敌人无法移动，并降低其防御能力。锯齿长枪则能利用长距离把对手挡在外侧，同时造成严重的流血伤口。

units.source: Human factions and units, including non-humans appearing with them.
units.zh: 这里列出人类阵营及其单位，也包括与这些阵营一同出现的非人类单位。

units.source: Humans are extremely diverse, different factions have wildly varying skills and equipment. They don't resist any status effects. They are the only creatures that can be raised as {#1}undead{/#1}.
units.zh: 人类单位种类繁多，各阵营的能力和装备差别很大。它们没有对状态效果的抗性，也是唯一可以被复活为{#1}亡灵{/#1}的生物。

units.source: Brigands are one of many Human factions in Battle Brothers.
units.zh: 强盗是《战场兄弟》中的人类阵营之一。

units.source: Nomads are one of many Human factions in Battle Brothers. They inhabit southern deserts.
units.zh: 游牧民是《战场兄弟》中的人类阵营之一，生活在南方沙漠。

units.source: Barbarians are one of many Human factions in Battle Brothers. They inhabit northern part of the world.
units.zh: 蛮族是《战场兄弟》中的人类阵营之一，生活在世界的北方。

units.source: City States are a type of Human factions in Battle Brothers. Southern city states send regiments to patrol surroundings, and caravans to trade with other settlements. Caravans are guarded by their melee units, usually {#1}Conscripts{/#1}. Southerners are hostile to {#2}Noble Houses{/#2} during the Holy War.
units.zh: 城邦是《战场兄弟》中的一种人类阵营。南方城邦会派出军团巡视周边，并派商队与其他聚落贸易。商队由近战单位护卫，通常是{#1}征召兵{/#1}。圣战期间，南方人与{#2}贵族家族{/#2}敌对。

units.source: Noble Houses are a type of Human factions in Battle Brothers. They are hostile to each other during the War of the Noble Houses, and hostile to southern {#1}City States{/#1} during the Holy War. They send Supply Caravans, guarded by their troops.
units.zh: 贵族家族是《战场兄弟》中的一种人类阵营。贵族战争期间，各家族互相敌对；圣战期间，它们会与南方{#1}城邦{/#1}敌对。家族还会派出由本方军队护卫的补给商队。

units.source: Civilian factions are a type of Human factions in Battle Brothers. Each non-military settlement is a separate faction. They send caravans, {#1}peasants{/#1} and, when enemies come close, can send militia squads to fight them.
units.zh: 平民阵营是《战场兄弟》中的一种人类阵营，每个非军事聚落都是独立的阵营。它们会派出商队和{#1}农民{/#1}；敌人逼近时，还可能派民兵队伍迎战。

units.source: Mercenary companies travel between settlements, offering their service. They are not a faction, and attacking one company does not affect the others. But it does worsen your relations with the faction who hired them, and mercenaries hired by factions hostile to you will also be hostile.
units.zh: 佣兵团在聚落之间行走，承接雇佣任务。它们不构成统一阵营，攻击其中一支不会影响其他佣兵团，但会恶化你与其雇主阵营的关系。受敌对阵营雇佣的佣兵也会与你敌对。

units.source: Arbalester is a ranged unit from the {#1}Noble{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 劲弩手是{#1}贵族{/#1}阵营的远程单位。

units.source: 80% chance of a {#1}Mail Coif{/#1} (80), {#2}Full Aketon Cap{/#2} (50), {#3}Aketon Cap{/#3} (40) or {#4}Headscarf{/#4} (20).

Shooting their bolts at enemies, Arbalesters sometimes choose a target directly behind an ally, risking to hit him instead, though it rarely happens. Sometimes they spend a turn repositioning. It is possible for an Arbalester to jump ahead of the formation to shoot, becoming an easy target for enemy arrows.
units.zh: 劲弩手有时会朝友军正后方的敌人射击，冒着误伤友军的风险，不过实际误伤很少发生。它们有时会花一回合调整位置，也可能突然走到阵形前方射击，成为敌方弓箭手容易攻击的目标。

units.source: Their {#1}crossbows{/#1} deal armor-piercing damage, causing {#2}injuries{/#2} and even instant death without defensive {#3}perks{/#3}.
units.zh: 它们的{#1}弩{/#1}能造成穿透护甲的伤害；缺少防御类{#3}特长{/#3}时，可能造成{#2}伤势{/#2}，甚至直接致死。

units.source: They often stand behind {#1}Billmen{/#1} or other Arbalesters, making them easier to shoot at.
units.zh: 它们常站在{#1}钩镰枪兵{/#1}或其他劲弩手身后，因而更容易受到射击。

units.source: If exposed, they are a priority targets for your archers.
units.zh: 若劲弩手暴露在外，应让弓箭手优先攻击它们。

units.source: If you don't rely on ranged units, prefer nighttime when they are less accurate.
units.zh: 如果你的队伍不依赖远程单位，尽量选择夜战，此时它们的射击命中更低。

units.source: They can use {#1}Rotation{/#1} to escape melee, but usually don't do it.
units.zh: 它们可以用{#1}换位{/#1}脱离近战，不过通常不会这样做。

units.source: When fighting on your side, they can {#1}rotate{/#1} you into dangerous positions.
units.zh: 它们作为友军参战时，可能会用{#1}换位{/#1}把你的成员换到危险的位置。

units.source: {#1}Footman{/#1} • {#2}Billman{/#2} • {#3}Arbalester{/#3} • {#4}Man at Arms{/#4} • {#5}Standard Bearer{/#5} • {#6}Sergeant{/#6} • {#7}Zweihander{/#7} • {#8}Knight{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Wardog{/#10} • {#11}Donkey{/#11}
Footman is a melee unit from the {#1}Noble{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 步兵是{#1}贵族{/#1}阵营的近战单位。

units.source: A {#1}Falchion{/#1}, {#2}Arming Sword{/#2}, {#3}Morning Star{/#3} or {#4}Military Pick{/#4}.
A {#1}Mail Hauberk{/#1} (150), {#2}Leather Scale Armor{/#2} (140) (only houses with certain banners), {#3}Mail Shirt{/#3} (130) or {#4}Basic Mail Shirt{/#4} (115).
A {#1}Flat Top with Mail{/#1} (230), {#2}Padded Flat Top Helmet{/#2} (150), {#3}Flat Top Helmet{/#3} (125) or {#4}Mail Coif{/#4} (80).
A {#1}Kettle Hat with Mail{/#1} (215), {#2}Padded Kettle Hat{/#2} (140), {#3}Kettle Hat{/#3} (115), or {#4}Mail Coif{/#4} (80).
A {#1}Nasal Helmet with Mail{/#1} (200), {#2}Padded Nasal Helmet{/#2} (130), {#3}Nasal Helmet{/#3} (105) or {#4}Mail Coif{/#4} (80).

Footmen are frontline units, dedicated to defending more vulnerable {#1}Billmen{/#1} and {#2}Arbalesters{/#2}. They often use {#3}Shieldwall{/#3} to improve their own survivability, and can {#4}Rotate{/#4} with allies to save them from danger.
units.zh: 步兵是前排单位，负责保护较脆弱的{#1}钩镰枪兵{/#1}和{#2}劲弩手{/#2}。它们常用{#3}盾墙{/#3}提高生存能力，也能与友军{#4}换位{/#4}，帮助对方脱险。

units.source: They mostly rely on melee defense, which comes from their shield. Have good accuracy to hit them reliably.
units.zh: 它们主要依赖盾牌提供的近战防御。要稳定命中，需要较高的命中能力。

units.source: Armor piercing weapons kill them faster through their medium armor.
units.zh: 穿透护甲的武器能更快杀死身穿中甲的步兵。

units.source: Breaking their shields takes time, but does not require melee skill or Double Grip.
units.zh: 破坏它们的盾牌需要时间，但不要求较高的近战命中，也不要求双手握持。

units.source: Attack Footmen with {#1}Heater Shields{/#1} with ranged weapons, and those with {#2}Kite Shields{/#2} with melee weapons.
units.zh: 用远程武器攻击持{#1}熨斗形盾{/#1}的步兵，用近战武器攻击持{#2}鸢形盾{/#2}的步兵。

units.source: {#1}Taunt{/#1} prevents them from shieldwalling, and forced movement cancels it.
units.zh: {#1}挑衅{/#1}能阻止它们使用盾墙，强制位移则会取消已经生效的盾墙。

units.source: {#1}Footman{/#1} • {#2}Billman{/#2} • {#3}Arbalester{/#3} • {#4}Man at Arms{/#4} • {#5}Standard Bearer{/#5} • {#6}Sergeant{/#6} • {#7}Zweihander{/#7} • {#8}Knight{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Wardog{/#10} • {#11}Donkey{/#11}
Various wild beasts roam the lands. Different beasts are allied with each other, because they belong to the same faction. However, in some events beasts can be hostile to each other.
units.zh: 各种野兽在大地上游荡。不同野兽属于同一阵营，彼此通常是盟友；但在某些事件中，它们也可能互相敌对。

units.source: Note: Armored Unholds are here only for convenience. They are from the {#1}Barbarians{/#1} faction actually.
units.zh: 注意：这里只是为了方便查阅才列出披甲巨魔，它们实际上属于{#1}蛮族{/#1}阵营。

units.source: The {#1}Alp{/#1} is a pale and haggard creature. It encroaches on settlements in the cover of night, invading the sleep of its helpless inhabitants with ghastly visions, and feeding on the fear and anguish of its victims like a parasite. Scholars speculate that Alps didn’t always look and behave like they do now; most Alps have eye sockets, but no eyes, and mouths with teeth, but only a rudimentary digestive system. Their pale skin peels like old parchment, their bones are frail, and their insides are dark and show signs of decay. Perhaps the Alp is the victim of an ancient curse, or perhaps it simply evolved from a different creature to the nocturnal predator it is now. Whatever it is, don’t fall asleep!
units.zh: {#1}梦魇{/#1}是一种苍白憔悴的生物。它趁夜潜入聚落，将可怕的幻象注入无助居民的睡梦，如寄生虫一般以受害者的恐惧和痛苦为食。学者推测，梦魇过去的模样和习性也许与现在不同：大多数梦魇有眼窝却没有眼睛，有嘴和牙齿却只有极不完整的消化系统。苍白的皮肤像旧羊皮纸一样剥落，骨骼脆弱，体内漆黑且显露腐烂迹象。也许它是某种古老诅咒的受害者，也许它从另一种生物演变成了如今的夜行掠食者。不管真相如何，千万别睡着！

units.source: Fun-fact: In german, nightmares are called "Alptraum" = Alp-dream (Which congruents to Nightmare)
units.zh: 趣闻：德语中的“噩梦”写作 Alptraum，也就是“Alp 的梦”，与这里的梦魇之名相呼应。

units.source: {#1}Direwolves{/#1} are a type of enemy in {#2}Battle Brothers{/#2}. They are fast and dangerous, as they will quickly charge, flank, and overwhelm a target in numbers. Can attack 3 times if they don't move.
units.zh: {#1}恐狼{/#1}是{#2}《战场兄弟》{/#2}中的一种敌人。它们行动迅速且危险，会快速冲锋、包抄，并利用数量优势围攻目标。若不移动，每回合可以攻击 3 次。

units.source: The {#1}Hexe{/#1} is a witch inspired by Grimm’s fairy tales, a malevolent old crone living in swamps and forests outside of villages alone or in a coven with other Hexen. They’re human, but have long sacrificed their humanity for otherworldly powers. They’re feared, but also worshiped by some. They’re burned at the stake, and yet people seek them out to plead for miracles. They lure and abduct little children to make broth and concoctions out of, they strike terrible pacts with villagers to receive their firstborn, they weave curses and cast hexes. Their huts may or may not be made of candy. With her sorcery, a Hexe can enthrall wild beasts, and even warp the mind of humans, and so will often be found in the company of creatures that serve her.
units.zh: {#1}女巫{/#1}的灵感来自格林童话：邪恶的老妪住在村庄外的沼泽和森林中，有的独居，有的与同类结成女巫集会。她们原本是人，却早已为超凡力量舍弃了人性。世人畏惧她们，也有人崇拜她们；人们把她们送上火刑柱，却又去求她们创造奇迹。她们诱拐幼童来熬汤配药，与村民订立可怕的委托，索取长子，还会编织诅咒、施展妖术。至于她们的小屋是不是糖果做的，那就难说了。女巫的巫术能够奴役野兽，甚至扭曲人的心智，因此她们身边往往跟着一群受其驱使的生物。

units.source: Prowling the southern deserts and steppe is the Hyena, a carnivorous mammal that resembles a poorly groomed cross between feline and canine. Prey can be few and far between in the endless sea of sand, and so the Hyena is both scavenger and nocturnal hunter. Many a traveler lost in the desert ended up a feast for a pack of Hyenas – but whether they tore him apart as he was still alive, or he died of thirst long before the pack came upon him, is another matter.
units.zh: 鬣狗游荡在南方沙漠和草原上。这种食肉哺乳动物看起来像猫与犬杂交而成，毛发又十分凌乱。无边沙海中的猎物稀少，因此鬣狗既会食腐，也会在夜间狩猎。许多迷失沙漠的旅人最终成了鬣狗群的大餐；至于他们是活着时被撕碎，还是在鬣狗发现之前早已渴死，那就另当别论了。

units.source: In the barren wastes of the south, no scrap of flesh can go to waste, and the Hyena has a jaw strong enough to crush bone so that it can get to every last shred. As it turns out, a jaw that can crush bone can crush armor quite well, too, making the Hyena a threat also to men in armor that would protect them against lesser wildlife. Although a Hyena is smaller than a northern Direwolf, and not always able to kill an unarmored man in a single turn, the way it rips flesh from its victims can leave terrible bleeding wounds and inflict the ‘Bleeding’ status effect. A battle against starved Hyenas is not lost as quickly as against a pack of Direwolves, but it may well be over before you even realize it when your men live on borrowed time as they slowly bleed out while the hyenas circle you in anticipation of a feast.
units.zh: 南方荒漠里，每一点血肉都不能浪费。鬣狗的颚部强健，能咬碎骨头，吃尽最后一丝残肉。能碎骨的利颚也很擅长咬破护甲，因此即使是能抵挡普通野兽的甲胄，也无法让穿戴者免受鬣狗威胁。鬣狗比北方恐狼小，未必能在一回合内杀死无甲的人类，但撕扯血肉时会留下严重伤口，造成流血状态。面对饥饿鬣狗，战局也许不会像遭遇恐狼群时那样迅速崩溃，却可能在你察觉前就已无力回天：成员们缓慢失血，命悬一线，鬣狗则在周围盘旋，等待大餐。

units.source: Hyenas roam and attack in packs that swarm and often surround their prey, attacking from multiple angles. They’re faster in combat than most other opponents, faster even than a Direwolf. A single Hyena can attack three times a turn, often overwhelming their victims and leaving them fatigued as they try to dodge every attack. However, their morale isn’t particularly good, and like most beasts they’re especially afraid of firearms spewing smoke and fire with a loud bang, unreliable as they otherwise may be. Naturally, Hyenas drop unique loot which can either be sold or used to craft new items, including a new armor attachment, if you own the ‘Beasts & Exploration’ DLC.
units.zh: 鬣狗成群活动和进攻，常会包围猎物，从多个方向扑咬。它们在战斗中比多数敌人行动更快，甚至快过恐狼。单只鬣狗每回合可攻击三次，密集的攻击会使受害者疲于闪避，积累疲劳。不过，它们的士气不佳，也和大多数野兽一样，尤其害怕伴随巨响喷出烟火的火器，尽管火器在其他方面未必可靠。如果安装了“野兽与探索”DLC，鬣狗还会掉落独有材料，可出售或用于制作新物品，其中包括一种新的护甲附件。

units.source: {#1}Lindwurms{/#1} are a type of enemy in {#2}Battle Brothers{/#2}. They are very dangerous beasts. The upper body will move first, followed by the tail. The upper body and the tail share the same health and armor, but attack differently. Acidic blood courses through its veins, and any attacker wounding (beyond a certain threshold) a Lindwurm in melee combat will suffer the blood's corrosive effects, which melts down the attacker's armor.
units.zh: {#1}林德蠕龙{/#1}是{#2}《战场兄弟》{/#2}中极其危险的野兽。躯干先行动，尾巴随后行动；两者共用生命值和护甲，但攻击方式不同。它的血液具有强酸性，在近战中对其造成超过一定阈值的伤害时，攻击者会被酸血腐蚀，护甲随之受损。

units.source: {#1}Nachzehrers{/#1} (German for "eater of remains," literally "after-eater") are a type of enemy in {#2}Battle Brothers{/#2}. They count as beasts, but because they feast on corpses, they are often seen in company with the {#3}Zombies{/#3} or {#4}Ancient Dead{/#4}.
units.zh: {#1}食尸鬼{/#1}是{#2}《战场兄弟》{/#2}中的一种敌人，名称 Nachzehrer 在德语中意为“吞食遗骸者”，字面上是“事后进食者”。它们属于野兽，却因为以尸体为食，常与{#3}行尸{/#3}或{#4}古代亡灵{/#4}一起出现。

units.source: The peasantry tells stories of men and women coming back to life after the sin of committing suicide as horribly shaped monstrosities, turned into a Nachzehrer. They’re said to resemble grey-skinned devils that dig up graves with their claws and devour fresh corpses, even devour parts of themselves and their funeral shrouds, and to grow in strength as they do so until they inevitably prey on the living. Others may claim that they are but wild beasts, merely scavengers drawn to fresh graves like seagulls to fishing nets. Whatever their true nature, they bring misery and disease upon any village they bedevil.
units.zh: 农民间流传着这样的故事：自杀的男女犯下罪孽，死后会以畸形怪物的模样复生，变成食尸鬼。据说它们像灰皮恶魔，用利爪掘开坟墓、吞食新鲜尸体，甚至会啃食自身和裹尸布。随着不断进食，它们越来越强，最终会捕食活人。也有人认为它们只是野兽，是受到新坟吸引的食腐者，就像海鸥会追逐渔网。无论本性如何，遭它们侵扰的村庄总会陷入苦难与疾病。

units.source: The creature known as Nachzehrer can grow up to two times as it gorges itself on a corpse, and it’s not shy of cannibalizing its own kind. Each time it does so, it increases in size and strength significantly. At its largest, when it’s become a hulking behemoth of grey flesh, it gains the ability to swallow a man whole. Anyone devoured like this isn’t dead, but in the belly of the beast and removed from the map. Slaying the Nachzehrer will free that character again, albeit covered in goo, but retreating while a character is devoured in this way will spell certain death for him.
units.zh: 食尸鬼吞食尸体后最多能成长两次，连同类的尸体也不会放过。每次进食，体形和力量都会显著增加。长到最大时，它会变成一头灰色血肉组成的庞然大物，能够将人整个吞下。被吞的人并未死亡，而是困在它腹中，从地图上暂时消失。杀死食尸鬼就能救出这个人，尽管他会沾满黏液；但若有人仍被吞在腹中就撤退，他必死无疑。

units.source: A Nachzehrer has long claws that they use to dig through the earth in search of food, and which can tear grievous wounds in combat. The larger the Nachzehrer, the more dangerous the claws become. On the bright side, a Nachzehrer doesn’t have any armor, which favors swords and cleavers, and it gets easier to hit with ranged weapons, the larger and less nimble it becomes.
units.zh: 食尸鬼的长爪既能掘土觅食，也能在战斗中撕开可怕的伤口。它体形越大，爪击就越危险。好消息是，食尸鬼没有护甲，因此剑和斩刀很适合对付它；随着体形增大、行动变笨拙，它也更容易被远程武器命中。

units.source: The Waldschrat, or {#1}Schrat{/#1} for short, is a fabled living tree found in the most remote forests of the world. A creature of bark and wood, it resembles no other, and its mind is truly alien. It blends between trees and shambles slowly, its roots digging through the soil. A frightening night time story tells of how trees watered with the blood of the unjustly killed turn into twisted living trees, out to strangle and choke the life out of children that don’t behave.
units.zh: Waldschrat，简称{#1}树妖{/#1}，是传说中生活在世界深处密林里的活树。它由树皮与木头构成，与其他生物截然不同，思维更是难以理解。它隐匿于树木之间，缓慢挪动，根须钻行于泥土。一个吓人的睡前故事说，无辜死者的血浇灌过的树会扭曲成活物，出来掐住不听话的孩子，将他们活活勒死。

units.source: While much of the south is made up of barren wasteland, the seas of sand are dotted with green islands that promise a treasure most sparse in these parts: water. Water means life in the great deserts, and so any caravans seeking to travel them will hop from one oasis to the next. They are lush refuges teeming with life, but also with danger, for they are home to a slithery predator: The Serpent.
units.zh: 南方大部分地区荒芜贫瘠，但沙海中仍散落着绿色岛屿，孕育着这里最稀缺的宝藏：水。在大沙漠中，水意味着生命，因此商队总要从一处绿洲赶往下一处。绿洲草木繁茂、生机盎然，却也暗藏危险，因为那里栖息着一种蜿蜒爬行的猎手——巨蛇。

units.source: The Serpent is a large non-venomous snake that preys on animals and humans alike in and around oases. Well-camouflaged on the ground, they are not always easily spotted from afar, but they are also slower on the world map than other beasts. Using their forked tongue to sample the air, they have a directional sense of smell and can hunt equally well in the darkness of night as they can in the bright of day.
units.zh: 巨蛇是一种大型无毒蛇，在绿洲内外捕食动物和人类。它善于贴地伪装，远处未必能轻易看见，但它在世界地图上的移动速度也比其他野兽慢。它用分叉的舌头感知空气，能够辨别气味的来向，因此无论黑夜还是白昼，都能熟练捕猎。

units.source: In battle, a Serpent will seek to wind itself around their prey, to constrict their movement and breath, and to drag them away from allies where they can be more easily killed in isolation. Similar to human opponents using the ‘Hook’ skill of Billhooks, Serpents can pull apart a formation, drag your men into being surrounded by several opponents, and expose your backline. Although Serpents are not venomous, they will attack using their fangs until their victim is either dead or limp enough to be devoured whole.
units.zh: 战斗中，巨蛇会缠住猎物，限制其行动和呼吸，再将其拖离同伴，方便孤立猎杀。与人类使用钩镰的钩拽技能类似，巨蛇能够拆散阵形，把你的成员拖入围攻，并让后排暴露。尽管没有毒液，它仍会用獠牙不断攻击，直到猎物死亡，或虚弱到可以被整个吞下。

units.source: Serpents can be dangerous for anyone traveling the south, but they also offer an opportunity for earning crowns. The body of a Serpent is covered with overlapping scales of different colors, and some serpent skin, particularly rainbow colored scales, is worth a lot to the upper class of the city states that seek to flaunt their wealth. A mercenary captain will often find contracts to hunt down Serpents, whether to turn them into expensive-looking slippers or simply because too many a caravan hand lost their live along a trade route so that business begins to suffer. The shimmering scales are quite resistant to heat and fire, and a taxidermist can also craft an armor attachment out of these for use with your own men.
units.zh: 巨蛇对南方旅人是一种威胁，也提供了挣取克朗的机会。它的全身覆盖着颜色各异、层层叠叠的鳞片；某些蛇皮，尤其是虹彩鳞片，在热衷炫富的城邦上层人士眼中价值不菲。佣兵队长常能接到猎杀巨蛇的委托：有时是为了做成名贵拖鞋，有时则是因为商路上死掉的商队杂工太多，已经影响了生意。这些闪亮鳞片十分耐热耐火，剥制工坊也能把它们做成护甲附件，供你的成员使用。

units.source: The {#1}Unhold{/#1} is a lumbering giant, easily the size of three men, and dwarfing even the tallest orc. It eats whole sheep for a snack and empties a pond to wash it down. There’s tales of enraged Unholds leveling remote farms and plucking the limbs off of unlucky farmers like wings from insects, but closer examination will reveal that Unholds aren’t malicious creatures. They’re fiercely territorial, but may often be content to persuade with ear-deafening bellowing and threatening gestures any invaders to run for their lives. The Unhold is a somewhat solitary creature and can be found either alone or in small groups only.
units.zh: {#1}巨魔{/#1}是一种行动笨重的巨人，体形足有三个人那么大，即使最高大的兽人在它面前也显得矮小。它能把整只羊当点心，再喝干一池水送下肚。传闻中，暴怒的巨魔会夷平偏远农场，像撕掉昆虫翅膀一样扯下倒霉农夫的四肢。不过仔细观察就会发现，巨魔并非生性恶毒。它们领地意识极强，却往往只需震耳欲聋的吼叫和威吓动作，就能让入侵者逃命。巨魔较为孤僻，通常独自活动，或只结成小群。

units.source: There are 3 variants of Unholds. The most common variant is found in the hills and tundra. Another variant is said to be found in swamps and sometimes forests, where they inhabit caves. The fiercest is the northern variant found in the snowy wastes, with white fur that protects equally against cold and steel. Then there are also armored Unholds that are tamed by barbarians.
units.zh: 巨魔有 3 种变体。最常见的一种出没于丘陵和冻原；另一种据说栖息在沼泽，有时也在森林洞穴中出现；最凶猛的是雪原上的北方变体，白色皮毛既能御寒，也能抵挡刀剑。此外，还有被蛮族驯服的披甲巨魔。

units.source: The {#1}Webknecht{/#1} is a large arachnid that lives in sizable colonies in the dark areas of forests throughout the world of Battle Brothers. It’s there that they spin their webs between trees to trap anything from bird to deer and between. Unlike most other beasts, Webknechts don’t usually roam a lot, preferring instead to sit in their territory and wait until something unfortunate gets itself caught in one of their nets. Still, they’re known to choose the vicinity of settlements for their home on occasion and threaten the lives of villagers and their livestock.
units.zh: {#1}巨蛛{/#1}是一种大型蛛形生物，在《战场兄弟》世界各地的幽暗森林中群居。它们在树木之间织网，捕捉从飞鸟到鹿等各种猎物。与大多数其他野兽不同，巨蛛通常不四处游荡，而是待在领地中，等倒霉的猎物落网。不过，它们偶尔也会在聚落附近筑巢，威胁村民和牲畜的性命。

units.source: Similar to the player company there are other mercenary companies that take {#1}Contracts{/#1} for the living in Darklands.
units.zh: 黑暗之地中还有其他佣兵团，和玩家战团一样，靠承接{#1}委托{/#1}谋生。

units.source: They consist of highly skilled {#1}Mercenaries{/#1} that are well armed and armored. Some companies spawn together with {#2}Hedge Knights{/#2}, {#3}Swordmasters{/#3}, {#4}Master Archers{/#4} or {#5}Wardogs{/#5}.
units.zh: 这些战团由技艺精湛、武器护甲齐备的{#1}佣兵{/#1}组成。有些队伍中还会出现{#2}流浪骑士{/#2}、{#3}剑术大师{/#3}、{#4}神射手{/#4}或{#5}战犬{/#5}。

units.source: They are highly dangerous, and confrontation should be avoided, unless your company is up for a challenging fight with great loot. Also notice, that you will have a negative opinion penalty with a town or house, which hired a mercenary company if you decide to attack one, except when they attack you during a {#1}Deliver Item{/#1} contract. Anyway if you attack one mercenary company, other mercenary companies will not pay attention on it - you will not have negative opinion with them.
units.zh: 这些佣兵团十分危险，应尽量避免交战，除非你的战团已准备好迎接一场艰苦但战利品丰厚的战斗。主动攻击它们还会降低你与其雇主城镇或贵族家族的关系，唯有在{#1}递送物品{/#1}委托中遭到它们攻击时例外。无论如何，攻击某支佣兵团都不会引起其他佣兵团的关注，也不会降低你与其他佣兵团的关系。

units.source: Various mercenary companies can be found roaming around on the {#1}Global map{/#1} and are also actively looking for and accepting {#2}Contracts{/#2} from settlements. You are not the only mercenaries out there!
units.zh: 你会在{#1}世界地图{/#1}上遇见四处行走的佣兵团；它们也会主动寻找并接受聚落发布的{#2}委托{/#2}。这片土地上的佣兵可不只有你们！

units.source: {#1}Wolf Bite{/#1} does 20-40 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 40% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 15% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} ({#11}Goblin Wolfriders{/#11} can use it only once per turn and it costs 0 AP for them)

Hounds are ferocious beasts trained for war. They can be carried by a brother into battle in the accessory slot. It costs no fatigue to do so. It unlocks the {#1}Unleash{/#1} skill which allows you to release the hound in any adjacent and unoccupied hex for a cost of 3 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} and 15 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}. Once released, the accessory slot will be filled with a collar until the hound is killed or until the battle ends. If a brother is killed with the hound still equipped, the hound will be automatically unleashed on top of the dead brother.
units.zh: 战犬是经过战争训练的凶猛野兽。成员可将其装备在饰品栏带入战斗，携带本身不增加疲劳负担。装备后可使用{#1}放出{/#1}技能，花费 3 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}和 15 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}，将犬只放到任意相邻空格。放出后，饰品栏中会留下项圈，直到犬只死亡或战斗结束。若成员阵亡时仍带着尚未放出的犬只，犬只会自动出现在该成员倒下的位置。

units.source: You have no direct control of hounds, although you can get them to more or less reliably attack a specific target if you deploy one in base contact with an enemy or in a hex close to the enemy you wish to target. Unfortunately, you do not have the ability to recall a hound once deployed. The AI for the hound will simply continue to choose a new target if their current target is killed (usually the closest enemy unit) until the battle ends or the hound itself is killed.
units.zh: 你无法直接控制犬只，但若将其放在紧邻敌人的格子，或靠近希望攻击的目标，它通常会攻击那个敌人。遗憾的是，放出后无法将其召回。当前目标死亡后，犬只会自行选择新目标，通常是最近的敌方单位，直到战斗结束或自身死亡。

units.source: Hounds have their own separate morale from your mercenaries. A morale check on one friendly hound can cause checks on other nearby friendly hounds if passed or failed. Abilities which affect the morale of your brothers do not affect friendly hounds; cannot be awaken by Rally in Alp fight. At night hounds have Vision value of 5.
units.zh: 犬只的士气独立于佣兵。友方犬只进行士气检定时，无论通过还是失败，都可能引发附近其他友方犬只的士气检定。影响战团成员士气的能力不会影响友方犬只；与梦魇交战时，鼓舞也无法将它们唤醒。夜间犬只的视野为 5。

units.source: {#1}Wardogs{/#1} may spawn together with {#2}Brigands{/#2}, {#3}Bounty Hunters{/#3} and {#4}Mercenary Companies{/#4}, {#5}Noble Houses{/#5} regiments. {#6}Warhounds{/#6} may spawn together with {#7}Barbarians{/#7}.

{#1}Wardogs{/#1} can occasionally be purchased from ordinary {#2}Markets{/#2} in settlements with Barracks and Stone Watchtower. However, {#3}Kennels{/#3} will offer a number of both unarmored and armored {#4}Wardogs{/#4} and {#5}Warhounds{/#5} (the latter are available in settlements' kennels at northern part of the world map, at 70+% 'latitude') with a regularly refreshed stock. Base Worth value for {#6}Wardog{/#6} is 200{#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7} and 250{#10}{#11}{#12/}{/#11}{/#10} for {#13}Warhound{/#13}. Wardog Armor, applicable to any unarmored hound, costs 200{#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14}.
When a hound kills an enemy, the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} will be split evenly between all brothers
units.zh: 犬只杀死敌人后，{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}会由全体成员平均分配。

units.source: Will not affect your brothers morale if it dies
units.zh: 犬只死亡不会影响战团成员的士气。

units.source: You can place a hound and use rotation on it to get out of trouble
units.zh: 可以先放出犬只，再与它换位，帮助成员脱险。

units.source: Unleash hounds to hinder some of the charging enemies while you handle the rest. They can stop them for a round or two
units.zh: 放出犬只牵制一部分冲来的敌人，自己先处理其他敌人。犬只通常能拖住它们一两回合。

units.source: Can be used to chase down retreating enemies for more {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} and profit. You can move 3 tiles then unleash a wardog to catch up with fleeing enemies up to 9 tiles away, if your fatigue allows
units.zh: 可用于追杀撤退的敌人，获得更多{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}和战利品。只要疲劳允许，成员先移动 3 格再放出战犬，就能追上最远 9 格外的逃敌。

units.source: Hounds can cause morale checks and count towards surround-bonus
units.zh: 犬只能触发敌人的士气检定，也计入包围加成。

units.source: You can put craftable armor on them with 55 or 85 durability
units.zh: 可为它们装备能够制作的犬甲，耐久度为 55 或 85。

units.source: They usually go after enemy backline units. Good for quickly disabling those who cannot use their skills when engaged in melee
units.zh: 它们通常会扑向敌方后排，很适合迅速缠住那些进入近战后就无法使用技能的单位。

units.source: Try to unleash hounds only when you are certain that they will help your battle. A free kill for the enemies can easily set them on confident morale
units.zh: 尽量只在确定犬只能帮助战局时再放出。若白白送给敌人一次击杀，很容易让敌人士气升至斗志昂扬。

units.source: Northern breed. More durable and does more damage, but less mobile and slightly more costly compared to Wardogs.
units.zh: 北方品种。与战犬相比更耐打、伤害更高，但机动性较差，价格也略高。

units.source: Can be used to chase down retreating enemies for more {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} and profit. You can move 3 tiles then unleash a warhound to catch up with fleeing enemies up to 8 tiles away, if your fatigue allows
units.zh: 可用于追杀撤退的敌人，获得更多{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}和战利品。只要疲劳允许，成员先移动 3 格再放出战獒，就能追上最远 8 格外的逃敌。

units.source: When a wolf kills an enemy, the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} will be split evenly between all brothers
You can place a wolf and use rotation on it to get out of trouble
units.zh: 可以先放出狼，再与它换位，帮助成员脱险。

units.source: Unleash it to hinder some of the charging enemies while you handle the rest. It can stop them for a round or two
units.zh: 放出它牵制一部分冲来的敌人，自己先处理其他敌人。它通常能拖住敌人一两回合。

units.source: Can be used to chase down retreating enemies for more {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} and profit. You can move 3 tiles then unleash it to catch up with fleeing enemies up to 9 tiles away, if your fatigue allows
units.zh: 可用于追杀撤退的敌人，获得更多{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}和战利品。只要疲劳允许，成员先移动 3 格再放出它，就能追上最远 9 格外的逃敌。

units.source: It can cause morale checks and count towards surround-bonus
units.zh: 它能触发敌人的士气检定，也计入包围加成。

units.source: You can only gain a wolf in the {#1}Houndmaster Tames Wolf{/#1} event once per campaign
units.zh: 每场战役只能通过{#1}驯犬师驯狼{/#1}事件获得一只狼。

units.source: It usually goes after enemy backline units. Good for quickly disabling those who cannot use their skills when engaged in melee
units.zh: 它通常会扑向敌方后排，很适合迅速缠住那些进入近战后就无法使用技能的单位。

units.source: Try to unleash the wolf only when you are certain that it will help your battle. A free kill for the enemies can easily set them on confident morale, plus this is the only wolf you would ever get
units.zh: 尽量只在确定狼能帮助战局时再放出。若白白送给敌人一次击杀，很容易让敌人士气升至斗志昂扬；况且，这是你能得到的唯一一只狼。

units.source: Ancient Dead are one of two {#1}Undead{/#1} factions. {#2}Zombies{/#2} are the other, and they unite during the Undead Scourge.
units.zh: 古代亡灵是两支{#1}亡灵{/#1}阵营之一，另一支是{#2}行尸{/#2}。亡灵灾祸期间，两者会联合行动。

units.source: Ancient Dead fight in a tight formation, which they try to not break. Their main strength is the {#1}shieldwall{/#1} that they can maintain indefinitely. In the early game you will only see weak unarmored {#2}Auxiliaries{/#2}, but later you will face {#3}Legionaries{/#3} with their medium armor and backline full of {#4}pikemen{/#4}. Their {#5}Priests{/#5} summon {#6}harmful gas clouds{/#6} that damage HP directly without missing, and their {#7}other spell{/#7} can lower your {#8}morale{/#8} and even {#9}stun{/#9}.
units.zh: 古代亡灵保持紧密阵形，尽量不让阵形散乱。它们的主要优势是能够无限维持{#1}盾墙{/#1}。前期遇到的只是弱小、无甲的{#2}古代辅兵{/#2}，后期则会出现身穿中甲的{#3}古代军团兵{/#3}，后排还站满了{#4}长枪兵{/#4}。{#5}古代祭司{/#5}能召唤{#6}有害的瘴气{/#6}，必定命中并直接伤害生命值；其{#7}另一种法术{/#7}还能降低你的{#8}士气{/#8}，甚至造成{#9}眩晕{/#9}。

units.source: Being skeletons, they {#1}resist piercing damage{/#1}, especially ranged. But skeletons are also very fragile, and non-piercing weapons with high enough direct damage quickly destroy them.
units.zh: 由于身体是骷髅，它们能{#1}抵抗穿刺伤害{/#1}，尤其是远程穿刺伤害。不过骷髅本身很脆弱，直接伤害足够高的非穿刺武器能迅速摧毁它们。

units.source: They use rusty slashing and piercing weaponry, that isn't good against heavy {#1}armor{/#1}.
units.zh: 它们使用锈蚀的劈砍与穿刺武器，对付重型{#1}护甲{/#1}效果不佳。

units.source: If the spacing is right, they will approach without shieldwall, and you will have two turns of attacks before they activate it. Waiting and then walking two steps back does the trick.
units.zh: 只要距离控制得当，它们接近时就不会开启盾墙，你可以在盾墙生效前得到两回合的攻击机会。先等待，再后退两格即可做到。

units.source: {#1}Necrosavants{/#1} are vampires. They are healed by damage they deal and can teleport. They can be extremely dangerous in the middle game.
units.zh: {#1}死灵剑士{/#1}是吸血鬼，能靠造成伤害恢复生命，也能传送。它们在游戏中期尤其危险。

units.source: {#1}{#2/}{/#1}

units.source: The world wasn’t always like it is now. Ruins dot the map, mass graves, sunken castles. But where did they come from?
units.zh: 这个世界并非一直如此。地图上散布着废墟、万人冢和沉没的城堡。它们究竟从何而来？

units.source: Many hundred years ago, in a different era, an empire of man spanned much of the known world. What has fallen into ruin now, what was abandoned to nature and beast, what has long been forgotten, all this was that of man once. An empire, not of petty noble houses, but one of a dozen provinces, from the frozen tundra of the north to the blistering sands of the south, of a dozen peoples under one banner.
units.zh: 数百年前，在另一个时代，一个人类帝国曾统治已知世界的大部分地区。如今坍塌成废墟、被自然与野兽吞没、早已遭人遗忘的地方，都曾属于人类。那不是由几个小贵族家族拼凑的国家，而是一个横跨十二个行省的帝国，从北方冰封的冻原延伸到南方灼热的沙漠，让十二个民族同奉一面旗帜。

units.source: So many peoples, so many cultures and ideas under one roof, all vying to pull the empire into a direction of their own. Could those not be reconciled? Did they, in the end, just pull the empire apart? As remote lands became provinces of the empire, so could local cults become religions that swept across its entirety. Was the authority of the emperor lost to religion? Was it the gods that punished man for worshipping spirits that promised to give what they would not?
units.zh: 如此多的民族、文化和思想聚集在一起，都想把帝国拉向自己期望的方向。它们之间真的无法调和吗？最终是否正是这些力量撕裂了帝国？随着遥远地区成为帝国行省，当地的教派也可能发展为席卷全国的宗教。皇权是否败给了信仰？人们转而崇拜许诺赐予诸神不肯给予之物的灵祇，是否因此遭到诸神惩罚？

units.source: Does it matter now what brought it down? The ancient dead are rising again, not living and yet not dead. Long lost legions heed the call of their emperor. They march once more, tirelessly and without emotion, to claim again what was once theirs. What brought down the empire in the end, and what is bringing it back to unlife, is for you to piece together based on clues hidden within the world, if you want to learn more.
units.zh: 如今，帝国因何覆灭还重要吗？古代死者正在复起，既非活人，也并非真正死去。失落已久的军团响应皇帝的召唤，再次行军，不知疲倦、毫无感情，要夺回曾经属于自己的一切。如果你想知道帝国最终如何衰亡，又为何重返这不死的世界，就要从各地隐藏的线索中拼凑答案。

units.source: The bulk of the ancient dead is made up of the ancient legions. They are what conquered most of the known world once, and they may well do so again. Legions that never tire, legionaries that know no fear, a cold machine that ever marches forward. What could stop them?
units.zh: 古代亡灵的主力是古代军团。它们曾征服已知世界的大部分地区，也可能再次做到。军团永不疲倦，士兵不知恐惧，犹如一台不断前进的冰冷机器。谁能阻止它们？

units.source: The legions fight like they did hundreds of years ago – in tight formation two ranks deep, with shields in front and polearms in the back. They rely quite heavily on the front row providing protection with their shields and locking down the enemy, while the second row uses polearms to inflict heavy damage on their opponents. A formation like this doesn’t charge like undisciplined rabble, but advances slowly and makes heavy use of shields to protect against arrow fire. They don’t possess any ranged weaponry and don’t do flanking maneuvers, preferring to simply walk through any enemy. Because much of their strength is in their formation, they’re at a disadvantage when fighting in difficult terrain, such as forests. They are also the missing piece of the puzzle that makes resolve an important attribute, as fighting them continually puts a test to the morale of the men.
units.zh: 军团仍沿用数百年前的战法：组成紧密的两排阵形，前排持盾，后排持长柄武器。它们十分依赖前排用盾牌掩护并缠住敌人，再由后排造成大量伤害。这样的军队不会像散兵游勇一样乱冲，而是缓缓推进，频繁用盾牌抵挡箭雨。它们没有远程武器，也不迂回包抄，更愿意直接碾过面前的敌人。由于实力很大程度上来自阵形，它们在森林等复杂地形中会处于劣势。与它们作战还会持续考验成员的士气，让意志这一属性的重要性进一步凸显。

units.source: The ancient legions come with a whole lot of unique armor, helmets and weapons. It’s old, it’s brittle and sometimes broken, but it can still be deadly.
units.zh: 古代军团拥有大量独特的护甲、头盔和武器。这些装备陈旧、脆弱，有时已经破损，却依然能够致命。

units.source: Wiederganger is a weak enemy from the {#1}Zombies{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 行尸是{#1}行尸{/#1}阵营中较弱的敌人。

units.source: 50% chance of a {#1}Bludgeon{/#1}, {#2}Militia Spear{/#2}, {#3}Butcher's Cleaver{/#3}, {#4}Pickaxe{/#4}, {#5}Wooden Stick{/#5}, {#6}Knife{/#6} or {#7}Pitchfork{/#7}.

A {#1}Leather Tunic{/#1} (30), {#2}Apron{/#2} (25), {#3}Butcher's Apron{/#3} (25), {#4}Linen Tunic{/#4} (20) (double chance), {#5}Monk's Robe{/#5} (20), {#6}Leather Wraps{/#6} (20), {#7}Sackcloth{/#7} (10) or {#8}Tattered Sackcloth{/#8} (5).
33% chance of a {#1}Full Aketon Cap{/#1} (50), {#2}Full Leather Cap{/#2} (45), {#3}Aketon Cap{/#3} (40), {#4}Open Leather Cap{/#4} (40) or {#5}Hood{/#5} (30).
50% chance of body armor and headgear having only 50% durability, rolled separately.
units.zh: 身体护甲和头部装备各有 50% 的几率仅剩 50% 耐久度，分别判定。

units.source: Wiedergangers come in large numbers. They don't have any idea about careful approach and instead slowly walk towards you, getting hit by {#1}spearwalls{/#1}.
units.zh: 行尸通常数量众多。它们不懂谨慎接近，只会慢慢走向你，任由{#1}矛墙{/#1}刺中自己。

units.source: They have a 66% chance to raise from the dead on their own once with 50% HP. When they do so, it causes a morale check similar to coming into melee. They can reanimate if someone stands on their corpse, and will push that unit one tile away. If there is nowhere to push, they stay dead. They can not revive if their head has been {#1}decapitated or smashed{/#1}, but can if disemboweled.
units.zh: 它们有 66% 的几率自行复活一次，恢复 50% 生命值。复活时会触发一次类似敌人进入近战范围的士气检定。即使有人站在尸体上，它们也能复活，并将该单位推开一格；如果无处可推，就会保持死亡。被{#1}斩首或击碎头颅{/#1}后无法复活，但被开膛仍可复活。

units.source: If they kill a human, he can rise as a Wiederganger too. He uses stats of {#1}Wiederganger Brother{/#1} and "Wiederganger" is added before his name.
units.zh: 被它们杀死的人类也可能变成行尸，使用{#1}化作行尸的弟兄{/#1}的属性，名字前会加上“行尸”。

units.source: They are unable to use {#1}ranged weapons{/#1}, and they can only use basic and area weapon attacks. They don't spawn with weapons with area attacks though.
units.zh: 它们不会使用{#1}远程武器{/#1}，只能使用武器的基础攻击和范围攻击。不过，它们生成时不会携带具备范围攻击的武器。

units.source: They are tough, numerous and can rise again. Brothers will accumulate much fatigue and likely hit its limit. A single hit of their {#1}mace{/#1} will inflict 30 fatigue. {#2}Recover{/#2} allows you to regain combat efficiency.
units.zh: 它们耐打、数量多，还能复活，成员会积累大量疲劳，很可能达到上限。它们的{#1}钉锤{/#1}一次命中就会造成 30 疲劳。{#2}恢复体力{/#2}能让成员重新有效作战。

units.source: The most dangerous weapons they wield are {#1}Militia Spear{/#1} and {#2}Pickaxe{/#2}. Spear gives them accuracy they lack, and Pickaxe can destroy your armor quickly.
units.zh: 它们携带的武器中，最危险的是{#1}民兵长矛{/#1}和{#2}矿镐{/#2}。矛能补足其命中不足，镐则能迅速破坏你的护甲。

units.source: The most dangerous positions in your squad are flanks, where brothers are attacked by multiple enemies with {#1}Backstabber{/#1}. Plan your defense accordingly.
units.zh: 队伍中最危险的是两翼，因为这里的成员会被多个拥有{#1}背刺者{/#1}的敌人同时攻击。应据此安排防守。

units.source: Graveyards, where you often fight them, have walls around them. You can use it to prevent being surrounded.
units.zh: 你经常会在墓地与它们交战，墓地四周的墙可以帮助你避免被包围。

units.source: If you lose your armor, even unarmed Wiedergangers can do serious damage with their bites.
units.zh: 一旦失去护甲，即使没有武器的行尸也能用撕咬造成严重伤害。

units.source: The sheer number of them coming close triggers many {#1}morale{/#1} checks that can break morale if your resolve is low.
units.zh: 大量行尸接近时会频繁触发{#1}士气{/#1}检定；意志较低的成员可能因此士气崩溃。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
Armored Wiederganger is an enemy from the {#1}Zombies{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 披甲行尸是{#1}行尸{/#1}阵营的敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Handaxe{/#1}, {#2}Scramasax{/#2}, {#3}Bludgeon{/#3}, {#4}Hatchet{/#4}, {#5}Shortsword{/#5} or {#6}Militia Spear{/#6}.
A {#1}Basic Mail Shirt{/#1} (115), {#2}Worn Mail Shirt{/#2} (110), {#3}Patched Mail Shirt{/#3} (90), {#4}Padded Leather{/#4} (80) or {#5}Rugged Surcoat{/#5} (55).

A {#1}Padded Kettle Hat{/#1} (140), {#2}Kettle Hat{/#2} (115), {#3}Padded Dented Nasal Helmet{/#3} (110), {#4}Mail Coif{/#4} (80), {#5}Full Aketon Cap{/#5} (50), {#6}Full Leather Cap{/#6} (45) or {#7}Aketon Cap{/#7} (40).
If he is a {#1}Necromancer{/#1}'s bodyguard, 50% chance for a {#2}Decayed Heater Shield{/#2} or {#3}Old Wooden Shield{/#3}.
units.zh: 若担任{#1}亡灵法师{/#1}的护卫，有 50% 的几率装备{#2}朽坏三角盾{/#2}或{#3}旧木盾{/#3}。

units.source: 66% chance of body armor and headgear having only 50% durability, rolled separately.
units.zh: 身体护甲和头部装备各有 66% 的几率仅剩 50% 耐久度，分别判定。

units.source: Wiedergangers come in large numbers. They have know any idea about careful approach and instead slowly walk towards you, getting hit by {#1}spearwalls{/#1}.
units.zh: 行尸通常数量众多。它们不懂谨慎接近，只会慢慢走向你，任由{#1}矛墙{/#1}刺中自己。

units.source: Sometimes they lose their weapons when they die. They can pick up weapons from the ground if this happens.
units.zh: 它们死亡时有时会丢失武器，之后可以从地上捡起武器。

units.source: They are unable to use {#1}ranged weapons{/#1}, and they can only use basic and area weapon attacks. They don't spawn with weapons with area attacks though. Bodyguards can {#2}knock{/#2} you with their {#3}shields{/#3} to push away from {#4}Necromancers{/#4}.
units.zh: 它们不会使用{#1}远程武器{/#1}，只能使用武器的基础攻击和范围攻击。不过，它们生成时不会携带具备范围攻击的武器。护卫还能用{#3}盾牌{/#3}{#2}击退{/#2}你，让你远离{#4}亡灵法师{/#4}。

units.source: They are tough, numerous and can rise again. Brothers will accumulate much fatigue and likely hit its limit. A single hit of their {#1}Bludgeon{/#1} will inflict 30 fatigue. {#2}Recover{/#2} allows you to regain combat efficiency.
units.zh: 它们耐打、数量多，还能复活，成员会积累大量疲劳，很可能达到上限。它们的{#1}重棒{/#1}一次命中就会造成 30 疲劳。{#2}恢复体力{/#2}能让成员重新有效作战。

units.source: The most dangerous weapons they wield are {#1}Militia Spear{/#1} and {#2}Handaxe{/#2}. Spear gives them accuracy they lack, and Handaxe can destroy your armor quickly.
units.zh: 它们携带的武器中，最危险的是{#1}民兵长矛{/#1}和{#2}手斧{/#2}。矛能补足其命中不足，手斧则能迅速破坏你的护甲。

units.source: Use {#1}flails{/#1} to hit their unprotected heads and loot the armor.
units.zh: 用{#1}连枷{/#1}攻击没有防护的头部，可以保留下来的护甲作为战利品。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor if the risk is low enough.
units.zh: 风险足够低时，可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}杀死它们，保留护甲。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
Wiederganger Brother is a human just killed in battle and raised as a Wiederganger.
units.zh: 化作行尸的弟兄，是刚在战斗中被杀死、随后作为行尸复活的人类。

units.source: Any human killed by Wiedergangers or during the {#1}Undead Scourge{/#1} can rise as a Wiederganger Brother. He isn't literally named brother but a "Wiederganger" is added before his name.
units.zh: 被行尸杀死的人类，或在{#1}亡灵灾祸{/#1}期间死去的人类，都可能变成化作行尸的弟兄。其实际名称并不会出现“弟兄”，而是在原名之前加上“行尸”。

units.source: They are unable to use {#1}ranged weapons{/#1}, and they can only use basic and area weapon attacks.
units.zh: 它们不会使用{#1}远程武器{/#1}，只能使用武器的基础攻击和范围攻击。

units.source: Most of the time you see them when fighting {#1}thieves{/#1} with a {#2}Necromancer{/#2}. Stand on corpses and he will be unable to raise them.
units.zh: 通常在与有{#2}亡灵法师{/#2}同行的{#1}盗贼{/#1}交战时会遇到它们。站在尸体上，就能阻止法师将其复活。

units.source: During the Undead Scourge they are hostile to living enemies, which prioritize them over you.
units.zh: 亡灵灾祸期间，它们也与活着的敌人敌对，而那些敌人会优先攻击它们。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
Fallen Hero is a heavily armored enemy from the {#1}Zombies{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 陨落英雄是{#1}行尸{/#1}阵营中身披重甲的敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Fighting Axe{/#1}, {#2}Winged Mace{/#2}, {#3}Military Cleaver{/#3}, {#4}Flail{/#4}, {#5}Handaxe{/#5}, {#6}Morning Star{/#6}, {#7}Arming Sword{/#7}, {#8}Greataxe{/#8}, {#9}Two-Handed Flail{/#9} or {#10}Longsword{/#10}.
A {#1}Decayed Coat of Plates{/#1} (260), {#2}Decayed Coat of Scales{/#2} (240) or {#3}Decayed Reinforced Mail Hauberk{/#3} (170).

90% chance of a {#1}Decayed Great Helm{/#1} (255), {#2}Decayed Full Helm{/#2} (240), {#3}Decayed Closed Flat Top with Mail{/#3} (230) or {#4}Covered Decayed Closed Flat Top with Mail{/#4} (230) (3 times less probable).
units.zh: 有 90% 的几率装备{#1}朽坏重型大盔{/#1}（255）、{#2}朽坏全覆盔{/#2}（240）、{#3}朽坏锁甲平顶盔{/#3}（230）或{#4}覆布朽坏锁甲平顶盔{/#4}（230，出现几率为其他选项的 3 分之一）。

units.source: If the weapon is one-handed, a {#1}Worn Kite Shield{/#1} or {#2}Decayed Heater Shield{/#2}.
units.zh: 若使用单手武器，则装备{#1}破旧鸢形盾{/#1}或{#2}朽坏三角盾{/#2}。

units.source: 33% chance of body armor and headgear having only 50% durability, rolled separately.
units.zh: 身体护甲和头部装备各有 33% 的几率仅剩 50% 耐久度，分别判定。

units.source: Fallen Heroes don't come in large numbers, but it's common to see five of them or so. They don't know any idea about careful approach and instead slowly walk towards you, getting hit by {#1}spearwalls{/#1}.
units.zh: 陨落英雄不会大批出现，但同时遇到五个左右并不少见。它们不懂谨慎接近，只会慢慢走向你，任由{#1}矛墙{/#1}刺中自己。

units.source: They have a 90% chance to raise from the dead on their own once with 50% HP. When they do it, it causes a morale check similar to coming into melee. They can reanimate if someone stands on their corpse, and will push that unit one tile away. If there is nowhere to push, they stay dead. Unlike Wiedergangers, they can rise headless, and if they do, all head hits they take are redirected to the body. They still can bite even with no head.
units.zh: 它们有 90% 的几率自行复活一次，恢复 50% 生命值。复活时会触发一次类似敌人进入近战范围的士气检定。即使有人站在尸体上，它们也能复活，并将该单位推开一格；如果无处可推，就会保持死亡。与普通行尸不同，它们没有头颅也能复活，之后所有头部命中都会转移到身体上。即便没有头，它们仍然能够撕咬。

units.source: If they kill a human, he can rise as a Wiederganger. He uses stats of {#1}Wiederganger Brother{/#1} and a "Wiederganger" is added before his name.
units.zh: 被它们杀死的人类也可能变成行尸，使用{#1}化作行尸的弟兄{/#1}的属性，名字前会加上“行尸”。

units.source: They are unable to use {#1}ranged weapons{/#1}, and they can only use basic and area weapon attacks. Bodyguards can {#2}knock{/#2} you with their {#3}shields{/#3} to push away from {#4}Necromancers{/#4}.
units.zh: 它们不会使用{#1}远程武器{/#1}，只能使用武器的基础攻击和范围攻击。护卫还能用{#3}盾牌{/#3}{#2}击退{/#2}你，让你远离{#4}亡灵法师{/#4}。

units.source: Armor piercing or anti-armor weapons are required to penetrate their armor.
units.zh: 需要使用能够穿透护甲或擅长破甲的武器，才能突破它们的防护。

units.source: Those armed with two-handed weapons are obviously more dangerous. However, you can make them unable to attack by pushing them back.
units.zh: 携带双手武器的个体显然更危险。不过，将它们推远可以让它们无法发动攻击。

units.source: A single hit of their {#1}Morning Star{/#1} will inflict 30 fatigue. {#2}Recover{/#2} allows you to regain combat efficiency if you hit the fatigue limit.
units.zh: 它们的{#1}晨星钉锤{/#1}一次命中就会造成 30 疲劳。疲劳达到上限后，{#2}恢复体力{/#2}能让成员重新有效作战。

units.source: Be very careful when moving, headless Fallen Heroes are easy to overlook.
units.zh: 移动时务必小心，无头的陨落英雄很容易被忽略。

units.source: Using {#1}flails{/#1} to hit their unprotected heads can kill them quickly. But flails can smash heads, removing this vulnerability, and you will have to penetrate or destroy armor.
units.zh: 用{#1}连枷{/#1}攻击没有防护的头部可以迅速杀死它们，但连枷也可能砸碎头颅，让这个弱点消失；此后就只能穿透或破坏护甲。

units.source: You can steal their weapon while they are dead.
units.zh: 趁它们尚未复活时，可以捡走它们的武器。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor is you can reliably stun or disarm them.
units.zh: 如果能稳定地将它们眩晕或缴械，就可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}保留护甲。

units.source: Use nets to slow their advance. They have only one attempt to break free per turn, and {#1}Backstabber{/#1} does not help to do it.
units.zh: 用投网拖慢它们的推进。它们每回合只能尝试挣脱一次，{#1}背刺者{/#1}不会提高挣脱几率。

units.source: They can only move two tiles on bad terrain. With {#1}Pathfinder{/#1} and {#2}Polearm Mastery{/#2} you can kite them without being hit, if there are no {#3}Geists{/#3} or {#4}Necromancers{/#4}.
units.zh: 在难走的地形上，它们每回合只能移动两格。如果没有{#3}怨魂{/#3}或{#4}亡灵法师{/#4}，拥有{#1}寻路者{/#1}和{#2}长柄武器精通{/#2}的成员可以边打边退，不被它们打到。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
Fallen Betrayer is a heavily armored elite enemy from the {#1}Zombies{/#1} faction, found in the {#2}Watermill{/#2} {#3}legendary location{/#3}.
units.zh: 陨落叛徒是{#1}行尸{/#1}阵营中身披重甲的精锐敌人，出现在{#3}传奇地点{/#3}{#2}水磨坊{/#2}。

units.source: They are based on the {#1}Fallen Hero{/#1}'s template, but have better stats, similarly to {#2}Lost Treasure Hunters{/#2}. They don't know any idea about careful approach and instead simply walk towards you, getting hit by {#3}spearwalls{/#3}.
units.zh: 它们以{#1}陨落英雄{/#1}为基础，但属性更高，类似于{#2}迷失的寻宝者{/#2}。它们不懂谨慎接近，只会径直走向你，任由{#3}矛墙{/#3}刺中自己。

units.source: They have a 90% chance to raise from the dead on their own once with 50% HP. When they do it, it causes a morale check similar to coming into melee. They can reanimate if someone stands on their corpse, and will push that unit one tile away. If there is nowhere to push, they stay dead. They can rise headless, and if they do, all head hits they take are redirected to the body. They still can bite even with no head.
units.zh: 它们有 90% 的几率自行复活一次，恢复 50% 生命值。复活时会触发一次类似敌人进入近战范围的士气检定。即使有人站在尸体上，它们也能复活，并将该单位推开一格；如果无处可推，就会保持死亡。它们没有头颅也能复活，之后所有头部命中都会转移到身体上。即便没有头，它们仍然能够撕咬。

units.source: Sometimes they lose their weapons when they die. They can pick up weapons from the ground if this happens. They are unable to use {#1}ranged weapons{/#1}, and they can only use basic and area weapon attacks.
units.zh: 它们死亡时有时会丢失武器，之后可以从地上捡起武器。它们不会使用{#1}远程武器{/#1}，只能使用武器的基础攻击和范围攻击。

units.source: They are somewhat similar to stronger {#1}Fallen Heroes{/#1}, but have a few important differences.
units.zh: 它们大致相当于更强的{#1}陨落英雄{/#1}，但也有几处重要差别。

units.source: High accuracy allows them to reliably hit evasive characters.
units.zh: 命中很高，能稳定击中擅长闪避的角色。

units.source: They have 8 AP instead of 7. It allows them to attack twice with one-handed weapons and removes their weakness to pushback if they have two-handed weapons.
units.zh: 它们拥有 8 行动点，而不是 7。这让它们能用单手武器攻击两次；使用双手武器时，也不会再轻易被击退战术限制。

units.source: {#1}Nets{/#1} are much less useful than they are against Fallen Heroes.
units.zh: {#1}投网{/#1}对它们的作用远不如对陨落英雄明显。

units.source: Pushing them on uneven ground still works as they lack {#1}Pathfinder{/#1}, but their {#2}location{/#2} is always on plains.
units.zh: 它们没有{#1}寻路者{/#1}，因此在高低不平的地形上将其推远仍然有效，但它们所在的{#2}地点{/#2}始终是平原。

units.source: A {#1}shieldwall{/#1} triangle of dedicated tanks holds them without being hit much.
units.zh: 让专职防御的成员组成三角形{#1}盾墙{/#1}，可以挡住它们，且不易被命中。

units.source: {#1}Two-handed hammers{/#1} and {#2}maces{/#2} work even if you are not specialized in them.
units.zh: {#1}双手战锤{/#1}和{#2}双手棱头钉锤{/#2}即使没有相应专精也能发挥作用。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
Rachegeist is the boss of the {#1}Watermill{/#1} {#2}legendary location{/#2}.
units.zh: 复仇怨魂是{#2}传奇地点{/#2}{#1}水磨坊{/#1}的首领。

units.source: What is important about Rachegeist, is that when he is killed, he instantly comes back as a ghost, and 10 regular {#1}Geists{/#1} spawn nearby.
units.zh: 复仇怨魂最值得注意的是：被杀死后，它会立刻以幽灵形态复起，并在附近生成 10 个普通{#1}怨魂{/#1}。

units.source: His armor does not drop, but you loot the {#1}Rachegeist's Helm{/#1} after the battle.
units.zh: 它的身体护甲不会掉落，但战后可以获得{#1}复仇之灵战盔{/#1}。

units.source: High accuracy allows him to reliably hit evasive characters.
units.zh: 它的命中很高，能稳定击中擅长闪避的角色。

units.source: Must be killed last, unless you want to fight both {#1}Fallen Betrayers{/#1} and {#2}Geists{/#2}.
units.zh: 应留到最后再杀，否则就要同时面对{#1}陨落叛徒{/#1}和{#2}怨魂{/#2}。

units.source: Control his normal form by {#1}stunning{/#1}, {#2}disarming{/#2}, {#3}spearwall{/#3} or {#4}taunt{/#4}.
Lacks {#1}Underdog{/#1} and becomes easier to control when you can surround him.
units.zh: 它没有{#1}以少敌多{/#1}，包围后会更容易控制。

units.source: Ghost form is evasive. {#1}Spears{/#1}, {#2}Backstabber{/#2}, {#3}Fast Adaptation{/#3} and high melee skill can be useful.
units.zh: 幽灵形态很难命中。{#1}矛{/#1}、{#2}背刺者{/#2}、{#3}快速适应{/#3}和较高的近战命中都能提供帮助。

units.source: A {#1}shieldwall{/#1} triangle of dedicated tanks holds him without being hit much.
units.zh: 让专职防御的成员组成三角形{#1}盾墙{/#1}，可以挡住它，且不易被命中。

units.source: If he lands a hit, the {#1}Reproach of Old Gods{/#1} inflicts extra damage to 3 brothers directly to HP without missing.
units.zh: 它命中目标后，{#1}古神之谴{/#1}会额外直接伤害 3 名成员的生命值，而且必定命中。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}

{#1}Raise Undead{/#1} will raise any type of wiedergangers and skeletons (with 50% of their {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}) and any dead humans; cannot be used if the target was decapitated or its head was smashed, or if someone is standing on the corpse; can be used 2 times a turn (has unlimited range)
units.zh: {#1}唤醒亡者{/#1}可以复活各类行尸和骷髅（恢复其 50% 的{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}），以及任何人类死者。目标被斩首、头颅被砸碎或尸体上站着其他单位时无法使用。每回合可施放 2 次，射程无限。

units.source: Necromancer is a spellcaster from the {#1}Zombies{/#1} faction. He isn't undead himself.
units.zh: 亡灵法师是{#1}行尸{/#1}阵营的施法者，其自身并非亡灵。

units.source: 80% chance of a {#1}Scramasax{/#1}, {#2}Butcher's Cleaver{/#2}, {#3}Dagger{/#3} or {#4}Knife{/#4}.

Necromancers stay far behind their undead minions and cast spells from there. There is rarely more than one of them. They are guarded by two undead bodyguards who have {#1}shields{/#1} and will try to {#2}Knock Back{/#2} anyone who gets near a Necromancer. On the first turn, however, they sometimes can become exposed to shots.
units.zh: 亡灵法师会远远待在亡灵仆从后方施法，通常只出现一名。它由两名亡灵护卫保护，护卫持有{#1}盾牌{/#1}，会尝试{#2}击退{/#2}接近法师的敌人。不过，法师有时会在首回合暴露在射程内。

units.source: They cast Possess Undead to make an undead more dangerous, prioritizing those who are in melee already, and {#1}Fallen Heroes{/#1} over {#2}Wiedergangers{/#2} if they have a choice. They can cast it twice per turn, waiting after the first cast.
units.zh: 它会施放附身亡灵来强化一个亡灵，优先选择已经进入近战的单位；可以选择时，会优先强化{#1}陨落英雄{/#1}，而非{#2}行尸{/#2}。每回合能施放两次，第一次之后会等待。

units.source: Also they cast Raise Undead to bring an undead back to unlife with full HP. They again prefer to cast it on Fallen Heroes. If the tile with the corpse if occupied, they are unable to raise it. They also can raise corpses of normal humans killed in battle, which use stats of {#1}Wiederganger Brother{/#1} and a "Wiederganger" is added before their names.
units.zh: 本页原文的战术说明称，法师也会用唤醒亡者将亡灵以满生命值复活，同样优先选择陨落英雄。尸体所在格被占据时无法复活。它也能复活战斗中死去的普通人类，使用{#1}化作行尸的弟兄{/#1}的属性，名字前会加上“行尸”。【译注：原文此处的复活生命值与上方技能说明不一致。】

units.source: They have 8 vision instead of 7 that units have normally.
units.zh: 它们的视野为 8，而普通单位通常为 7。

units.source: Possessed undead swing one-handed weapons three times, and two-handed weapons twice. Accuracy is also increased.
units.zh: 被附身的亡灵可以用单手武器攻击三次，或用双手武器攻击两次，命中也会提高。

units.source: Possess Undead is canceled if he is {#1}stunned{/#1}, hit for 10 damage or killed, or the target is stunned or killed.
units.zh: 法师被{#1}眩晕{/#1}、受到 10 点伤害或被杀死时，附身亡灵会中断；被附身的目标眩晕或死亡时也会中断。

units.source: One of tactics against them is sniping. You need a few archers with {#1}Bullseye{/#1}, who are deployed in frontline, then move forward and shoot. {#2}Falcon{/#2} on a brother with high initiative allows to reveal the position of the Necromancer. {#3}Spiked Impaler{/#3} is not recommended because it knocks Necromancers out of range. Melee troops must guard archers and not let anyone come close.
units.zh: 一种战术是远程狙杀。让几名拥有{#1}鹰眼{/#1}的弓箭手部署在前排，向前移动后射击。先攻高的成员携带{#2}猎鹰{/#2}，可以提前侦明亡灵法师的位置。不建议使用{#3}刺桩重弩{/#3}，因为它会把法师击退出射程。近战成员必须保护弓箭手，不让敌人接近。

units.source: Arrows from {#1}Bloodletter's Reach{/#1} cause bleeding, not only dealing extra damage but also canceling their concentration on Possess Undead, even if you miss your next shot.
units.zh: {#1}放血者之触{/#1}射出的箭会造成流血，既增加伤害，也能中断法师维持附身亡灵的专注，即使下一箭未命中也能奏效。

units.source: Another tactic is just dealing very high damage to undead. Spells may be annoying, but as long as a Necromancer is alive, two undead will guard him and not fight you.
units.zh: 另一种战术是直接对亡灵倾泻高伤害。法术固然烦人，但只要法师活着，就会有两名亡灵守在它身边，而不是与你交战。

units.source: Flanking can be dangerous because of {#1}Geist{/#1} screams and a stray undead engaging you in melee.
units.zh: 包抄可能很危险，因为{#1}怨魂{/#1}的尖啸和游离的亡灵可能把包抄者拖入近战。

units.source: Sometimes they spawn on the north side, with too few troops guarding them. These are vulnerable to flanking.
units.zh: 有时法师会出现在北侧，身边护卫太少，此时较容易遭到包抄。

units.source: If a Necromancer starts {#1}fleeing{/#1}, bodyguards leave him and attack. He will likely rally on the next turn.
units.zh: 如果亡灵法师开始{#1}逃跑{/#1}，护卫会离开它转而进攻。法师很可能在下一回合恢复士气。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
{#1}Horrific Scream{/#1} will cause resolve-checks with a range of 3 tiles
units.zh: {#1}恐怖尖啸{/#1}会对 3 格范围内的目标触发意志检定。

units.source: Geist is a special enemy from the {#1}Zombies{/#1} faction, that breaks morale of your men.
units.zh: 怨魂是{#1}行尸{/#1}阵营中的特殊敌人，能够击溃成员的士气。

units.source: {#1}Incorporeal{/#1} grants +10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} and +10 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} for each tile range away from a Geist (active at range 2+)

Geists sometimes accompany zombies. They usually try to stay behind them, screaming at your squad from a few tiles of distance. If your resolve if very high, they give up and instead fight in melee, using their touch. It is not uncommon for them to wait if someone is fleeing, to be able to break his {#1}morale{/#1} after a sergeant uses {#2}Rally the Troops{/#2} to restore it.
units.zh: 怨魂有时会与行尸同行，通常躲在它们身后，隔着几格朝你的队伍尖啸。如果你的意志极高，它们就会放弃尖啸，转而用触碰进行近战。有人逃跑时，怨魂经常会先等待，等军士用{#2}重振士气{/#2}恢复其士气后，再次击溃其{#1}士气{/#1}。

units.source: Graveyards sometimes have nothing but a lot of Geists guarding them.
units.zh: 有些墓地只由大量怨魂看守，没有其他敌人。

units.source: Their Horrific Scream causes four morale checks with no modifier.
units.zh: 恐怖尖啸会触发四次不带修正的士气检定。

units.source: They have only 1 HP and rely on evasion, which increases with distance. {#1}Whips{/#1} have good reach, but you need high melee skill to reliably hit with them. {#2}Spears{/#2} and especially {#3}Three-Headed Flails{/#3} have good chances to kill them, but require being at melee distance. {#4}Ranged weapons{/#4} are almost useless.
units.zh: 它们只有 1 生命值，主要依赖闪避，而且距离越远越难命中。{#1}鞭子{/#1}攻击距离较长，但要稳定命中仍需很高的近战命中。{#2}矛{/#2}，尤其是{#3}三头连枷{/#3}，有较高的几率杀死它们，但必须靠近到近战距离。{#4}远程武器{/#4}几乎毫无用处。

units.source: Stand in your {#1}banner{/#1}'s resolve aura to resist their screams and be affected by {#2}Rally the Troops{/#2}.
units.zh: 站在{#1}战旗{/#1}的意志光环范围内，既能抵抗尖啸，也能受到{#2}重振士气{/#2}的影响。

units.source: As Rally The Troops doesn't always work, it is wise to have more than one brother having this perk.
units.zh: 重振士气并不总能成功，因此让不止一名成员学习这项特长比较稳妥。

units.source: Horrific Scream is a mental attack, so {#1}Witchhunters{/#1}, {#2}Undead Trophy{/#2}, {#3}Protective Runes and Sigils{/#3} and {#4}Mad{/#4} trait are effective against it.
units.zh: 恐怖尖啸属于精神攻击，因此{#1}猎巫人{/#1}、{#2}亡灵战利品项链{/#2}、{#3}护佑符文与法印{/#3}以及{#4}疯狂{/#4}特性都能有效抵抗它。

units.source: They are faster that any other undead and will get ahead of them if you move backwards, especially on bad terrain.
units.zh: 它们比其他所有亡灵都快。向后撤时，怨魂会走到其他亡灵前面，尤其是在难走的地形上。

units.source: A {#1}Flask of Blessed Water{/#1} instantly kills a Geist but is too precious to spend on it.
units.zh: {#1}圣水瓶{/#1}能立刻杀死怨魂，但这种物品太珍贵，不值得只用来杀一只。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
Ancient Auxiliary is a weak enemy from the {#1}Ancient Dead{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 古代辅兵是{#1}古代亡灵{/#1}阵营中较弱的敌人。

units.source: {#1}Resistant to Ranged Attacks{/#1} {#2}Ancient Dead{/#2} take only 10% damage from bows, 25% damage from javelins and fire lances' ignite, 33% damage from crossbows, slings and handgonnes, 50% from other piercing attacks.
units.zh: {#1}远程攻击抗性{/#1}：{#2}古代亡灵{/#2}只承受弓造成的 10% 伤害、标枪与火矛点火造成的 25% 伤害、弩、投石索和手铳造成的 33% 伤害，以及其他穿刺攻击造成的 50% 伤害。

units.source: Fragile and unarmored, they rely on shieldwall which they can maintain indefinitely. Low level brothers with poor melee skill have trouble hitting them when they are shieldwalling.
units.zh: 它们身体脆弱且没有护甲，依靠能够无限维持的盾墙防守。低等级、近战命中较差的成员很难命中开启盾墙的古代辅兵。
