units.source: {#1}Flails{/#1} are the best weapons against them because they bypass their shields. {#2}Swords{/#2} have +10 to hit. {#3}Spears{/#3} have +20 to hit but deal piercing damage which they resist. {#4}Ranged weapons{/#4} are almost useless, except {#5}throwing axes{/#5}.
units.zh: {#1}连枷{/#1}能绕过盾牌，是对付它们的最佳武器。{#2}剑{/#2}有 +10 命中加成，{#3}矛{/#3}有 +20 命中加成，但矛造成的穿刺伤害会受到抗性削减。除{#5}投斧{/#5}外，{#4}远程武器{/#4}几乎毫无作用。

units.source: {#1}Woodcutter's Axe{/#1} does 15 damage to their shield, leaving it with 1 durability, and subsequent hit with any weapon destroys it. {#2}Hatchet{/#2} needs 4 hits. {#3}Crude Axe{/#3} and {#4}Handaxe{/#4} need 3.
units.zh: {#1}伐木斧{/#1}会对盾牌造成 15 点伤害，使其只剩 1 耐久度，随后任意武器再命中一次就能摧毁。{#2}短斧{/#2}需要 4 次命中；{#3}粗制斧{/#3}和{#4}手斧{/#4}需要 3 次。

units.source: They have {#1}Fearsome{/#1}, and in the early game you have nothing to counter it.
units.zh: 它们拥有{#1}威慑{/#1}，而你在游戏前期还缺乏应对手段。

units.source: Wait and move two tiles back on your first turn. Wait on the second turn, enemies will approach with no shieldwall. You have two turns in a row to attack them.
units.zh: 首回合先等待，再后退两格；第二回合继续等待，敌人就会不开盾墙接近。这样可以连续获得两回合的攻击机会。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}
Ancient Legionary is an enemy from the {#1}Ancient Dead{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 古代军团兵是{#1}古代亡灵{/#1}阵营的敌人。

units.source: An {#1}Ancient Sword{/#1} (75% chance) or {#2}Broken Ancient Sword{/#2} (25% chance).
An {#1}Ancient Breastplate{/#1} (135), {#2}Ancient Scale Harness{/#2} (125), {#3}Ancient Double Layer Mail{/#3} (120) or {#4}Ancient Mail{/#4} (100).
An {#1}Ancient Coffin Shield{/#1} (66% chance) or {#2}Ancient Tower Shield{/#2} (34% chance).
These enemies often {#1}shieldwall{/#1} to protect themselves. They use {#2}Rotation{/#2} to swap places with a {#3}pikeman{/#3} engaged in melee, if they are not in melee themselves.
units.zh: 这些敌人常用{#1}盾墙{/#1}保护自己。如果自身尚未陷入近战，它们会用{#2}换位{/#2}替换已经被近身的{#3}长枪兵{/#3}。

units.source: Fragile, but armored and difficult to hit when shieldwalling.
units.zh: 身体脆弱，但有护甲，开启盾墙后也很难命中。

units.source: Armor piercing weapons kill them through their medium armor, just make sure they do blunt or slashing damage and not actual piercing.
units.zh: 能穿透护甲的武器可以越过其中等护甲杀死它们，但要确保武器造成钝击或劈砍伤害，而非实际的穿刺伤害。

units.source: Their weaponry doesn't work well against heavy {#1}armor{/#1}, but will cause early {#2}morale{/#2} checks on {#3}Nimble{/#3} brothers because of {#4}Fearsome{/#4}.
units.zh: 它们的武器不擅长对付重型{#1}护甲{/#1}，但由于拥有{#4}威慑{/#4}，会让{#3}轻灵{/#3}成员更早进行{#2}士气{/#2}检定。

units.source: {#1}Throwing Axes{/#1} are required for your ranged brothers to be effective.
units.zh: 远程成员需要使用{#1}投斧{/#1}，才能有效对付它们。

units.source: {#1}Heavy Rusty Axe{/#1} kills them in one hit with a {#2}trait{/#2} like {#3}Huge{/#3}. {#4}Two-Handed Flanged Mace{/#4} does it with {#5}Killing Frenzy{/#5}. {#6}Named{/#6} two-handed weapons can be even better.
units.zh: 配合{#3}高大{/#3}等{#2}特性{/#2}，{#1}锈蚀重斧{/#1}可以一击杀死它们；{#4}双手棱头钉锤{/#4}配合{#5}杀戮狂热{/#5}也能做到。{#6}名贵{/#6}双手武器可能更强。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}
Ancient Honor Guard is a heavily armored enemy from the {#1}Ancient Dead{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 古代荣誉卫士是{#1}古代亡灵{/#1}阵营中身披重甲的敌人。

units.source: An {#1}Ancient Sword{/#1}, {#2}Khopesh{/#2}, {#3}Rhomphaia{/#3}, {#4}Crypt Cleaver{/#4} or {#5}Warscythe{/#5}.
An {#1}Ancient Plated Scale Hauberk{/#1} (210), {#2}Ancient Plate Harness{/#2} (200), {#3}Ancient Scale Coat{/#3} (190) or {#4}Ancient Plated Mail Hauberk{/#4} (180).
If the weapon is one-handed, an {#1}Ancient Tower Shield{/#1}.
units.zh: 若使用单手武器，则装备{#1}古代塔盾{/#1}。

units.source: Armor piercing or anti-armor weapons are required to penetrate their armor, just make sure they do blunt or slashing damage and not actual piercing.
units.zh: 需要使用能够穿透护甲或擅长破甲的武器，才能突破它们的防护；要确保武器造成钝击或劈砍伤害，而非实际的穿刺伤害。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor if the risk is low enough or you can reliably {#2}stun{/#2} or {#3}disarm{/#3} them.
units.zh: 风险足够低，或能稳定将其{#2}眩晕{/#2}、{#3}缴械{/#3}时，可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}保留护甲。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}

{#1}Horror{/#1} will cause separate resolve checks that can lower the morale (with {#2}-15{/#2}{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}) and {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}Horrify{/#9} targets for one turn, making them unable to act (with {#10}-5{/#10}{#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11}) (targets an area of 7 tiles and has a range of 7 tiles)

{#1}Miasma{/#1} does direct 5-10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage each turn to a living unit that finishes its turn standing in it (targets an area of 7 tiles, has a range of 8 tiles and lasts for 3 turns on the ground)
units.zh: {#1}瘴气{/#1}每回合对在其中结束回合的活物直接造成 5-10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}伤害。作用范围为 7 格，射程为 8 格，在地面上持续 3 回合。

units.source: Ancient Priest is a spellcaster from the {#1}Ancient Dead{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 古代祭司是{#1}古代亡灵{/#1}阵营的施法者。

units.source: The helmet has an empty string as a name, which results in log entries like "Ancient Priest's is hit for 4 damage".
units.zh: 这顶头盔的名称是空字符串，因此日志中会出现“古代祭司的被击中，受到 4 点伤害”之类缺少装备名称的记录。

units.source: Ancient Priests seem to prioritize casting Miasma over Horror.{#1}{#2}[citation required]{/#2}{/#1} They stay in the back and are guarded by a few skeletons, but will advance to get in range of their attacks. They can cast spells even if engaged in melee.
units.zh: 古代祭司似乎优先施放瘴气，而非恐怖威慑。{#1}{#2}[需要来源]{/#2}{/#1}它们待在后方，由几个骷髅保护，但会向前移动，直到目标进入施法范围。即使被近身，它们也能施法。

units.source: They resist ranged attacks and don't pose much threat. Only should be prioritized if an opportunity arises.
units.zh: 它们有远程攻击抗性，威胁也不算很大；只在出现合适机会时才需要优先处理。

units.source: {#1}Miasma{/#1} punishes an overly defensive playstyle and may force your brothers to break formation.
units.zh: 过于被动防守会受到{#1}瘴气{/#1}惩罚，它可能迫使你的成员离开阵形。

units.source: {#1}Horror{/#1} can rout low morale brothers and make damage dealing brothers {#2}skip turns{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}恐怖威慑{/#1}能让士气低落的成员溃逃，也能让主力攻击手{#2}无法行动{/#2}。

units.source: Horror counts as a mental attack, so {#1}Witchhunters{/#1}, {#2}Undead Trophy{/#2} and {#3}Protective Runes and Sigils{/#3} are effective against it.
units.zh: 恐怖威慑属于精神攻击，因此{#1}猎巫人{/#1}、{#2}亡灵战利品项链{/#2}和{#3}护佑符文与法印{/#3}都能有效抵抗它。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}
Conqueror is the boss of the {#1}Black Monolith{/#1} {#2}legendary location{/#2}.
units.zh: 征服者是{#2}传奇地点{/#2}{#1}黑色巨石{/#1}的首领。

units.source: His body armor is notable for its ability to reflect 25% of received damage back to the attacker. That damage always hits body and does not pierce armor. While the tooltip says that it reflects melee damage, it's not always true. Damage is actually reflected if the attacker is adjacent, and the attack does not have to be melee. So being two tiles away and attacking with a {#1}polearm{/#1} does not trigger reflection, but point blank {#2}crossbow{/#2} shot does. Reflection continues to work even after the armor is destroyed.
units.zh: 它的身体护甲能够将受到伤害的 25% 反射给攻击者。反射伤害始终命中身体，且不穿透护甲。虽然提示写的是反射近战伤害，实际判定却不完全如此：只要攻击者与它相邻，即使不是近战攻击也会反伤。因此，隔两格使用{#1}长柄武器{/#1}攻击不会触发反伤，贴身用{#2}弩{/#2}射击却会。即使护甲被摧毁，反伤仍然生效。

units.source: His armor does not drop. {#1}The Emperor's Armor{/#1} you get after the battle is a different item.
units.zh: 它的护甲不会掉落，战后获得的{#1}帝王铠甲{/#1}是另一件物品。

units.source: Very tough, deals high damage and his high accuracy allows him to reliably hit evasive characters.
units.zh: 它非常耐打，伤害很高，命中也很高，能稳定击中擅长闪避的角色。

units.source: Use long weapons to avoid triggering damage reflection, preferably anti-armor ones.
units.zh: 使用长距离武器避免触发反伤，优先选择擅长破甲的武器。

units.source: {#1}Flails{/#1} or {#2}Head Hunter{/#2} can allow to defeat him without breaking his body armor.
units.zh: {#1}连枷{/#1}或{#2}猎首者{/#2}能帮助你在不打破身体护甲的情况下杀死它。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}
Necrosavant is a dangerous enemy from the {#1}Ancient Dead{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 死灵剑士是{#1}古代亡灵{/#1}阵营中的危险敌人。

units.source: {#1}Vampire{/#1} The necrosavant will be healed by the amount of {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage dealt by its attack
units.zh: {#1}吸血鬼{/#1}：死灵剑士会恢复等同于本次攻击造成的{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}伤害的生命值。

units.source: {#1}Darkflight{/#1} Teleports the {#2}necrosvant{/#2} to another tile (has a range of 6 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}暗影跃迁{/#1}：将{#2}死灵剑士{/#2}传送到另一个格子，射程为 6 格。

units.source: Necrosavants are extremely mobile and do not respect zones of control, because they can teleport. They are healed by the damage they deal. They like to attack {#1}donkeys{/#1} and {#2}dogs{/#2}, probably because they are an easy source of blood. They don't like to be surrounded and will teleport away even if adjacent to two brothers. But {#3}Taunt{/#3} has such great effect on them so they even teleport into surrounding in response. When Necrosavants are encountered with other undead, they wait a few turns, and attack when you are distracted by melee combat. They can {#4}bleed{/#4}, unlike any other undead.
units.zh: 死灵剑士能够传送，因此机动性极强，不受控制区限制。它们造成伤害时会恢复生命，喜欢攻击{#1}驴{/#1}和{#2}犬只{/#2}，可能是因为这些目标容易提供鲜血。它们不愿被包围，即使只是与两名成员相邻，也会传送离开。不过{#3}挑衅{/#3}对它们格外有效，甚至能诱使它们传送进包围圈。与其他亡灵一同出现时，它们会先等几回合，等你被近战牵制后再进攻。与其他亡灵不同，死灵剑士能够{#4}流血{/#4}。

units.source: {#1}Three-Headed Flails{/#1} are good at countering their {#2}Nine Lives{/#2}, and can target their heads for high damage.
units.zh: {#1}三头连枷{/#1}很适合克制其{#2}九命{/#2}，还可以瞄准头部造成高伤害。

units.source: Engage a Necrosavant with a second brother to make it spend AP on teleporting instead of attacking.
units.zh: 让第二名成员贴近同一只死灵剑士，迫使它将行动点花在传送上，而不是攻击。

units.source: Don't use {#1}dogs{/#1} as they are free healing for Necrosavants.
units.zh: 不要使用{#1}犬只{/#1}，那等于白送死灵剑士恢复生命。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}

Direwolves spawn in forests. They also can be encountered in {#1}Hunting Beasts{/#1} contracts that appear in any village, but snow, tundra and forest villages are more likely to generate wolves, and steppe and swamp villages are less likely to generate them.
units.zh: 恐狼在森林中生成。各类村庄发布的{#1}猎杀野兽{/#1}委托也可能出现恐狼，其中雪地、冻原和森林村庄更容易生成，草原与沼泽村庄则较少。

units.source: An {#1}Unusually Large Wolf Pelt{/#1} (35% chance), {#2}Adrenaline Gland{/#2} (15% chance) or {#3}Strange Meat{/#3} (16.5% chance).
An {#1}Unusually Large Wolf Pelt{/#1} (35% chance), {#2}Adrenaline Gland{/#2} (15% chance) or {#3}Strange Meat{/#3} (16.5% chance). 50% chance of another, rolling separately.
units.zh: 掉落{#1}异常巨大的狼皮{/#1}（35% 几率）、{#2}肾上腺{/#2}（15% 几率）或{#3}不明兽肉{/#3}（16.5% 几率）。另外有 50% 的几率再掉落一份，独立判定。

units.source: An {#1}Unusually Large Wolf Pelt{/#1} (50% chance) or {#2}Strange Meat{/#2} (16.5% chance).
Direwolves rush you even if they will have no AP left to attack. They have enough AP to reach you on the first turn.
units.zh: 恐狼即使冲过来后已没有行动点攻击，也会直扑你。它们的行动点足以在首回合接近。

units.source: Dangerous in the early game, when you don't have good skills and {#1}armor{/#1}.
units.zh: 游戏前期，成员能力较弱、{#1}护甲{/#1}也不够好时，恐狼很危险。

units.source: {#1}Riposte{/#1} and {#2}Shieldwall{/#2} allow you to strike three times (and more if surrounded) while defending.
units.zh: {#1}还击架势{/#1}配合{#2}盾墙{/#2}，能在防守的同时攻击三次，被包围时次数还会更多。

units.source: Be careful when attacking a pack of them, they can be much stronger {#1}Frenzied{/#1} ones.
units.zh: 袭击狼群时要小心，其中可能有强得多的{#1}狂暴恐狼{/#1}。

units.source: Frenzied Direwolf is an enemy from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 狂暴恐狼是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营的敌人。

units.source: Frenzied Direwolves are like {#1}Direwolves{/#1}, but stronger. They rush you even if they will have no AP left to attack. They have enough AP to reach you on the first turn.
units.zh: 狂暴恐狼与{#1}恐狼{/#1}相似，但更强。即使接近后已没有行动点攻击，它们也会直扑你；其行动点足以在首回合接近。

units.source: They will {#1}Overwhelm{/#1} you, unless you are faster, use {#2}Adrenaline{/#2}, {#3}nets{/#3}, {#4}daze{/#4} or {#5}stagger{/#5}.
{#1}Riposte{/#1} and {#2}Shieldwall{/#2} allow you to strike three times while defending, though your accuracy will decrease as Overwhelm builds up.
units.zh: {#1}还击架势{/#1}配合{#2}盾墙{/#2}，能在防守的同时攻击三次，不过压制层数增加后，命中会不断降低。

units.source: High melee defense with a {#1}shield{/#1} or {#2}Dodge{/#2} makes them almost harmless, because they have low melee skill and no accuracy {#3}perks{/#3}.
units.zh: 用{#1}盾牌{/#1}或{#2}闪避{/#2}获得较高近战防御后，它们几乎构不成威胁，因为其近战命中较低，也没有增加命中的{#3}特长{/#3}。

units.source: {#1}Gruesome Feast{/#1} Eats a dead body, grows in size (if possible), improves its morale, removes all injuries and heals up to max {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} (the nachzehrer has to be on the same tile as the dead body)
units.zh: {#1}血腥盛宴{/#1}：吞食一具尸体，在尚能成长时增大体形，改善士气，移除所有伤势，并将{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}恢复至上限。食尸鬼必须与尸体处在同一格。

units.source: {#1}Swallow Whole{/#1} Devours a brother and removes him from the battle until the nachzehrer has died - The brother takes 10-20 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage, but will at least emerge with 5 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} remaining - You can't straight up die from being devoured
units.zh: {#1}囫囵吞食{/#1}：吞下一名成员，使其暂时离开战斗，直到食尸鬼死亡。成员会受到 10-20 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}伤害，但获救时至少保留 5 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}。被吞食本身不会直接致死。

units.source: Nachzehrer is a ghoul-like enemy from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction. They come in three sizes.
units.zh: 食尸鬼是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营中以尸体为食的敌人，有三种体形。

units.source: Nachzehrers spawn in plains and steppes. They also can be encountered in {#1}Hunting Beasts{/#1} contracts that appear in any village, but steppe, plains and swamp villages are more likely to generate nachzehrers, tundra villages are are less likely, and snow villages never generate them. They also sometimes can be encountered in {#2}Hunting Beasts{/#2} contracts that appear in southern cities.
units.zh: 食尸鬼在平原和草原上生成。各类村庄发布的{#1}猎杀野兽{/#1}委托也可能出现，其中草原、平原和沼泽村庄更容易生成，冻原村庄较少，雪地村庄则不会生成。南方城市发布的{#2}猎杀野兽{/#2}委托有时也会出现食尸鬼。

units.source: {#1}Jagged Fangs{/#1} (35% chance), {#2}Nachzehrer Horn{/#2} (35% chance) or {#3}Nachzehrer Brain{/#3} (30% chance).
{#1}Growth Pearls{/#1} (30% chance if large, 15% if medium, 0% if small) (200 crowns).
{#1}Jagged Fangs{/#1} (35% chance), {#2}Nachzehrer Horn{/#2} (35% chance) or {#3}Nachzehrer Brain{/#3} (30% chance). 50% chance of another one, rolled separately.
units.zh: 掉落{#1}锯齿獠牙{/#1}（35% 几率）、{#2}食尸鬼角{/#2}（35% 几率）或{#3}食尸鬼脑髓{/#3}（30% 几率）。另外有 50% 的几率再掉落一份，独立判定。

units.source: Nachzehrers come in three sizes. Larger ones have more HP, damage, resolve, melee skill and defense, but less ranged defense. It's not uncommon to see one large Nachzehrer among small ones in the early game.
units.zh: 食尸鬼有三种体形。越大的个体生命值、伤害、意志、近战命中和近战防御越高，但远程防御更低。游戏前期，在一群小型食尸鬼中夹着一只大型食尸鬼并不罕见。

units.source: They have the ability to {#1}eat corpses{/#1}, including those of their own kind, to grow in size, fully heal and improve morale. They are attracted to corpses and will try reaching them even if there is a {#2}spearwall{/#2} or sometimes even if they are already in a zone of control.
units.zh: 它们可以{#1}吞食尸体{/#1}，包括同类尸体，借此增大体形、恢复全部生命并改善士气。尸体对它们很有吸引力，即使前方有{#2}矛墙{/#2}，有时甚至已经处在控制区内，它们仍会试图靠近尸体。

units.source: The largest variant does not grow, but still can heal itself by eating corpses. It also can {#1}swallow a character alive{/#1}. That character takes a bit of non-lethal damage and his {#2}morale{/#2} is set to Breaking. There is no damage over time. When the Nachzehrer is slain, the character returns to battle. However he will die if you let the Nachzehrer escape with him. This ability is only used against player units.
units.zh: 最大体形的食尸鬼不会继续成长，但仍可通过吞尸恢复生命。它还能{#1}活吞角色{/#1}，造成少量非致命伤害，并将其{#2}士气{/#2}设为濒临崩溃。被吞后不会持续受到伤害。食尸鬼被杀死时，该角色会回到战场；但若让食尸鬼带着他逃走，他就会死亡。这项能力只会对玩家单位使用。

units.source: Nachzehrers approach somewhat carefully and often wait for an opportunity to occupy a tile with a corpse and eat it on the next turn.
units.zh: 食尸鬼接近时较为谨慎，经常等待机会占据尸体所在格，再在下一回合吞食。

units.source: They have the potential to snowball the entire fight out of control.
units.zh: 它们可能越吃越强，让整场战斗迅速失控。

units.source: Be careful with killing as it creates more corpses. Don't create corpses that you can't control.
units.zh: 击杀敌人时要留意，死亡会留下更多尸体。不要留下自己无法守住的尸体。

units.source: They don't have enough Action Points to be able to move more than 1 tile and eat a corpse in the same turn.
units.zh: 它们的行动点不足以在同一回合移动超过 1 格后再吞食尸体。

units.source: {#1}Stun{/#1} or pushback prevent a large Nachzehrer from swallowing a brother, also it can't do it when capped on fatigue.
units.zh: {#1}眩晕{/#1}或击退能阻止大型食尸鬼吞食成员；其疲劳达到上限时也无法吞食。

units.source: {#1}Militia{/#1} squads have trouble fighting them and are not good allies in these fights.
units.zh: {#1}民兵{/#1}队伍很难应付食尸鬼，在这类战斗中并不是可靠盟友。

units.source: Some people talked about a strategy involving a very wide formation and {#1}dogs{/#1}. Dogs provide extra damage and surrounding bonus, and make you difficult to surround. Nachzehrers prioritize brothers over dogs.
units.zh: 有玩家提出过拉宽阵形并使用{#1}犬只{/#1}的战术。犬只能提供额外伤害和包围加成，也让你的队伍更难被包围。食尸鬼会优先攻击成员，而非犬只。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
{#1}Move Tail{/#1} Teleports the tail right next to the body (has unlimited range)
units.zh: {#1}移动尾部{/#1}：将尾巴传送到紧邻躯干的位置，距离无限。

units.source: {#1}Tail Slam Sweep{/#1} does 60-120 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 150% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, 35% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, has {#11}-5%{/#11} chance to hit, will hit up to 3 targets next to each other, causes the target to be {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} {#15}dazed{/#15} for 2 turns or has knockback or will {#16}{#17}{#18/}{/#17}{/#16} {#19}stun{/#19} for 1 turn

{#1}Tail Slam Thresh{/#1} does 60-120 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 150% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, 35% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, has {#11}-5%{/#11} chance to hit, will hit up to 6 targets right next to the tail, causes the target to be {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} {#15}dazed{/#15} for 2 turns or has knockback or will {#16}{#17}{#18/}{/#17}{/#16} {#19}stun{/#19} for 1 turn
Lindwurm is a dangerous two-tile enemy from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction. It has separate head and tail tokens.
units.zh: 林德蠕龙是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营中占据两格的危险敌人，头部与尾部各有独立单位。

units.source: Lindwurms spawn in steppes and deserts. They also can be encountered in {#1}Hunting Lindwurms{/#1} contracts that appear in steppe and plains villages and cities.
units.zh: 林德蠕龙在草原和沙漠中生成。草原与平原的村庄、城市发布的{#1}猎杀林德蠕龙{/#1}委托也可能出现。

units.source: {#1}Acid Blood{/#1} Every time you do at least 10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} to their {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} with melee, the tile next to the Lindwurm will be sprayed with acid - the acid corrodes both body and head armor at the rate of 10% of armor each turn for three turns - this effect doesn't stack, but it will refresh
units.zh: {#1}酸性血液{/#1}：每当近战攻击对其{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}造成至少 10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}，林德蠕龙相邻的格子就会被酸液溅到。酸液每回合腐蚀身体和头部护甲的 10%，持续三回合。效果不会叠加，但可以刷新持续时间。

units.source: {#1}Lindwurm Blood{/#1} (35% chance), {#2}Lindwurm Scales{/#2} (35% chance) or {#3}Lindwurm Bones{/#3} (30% chance).
{#1}Lindwurm Blood{/#1} (35% chance), {#2}Lindwurm Scales{/#2} (35% chance) or {#3}Lindwurm Bones{/#3} (30% chance). 50% chance of another one, rolling separately.
units.zh: 掉落{#1}林德蠕龙血{/#1}（35% 几率）、{#2}林德蠕龙鳞甲{/#2}（35% 几率）或{#3}林德蠕龙骨{/#3}（30% 几率）。另外有 50% 的几率再掉落一份，独立判定。

units.source: Lindwurm is a two-tile monster. Its head and tail occupy separate tiles. They share HP, armor, fatigue and morale. When the head acts, the tail acts right after it. The tail tries to stay close to the head, but sometimes becomes disconnected. The tail ignores zone of control. Fatigue decreases only on head's turns. Effects like {#1}Bleeding{/#1}, {#2}Daze{/#2}, {#3}Taunt{/#3} and {#4}Overwhelm{/#4} affect each part separately. {#5}Injuries{/#5} are not shared and only affect the head.
units.zh: 林德蠕龙占据两格，头部与尾部分别占据一个格子，共享生命值、护甲、疲劳和士气。头部行动后，尾部立即行动。尾部会尽量靠近头部，但有时会与其脱节，而且不受控制区限制。只有头部的回合会恢复疲劳。{#1}流血{/#1}、{#2}恍惚{/#2}、{#3}挑衅{/#3}和{#4}压制{/#4}等效果分别作用于两个部分；{#5}伤势{/#5}不共享，只对头部生效。

units.source: Non-critical hits to the head are redirected to the body. Critical hits to the tail are not redirected but do critical damage and inflict head injuries. If the tail is hit by {#1}Split Man{/#1}, all damage goes to the body.
units.zh: 对头部单位的非暴击命中会转移至身体。对尾部的暴击不会转移，仍会造成暴击伤害，并施加头部伤势。若尾部被{#1}劈身{/#1}命中，全部伤害都会作用于身体。

units.source: Both head and body will splash attackers with acid when hit for 10 damage, but only if attacked from adjacent tiles. Being next to one part and attacking the other of the same Lindwurm from a safe distance will still splash with acid.
units.zh: 头部和身体受到 10 点伤害时都会向攻击者溅出酸液，但只有从相邻格攻击才会触发。即使你与其中一部分相邻、从安全距离攻击同一只林德蠕龙的另一部分，仍会被酸液溅到。

units.source: Their extreme damage and toughness make them dangerous to fight in direct combat.
units.zh: 它们极高的伤害和耐打程度，使正面交锋十分危险。

units.source: Use {#1}polearms{/#1} and reach weapons to avoid acid effect. {#2}Whips{/#2} and {#3}bows{/#3} are effective when their armor is broken. {#4}Cleavers{/#4}' {#5}Decapitate{/#5} attack deals high damage when they are already wounded.
units.zh: 使用{#1}长柄武器{/#1}等长距离武器，避免受到酸液影响。护甲被打破后，{#2}鞭子{/#2}和{#3}弓{/#3}都很有效。敌人已经受伤时，{#4}斩刀{/#4}的{#5}斩首{/#5}攻击能造成高额伤害。

units.source: Prefer attacking the tail. It can receive criticals and you avoid wasting effort on head armor. Area attacks that hit both parts do damage twice.
units.zh: 优先攻击尾部，既能造成暴击，也不会把伤害浪费在头部护甲上。同时命中两个部分的范围攻击会造成两次伤害。

units.source: They are slow. Bait characters, usually sergeants, can distract and make them run around the map as long as you want. {#1}Pathfinder{/#1} is essential for them. The squad can either {#2}Footwork{/#2} away while dealing damage or kill Lindwurms one by one using a tank to separate a Lindwurm from the group.
units.zh: 它们行动缓慢。可以用通常由军士担任的诱饵吸引注意，让它们在地图上来回追逐；诱饵必须有{#1}寻路者{/#1}。其他成员可以用{#2}灵活步法{/#2}边退边打，也可以由防御手将一只林德蠕龙从群体中分离出来，再逐只击杀。

units.source: {#1}Indomitable{/#1} reduces damage and gives {#2}stun{/#2} immunity. When you need to {#3}Recover{/#3} and a tail is about to attack you, don't end turn immediately, because then if you will be stunned, the effect will go away at the end of your turn.
units.zh: {#1}不屈{/#1}能减少伤害，并免疫{#2}眩晕{/#2}。需要{#3}恢复体力{/#3}且尾巴即将攻击时，先别立刻结束自己的回合；这样即使被眩晕，效果也会在你结束回合时消失。

units.source: {#1}Lindwurm Helmet{/#1}, {#2}Lindwurm Armor{/#2} and {#3}Lindwurm Scale Cloak{/#3} resist their acid.
units.zh: {#1}林德蠕龙战盔{/#1}、{#2}林德蠕龙护甲{/#2}和{#3}林德蠕龙鳞披风{/#3}能抵抗其酸液。

units.source: They aren't hard to {#1}Overwhelm{/#1}, but Overwhelm isn't shared between parts. Ranged attacks without {#2}Bullseye{/#2} apply Overwhelm to both parts as shots go astray.
units.zh: 它们很容易受到{#1}压制{/#1}，但两个部分的压制效果不共享。没有{#2}鹰眼{/#2}时，远程射击的偏离可能让两个部分都受到压制。

units.source: To prevent rallying of a {#1}fleeing{/#1} Lindwurm, both head and tail must be adjacent to a brother.
units.zh: 要阻止{#1}逃跑{/#1}的林德蠕龙恢复士气，必须让其头部和尾部都与战团成员相邻。

units.source: {#1}Injuring{/#1} them is impractical but possible. Take {#2}Crippling Strikes{/#2} and use {#3}Greatsword{/#3}'s {#4}Overhead Strike{/#4}, {#5}Shamshir{/#5}'s {#6}Gash{/#6} with {#7}Sword Mastery{/#7}, {#8}Fencing Sword{/#8}'s {#9}Lunge{/#9} with extremely high initiative, or two-handed {#10}cleaver{/#10}'s {#11}Decapitate{/#11} when the Lindwurm is wounded. The hit must be critical, and you still need {#12}Huge{/#12}, {#13}Drunkard{/#13}, {#14}Killing Frenzy{/#14}, {#15}Strange Mushrooms{/#15} or the weapon to be {#16}named{/#16} and having increased damage to have a chance to inflict an injury.
units.zh: 对它们造成{#1}伤势{/#1}并不实用，但仍然可能。学习{#2}致残打击{/#2}后，可以使用{#3}巨剑{/#3}的{#4}当头劈斩{/#4}、配合{#7}剑术精通{/#7}的{#5}舍施尔弯刀{/#5}{#6}撕裂{/#6}、极高先攻下的{#8}决斗刺剑{/#8}{#9}突刺{/#9}，或在林德蠕龙已经受伤时，用双手{#10}斩刀{/#10}施展{#11}斩首{/#11}。这一击必须暴击，而且仍需{#12}高大{/#12}、{#13}酒鬼{/#13}、{#14}杀戮狂热{/#14}、{#15}奇异蘑菇{/#15}，或伤害更高的{#16}名贵{/#16}武器加持，才有机会造成伤势。

units.source: {#1}Unstoppable Charge{/#1} will {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}stun{/#5} and {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}stagger{/#9} the target (has a range of 3 tiles)
Unhold is an enemy from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction. There are three slightly different species of them.
units.zh: 巨魔是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营的敌人，有三种略有差异的种类。

units.source: Regular Unholds spawns in tundras, hills and mountains. Bog Unholds spawn in swamps and leafy forests (only green, not autumn). Frost Unholds spawn in snowy areas and sometimes in tundras.
units.zh: 普通巨魔生成于冻原、丘陵和山地。沼泽巨魔生成于沼泽及阔叶林，但只会出现在绿色森林，而非秋季森林。霜巨魔生成于雪地，有时也出现在冻原。

units.source: They can also be encountered in {#1}Hunting Giants{/#1} contracts. Tundra and small mining villages generate regular Unholds, forest and swamp villages generate Bog Unholds, and snow villages generate Frost Unholds.
units.zh: {#1}猎杀巨人{/#1}委托也可能出现它们。冻原和小型采矿村庄会生成普通巨魔，森林与沼泽村庄会生成沼泽巨魔，雪地村庄则会生成霜巨魔。

units.source: {#1}Regeneration{/#1} will heal for 15% of their max {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} at the start of each turn
{#1}Fling Back{/#1} will toss the target behind the {#2}unhold{/#2}, target gets {#3}10{/#3} {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} and suffers falling damage
A {#1}Giant Skull and Bones{/#1} (40% chance), {#2}Unhold Hide{/#2} (40% chance) or {#3}Unhold's Heart{/#3} (20% chance).
Frost Unholds drop {#1}Thick White Fur{/#1} instead of {#2}Unhold Hide{/#2}.
units.zh: 霜巨魔掉落{#1}厚实白毛皮{/#1}，而非{#2}巨魔厚皮{/#2}。

units.source: A {#1}Giant Skull and Bones{/#1} (40% chance), {#2}Unhold Hide{/#2} (40% chance) or {#3}Unhold's Heart{/#3} (20% chance). 50% chance of another one, rolling separately.
units.zh: 掉落{#1}巨型头骨与骨骼{/#1}（40% 几率）、{#2}巨魔厚皮{/#2}（40% 几率）或{#3}巨魔之心{/#3}（20% 几率）。另外有 50% 的几率再掉落一份，独立判定。

units.source: Unholds usually approach with their Unstoppable Charge, that can't be repelled by a {#1}spearwall{/#1}. They prefer fighting with a regular attack, but can use Fling Back to get close to a vulnerable brother, take the high ground, cancel a {#2}shieldwall{/#2}, or kill someone with 10 HP or less.
units.zh: 巨魔通常用势不可挡接近，{#1}矛墙{/#1}无法将其挡回。它们偏爱普通攻击，但也会用向后抛掷接近脆弱成员、抢占高地、解除{#2}盾墙{/#2}，或杀死生命值不超过 10 的目标。

units.source: Early game brothers will suffer an {#1}injury{/#1} on the first hit. {#2}Nimble{/#2} or heavy {#3}armor{/#3} protect from early injuries.
units.zh: 前期成员往往挨第一击就会出现{#1}伤势{/#1}。{#2}轻灵{/#2}或重型{#3}护甲{/#3}能避免过早受伤。

units.source: HP regeneration makes defensive strategies less effective. Try to concentrate damage rather than spread it. Use weapons with high raw damage. Prefer attacking over shieldwalling. Even meaningless damage can cause a morale drop.
units.zh: 生命再生使被动防守不太有效，应集中伤害，而不是分散攻击。使用基础伤害高的武器，尽量多攻击、少开盾墙。即使造成的伤害很少，也可能导致其士气下降。

units.source: Don't position backliners directly behind frontliners, Unholds will get close to them with Fling Back.
units.zh: 不要把后排放在前排的正后方，巨魔会利用向后抛掷接近他们。

units.source: {#1}Polearm Mastery{/#1} allows to attack from 3 tiles away by stepping forward and retreating.
units.zh: {#1}长柄武器精通{/#1}能让成员从相距 3 格的位置前进一步、攻击后退回。

units.source: {#1}Indomitable{/#1} makes you immune to knockback, {#2}stun{/#2} and Fling Back.
units.zh: {#1}不屈{/#1}能免疫击退、{#2}眩晕{/#2}和向后抛掷。

units.source: They can't use Unstoppable Charge and Fling Back when caught in a {#1}net{/#1}.
units.zh: 被{#1}投网{/#1}困住时，它们无法使用势不可挡和向后抛掷。

units.source: If you charge them, they will not use Unstoppable Charge.
units.zh: 如果你主动冲到它们身边，它们就不会使用势不可挡。

units.source: If you are faster and wait, even with AP already spent, stun will go away at the end of your turn.
units.zh: 如果你行动更快，可以先等待，即使行动点已经用完也一样；之后受到的眩晕会在你的回合结束时消失。

units.source: {#1}Cleavers{/#1}' {#2}Decapitate{/#2} attack kills them faster when they are already wounded.
units.zh: 敌人已经受伤时，{#1}斩刀{/#1}的{#2}斩首{/#2}攻击能更快杀死它们。

units.source: {#1}Injuring{/#1} them is difficult, but possible. You need {#2}Crippling Strikes{/#2} or a {#3}named weapon{/#3} with increased damage.
units.zh: 对它们造成{#1}伤势{/#1}很难，但并非不可能。需要{#2}致残打击{/#2}，或伤害更高的{#3}名贵武器{/#3}。

units.source: If their {#1}morale{/#1} breaks, keep a brother next to them to prevent rallying.
units.zh: 它们的{#1}士气{/#1}崩溃后，让一名成员贴在旁边，阻止其恢复士气。

units.source: Scripts contain code that spawns Bog Unholds in oasises, and their behavior only allows them to roam swamps and leafy forests, not oasises.
units.zh: 原文指出，脚本中有让沼泽巨魔在绿洲生成的代码，但其活动范围只允许沼泽和阔叶林，不包括绿洲。

units.source: {#1}Fling Back{/#1} will toss the target behind the {#2}unhold{/#2}, target gets {#3}10{/#3} {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} and suffers falling damage
Armored Unhold is a beast, used for war by {#1}Barbarians{/#1} faction, controlled by {#2}Beastmasters{/#2}.
units.zh: 披甲巨魔是被{#1}蛮族{/#1}阵营用于战争的野兽，受{#2}驯兽师{/#2}控制。

units.source: Unholds usually approach with their {#1}Unstoppable Charge{/#1}, that can't be repelled by a spearwall. They prefer fighting with a regular attack, but can use {#2}Fling Back{/#2} to get close to a vulnerable brother, take the high ground, cancel a shieldwall, or kill someone with 10 HP or less.
units.zh: 巨魔通常用{#1}势不可挡{/#1}接近，矛墙无法将其挡回。它们偏爱普通攻击，但也会用{#2}向后抛掷{/#2}接近脆弱成员、抢占高地、解除盾墙，或杀死生命值不超过 10 的目标。

units.source: It's impossible to swap places with Unholds with {#1}Barbarian Fury{/#1}.
units.zh: 无法用{#1}蛮族狂怒{/#1}与巨魔交换位置。

units.source: If not {#1}whipped{/#1}, an Armored Unhold has a 33% chance to turn wild at the start of its turn. Uncontrolled Armored Unholds are hostile to barbarians and controlled Armored Unholds, but not to each other, and they are allied with other {#2}Beasts{/#2} in a three-way fight. Whipped Armored Unholds still retain their wild status until their next turn (verify?).
units.zh: 如果没有受到{#1}鞭击{/#1}，披甲巨魔在自己回合开始时有 33% 的几率失控。失控的披甲巨魔与蛮族和仍受控制的披甲巨魔敌对，但彼此不敌对；三方混战时，它们还会与其他{#2}野兽{/#2}结盟。受到鞭击后，失控状态仍会保留到下一回合（原文标注：待核实）。

units.source: Controlled and wild Armored Unholds can be distinguished by their tokens' bases. Barbarians' base means it's controlled, and Beasts' base indicates it's wild.
units.zh: 可以通过单位底座区分受控和失控的披甲巨魔：蛮族底座表示受控，野兽底座表示失控。

units.source: Normal Armored Unholds are similar to unarmored Unholds, but Armored Frost Unholds have very heavy armor that requires anti-armor weapons to destroy.
units.zh: 普通披甲巨魔与无甲巨魔差别不大，但披甲霜巨魔拥有极厚护甲，需要破甲武器才能摧毁。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
{#1}Grow Shield{/#1} creates a new shield after the old one was broken
units.zh: {#1}再生木盾{/#1}会在旧盾被打破后生成一面新盾。

units.source: Schrat is a dangerous tree-like enemy from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 树妖是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营中形似树木的危险敌人。

units.source: Schrats spawn in forests, except snowy. They also can be encountered in {#1}Haunted Woods{/#1} contracts, that appear in forest villages and cities.
units.zh: 树妖生成于雪地以外的森林，也会出现在森林村庄和城市发布的{#1}闹鬼的森林{/#1}委托中。

units.source: {#1}Shielded{/#1} causes a Schrat to take only 30% damage. Schrats also receive only 25% damage from bolts and arrows, and 50% from javelins - but 1/3 more damage from firelance. When Schrat takes at least 60 dmg, a Sapling will be spawned if a free tile around is available.
units.zh: {#1}盾牌保护{/#1}使树妖只承受 30% 的伤害。此外，它只承受弩矢和箭矢造成的 25% 伤害、标枪造成的 50% 伤害，但受到火矛攻击时会额外承受 1/3 的伤害。树妖受到至少 60 点伤害时，若周围有空格，就会生成树苗。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Wood{/#1} (40% chance), {#2}Glowing Resin{/#2} (40% chance) or {#3}Heart of the Forest{/#3} (20% chance).
{#1}Ancient Wood{/#1} (40% chance), {#2}Glowing Resin{/#2} (40% chance) or {#3}Heart of the Forest{/#3} (20% chance). 50% chance of another one, rolled separately.
units.zh: 掉落{#1}古老木材{/#1}（40% 几率）、{#2}发光树脂{/#2}（40% 几率）或{#3}森林之心{/#3}（20% 几率）。另外有 50% 的几率再掉落一份，独立判定。

units.source: Schrats reduce damage greatly if they have a shield and can regrow it. {#1}Fire Pots{/#1} do triple damage to them. If hit by 60 damage or more, they spawn a {#2}Sapling{/#2} if there is a free tile for it. It acts on the next round.
units.zh: 树妖持盾时会大幅减少所受伤害，而且能够重新长出盾牌。{#1}燃烧罐{/#1}对其造成三倍伤害。受到至少 60 点伤害时，只要附近有空格，它就会生成一棵{#2}树苗{/#2}，树苗从下一轮开始行动。

units.source: Schrats have an area attack that can only hit straight lines. It can strike right through obstacles. They very much like to attack multiple characters with it even if {#1}taunted{/#1}. They seem to be attracted to tight formations where this attack would be effective, and often actively avoid engaging single targets, moving around them instead.
units.zh: 树妖的范围攻击只能沿直线发动，但可以直接穿过障碍物。即使受到{#1}挑衅{/#1}，它们仍非常喜欢用这一招同时攻击多个角色。它们似乎会优先靠近适合范围攻击的密集阵形，常常绕开单独目标，而不是与之交战。

units.source: They can kill early game brothers with one head hit, and will easily inflict {#1}injuries{/#1} even in late game, unless brothers use {#2}Indomitable{/#2} or have extremely high HP.
units.zh: 它们一次头部命中就可能杀死前期成员。即使到了后期，也很容易造成{#1}伤势{/#1}，除非成员使用{#2}不屈{/#2}，或拥有极高生命值。

units.source: {#1}Axes{/#1} are recommended to break shields and rid Schrats of their damage reduction. It does not require melee skill or Double Grip.
units.zh: 建议用{#1}斧{/#1}破坏盾牌，解除树妖的减伤。破盾不要求较高的近战命中，也不要求双手握持。

units.source: They have 2000 effective HP if you don't break their shields.
units.zh: 不打破盾牌时，它们的等效生命值为 2000。

units.source: If their numbers are low enough, they leave blind spots for your backliners to attack from.
units.zh: 数量足够少时，它们的攻击范围会留下死角，后排可以从这些位置进攻。

units.source: Surround them if possible to prevent {#1}Saplings{/#1} from spawning. Partial surrounding also works because Saplings occupy tiles too.
units.zh: 尽量包围它们，阻止{#1}树苗{/#1}生成。部分包围也有作用，因为树苗本身也会占据格子。

units.source: One-handed weapons with shields don't cause Saplings to spawn and provide some defense.
units.zh: 单手武器搭配盾牌不会触发树苗生成，也能提供一定防护。

units.source: Two-handed weapons do more damage, but cause Saplings to spawn. Killing Saplings activates {#1}Berserk{/#1} and {#2}Killing Frenzy{/#2}, causes a 5% {#3}morale{/#3} check on all Schrats and gives XP.
units.zh: 双手武器伤害更高，但会触发树苗生成。击杀树苗能触发{#1}狂战{/#1}和{#2}杀戮狂热{/#2}，使所有树妖进行一次 5% 几率的{#3}士气{/#3}检定，并提供经验。

units.source: {#1}Dazing{/#1} Schrats with two-handed maces reduces their damage to the point where it's insufficient to injure a properly built lategame brother in the beginning of combat.
units.zh: 双手钉锤造成的{#1}恍惚{/#1}能降低树妖伤害，使其在战斗初期不足以对培养得当的后期成员造成伤势。

units.source: They aren't hard to {#1}Overwhelm{/#1}, but {#2}stagger{/#2} on hits, ruining your initiative.
units.zh: 它们很容易受到{#1}压制{/#1}，但命中时会使你{#2}踉跄{/#2}，大幅破坏先攻优势。

units.source: Two tanks in a line distract them without {#1}Taunt{/#1} at the cost of receiving more attacks.
units.zh: 将两名防御手排成一直线，不用{#1}挑衅{/#1}也能吸引它们，但代价是承受更多攻击。

units.source: Sapling is a small tree-like enemy spawned by damaging {#1}Schrats{/#1}.
units.zh: 树苗是对{#1}树妖{/#1}造成伤害时生成的小型树木敌人。

units.source: While small, they still give surround bonus, attack, hit, {#1}stagger{/#1} and {#2}injure{/#2}.
units.zh: 虽然体形小，它们仍能提供包围加成、发动攻击、命中目标，并造成{#1}踉跄{/#1}和{#2}伤势{/#2}。

units.source: Unlike Schrats, they don't resist {#1}ranged weapons{/#1} and don't take extra fire damage.
units.zh: 与树妖不同，它们没有{#1}远程武器{/#1}抗性，也不会承受额外火焰伤害。

units.source: They are faster and harder to hit than Schrats.
units.zh: 它们比树妖行动更快，也更难命中。

units.source: Killing Saplings activates {#1}Berserk{/#1} and {#2}Killing Frenzy{/#2}, causes a 5% {#3}morale{/#3} check on all Schrats and gives XP.
units.zh: 击杀树苗能触发{#1}狂战{/#1}和{#2}杀戮狂热{/#2}，使所有树妖进行一次 5% 几率的{#3}士气{/#3}检定，并提供经验。

units.source: {#1}Weave Web{/#1} will throw a web on enemies, preventing movement, reducing their {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}, {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} and {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} by 50% (has a cooldown of 3 turns)
Webknecht is a giant spider, a weak enemy from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 巨蛛是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营中的巨型蜘蛛，属于较弱的敌人。

units.source: Webknechts spawn in forests, except snowy. They also can be encountered in {#1}Hunting Webknechts{/#1} {#2}contracts{/#2}, that appear in forest villages, and in {#3}Hunting Beasts{/#3} contracts that appear in any village, but swamp and especially forest villages are more likely to generate spiders, and snowy villages never generate them.
units.zh: 巨蛛会出现在非雪地森林。森林村庄提供的{#1}猎杀巨蛛{/#1}{#2}委托{/#2}也会遇到它们。此外，所有村庄都可能发布{#3}猎杀野兽{/#3}委托，其中沼泽村庄，尤其是森林村庄，更容易生成巨蛛；雪地村庄则不会生成巨蛛。

units.source: {#1}Webknecht Poison{/#1} will add the {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} poison status to any target that takes at least 6 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} damage from {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} {#11}Webknecht{/#11} (the poison does 5 {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} damage at the end of character's turn)
Webknechts spawn with size from 0.7 to 0.9, and only drop loot if it is greater than 0.75, and the probability is 60% on top of that. This results in a 3/7 roll.
units.zh: 巨蛛生成时的体型介于0.7至0.9之间，只有体型大于0.75才可能掉落战利品；满足体型要求后，还需要通过60%的掉落判定。因此，综合掉落概率为3/7。

units.source: A {#1}Gossamer{/#1} (60% chance) or {#2}Poison Gland{/#2} (40% chance). 50% chance of another, rolled separately.
units.zh: 掉落{#1}蛛丝{/#1}（60%概率）或{#2}毒腺{/#2}（40%概率）。另有50%概率额外掉落一件，种类独立判定。

units.source: Spiders hatched from eggs are too small to drop any loot.
units.zh: 由蛛卵孵化出的巨蛛体型太小，不会掉落任何战利品。

units.source: Webknechts are very numerous, and will also generate {#1}Webknecht Eggs{/#1} that spawn even more. The number of eggs is 5 times less than spiders, and each egg can spawn 4 of them. Spiders that hatched don't drop loot and their XP reward is halved. Eggs only appear when there is more than 5 spiders.
units.zh: 巨蛛数量众多，还会生成{#1}蛛卵{/#1}，孵化出更多巨蛛。每5只巨蛛对应一枚蛛卵，每枚蛛卵可孵化4只巨蛛。孵化出的巨蛛不掉落战利品，提供的经验值减半。只有巨蛛数量超过5只时才会出现蛛卵。

units.source: Webknechts are beasts dumb enough to run into {#1}spearwall{/#1} or come close without being able to attack. They sometimes run into surrounding and {#2}footwork{/#2} away. They almost always prioritize {#3}web{/#3} over {#4}bite{/#4}.
units.zh: 巨蛛不够聪明，会直接冲进{#1}矛墙{/#1}，或在行动点不足以攻击时靠近敌人。它们有时还会钻进包围圈，再用{#2}灵活步法{/#2}脱身。它们几乎总是优先{#3}织网{/#3}，而不是{#4}撕咬{/#4}。

units.source: High melee skill is good to have because it is required to remove {#1}webs{/#1}.
units.zh: 挣脱{#1}蛛网{/#1}需要进行近战命中检定，因此较高的近战命中很有帮助。

units.source: Webs decrease damage you do and increase damage taken from spiders. Prioritize removing webs over attacking.
units.zh: 蛛网会降低你的伤害，并提高你受到的巨蛛伤害。应优先解除蛛网，再考虑攻击。

units.source: You will fight almost two times more spiders because of {#1}eggs{/#1}. However they attack with a delay, instead of in a one wave.
units.zh: 由于{#1}蛛卵{/#1}的存在，实际要对付的巨蛛数量接近最初的两倍。不过，孵化出的巨蛛会稍晚加入战斗，不会一次全部涌上来。

units.source: Defensive strategies don't work well because webs lower defense, and less killing means more spiders and more webs, more value of their {#1}Backstabber{/#1} and {#2}Fast Adaptation{/#2}.
units.zh: 防守战术效果不佳，因为蛛网会降低防御；杀敌越慢，场上的巨蛛和蛛网就越多，它们的{#1}背刺者{/#1}和{#2}快速适应{/#2}也就越容易发挥作用。

units.source: 6 AP weapons don't pair well with 4 AP breaking free. They require someone else to remove the web.
units.zh: 耗费6行动点的武器与耗费4行动点的挣脱蛛网动作难以兼顾。这类武器的使用者需要别人帮忙解除蛛网。

units.source: Double gripped {#1}swords{/#1} (anything better than {#2}Shortsword{/#2}) always kill them in two hits and have +10 to hit. {#3}Warbrands{/#3} are similar because they have a 4 AP attack.
units.zh: 双手握持的{#1}剑{/#1}（优于{#2}短剑{/#2}的型号）总能两击杀死巨蛛，并有+10命中加成。{#3}长刃战刀{/#3}也有类似效果，因为它的攻击只需4行动点。

units.source: {#1}Polearms{/#1} with {#2}Mastery{/#2} allow to both attack and remove a web. Head hits kill spiders. {#3}Swordlance{/#3} is the best choice because it attacks multiple targets. {#4}Killing Frenzy{/#4} allows to kill spiders without head hits, and {#5}Berserk{/#5} allows to attack more.
units.zh: 拥有{#2}长柄武器精通{/#2}时，使用{#1}长柄武器{/#1}可在同一回合攻击并解除蛛网。命中头部可以直接杀死巨蛛。{#3}长柄剑刃{/#3}能够攻击多个目标，是最佳选择。{#4}杀戮狂热{/#4}可让你不必击中头部也能击杀巨蛛，{#5}狂战{/#5}则能增加攻击次数。

units.source: {#1}Spearwall{/#1} does damage, but is fatiguing to use and can be quickly breached given the number of attempts spiders do.
units.zh: {#1}矛墙{/#1}能够造成伤害，但很消耗体力，而且巨蛛会不断尝试接近，很可能很快突破矛墙。

units.source: {#1}Recover{/#1} can be useful to restore stamina lost while killing and breaking free from webs.
units.zh: {#1}恢复体力{/#1}有助于恢复杀敌和挣脱蛛网所消耗的体力。

units.source: Evergreen forests, where you often fight them, have narrow passages that are easier to hold. On the other side, you start surrounded and shuffled, your archer can spawn isolated and spiders on their first turn will move next to him. Be prepared.
units.zh: 与巨蛛交战的地点往往是常绿森林，其中的狭窄通道比较容易防守。但另一方面，部队开战时会被包围，站位也会打乱。弓手可能被孤立在远处，巨蛛首回合就能贴近他，务必有所准备。

units.source: {#1}Contracts{/#1} to protect {#2}firstborn{/#2} can be difficult because Webknechts should be fought aggressively and {#3}Hexen{/#3} must be fought carefully, and also spiders hatch from eggs and come from behind.
units.zh: 保护{#2}长子{/#2}的{#1}委托{/#1}可能很棘手：对付巨蛛应主动进攻，对付{#3}女巫{/#3}却需要谨慎行事，而且孵化出的巨蛛还会从后方袭来。

units.source: {#1}Charm{/#1} will attempt to mindcontrol 1 of your brothers for 2 turns - Your chance to resist being charmed is your {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} - 35. That means with 35 or less you will always be charmed and with 130 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} you have a 95% chance to resist. (95% is the max) - Standing right next to the hexe makes resisting charm more difficult. (-40 instead of -35) - You get 2 chances to resist the charm effect - The status ends on the start of your turn if the hexe is dead (has a range of 8 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}魅惑{/#1}尝试控制1名弟兄，持续2回合。抵抗概率为你的{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} -35。这意味着意志为35或更低时必定被魅惑；拥有130{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}时，抵抗概率为95%（上限为95%）。紧邻女巫时更难抵抗，修正由-35变为-40。你有2次机会抵抗魅惑。若女巫死亡，魅惑状态会在你的回合开始时结束。射程为8格。

units.source: {#1}Drink Night Owl Elixir{/#1} will remove all {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Nighttime{/#5} penalties

{#1}Hex{/#1} curses one of your brothers for 2 turns (you will take the same damage as the hexe) - The damage will ignore your armor - The hex can't be resisted and a brother can't have more than 1 hex on him at the same time (has a range of 8 tiles and a cooldown of 1 or 2 turns)
units.zh: {#1}咒缚{/#1}会诅咒一名弟兄，持续2回合，使他承受与女巫相同的伤害。此伤害无视护甲。咒缚无法抵抗，同一名弟兄身上不能同时存在超过1个咒缚。射程为8格，冷却时间为1或2回合。

units.source: Hexe is a spellcaster from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction, guarded by beasts or {#2}brigands{/#2}, charmed by her.
units.zh: 女巫是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营的施法者，身边有受她魅惑的野兽或{#2}强盗{/#2}守护。

units.source: Hexen spawn everywhere, except snow, deserts, hills and mountains. They can also be encountered in {#1}Pact with Witches{/#1} contracts, that appear in villages expect snow ones.
units.zh: 女巫会出现在雪地、沙漠、丘陵和山地以外的地区。非雪地村庄提供的{#1}女巫委托{/#1}中也可能遇到她们。

units.source: There can be only one or a few Hexen in a group, everyone else can be:
units.zh: 一支队伍中可能只有一名女巫，也可能有数名；其余成员可能是：

units.source: {#1}Nachzehrers{/#1} (all small, all medium or varying from small to large)
units.zh: {#1}食尸鬼{/#1}（全部为小型、全部为中型，或由小型至大型混合组成）

units.source: {#1}Witch Hair{/#1} (35% chance), {#2}Mysterious Herbs{/#2} (35% chance) or {#3}Poisoned Apple{/#3} (30% chance).
Hexen have no zone of control, and are unable to break free from {#1}nets{/#1}. They can cast both Charm and Hex on the same turn if not capped on fatigue.
units.zh: 女巫没有控制区，也无法挣脱{#1}投网{/#1}。只要没有达到疲劳上限，她们就能在同一回委托时施放魅惑和咒缚。

units.source: When using Charm, Hexen prefer brothers with low resolve, dangerous weapons, many adjacent brothers to create a zone of control over them, unguarded ranged brothers, or those who threaten them or are in melee already. Hexen are less likely to target brothers with high resolve, weak weapons, guarded ranged brothers and those who waits with low AP. Charm is prioritized over Hex and will be used when capped on fatigue.
units.zh: 施放魅惑时，女巫偏好意志较低、武器危险、身旁弟兄较多（可借控制区限制他们）、缺乏保护的远程弟兄，以及已经构成威胁或进入近战的目标。她们较少选择意志高、武器较弱、受到保护的远程弟兄，以及行动点所剩不多而正在等待的目标。魅惑的优先级高于咒缚；即便达到疲劳上限，女巫仍会使用魅惑。

units.source: When using Hex, Hexen prefer wounded targets, especially having an effect like {#1}Bleeding{/#1} that will kill them, and prefer brothers over allies in three-way fights. They avoid using Hex against brothers with {#2}Indomitable{/#2}, even inactive, or low level poorly armored brothers. {#3}Taunt{/#3} causes them to Hex the taunting brother. They only cast Hex when they think they are in danger, and even then not always do it.
units.zh: 施放咒缚时，女巫偏好受伤的目标，尤其是带有可能致死的{#1}流血{/#1}等状态者；三方混战中，她们也更偏好弟兄，而非友军。她们会避开拥有{#2}不屈{/#2}的弟兄，即便该技能尚未启用；也会避开低等级、护甲差的弟兄。{#3}挑衅{/#3}会迫使女巫对挑衅者施放咒缚。她们只有在认为自己有危险时才会施放咒缚，而且即使如此也未必会施放。

units.source: Their allies get +20 resolve from the fake charmed status. Some of them guard Hexen, staying near them.
units.zh: 女巫的盟友带有一个用于表现受魅惑的状态，因此获得+20意志。其中部分会留在女巫附近保护她们。

units.source: {#1}Fleeing{/#1} Hexen don't actually flee, probably due to a bug. One brother standing near them is enough to prevent rallying, as long as he isn't {#2}charmed{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}溃逃{/#1}的女巫实际上不会逃跑，可能是程序错误。只要一名未被{#2}魅惑{/#2}的弟兄站在她身旁，就足以阻止她恢复士气。

units.source: They seem to have 8 vision instead of 7 that units have normally.
units.zh: 女巫的视野似乎是8格，而普通单位通常为7格。

units.source: Aggressive strategies don't work well because you will be destroyed by your own damage dealers. Don't bring dangerous weapons unless you know what you are doing.
units.zh: 主动猛攻的效果不佳，因为己方的输出手被控制后可能摧毁整支队伍。除非有把握应对，否则不要携带杀伤力过高的武器。

units.source: Good resolve is essential to operate in Charm range.
units.zh: 要在魅惑范围内行动，较高的意志至关重要。

units.source: Stand in your {#1}banner{/#1}'s resolve aura to resist their Charm.
units.zh: 站在{#1}战旗{/#1}的意志光环范围内，以提高抵抗魅惑的机会。

units.source: Sniping Hexen can win a fight quickly, but is unreliable as you can miss or a Hexe can {#1}hide{/#1} in a bush.
units.zh: 远程狙杀女巫可以迅速结束战斗，但不够可靠：攻击可能落空，女巫也可能{#1}躲在{/#1}灌木丛中。

units.source: Any third party, including your {#1}dogs{/#1}, will attack charmed brothers and does not care about Hex.
units.zh: 任何第三方单位，包括你的{#1}犬只{/#1}，都会攻击被魅惑的弟兄，也不会顾忌咒缚的后果。

units.source: If you are faster than her, spending AP and waiting negates one turn of Charm.
units.zh: 如果你的行动顺序早于女巫，可先消耗行动点再选择等待，从而抵消魅惑中的一个回合。

units.source: {#1}Stun{/#1} them to stop spellcasting. {#2}Knock Back{/#2} with shields to inflict fatigue.
units.zh: 用{#1}眩晕{/#1}阻止女巫施法，或用盾牌{#2}击退{/#2}来增加她的疲劳。

units.source: Control charmed brothers by stunning and {#1}disarming{/#1}. However you can miss and sometimes turn order doesn't allow to do it.
units.zh: 可以通过眩晕或{#1}缴械{/#1}控制被魅惑的弟兄。不过，这些攻击可能落空，行动顺序有时也不允许及时出手。

units.source: Charm is a mental attack, so {#1}Witchhunters{/#1}, {#2}Undead Trophy{/#2}, {#3}Protective Runes and Sigils{/#3} and {#4}Mad{/#4} trait are effective against it.
units.zh: 魅惑属于精神攻击，因此{#1}女巫猎人{/#1}、{#2}亡灵战利品项链{/#2}、{#3}护佑符文与法印{/#3}以及{#4}疯狂{/#4}特质都能有效抵抗。

units.source: There is a common misconception that {#1}Eunuchs{/#1} and {#2}Player Character{/#2} have immunity to Charm. It isn't true for the vanilla game.
units.zh: 有人误以为{#1}阉人{/#1}和{#2}玩家角色{/#2}免疫魅惑；在原版游戏中并非如此。

units.source: {#1}Nine Lives{/#1} works against Hex damage. {#2}Indomitable{/#2} too, but the brother is unlikely to be targeted without {#3}Taunt{/#3}.
units.zh: {#1}九命{/#1}可以应对咒缚伤害。{#2}不屈{/#2}也有效，但如果不用{#3}挑衅{/#3}，这名弟兄通常不会成为咒缚目标。

units.source: Charmed ranged brothers can't attack in a zone of control, except when their {#1}crossbow{/#1} is loaded. {#2}Whips{/#2} are harmless in hands of a charmed brother as they do almost nothing against armor.
units.zh: 被魅惑的远程弟兄无法在敌方控制区内攻击，唯一的例外是已经装填好的{#1}弩{/#1}。{#2}鞭子{/#2}几乎无法伤害护甲，因此在被魅惑的弟兄手中威胁很小。

units.source: The {#1}Firstborn{/#1} is immune to charm and you can give him a weapon.
units.zh: {#1}长子{/#1}免疫魅惑，你可以给他装备武器。

units.source: If you are facing them in the early game, without decent resolve, keep some distance between brothers. When charmed, their zone of control won't instantly lock down anyone, and they will spend turns moving instead of attacking.
units.zh: 如果前期意志还不够高就遭遇女巫，应让弟兄之间保持一些距离。这样即使有人被魅惑，也不会立刻用控制区锁住其他人，而且会花回合移动，而不是攻击。

units.source: {#1}Nightmare{/#1} does 25 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage - 25% of your current {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, will at least do 5 {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} damage, ignores armor, never misses, can only be used on sleeping brothers and will wake them up (has a range of 2 tiles)

{#1}Sleep{/#1} attempts to put a brother to sleep, sleep is like a stun but the brother can be woken up by other brothers or rally the troops skill, can be resisted with a {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} check, after 3 turns the brother will wake up on his own (has a range of 2 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}沉睡{/#1}尝试使一名弟兄沉睡。沉睡类似眩晕，但其他弟兄或重振士气技能可以将其唤醒；可通过{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}检定抵抗。3回合后，弟兄会自行醒来。射程为2格。

units.source: Alp is a nighttime enemy from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 梦魇是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营中在夜间出现的敌人。

units.source: Alps spawn everywhere, except forests, swamps, hills and mountains. They can also be encountered in {#1}Ending the Nightmare{/#1} contracts, that appear in villages except forest ones.
units.zh: 梦魇会出现在森林、沼泽、丘陵和山地以外的地区。非森林村庄提供的{#1}终结噩梦{/#1}委托中也可能遇到它们。

units.source: {#1}Existing Partly in Dreams{/#1} {#2}Alps{/#2} take only 10% damage from bows, 25% damage from javelins, 33% damage from crossbows, slings and dog bites, 50% from other piercing attacks and handgonnes.
units.zh: {#1}半身入梦{/#1}：{#2}梦魇{/#2}受到的弓箭伤害只有10%，标枪伤害为25%，弩、投石索和犬只撕咬的伤害为33%，其他穿刺攻击与手铳的伤害为50%。

units.source: {#1}Fade{/#1} teleports all alps to another tile after one took damage (the tile will be within 2 tiles of your brothers)
units.zh: {#1}遁隐{/#1}会在一只梦魇受伤后，将所有梦魇传送到其他格子；落点位于弟兄周围2格内。

units.source: A {#1}Parched Skin{/#1} (40% chance), {#2}Third Eye{/#2} (40% chance) or {#3}Petrified Scream{/#3} (20% chance).
A {#1}Parched Skin{/#1} (40% chance), {#2}Third Eye{/#2} (40% chance) or {#3}Petrified Scream{/#3} (20% chance). 50% chance of another, rolling separately.
units.zh: {#1}干枯皮肤{/#1}（40%概率）、{#2}第三只眼{/#2}（40%概率）或{#3}凝固的尖啸{/#3}（20%概率）。另有50%概率额外掉落一件，种类独立判定。

units.source: Alp groups are only visible and interactable at night. Sometimes there are {#1}Direwolves{/#1} alongside them, including {#2}Frenzied{/#2} ones.
units.zh: 梦魇队伍只有在夜间才可见并能与之互动。有时它们还会伴随{#1}恐狼{/#1}，其中也可能有{#2}狂暴恐狼{/#2}。

units.source: Alps fight by first putting their enemies to sleep and then casting nightmares, dealing damage and waking them up. You can wake up an ally for 4 AP, and {#1}Rally the Troops{/#1} wakes up everyone in its range.
units.zh: 梦魇会先让敌人沉睡，再施放梦魇攻击，造成伤害并将其惊醒。你可以花费4行动点唤醒一名友军；{#1}重振士气{/#1}则会唤醒范围内所有人。

units.source: When one Alp takes damage, they all teleport to tiles one empty space away from you. They have no zone of control, and are unable to break free from {#1}nets{/#1}, and can't even teleport when caught.
units.zh: 一只梦魇受到伤害时，所有梦魇都会传送到与你相隔一个空格的位置。它们没有控制区，无法挣脱{#1}投网{/#1}；被网住时甚至无法传送。

units.source: {#1}Fleeing{/#1} Alps don't actually flee, probably due to a bug. One brother standing near them is enough to prevent rallying, as long as he isn't {#2}sleeping{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}溃逃{/#1}的梦魇实际上不会逃跑，可能是程序错误。只要一名没有{#2}沉睡{/#2}的弟兄站在它身旁，就足以阻止它恢复士气。

units.source: Alps can stunlock an already sleeping brother, using Nightmare then Sleep. They don't actively try to do it though.
units.zh: 梦魇可以先对沉睡的弟兄使用梦魇攻击，再施放沉睡，使其持续无法行动。不过，它们并不会主动追求这种连招。

units.source: Don't hurry to attack the first Alp you see. They will all teleport and attack you instead of spending all AP on movement.
units.zh: 不要急着攻击最先看到的梦魇，否则它们会全部传送过来直接攻击，而不必把行动点花在移动上。

units.source: Prefer blunt and slashing damage. {#1}Ranged weapons{/#1} are not recommended due to resistance and Nighttime.
units.zh: 优先使用钝击或斩击伤害。由于梦魇的抗性和夜间惩罚，不推荐使用{#1}远程武器{/#1}。

units.source: Stand in your {#1}banner{/#1}'s resolve aura to resist their attacks and be affected by {#2}Rally the Troops{/#2}.
units.zh: 站在{#1}战旗{/#1}的意志光环范围内，以提高抵抗攻击的机会，同时确保自己能受到{#2}重振士气{/#2}影响。

units.source: Their attacks are mental, so {#1}Witchhunters{/#1}, {#2}Undead Trophy{/#2}, {#3}Protective Runes and Sigils{/#3} and {#4}Mad{/#4} trait are effective against it.
units.zh: 梦魇的攻击属于精神攻击，因此{#1}女巫猎人{/#1}、{#2}亡灵战利品项链{/#2}、{#3}护佑符文与法印{/#3}以及{#4}疯狂{/#4}特质都能有效抵抗。

units.source: Lack of zone of control allows you to step back if you miss and have enough AP.
units.zh: 梦魇没有控制区，因此如果攻击落空且行动点足够，可以后退一步。

units.source: They can't teleport if {#1}stunned{/#1}, fleeing or caught in net.
units.zh: 梦魇在{#1}眩晕{/#1}、溃逃或被网投住时无法传送。

units.source: Alps' inability to break free makes {#1}nets{/#1} extremely useful. Have some in your inventory in the early game to make easy money on an occational Alp contract.
units.zh: 梦魇无法挣脱束缚，因此{#1}投网{/#1}极为有效。前期可在行囊中准备一些，遇到梦魇委托时便能轻松赚取报酬。

units.source: Alps' attacks deal direct damage to HP, so fighting them without body armor/helmets/shields can help you reduce the penalty to your soldiers' initiative and maximum fatigue. But beware: they can be accompanied by (Frenzied) Direwolves.
units.zh: 梦魇的攻击直接伤害生命值，因此脱下盔甲、头盔和盾牌作战，可以减少这些装备对先攻与疲劳上限的惩罚。不过要小心：梦魇可能与狂暴恐狼或普通恐狼同行。

units.source: {#1}Devour{/#1} instantly kills the brother if you end your turn next to the mouth
units.zh: {#1}吞噬{/#1}：如果弟兄在巨口旁结束回合，就会被立即杀死。

units.source: {#1}Ensnare:{/#1} You are rooted, can't move, unable to use skills and are dragged towards its maw - You can be dragged by up to 6 tiles - Your chance to break free is your {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} + 10 for each previous try - You also lose 10 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} at the end of your turn - You have {#8}-100{/#8} {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} while you are rooted - Removing the ensnare will damage the tentacle (has a range of 2 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}缠缚：{/#1}目标被定身，无法移动或使用技能，并被拖向巨口，最多可被拖行6格。挣脱概率为你的{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}，此前每次尝试再提供+10加成。回合结束时还会损失10{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}。被缠住期间，{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9}修正为{#8}-100{/#8}。解除缠缚会伤害触手。射程为2格。

units.source: {#1}Move Tentacle{/#1} teleports the tentacle to another tile (has a range of 8 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}移动触手{/#1}将触手传送到另一个格子，射程为8格。

units.source: Kraken is the boss of the {#1}Stone Pillars{/#1} legendary location. Its tentacles are called Irrlichts.
units.zh: 克拉肯是传奇地点{#1}石柱群{/#1}的首领。它的触手名为伊尔利希特。

units.source: After you defeat the first Kraken, others can sometimes spawn in swamps and remain there stationary.
units.zh: 击败首只克拉肯后，其他克拉肯有时会出现在沼泽中，并停留在原地。

units.source: Kraken fight has two phases. In the first phase tentacles always try to grab brothers and drag them to the head, which has a guaranteed instant kill attack hitting all tiles adjacent to it. Entangled brothers are dragged at the start of their turn. Tentacles respawn when killed, and Kraken takes HP damage, 190 initially, but decreases by 5 with each tentacle to a minimum of 35.
units.zh: 克拉肯战有两个阶段。第一阶段，触手总会尝试抓住弟兄并将其拖向头部；头部能发动必定秒杀的攻击，波及周围所有相邻格。被缠住的弟兄会在自己的回合开始时被拖行。触手被杀死后会重新生成，同时克拉肯损失生命值。每根触手最初造成190点伤害，此后每击杀一根，伤害就减少5点，最低为35点。

units.source: The second phase begins when its HP drops below half, or when six tentacles die. Tentacles gain a high damage bite attack, but sometimes will still entangle, and they begin to deal 10-15 HP damage to entangled characters. In this phase, as the Kraken's HP lowers, so does the number of tentacles. Kraken loses one tentacle at each of 43,75%, 37,5%, 31,25% and 25% HP thresholds.
units.zh: 克拉肯生命值降至一半以下，或六根触手死亡后，战斗进入第二阶段。触手获得伤害很高的撕咬攻击，但有时仍会缠住目标，并开始对被缠住的角色造成10-15点生命值伤害。此阶段，触手数量也会随着克拉肯生命值下降而减少：生命值分别降至43,75%、37,5%、31,25%和25%时，各失去一根触手。

units.source: Breaking free from tentacles is similar to nets. Successfully disentangling damages the tentacle for 15-30 damage, but leaves it with at least 25 HP.
units.zh: 挣脱触手与挣脱投网类似。成功解除缠缚会对触手造成15-30点伤害，但至少会为其留下25点生命值。

units.source: Kraken head and its tentacles are not affected by {#1}morale{/#1} and have no zone of control. Body hits that Kraken head takes are redirected to the head.
units.zh: 克拉肯头部和触手不受{#1}士气{/#1}影响，也没有控制区。对克拉肯头部作出的躯干命中会转为头部命中。

units.source: High melee skill is good to have because it is required to disentangle and tentacles are somewhat evasive.
units.zh: 解除缠缚需要近战命中检定，而且触手有一定闪避能力，因此较高的近战命中很有帮助。

units.source: Fatigue management is important in this fight. {#1}Pathfinder{/#1} and {#2}Recover{/#2} are recommended. You also may consider using {#3}Second Wind Potions{/#3}.
units.zh: 这场战斗中，管理疲劳非常重要。推荐{#1}寻路者{/#1}和{#2}恢复体力{/#2}，也可考虑使用{#3}回气药剂{/#3}。

units.source: {#1}Goblin Trophy{/#1} gives immunity to tentacle grab. This allows to play following tactics.
units.zh: {#1}地精战利品项链{/#1}可使佩戴者免疫触手抓取，因此能采用以下战术。

units.source: Attacking the head until second phase and finishing it more quickly.
units.zh: 直接攻击头部，尽快进入第二阶段并结束战斗。

units.source: {#1}Hiding{/#1} everyone else in bushes and luring tentacles to the corner of the map, then beating the head.
units.zh: 让其他所有人{#1}藏在{/#1}灌木丛中，将触手引到地图角落，然后攻击头部。

units.source: Deploying a single brother with {#1}Lone Wolf{/#1}, {#2}Polehammer{/#2} and {#3}Swordlance{/#3}, damaging tentacles and the head, recovering fatigue and then killing all tentacles for massive damage to Kraken.
units.zh: 只派出一名拥有{#1}孤狼{/#1}、携带{#2}长柄战锤{/#2}和{#3}长柄剑刃{/#3}的弟兄，先打伤触手和头部，恢复体力，再杀死所有触手，对克拉肯造成大量伤害。

units.source: {#1}Oathtakers{/#1} don't have Goblin Trophy but some oaths like Oath of Dominion can be useful in this battle.
units.zh: {#1}立誓者{/#1}没有地精战利品项链，但统御之誓等部分誓言可以在这场战斗中发挥作用。

units.source: If you are fighting fairly without Goblin Trophy, it's too risky to approach the head. Kraken can be killed with tentacle damage alone.
units.zh: 如果没有地精战利品项链、准备正面作战，接近头部会非常危险。仅靠击杀触手造成的伤害也能杀死克拉肯。

units.source: 6 AP weapons don't pair well with 4 AP breaking free.
units.zh: 耗费6行动点的武器难以与耗费4行动点的挣脱动作兼顾。

units.source: Polehammer is the best weapon for breaking its armor. Lack of zone of control makes it possible to use {#1}cleavers{/#1}' {#2}Decapitate{/#2} on wounded Kraken and step back to safety.
units.zh: 长柄锤最适合破坏克拉肯的护甲。它没有控制区，因此可用{#1}斩刀{/#1}的{#2}斩首{/#2}攻击受伤的克拉肯，再退回安全位置。

units.source: Try to hold a piece of dry land surrounded by a swamp. {#1}Swamp debuffs stats{/#1}, including those of tentacles. If adjacent to swamp, brothers will sometimes throw tentacles into it after disentangling.
units.zh: 尽量占据一片被沼泽包围的干地。{#1}沼泽会降低属性{/#1}，触手也不例外。弟兄若与沼泽相邻，成功挣脱后有时会将触手甩进沼泽。

units.source: Enraged tentacles hit very hard. Control them by {#1}stunning{/#1} or {#2}taunting{/#2}.
units.zh: 狂怒触手的伤害很高，可以用{#1}眩晕{/#1}或{#2}挑衅{/#2}控制它们。

units.source: {#1}Bandages{/#1} can always be used because tentacles have no zone of control. {#2}Nine Lives{/#2} protects against both heavy hits and {#3}bleeding{/#3}.
units.zh: 由于触手没有控制区，随时都能使用{#1}绷带{/#1}。{#2}九命{/#2}既能防止被重击杀死，也能防止死于{#3}流血{/#3}。

units.source: Hide wounded brothers in bushes to keep them alive.
units.zh: 将受伤的弟兄藏进灌木丛，保护他们活下来。

units.source: Krakens generate with the following names, however the first one is always named Beast of Beasts.
units.zh: 克拉肯会使用以下随机名字，但首只克拉肯始终名为“万兽之王”。

units.source: Brigand Thug is a weak enemy from the {#1}Brigands{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 强盗打手是{#1}强盗{/#1}阵营中较弱的敌人。

units.source: 10/11 chance of a {#1}Shortsword{/#1}, {#2}Hatchet{/#2}, {#3}Militia Spear{/#3}, {#4}Bludgeon{/#4}, {#5}Wooden Stick{/#5}, {#6}Reinforced Wooden Flail{/#6}, {#7}Wooden Flail{/#7}, {#8}Butcher's Cleaver{/#8}, {#9}Pickaxe{/#9} or {#10}Dagger{/#10}.

A {#1}Blotched Gambeson{/#1} (70), {#2}Gambeson{/#2} (65), {#3}Rugged Surcoat{/#3} (55), {#4}Padded Surcoat{/#4} (50), {#5}Thick Tunic{/#5} (35), {#6}Leather Tunic{/#6} (30), {#7}Leather Wraps{/#7} (20), {#8}Monk's Robe{/#8} (20) or {#9}Tattered Sackcloth{/#9} (5).
50% chance of a {#1}Full Leather Cap{/#1} (45), {#2}Open Leather Cap{/#2} (40), {#3}Aketon Cap{/#3} (40), {#4}Hood{/#4} (30), {#5}Headscarf{/#5} (20) or {#6}Mouthpiece{/#6} (10).
Early game enemy, probably the first one you face.
units.zh: 这是前期敌人，很可能也是你最先面对的敌人。

units.source: Wear {#1}hats{/#1} and light (~80) {#2}armor{/#2} to avoid casualties, early {#3}injuries{/#3} and {#4}morale{/#4} drops.
units.zh: 佩戴{#1}头部防具{/#1}并穿上轻型{#2}护甲{/#2}（耐久约80），以避免伤亡、早期{#3}伤势{/#3}和{#4}士气{/#4}下降。

units.source: {#1}Spearwall{/#1}, while fatiguing, can delay their advance, allowing you to shoot.
units.zh: {#1}矛墙{/#1}虽然消耗体力，却能拖延敌人接近，为远程射击争取时间。

units.source: Use {#1}shields{/#1} to reduce the chance of being hit.
units.zh: 使用{#1}盾牌{/#1}可以降低被命中的概率。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
Brigand Poacher is the weak ranged enemy from the {#1}Brigands{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 强盗猎手是{#1}强盗{/#1}阵营中较弱的远程敌人。

units.source: However they still sometimes hit your backliners. Protect them accordingly.
units.zh: 不过，他们有时仍会命中你的后排，应做好相应保护。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
Brigand Raider is the most common enemy from the {#1}Brigands{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 强盗劫掠者是{#1}强盗{/#1}阵营中最常见的敌人。

units.source: 25% chance of a {#1}Woodcutter's Axe{/#1}, {#2}Two-Handed Mallet{/#2}, {#3}Hooked Blade{/#3} or {#4}Pike{/#4}.
75% chance of a {#1}Boar Spear{/#1}, {#2}Flail{/#2}, {#3}Handaxe{/#3}, {#4}Morning Star{/#4}, {#5}Falchion{/#5} or {#6}Shortsword{/#6}.
If the weapon's range is 1, 25% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#1} or {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2}.
units.zh: 若武器射程为1格，则有25%概率携带{#1}飞斧束{/#1}或{#2}标枪束{/#2}。

units.source: A {#1}Worn Mail Shirt{/#1} (110), {#2}Leather Lamellar Armor{/#2} (95), {#3}Patched Mail Shirt{/#3} (90), {#4}Padded Leather{/#4} (80) or {#5}Rugged Surcoat{/#5} (55).
75% chance of a {#1}Padded Dented Nasal Helmet{/#1} (110), {#2}Nasal Helmet{/#2} (105), {#3}Rusty Mail Coif{/#3} (70) or {#4}Headscarf{/#4} (20).
66% chance of a shield: {#1}Wooden Shield{/#1} (67% chance) or {#2}Buckler{/#2} (33% chance).

20% chance of a {#1}Woodcutter's Axe{/#1}, {#2}Longaxe{/#2}, {#3}Two-Handed Mallet{/#3}, {#4}Two-Handed Mace{/#4}, {#5}Two-Handed Wooden Flail{/#5}, {#6}Longsword{/#6}, {#7}Warbrand{/#7}, {#8}Hooked Blade{/#8} or {#9}Pike{/#9}.

80% chance of a {#1}Arming Sword{/#1}, {#2}Military Pick{/#2}, {#3}Scramasax{/#3}, {#4}Boar Spear{/#4}, {#5}Flail{/#5}, {#6}Handaxe{/#6}, {#7}Morning Star{/#7}, {#8}Falchion{/#8} or {#9}Shortsword{/#9}.
If the weapon's range is 1, 35% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#1}, {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2} or {#3}Throwing Spear{/#3}.
A {#1}Worn Mail Shirt{/#1} (110) (double chance), {#2}Patched Mail Shirt{/#2} (90) (double chance), {#3}Padded Leather{/#3} (80) or {#4}Rugged Surcoat{/#4} (55).
85% chance of a {#1}Nasal Helmet with Rusty Mail{/#1} (140), {#2}Padded Dented Nasal Helmet{/#2} (110), {#3}Nasal Helmet{/#3} (105), {#4}Rusty Mail Coif{/#4} (70), {#5}Headscarf{/#5} (20).
75% chance of a shield: {#1}Wooden Shield{/#1} (75% chance) or {#2}Kite Shield{/#2} (25% chance).
If armed with a long weapon like {#1}Pike{/#1} and there are no enemies nearby, they wait to not get ahead of their melee allies.
units.zh: 若装备{#1}长枪{/#1}等长柄武器，且附近没有敌人，他们会等待，以免走到近战同伴前面。

units.source: They can be dangerous in the early game, but can also drop good loot, especially armor.
units.zh: 前期的强盗劫掠者相当危险，但也可能掉落不错的战利品，尤其是护甲。

units.source: Surround them with dagger-wielding brothers and use {#1}Puncture{/#1} to acquire their armor in good condition. Do this when they start fleeing or there is only a few of them left.
units.zh: 用持匕首的弟兄包围敌人，再以{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}攻击，可以获得状态良好的护甲。应在敌人开始溃逃或只剩少数人时这样做。

units.source: Their switching to {#1}throwing weapons{/#1} can be a waste of action points, but also makes {#2}Spearwall{/#2} ineffective, and invites you to attack them on a high ground if they take it.
units.zh: 他们切换{#1}投掷武器{/#1}有时会浪费行动点，但也会让{#2}矛墙{/#2}失去作用；若他们占据高地，还会迫使你主动仰攻。

units.source: Durable {#1}helmets{/#1} are important to avoid a quick death from their {#2}flails{/#2} and two-handed weapons.
units.zh: 结实的{#1}头盔{/#1}非常重要，否则可能被他们的{#2}连枷{/#2}或双手武器迅速杀死。

units.source: They can hit backliners with throwing weapons. Protect them accordingly.
units.zh: 他们的投掷武器能命中后排，应做好相应保护。

units.source: Their helmets can be quite weak. Use {#1}flails{/#1} to hit their unprotected heads and loot the armor.
units.zh: 他们的头盔可能很薄弱。可以用{#1}连枷{/#1}攻击缺乏保护的头部，保留下护甲作为战利品。

units.source: {#1}Flail Mastery{/#1} is good to have as they usually have {#2}shields{/#2}.
units.zh: 他们通常持有{#2}盾牌{/#2}，因此{#1}连枷精通{/#1}很有用。

units.source: {#1}Axes{/#1} and two-handed weapons also do so but less reliably. See: {#2}Split Man mechanics{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}斧{/#1}和双手武器也能做到这一点，但不够稳定。详见{#2}劈身机制{/#2}。

units.source: When they are mixed with {#1}Thugs{/#1}, killing them first can easily break the Raider's morale.
units.zh: 如果敌人中混有{#1}强盗打手{/#1}，先杀死打手可以轻易击溃劫掠者的士气。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
Brigand Marksman is a ranged enemy from the {#1}Brigands{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 强盗射手是{#1}强盗{/#1}阵营中的远程敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Short Bow{/#1}, {#2}Hunting Bow{/#2}, {#3}Light Crossbow{/#3} or {#4}Crossbow{/#4}.
Has a {#1}Blotched Gambeson{/#1} (70), {#2}Padded Surcoat{/#2} (50), {#3}Thick Tunic{/#3} (35) or {#4}Leather Wraps{/#4} (20).
50% chance of a {#1}Full Leather Cap{/#1} (45), {#2}Open Leather Cap{/#2} (40), {#3}Hood{/#3} (30), {#4}Headscarf{/#4} (20) or {#5}Mouthpiece{/#5} (10).

Brigands will often have ranged superiority because of their many Marksmen, and when they do, they will just stand there and guard them and wait for you to come. It is however possible to sometimes see charging {#1}Raiders{/#1} or exposed Marksmen. Being a ranged units, they can target anyone they want and prefer to shoot at shieldless units or rookies, even when they are behind an obstacle.
units.zh: 强盗拥有大量射手时，通常会取得远程优势，随后原地保护射手，等你主动靠近。不过，有时仍会出现主动冲锋的{#1}劫掠者{/#1}或暴露的射手。作为远程单位，射手可以自由选择目标，偏好攻击不持盾的单位或新兵，即使这些目标位于障碍物后方。

units.source: In late game many Marksmen will hunt recruits you are trying to level-up, and are capable of killing them. Rookies should wear heavy {#1}armor{/#1} to reduce damage or not be in this fight at all.
units.zh: 后期的大量射手会专门攻击你正在培养的新兵，而且足以将其杀死。新兵应穿戴重型{#1}护甲{/#1}减伤，或干脆不参加这场战斗。

units.source: High ground makes them more dangerous, so be careful about terrain where you fight them.
units.zh: 高地会让射手更加危险，因此交战时要留意地形。

units.source: Use {#1}Kite Shields{/#1} and take {#2}Dodge{/#2} to reduce their chance to hit.
units.zh: 使用{#1}鸢形盾{/#1}并学习{#2}闪避{/#2}，可以降低射手的命中率。

units.source: Flanking can be effective if there are too few {#1}Raiders{/#1} to interfere.
units.zh: 如果{#1}劫掠者{/#1}数量不足以阻拦，包抄侧翼会很有效。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
Brigand Leader is an elite unit from the {#1}Brigands{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 强盗头目是{#1}强盗{/#1}阵营的精锐单位。

units.source: A {#1}Noble Sword{/#1}, {#2}Fighting Axe{/#2}, {#3}Warhammer{/#3}, {#4}Fighting Spear{/#4}, {#5}Winged Mace{/#5}, {#6}Military Cleaver{/#6}, {#7}Arming Sword{/#7}, {#8}Greataxe{/#8}, {#9}Greatsword{/#9} or {#10}Warbrand{/#10}.
35% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#1} or {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2}.

A {#1}Reinforced Mail Hauberk{/#1} (210), {#2}Footman's Armor{/#2} (190), {#3}Light Scale Armor{/#3} (170), {#4}Leather Scale Armor{/#4} (140), {#5}Mail Shirt{/#5} (130), {#6}Worn Mail Shirt{/#6} (110) or {#7}Patched Mail Shirt{/#7} (90).

A {#1}Kettle Hat with Closed Mail{/#1} (250), {#2}Flat Top with Mail{/#2} (230), {#3}Kettle Hat with Mail{/#3} (215), {#4}Bascinet with Mail{/#4} (210), {#5}Nasal Helmet with Mail{/#5} (200), {#6}Padded Flat Top Helmet{/#6} (150), {#7}Padded Kettle Hat{/#7} (140), {#8}Padded Nasal Helmet{/#8} (130) or {#9}Closed Mail Coif{/#9} (90).
If the weapon is one-handed, a {#1}Wooden Shield{/#1}, {#2}Kite Shield{/#2} or {#3}Heater Shield{/#3}.
units.zh: 若使用单手武器，则装备{#1}木盾{/#1}、{#2}鸢形盾{/#2}或{#3}熨斗形盾{/#3}。

units.source: {#1}Captain{/#1} is an aura that increases the {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} of other allies by +15% (range of 5 tiles)

Brigand Leaders start appearing in the middle game. Late game brigand groups usually have a Leader. It's rare to see simultaneously more than one. The Leader spawns in the very back and usually does not hurry to enter battle.
units.zh: 强盗头目从中期开始出现；后期的强盗队伍通常都会有一名头目，同时出现多名头目的情况很少见。头目生成在队伍最后方，通常不急于参战。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor if the risk is not too high.
units.zh: 如果风险不高，可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}夺取他的护甲。

units.source: They are easier source of good {#1}armor{/#1} and {#2}weapons{/#2} in comparison to other strong foes.
units.zh: 与其他强敌相比，头目是比较容易获取优质{#1}护甲{/#1}和{#2}武器{/#2}的目标。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
{#1}Barbarian Fury{/#1} allows two adjacent units to swap their place similar to the {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Rotation{/#5} perk. Cannot swap place with {#6}Unholds{/#6}.
Barbarian Thrall is a somewhat weak enemy from the {#1}Barbarians{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 蛮族奴兵是{#1}蛮族{/#1}阵营中较弱的敌人。

units.source: 40% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#1}, {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2} or {#3}Bundle of Crude Javelins{/#3}.
60% chance of an {#1}Animal Hide Armor{/#1} (45) or {#2}Thick Furs{/#2} (30).

Like all barbarians, they move forward and switch to {#1}throwing weapons{/#1} if they have them. They will use {#2}Adrenaline{/#2} to get ahead of the enemy if not already faster than them. They can {#3}rotate{/#3} with each other to save a wounded ally, attack someone vulnerable, or without a clear purpose.
units.zh: 与所有蛮族一样，奴兵会向前推进；若带有{#1}投掷武器{/#1}，就会切换使用。如果原本行动顺序不比敌人早，就会使用{#2}肾上腺素{/#2}抢先行动。他们可以相互{#3}换位{/#3}，用来救出受伤同伴、攻击脆弱目标，有时也看不出明确目的。

units.source: They can sometimes hit the head of your backliner with a {#1}crude javelin{/#1}. Protect brothers accordingly.
units.zh: 他们有时会用{#1}粗制标枪{/#1}命中后排弟兄的头部，应做好相应保护。

units.source: Barbarians with {#1}throwing weapons{/#1} won't charge into Spearwall, and can be problematic if they take a high ground.
units.zh: 持有{#1}投掷武器{/#1}的蛮族不会冲进矛墙；若占据高地，会更难处理。

units.source: Prioritize those who have {#1}Militia Spears{/#1} because they hit more often.
units.zh: 优先对付持有{#1}民兵矛{/#1}的奴兵，因为他们更容易命中。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
Barbarian Reaver is an enemy from the {#1}Barbarians{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 蛮族掠夺者是{#1}蛮族{/#1}阵营的敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Two-Handed Spiked Mace{/#1}, {#2}Two-Handed Skull Hammer{/#2}, {#3}Blunt Cleaver{/#3}, {#4}Crude Axe{/#4} or {#5}Axehammer{/#5}.
40% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Heavy Javelins{/#1}, {#2}Bundle of Heavy Throwing Axes{/#2} or {#3}Throwing Spear{/#3}.
A {#1}Hide and Bone Armor{/#1} (95), {#2}Scrap Metal Armor{/#2} (75) or {#3}Reinforced Animal Hide Armor{/#3} (65).
80% chance or a {#1}Crude Metal Helmet{/#1} (145), {#2}Leather Helmet{/#2} (105), {#3}Bear Headpiece{/#3} (50) or {#4}Leather Headband{/#4} (30).

Like all barbarians, they move forward and switch to {#1}throwing weapons{/#1} if they have them. They will use {#2}Adrenaline{/#2} to get ahead of the enemy if not already faster than them. Usually they wait after acting, and activate it at the very end. They can {#3}rotate{/#3} with each other to save a wounded ally, attack someone vulnerable, or without a clear purpose.
units.zh: 与所有蛮族一样，掠夺者会向前推进；若带有{#1}投掷武器{/#1}，就会切换使用。如果原本行动顺序不比敌人早，就会使用{#2}肾上腺素{/#2}抢先行动。他们通常在行动后选择等待，到回合末才启用此技能。他们可以相互{#3}换位{/#3}，用来救出受伤同伴、攻击脆弱目标，有时也看不出明确目的。

units.source: Their two-handed weapons can instantly kill without high HP or defensive {#1}perks{/#1} even through a helmet.
units.zh: 如果生命值不够高，又没有防御{#1}特长{/#1}，他们的双手武器即使隔着头盔也可能一击致命。

units.source: Their {#1}Hide and Bone Armor{/#1} is surprisingly good, having stats exactly like {#2}Leather Lamellar Armor{/#2}.
units.zh: 他们的{#1}骨饰兽皮甲{/#1}意外地不错，属性与{#2}皮札甲{/#2}完全相同。

units.source: Use {#1}flails{/#1} to hit their unprotected heads and loot the armor, however it may take a while due to their high HP.
units.zh: 用{#1}连枷{/#1}攻击缺乏保护的头部，可以保留下护甲作为战利品。不过他们生命值较高，可能要花一些时间。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor when fleeing, but they will rarely be due to high resolve.
units.zh: 敌人溃逃时可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}夺取护甲，不过他们意志很高，很少溃逃。

units.source: Use {#1}shields{/#1} and take {#2}Dodge{/#2} to reduce their chance to hit.
units.zh: 使用{#1}盾牌{/#1}并学习{#2}闪避{/#2}，可以降低被他们命中的概率。

units.source: They like to break shields, don't bring fragile shields you don't want to lose. {#1}Shield Expert{/#1} and extra shields can win more time.
units.zh: 他们喜欢破坏盾牌，因此不要携带不愿损失的脆弱盾牌。{#1}盾牌精通{/#1}和备用盾牌可以争取更多时间。

units.source: They are the only source of heavy throwing weapons.
units.zh: 他们是重型投掷武器的唯一来源。

units.source: If they waited, don't {#1}Taunt{/#1} or {#2}Disarm{/#2} them as the effect will instantly go away. {#3}Stun{/#3} goes away but prevents {#4}Adrenaline{/#4}.
units.zh: 如果敌人已经等待，不要对其使用{#1}挑衅{/#1}或{#2}缴械{/#2}，因为效果很快就会消失。{#3}眩晕{/#3}同样会消失，但能阻止其使用{#4}肾上腺素{/#4}。

units.source: Their throwing weapons can drop (90% chance) if above 0 ammo when held or above 0 but less than max ammo when in the bag.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1} If you are looking to loot their throwing weapons it is therefore best to either kill them with ranged brothers before they use up all their ammo or by letting them throw at least once before engaging with melee brothers, unless you can kill them before they switch to their melee weapon.
units.zh: 投掷武器若拿在手上，弹药大于0即可掉落；若放在背包中，则弹药必须大于0且低于最大值。满足条件时，掉落概率为90%。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}因此，若想获取投掷武器，最好让远程弟兄在敌人耗尽弹药前将其击杀，或等敌人至少投掷一次后再让近战弟兄接敌；除非你能在其切换近战武器前杀死他。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
Barbarian Chosen is a heavily armored elite enemy from the {#1}Barbarians{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 蛮族神选战士是{#1}蛮族{/#1}阵营中身披重甲的精锐敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Rusty Warblade{/#1}, {#2}Heavy Rusty Axe{/#2}, {#3}Two-Handed Skull Hammer{/#3} or {#4}Two-Handed Spiked Mace{/#4}.
A {#1}Thick Plated Barbarian Armor{/#1} (230), {#2}Heavy Iron Armor{/#2} (170) or {#3}Rugged Scale Armor{/#3} (140).
A {#1}Closed Scrap Metal Helmet{/#1} (190), {#2}Crude Faceguard Helmet{/#2} (160), {#3}Crude Metal Helmet{/#3} (145).

Like all barbarians, they move forward and attack the enemy. They will use {#1}Adrenaline{/#1} to get ahead of the enemy if not already faster than them. Usually they wait after acting, and activate it at the very end. They can {#2}rotate{/#2} with each other to save a wounded ally, attack someone vulnerable, or without a clear purpose.
units.zh: 与所有蛮族一样，神选战士会向前推进并攻击敌人。如果原本行动顺序不比敌人早，就会使用{#1}肾上腺素{/#1}抢先行动。他们通常在行动后选择等待，到回合末才启用此技能。他们可以相互{#2}换位{/#2}，用来救出受伤同伴、攻击脆弱目标，有时也看不出明确目的。

units.source: Late game enemy. You are supposed to fight them with a strong squad or allies.
units.zh: 这是后期敌人，应带上强大的队伍，或与友军一起对付他们。

units.source: When they are mixed with {#1}Reavers{/#1}, kill Reavers with two-handed weapons first as they pose similar threat but are easier to kill.
units.zh: 如果队伍中混有{#1}蛮族掠夺者{/#1}，应先杀持双手武器的掠夺者：他们的威胁相近，却更容易杀死。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor it you can reliably stun or disarm them.
units.zh: 如果能稳定地眩晕或缴械敌人，可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}夺取他的护甲。

units.source: If they waited, don't {#1}Taunt{/#1} or Disarm them as the effect will instantly go away. Stun goes away but prevents {#2}Adrenaline{/#2}.
units.zh: 如果敌人已经等待，不要对其使用{#1}挑衅{/#1}或缴械，因为效果很快就会消失。眩晕同样会消失，但能阻止其使用{#2}肾上腺素{/#2}。

units.source: While a {#1}net{/#1} doesn't do much, breaking free makes them unable to attack with a 6 AP weapon.
units.zh: {#1}投网{/#1}虽然无法限制太久，但挣脱会使敌人没有足够行动点使用耗费6行动点的武器。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
Barbarian King is a dangerous, heavily armored elite enemy from the {#1}Barbarians{/#1} faction, encountered in a contract to hunt him.
units.zh: 蛮族之王是{#1}蛮族{/#1}阵营中危险的重甲精锐敌人，只在猎杀他的委托中出现。

units.source: A {#1}Thick Plated Barbarian Armor{/#1} (230) with a {#2}Horn and Bone{/#2} attachment (40).

Barbarian Kings only appear in contracts to hunt them. Their warbands are visible from twice the usual distance. Only one King will be in it. If attacked by a stronger non-player squad on the world map, the King always survives by the virtue of having plot armor, defeating the enemy army alone. The contract of course becomes much easier in this case.
units.zh: 蛮族之王只在猎杀他的委托中出现。他的战团在通常视野距离的两倍处即可被发现，每支战团仅有一名蛮族之王。如果世界地图上有更强的非玩家队伍攻击他们，蛮族之王会凭借剧情保护始终存活，独自击败整支敌军。这样一来，委托自然就容易得多。

units.source: Like all barbarians, he moves forward and attacks the enemy. He will use {#1}Adrenaline{/#1} to get ahead of the enemy if not already faster than them. Usually he waits after acting, and activates it at the very end. He can {#2}rotate{/#2} with other barbarians to save a wounded ally, attack someone vulnerable, or without a clear purpose.
units.zh: 与所有蛮族一样，蛮族之王会向前推进并攻击敌人。如果原本行动顺序不比敌人早，就会使用{#1}肾上腺素{/#1}抢先行动。他通常在行动后选择等待，到回合末才启用此技能。他可以与其他蛮族{#2}换位{/#2}，用来救出受伤同伴、攻击脆弱目标，有时也看不出明确目的。

units.source: If he escapes, the contract does not fail and continues as if you have killed him, including bringing his head to the nobleman.
units.zh: 即便蛮族之王逃跑，委托也不会失败，而是按你已将其杀死继续进行，甚至包括把他的首级交给贵族。

units.source: Is like a heavier version of {#1}Chosen{/#1}, so all advice about them also applies here.
units.zh: 他相当于更强壮的{#1}神选战士{/#1}，因此针对神选战士的建议也适用。

units.source: There is only one King per squad, and in the middle game he will be accompanied by weak {#1}Thralls{/#1} or {#2}Reavers{/#2}, so you will have easier time {#3}stunning{/#3} or {#4}disarming{/#4} him.
units.zh: 每支队伍只有一名蛮族之王，中期还会由较弱的{#1}奴兵{/#1}或{#2}掠夺者{/#2}陪同，因此你更容易集中力量将他{#3}眩晕{/#3}或{#4}缴械{/#4}。
