units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
Barbarian Madman is the boss of the {#1}Icy Cave{/#1} {#2}legendary location{/#2}.
units.zh: 蛮族疯汉是{#2}传奇地点{/#2}{#1}冰洞{/#1}的首领。

units.source: {#1}Ijirok Regeneration{/#1} will heal for 6% of their max {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} at the start of each turn

You must fight him one on one. The game lets you choose one of four most experienced brothers who are not currently in reserve. Unlike most enemies, he prioritizes attacking a {#1}dog{/#1} over a brother. He is excluded from {#2}morale{/#2} checks.
units.zh: 你必须与他单挑。游戏允许你从当前不在预备队中、经验最高的四名弟兄里选择一人。与大多数敌人不同，他会优先攻击{#1}犬只{/#1}而非弟兄。他也不会进行{#2}士气{/#2}检定。

units.source: His armor does not drop. You always receive {#1}Broken Ritual Armor{/#1} no matter what.
units.zh: 他的护甲不会掉落；无论如何，你得到的都是{#1}破损的仪式护甲{/#1}。

units.source: His token's base is the one used for {#1}beasts{/#1}, and battle with him counts as battle with beasts.
units.zh: 他的单位底座使用{#1}野兽{/#1}样式，与他的战斗也算作对抗野兽。

units.source: This fight is especially random and can kill a high-level brother with bad enough luck.
units.zh: 这场战斗尤其依赖运气；只要运气足够差，高等级弟兄也可能被杀。

units.source: Popular weapon choices against him are {#1}two-handed hammers{/#1}, {#2}throwing weapons{/#2} and hard-hitting {#3}named{/#3} two-handed weapons.
units.zh: 常见的应对武器包括{#1}双手锤{/#1}、{#2}投掷武器{/#2}以及伤害很高的{#3}名贵{/#3}双手武器。

units.source: {#1}Nets{/#1} and an armored {#2}dog{/#2} distract him for a while, winning time.
units.zh: {#1}投网{/#1}和披甲{#2}犬只{/#2}可以暂时分散他的注意力，为你争取时间。

units.source: Being unaffected by {#1}morale{/#1}, he does not gain confidence after killing a dog.
units.zh: 由于他不受{#1}士气{/#1}影响，杀死犬只后也不会变得斗志昂扬。

units.source: The {#1}named cleaver{/#1} he wields is more dangerous to {#2}Nimble{/#2} than to {#3}Battle Forged{/#3} brothers.
units.zh: 他手中的{#1}名贵斩刀{/#1}对{#2}轻灵{/#2}弟兄的威胁高于对{#3}久经战阵{/#3}弟兄。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
{#1}Drums of War{/#1} will reduce the {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} of his mates by {#5}10{/#5}
Barbarian Drummer is a specialist from the {#1}Barbarians{/#1} faction. He reduces fatigue that other barbarians accumulate.
units.zh: 蛮族鼓手是{#1}蛮族{/#1}阵营的特殊单位，可以减少其他蛮族积累的疲劳。

units.source: A {#1}Reinforced Animal Hide Armor{/#1} (65), {#2}Animal Hide Armor{/#2} (45) or {#3}Thick Furs{/#3} (30).

Drummers will always simply stand there and beat their drums. If engaged in melee, they, however, draw weapons and try to fight. Sometimes they continue to beat drums even with melee attackers next to them.
units.zh: 鼓手通常只会原地击鼓。被近战接敌后，他们会拔出武器尝试还击；不过，有时即便敌人已经贴身，他们仍会继续击鼓。

units.source: This enemy only reduces fatigue of other barbarians. Barbarians already have a high fatigue limit and almost never reach it, and especially it isn't happening instantly when Drummers are killed, so it's better to simply ignore them.
units.zh: 鼓手的作用仅是降低其他蛮族的疲劳。蛮族本就有很高的疲劳上限，几乎不会达到上限；更不会在鼓手死后立刻满疲劳，因此通常直接忽略鼓手更好。

units.source: Don't let them escape because they are worth XP.
units.zh: 不要让鼓手逃跑，击杀他们也能获得经验。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
{#1}Crack the Whip{/#1} is used to keep their {#2}Armored Unholds{/#2} and {#3}Armored Frost Unholds{/#3} under control
Barbarian Beasmaster is a specialist from the {#1}Barbarians{/#1} faction, who controls {#2}Armored Unholds{/#2}.
units.zh: 蛮族驯兽师是{#1}蛮族{/#1}阵营的特殊单位，负责控制{#2}披甲巨魔{/#2}。

units.source: The main job of Beastmasters is controlling {#1}Armored Unholds{/#1}. One use of Crack the Whip whips all Armored Unholds at once without range limit.
units.zh: 驯兽师的主要职责是控制{#1}披甲巨魔{/#1}。使用一次挥鞭驱策就能同时鞭策所有披甲巨魔，没有距离限制。

units.source: Beastmasters may approach under protection of other barbarians and Unholds, and use their {#1}whips{/#1} against you directly.
units.zh: 驯兽师可能在其他蛮族和巨魔的保护下靠近，直接用{#1}鞭子{/#1}攻击你。

units.source: They can't destroy armor or hurt through it. However they try to use {#1}Disarm{/#1} or attack someone whose armor got destroyed in a range of 3 tiles.
units.zh: 鞭子无法破坏护甲，也无法穿透护甲造成伤害。不过，驯兽师会尝试对3格范围内的目标使用{#1}缴械{/#1}，或攻击护甲已经被摧毁的人。

units.source: If not whipped, an {#1}Armored Unhold{/#1} has a 33% chance to turn wild at the start of its turn.
units.zh: 如果没有受到鞭策，{#1}披甲巨魔{/#1}会在自身回合开始时有33%概率失控。

units.source: Uncontrolled Armored Unholds are hostile to barbarians and controlled Armored Unholds, but not to each other.
units.zh: 失控的披甲巨魔会敌视蛮族和仍受控制的披甲巨魔，但彼此之间不会敌对。

units.source: Whipped Armored Unholds still retain their wild status until their next turn (verify?).
units.zh: 失控的披甲巨魔即便受到鞭策，也会维持失控状态直到下一回合（原文标注：待核实）。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
Billman is a backline melee unit from the {#1}Noble{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 钩镰枪兵是{#1}贵族{/#1}阵营的后排近战单位。

units.source: A {#1}Mail Shirt{/#1} (130), {#2}Basic Mail Shirt{/#2} (115), {#3}Gambeson{/#3} (65) or {#4}Padded Surcoat{/#4} (50).
50% chance of depending on the banner of their noble house:
units.zh: 有50%概率根据所属贵族家族的旗帜装备以下物品：

units.source: 50% chance of a {#1}Full Aketon Cap{/#1} (50), {#2}Aketon Cap{/#2} (40) (double chance) or {#3}Headscarf{/#3} (20).

Usually Billmen fight from the backline as expected. However, they can sometimes expose themselves to ranged fire or flanking. They often spend a whole turn to take a position two tiles away from the enemy, preventing allies from attacking from there.
units.zh: 钩镰枪兵通常会在后排作战，但有时也会暴露在远程火力或侧翼攻击之下。他们经常花费整个回合移动到距敌人两格的位置，反而占住了友军可以攻击的位置。

units.source: Priority targets because of their threat, and usually vulnerable.
units.zh: 他们威胁很大，而且通常缺乏保护，应优先处理。

units.source: Reach weapons, {#1}Split{/#1} skill, {#2}Handgonnes{/#2} or ranged attacks with {#3}Bullseye{/#3} can take them out early.
units.zh: 长柄武器、{#1}劈开{/#1}技能、{#2}手铳{/#2}，或拥有{#3}鹰眼{/#3}的远程攻击，都能尽早击杀他们。

units.source: {#1}Footman{/#1} • {#2}Billman{/#2} • {#3}Arbalester{/#3} • {#4}Man at Arms{/#4} • {#5}Standard Bearer{/#5} • {#6}Sergeant{/#6} • {#7}Zweihander{/#7} • {#8}Knight{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Wardog{/#10} • {#11}Donkey{/#11}
Standard Bearer is a rallying unit from the {#1}Noble{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 旗手是{#1}贵族{/#1}阵营中负责重振士气的单位。

units.source: A {#1}Mail Hauberk{/#1} (150), {#2}Mail Shirt{/#2} (130) or {#3}Basic Mail Shirt{/#3} (115) (double chance).
90% chance of a helmet, depending on the banner of their noble house:
units.zh: 有90%概率根据所属贵族家族的旗帜装备以下头盔：

units.source: A rallying unit of the noble armies, Standard Bearer uses {#1}Rally the Troops{/#1} if he sees somewhere morale below steady. He usually stays in the back, but may approach like a {#2}Billman{/#2}. The battlefield is too large for him to rally everyone, but a squad can deploy more than one Standard Bearer. In this case they even can rally each other if one of them begins to waver.
units.zh: 旗手负责为贵族军队重振士气：只要发现有人士气低于镇定，就会使用{#1}重振士气{/#1}。他通常留在后排，但也可能像{#2}钩镰枪兵{/#2}一样靠近敌人。战场太大，单个旗手无法照顾所有人，不过一支队伍可以有多名旗手；其中有人动摇时，他们甚至能够互相重振士气。

units.source: Can be a problem if you rely on {#1}Fearsome{/#1}, otherwise they are weaker {#2}Billmen{/#2} that skip turns.
units.zh: 如果你的战术依赖{#1}威慑{/#1}，旗手可能很麻烦。否则，他们只是会跳过回合、实力更弱的{#2}钩镰枪兵{/#2}。

units.source: Ranged attacks with {#1}Bullseye{/#1} can take them out early.
units.zh: 拥有{#1}鹰眼{/#1}的远程攻击可以尽早击杀旗手。

units.source: {#1}Taunt{/#1} does not prevent them from using {#2}Rally the Troops{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}挑衅{/#1}无法阻止旗手使用{#2}重振士气{/#2}。

units.source: According to the datafiles, a Standard Bearer has {#1}Inspiring Presence{/#1}. However, it seems to not work in the actual game and is therefore unlisted from the Skills section and the Infobox on this page.
units.zh: 游戏数据文件显示旗手拥有{#1}领袖风范{/#1}，但它在实际游戏中似乎不起作用，因此本页技能列表和信息栏未列出该特长。

units.source: {#1}Footman{/#1} • {#2}Billman{/#2} • {#3}Arbalester{/#3} • {#4}Man at Arms{/#4} • {#5}Standard Bearer{/#5} • {#6}Sergeant{/#6} • {#7}Zweihander{/#7} • {#8}Knight{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Wardog{/#10} • {#11}Donkey{/#11}
Knight is a heavily armored elite unit from the {#1}Noble{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 骑士是{#1}贵族{/#1}阵营中身披重甲的精锐单位。

units.source: A {#1}Noble Sword{/#1}, {#2}Warhammer{/#2}, {#3}Winged Mace{/#3} or {#4}Fighting Axe{/#4}.
A {#1}Coat of Plates{/#1} (320), {#2}Coat of Scales{/#2} (300) or {#3}Reinforced Mail Hauberk{/#3} (210).
The armor has a 40% chance of {#1}Heraldic Shoulderguards{/#1} (40) (only houses with certain banners), {#2}Metal Joint Covers{/#2} (30) or a {#3}Mail Patch{/#3} (20) on it.
units.zh: 护甲有40%概率带有{#1}纹章护肩{/#1}（40，仅部分旗帜对应的家族）、{#2}金属关节护板{/#2}（30）或{#3}锁甲补片{/#3}（20）。

units.source: Knights fight aggressively, using special attacks until fatigued. Unlike what a human usually does, they can spend all AP to come into melee distance. They rarely shieldwall, instead striking twice or using a special attack. Even their {#1}shield{/#1} is used for offense, to {#2}knock{/#2} enemies from high ground for them to claim it.
units.zh: 骑士作战积极，会不断使用特殊攻击直到疲劳过高。与玩家通常的做法不同，他们可能花光全部行动点来进入近战距离。他们很少使用盾墙，而是攻击两次或使用特殊攻击。就连{#1}盾牌{/#1}也被用于进攻：把敌人从高地{#2}击退{/#2}，再自己占据高地。

units.source: {#1}Nets{/#1} make them easier to hit, but {#2}Taunt{/#2} is required to prevent them from breaking free.
units.zh: {#1}投网{/#1}能让骑士更容易被命中，但需要用{#2}挑衅{/#2}阻止他们挣脱。

units.source: Can use their shield to take your high ground, and it will be hard to take back.
units.zh: 骑士能用盾牌夺取你的高地，而你很难再抢回来。

units.source: {#1}Two-Handed Flails{/#1} bypass their shields and inflict more damage on headshots, because Knights don't have {#2}Steel Brow{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}双手连枷{/#1}可以绕过骑士的盾牌；骑士没有{#2}钢铁额骨{/#2}，所以命中头部还会造成更多伤害。

units.source: Prolonged combat with them can be dangerous. {#1}Rotation{/#1}, {#2}Footwork{/#2} or a {#3}Smoke Pot{/#3} allow to escape it.
units.zh: 与骑士长时间缠斗很危险。{#1}换位{/#1}、{#2}灵活步法{/#2}或{#3}烟雾罐{/#3}都可以帮助脱离。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor if their {#2}morale{/#2} breaks or if you can reliably {#3}stun{/#3} or {#4}disarm{/#4} them.
units.zh: 如果骑士{#2}士气{/#2}崩溃，或你能稳定地将其{#3}眩晕{/#3}、{#4}缴械{/#4}，可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}夺取护甲。

units.source: {#1}Footman{/#1} • {#2}Billman{/#2} • {#3}Arbalester{/#3} • {#4}Man at Arms{/#4} • {#5}Standard Bearer{/#5} • {#6}Sergeant{/#6} • {#7}Zweihander{/#7} • {#8}Knight{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Wardog{/#10} • {#11}Donkey{/#11}
Sergeant is an elite unit from the {#1}Noble{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 军士是{#1}贵族{/#1}阵营的精锐单位。

units.source: An {#1}Arming Sword{/#1}, {#2}Fighting Axe{/#2}, {#3}Military Cleaver{/#3}, {#4}Winged Mace{/#4} or {#5}Warhammer{/#5}.
Sergeants have a {#1}Sergeant's Sash{/#1} and often a visible {#2}permanent injury{/#2}. Both are purely cosmetic and have no effect, the Sash does not drop.
units.zh: 军士佩有{#1}军士绶带{/#1}，还经常带有肉眼可见的{#2}永久伤势{/#2}。两者都只是外观，没有实际效果；绶带也不会掉落。

units.source: Use {#1}flails{/#1} to hit their unprotected heads. They have {#2}Nimble{/#2} and {#3}Steel Brow{/#3}, but at least you won't have to break the armor. {#4}Head Hunter{/#4} can be useful too.
units.zh: 用{#1}连枷{/#1}攻击军士缺乏保护的头部。虽然他们拥有{#2}轻灵{/#2}和{#3}钢铁额骨{/#3}，但至少不必先破坏护甲。{#4}猎首者{/#4}也有帮助。

units.source: Control them with {#1}stun{/#1} or {#2}disarm{/#2}, have high melee skill to counter their melee defense.
units.zh: 用{#1}眩晕{/#1}或{#2}缴械{/#2}控制军士，并提高近战命中来应对他们的近战防御。

units.source: {#1}Footman{/#1} • {#2}Billman{/#2} • {#3}Arbalester{/#3} • {#4}Man at Arms{/#4} • {#5}Standard Bearer{/#5} • {#6}Sergeant{/#6} • {#7}Zweihander{/#7} • {#8}Knight{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Wardog{/#10} • {#11}Donkey{/#11}
Zweihander is an elite unit of the {#1}Noble{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 双手剑士是{#1}贵族{/#1}阵营的精锐单位。

units.source: A {#1}Scale Armor{/#1} (240), {#2}Reinforced Mail Hauberk{/#2} (210), {#3}Footman's Armor{/#3} (190) or {#4}Mail Hauberk{/#4} (150) (double chance).
Priority targets because of their threat, and somewhat vulnerable.
units.zh: 他们威胁很大，同时也有一定弱点，应优先处理。

units.source: Prioritize less protected ones if you have a choice.
units.zh: 如果可以选择，优先攻击防护较弱的目标。

units.source: Their light {#1}Duelist's Hat{/#1} offers little protection from {#2}flails{/#2} and head hits.
units.zh: 轻便的{#1}决斗者帽{/#1}很难抵御{#2}连枷{/#2}和头部命中。

units.source: {#1}Footman{/#1} • {#2}Billman{/#2} • {#3}Arbalester{/#3} • {#4}Man at Arms{/#4} • {#5}Standard Bearer{/#5} • {#6}Sergeant{/#6} • {#7}Zweihander{/#7} • {#8}Knight{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Wardog{/#10} • {#11}Donkey{/#11}
Militia is a weak unit that appears in militia squads.
units.zh: 民兵是民兵队伍中较弱的单位。

units.source: 2/11 chance of a {#1}Woodcutter's Axe{/#1}, {#2}Goedendag{/#2}, {#3}Pitchfork{/#3}, {#4}Hooked Blade{/#4}, {#5}Knife{/#5} or {#6}Dagger{/#6}.

A {#1}Shortsword{/#1}, {#2}Hatchet{/#2}, {#3}Militia Spear{/#3}, {#4}Bludgeon{/#4}, {#5}Wooden Stick{/#5}, {#6}Reinforced Wooden Flail{/#6}, {#7}Wooden Flail{/#7}, {#8}Butcher's Cleaver{/#8}, {#9}Scramasax{/#9} or {#10}Dagger{/#10}.
A {#1}Padded Surcoat{/#1} (50), {#2}Thick Tunic{/#2} (35), {#3}Leather Tunic{/#3} (30), {#4}Linen Tunic{/#4} (20), {#5}Sackcloth{/#5} (10) or {#6}Tattered Sackcloth{/#6} (5).
50% chance of a {#1}Full Leather Cap{/#1} (45), {#2}Open Leather Cap{/#2} (40), {#3}Aketon Cap{/#3} (40), {#4}Hood{/#4} (30) or {#5}Headscarf{/#5} (20).
They are very weak and rely on outnumbering the enemy.
units.zh: 民兵实力很弱，主要依靠人数优势对抗敌人。

units.source: When fighting alongside you, they still distract some enemies and deal some damage to them.
units.zh: 作为友军参战时，民兵仍能牵制一部分敌人，并造成一些伤害。

units.source: In fights with {#1}Nachzehrers{/#1} they die a lot and Nachzehrers become stronger from eating corpses.
units.zh: 对付{#1}食尸鬼{/#1}时，民兵会大量阵亡，而食尸鬼吃掉尸体后会变得更强。

units.source: {#1}Orc Berserkers{/#1} gain many {#2}Rage{/#2} stacks when killing them.
units.zh: {#1}兽人狂战士{/#1}击杀民兵后会积累大量{#2}怒火{/#2}层数。

units.source: {#1}Necrosavants{/#1} heal when dealing damage to them, and prefer attacking them.
units.zh: {#1}死灵剑士{/#1}伤害民兵时会恢复生命值，因此偏好攻击他们。

units.source: {#1}Militia{/#1} • {#2}Militia Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Militia Veteran{/#3} • {#4}Militia Captain{/#4} • {#5}Caravan Hand{/#5} • {#6}Caravan Guard{/#6} • {#7}Donkey{/#7} • {#8}Peasant{/#8}
Militia Veteran is a unit that appears in militia squads.
units.zh: 老练民兵是民兵队伍中的一种单位。

units.source: A {#1}Pike{/#1}, {#2}Bludgeon{/#2}, {#3}Militia Spear{/#3}, {#4}Boar Spear{/#4}, {#5}Woodcutter's Axe{/#5}, {#6}Shortsword{/#6}, {#7}Handaxe{/#7}, {#8}Goedendag{/#8}, {#9}Warfork{/#9}, {#10}Falchion{/#10} or {#11}Hooked Blade{/#11}.
A {#1}Leather Lamellar Armor{/#1} (95), {#2}Padded Leather{/#2} (80), {#3}Gambeson{/#3} (65), {#4}Padded Surcoat{/#4} (50), {#5}Thick Tunic{/#5} (35) or {#6}Leather Tunic{/#6} (30).
75% chance of a {#1}Full Aketon Cap{/#1} (50), {#2}Aketon Cap{/#2} (40) or {#3}Hood{/#3} (30).
They are weak, but can have good early-game weapons and armor.
units.zh: 他们实力较弱，但可能携带前期不错的武器和护甲。

units.source: {#1}Militia{/#1} • {#2}Militia Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Militia Veteran{/#3} • {#4}Militia Captain{/#4} • {#5}Caravan Hand{/#5} • {#6}Caravan Guard{/#6} • {#7}Donkey{/#7} • {#8}Peasant{/#8}
Militia Veteran is a unit that commands militia squads.
units.zh: 民兵队长负责指挥民兵队伍。【译注：原文将本条单位称为“老练民兵”，与本页标题不一致。】

units.source: A {#1}Boar Spear{/#1}, {#2}Military Cleaver{/#2}, {#3}Arming Sword{/#3}, {#4}Shortsword{/#4}, {#5}Handaxe{/#5}, {#6}Falchion{/#6} or {#7}Billhook{/#7}.
A {#1}Mail Shirt{/#1} (130), {#2}Basic Mail Shirt{/#2} (115) or {#3}Padded Leather{/#3} (80).
A {#1}Nasal Helmet with Mail{/#1} (200), {#2}Kettle Hat{/#2} (115), {#3}Mail Coif{/#3} (80) or {#4}Feathered Hat{/#4} (30).
Only one Captain per squad can be present. He uses {#1}Rally the Troops{/#1} if he sees somewhere {#2}morale{/#2} below steady and often fails to raise it.
units.zh: 每支队伍只能有一名队长。他发现有人{#2}士气{/#2}低于镇定时会使用{#1}重振士气{/#1}，但经常无法成功提振士气。

units.source: {#1}Rally the Troops{/#1} does not allow them to swing a {#2}Billhook{/#2} on the same turn.
units.zh: 使用{#1}重振士气{/#1}后，队长无法在同一回合挥动{#2}钩镰{/#2}。

units.source: Try not to break a {#1}Nasal Helmet with Mail{/#1} when you see it.
units.zh: 遇到{#1}锁甲护鼻盔{/#1}时，尽量不要将其打坏。

units.source: {#1}Militia{/#1} • {#2}Militia Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Militia Veteran{/#3} • {#4}Militia Captain{/#4} • {#5}Caravan Hand{/#5} • {#6}Caravan Guard{/#6} • {#7}Donkey{/#7} • {#8}Peasant{/#8}
Militia Marksman is a ranged unit that appears in militia squads.
units.zh: 民兵射手是民兵队伍中的远程单位。

units.source: A {#1}Leather Tunic{/#1} (30), {#2}Linen Tunic{/#2} (20), {#3}Sackcloth{/#3} (10) or {#4}Tattered Sackcloth{/#4} (5).
50% chance of a {#1}Full Leather Cap{/#1} (45), {#2}Open Leather Cap{/#2} (40), {#3}Aketon Cap{/#3} (40) or {#4}Hood{/#4} (30).
{#1}Militia{/#1} • {#2}Militia Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Militia Veteran{/#3} • {#4}Militia Captain{/#4} • {#5}Caravan Hand{/#5} • {#6}Caravan Guard{/#6} • {#7}Donkey{/#7} • {#8}Peasant{/#8}
Donkeys are common draft or pack animals, often used to pull caravan carts.
units.zh: 驴是常见的役用或驮运牲畜，常被用来拉商队货车。

units.source: Donkeys are stationary, have no skills, and are not in the turn order. They do however accumulate fatigue when hit, but don't reduce it.
units.zh: 驴停在原地，没有技能，也不进入行动顺序。受到攻击时会积累疲劳，却不会消减疲劳。

units.source: A caravan cart generates next to them, which is only an obstacle.
units.zh: 驴旁边会生成一辆商队货车，仅作为障碍物存在。

units.source: During an {#1}Escort Caravan{/#1} contract, letting a donkey die halves your payment.
units.zh: 在{#1}护送商队{/#1}委托中，如果驴死亡，你的报酬会减半。

units.source: When attacking a caravan, if all enemies other than the donkeys are slain, they will instantly die without giving XP and loot.
units.zh: 袭击商队时，如果驴以外的所有敌人都被杀死，驴也会立即死亡，不提供经验或战利品。

units.source: Enemies prefer attacking donkeys over your brothers.{#1}{#2}[citation required]{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: 敌人优先攻击驴，而非你的弟兄。{#1}{#2}〔原文待补来源〕{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: Your units can walk through them if they are allied.
units.zh: 如果驴属于友军，你的单位可以从其所在格穿过。

units.source: When the enemy starts retreating, enemies adjacent to donkeys and no one else retreat without trying to kill them, because Donkeys have no zone of control.
units.zh: 敌人开始撤退时，如果身旁只有驴而没有其他单位，就会直接离开，不会先尝试杀驴，因为驴没有控制区。

units.source: If you are attacking, make sure to kill them before the battle ends to get XP and loot.
units.zh: 如果你是袭击方，应在战斗结束前杀死驴，以获得经验和战利品。

units.source: {#1}Footman{/#1} • {#2}Billman{/#2} • {#3}Arbalester{/#3} • {#4}Man at Arms{/#4} • {#5}Standard Bearer{/#5} • {#6}Sergeant{/#6} • {#7}Zweihander{/#7} • {#8}Knight{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Wardog{/#10} • {#11}Donkey{/#11}

{#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}
{#1}Militia{/#1} • {#2}Militia Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Militia Veteran{/#3} • {#4}Militia Captain{/#4} • {#5}Caravan Hand{/#5} • {#6}Caravan Guard{/#6} • {#7}Donkey{/#7} • {#8}Peasant{/#8}
Caravan Hand is a weak unit that appears in trading caravans.
units.zh: 商队杂工是贸易商队中较弱的单位。

units.source: A {#1}Shortsword{/#1}, {#2}Hatchet{/#2}, {#3}Militia Spear{/#3}, {#4}Bludgeon{/#4}, {#5}Wooden Stick{/#5}, {#6}Scramasax{/#6}, {#7}Dagger{/#7} or {#8}Knife{/#8}.
A {#1}Padded Surcoat{/#1} (50), {#2}Thick Tunic{/#2} (35), {#3}Leather Tunic{/#3} (30) or {#4}Linen Tunic{/#4} (20).

Their behavior is strange. Sometimes they recklessly charge {#1}orcs{/#1}, and sometimes stand stationary near {#2}donkeys{/#2}, receiving damage from {#3}throwing weapons{/#3} and doing nothing about it.
units.zh: 杂工的行为有些古怪：有时会鲁莽地冲向{#1}兽人{/#1}，有时却一动不动地站在{#2}驴{/#2}旁，任由{#3}投掷武器{/#3}攻击而毫无反应。

units.source: If you are defending a caravan, the enemy prioritizes them over you because they are weaker.
units.zh: 护送商队时，敌人会优先攻击杂工，因为他们比你的弟兄更弱。

units.source: {#1}Militia{/#1} • {#2}Militia Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Militia Veteran{/#3} • {#4}Militia Captain{/#4} • {#5}Caravan Hand{/#5} • {#6}Caravan Guard{/#6} • {#7}Donkey{/#7} • {#8}Peasant{/#8}
Caravan Guard is a unit that appears in trading caravans.
units.zh: 商队护卫是贸易商队中的一种单位。

units.source: A {#1}Boar Spear{/#1}, {#2}Arming Sword{/#2}, {#3}Shortsword{/#3}, {#4}Handaxe{/#4} or {#5}Falchion{/#5}.
A {#1}Leather Lamellar Armor{/#1} (95), {#2}Padded Leather{/#2} (80), {#3}Padded Surcoat{/#3} (50) or {#4}Leather Tunic{/#4} (30).
75% chance of a {#1}Padded Nasal Helmet{/#1} (130), {#2}Nasal Helmet{/#2} (105), {#3}Full Aketon Cap{/#3} (50), {#4}Aketon Cap{/#4} (40) or {#5}Hood{/#5} (30).
Use {#1}shield{/#1} and take {#2}Dodge{/#2} to reduce their chance to hit.
units.zh: 使用{#1}盾牌{/#1}并学习{#2}闪避{/#2}，可以降低被他们命中的概率。

units.source: Use {#1}flails{/#1} to counter shields. With {#2}Flail Mastery{/#2} you can hit their unprotected heads and loot the armor.
units.zh: 用{#1}连枷{/#1}对付盾牌。拥有{#2}连枷精通{/#2}后，可以攻击敌人缺乏保护的头部，保留下护甲作为战利品。

units.source: {#1}Militia{/#1} • {#2}Militia Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Militia Veteran{/#3} • {#4}Militia Captain{/#4} • {#5}Caravan Hand{/#5} • {#6}Caravan Guard{/#6} • {#7}Donkey{/#7} • {#8}Peasant{/#8}
Peasant is a weak unit that travels between {#1}settlements{/#1} in small groups.
units.zh: 农民是较弱的单位，会成群结队地往来于{#1}定居点{/#1}之间。

units.source: 60% chance of a {#1}Knife{/#1}, {#2}Pitchfork{/#2}, {#3}Wooden Stick{/#3} (double chance), {#4}Pickaxe{/#4} or {#5}Butcher's Cleaver{/#5}.
A {#1}Thick Tunic{/#1} (35), {#2}Apron{/#2} (25), {#3}Linen Tunic{/#3} (20) (6 times more probable), {#4}Sackcloth{/#4} (10) or {#5}Tattered Sackcloth{/#5} (5).
33% chance of a {#1}Hood{/#1} (30), {#2}Straw Hat{/#2} (30), {#3}Feathered Hat{/#3} (30) or {#4}Headscarf{/#4} (20).
Armed Peasants appear in some {#1}contracts{/#1} alongside with stronger enemies on which they will cause {#2}morale{/#2} checks when they die.
units.zh: 某些{#1}委托{/#1}中，武装农民会与更强的敌人一同出现。农民阵亡会让这些强敌进行{#2}士气{/#2}检定。

units.source: {#1}Militia{/#1} • {#2}Militia Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Militia Veteran{/#3} • {#4}Militia Captain{/#4} • {#5}Caravan Hand{/#5} • {#6}Caravan Guard{/#6} • {#7}Donkey{/#7} • {#8}Peasant{/#8}
Has light headgear (20-30) or no helmet at all (67% chance)
units.zh: 佩戴轻型头部防具（20-30），或根本不戴头盔（67%概率）。

units.source: Crush them, it is impossible to lose a fight against them (as long as you are not totally undergeared, injured and/or outnumbered)
units.zh: 直接击溃他们即可：只要你不是装备严重不足、伤势严重，或人数处于巨大劣势，几乎不可能输给他们。

units.source: Mercenary is a melee unit of variable strength, which appears in {#1}mercenary squads{/#1} and as enemy during some {#2}contracts{/#2}.
units.zh: 佣兵是实力不一的近战单位，会出现在{#1}佣兵队伍{/#1}中，也会在部分{#2}委托{/#2}中作为敌人出现。

units.source: 75% chance of a {#1}Handaxe{/#1}, {#2}Flail{/#2}, {#3}Morning Star{/#3}, {#4}Boar Spear{/#4}, {#5}Arming Sword{/#5} or {#6}Falchion{/#6}.
If the weapon's range is 1, 50% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#1} or {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2}.
units.zh: 若武器射程为1格，则有50%概率携带{#1}飞斧束{/#1}或{#2}标枪束{/#2}。

units.source: A {#1}Mail Hauberk{/#1} (150), {#2}Mail Shirt{/#2} (130), {#3}Basic Mail Shirt{/#3} (115), {#4}Padded Leather{/#4} (80), {#5}Gambeson{/#5} (65), {#6}Rugged Surcoat{/#6} (55) or {#7}Padded Surcoat{/#7} (50).

90% chance of a {#1}Padded Flat Top Helmet{/#1} (150), {#2}Padded Kettle Hat{/#2} (140), {#3}Padded Nasal Helmet{/#3} (130), {#4}Flat Top Helmet{/#4} (125), {#5}Kettle Hat{/#5} (115), {#6}Nasal Helmet{/#6} (105), {#7}Closed Mail Coif{/#7} (90), {#8}Mail Coif{/#8} (80) or {#9}Headscarf{/#9} (20).
If the weapon is one-handed, a {#1}Wooden Shield{/#1}, {#2}Heater Shield{/#2}, {#3}Kite Shield{/#3} or {#4}Throwing Net{/#4}.

A {#1}Billhook{/#1}, {#2}Pike{/#2}, {#3}Warbrand{/#3}, {#4}Arming Sword{/#4}, {#5}Flail{/#5}, {#6}Handaxe{/#6}, {#7}Morning Star{/#7}, {#8}Falchion{/#8}, {#9}Polehammer{/#9}, {#10}Three-Headed Flail{/#10}, {#11}Bardiche{/#11}, {#12}Scimitar{/#12}, {#13}Fighting Spear{/#13}, {#14}Military Pick{/#14} or {#15}Longsword{/#15}.
If the weapon's range is 1, 60% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#1}, {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2} or {#3}Throwing Spear{/#3}.

A {#1}Sellsword's Armor{/#1} (260), {#2}Lamellar Harness{/#2} (230), {#3}Reinforced Mail Hauberk{/#3} (210), {#4}Footman's Armor{/#4} (190), {#5}Light Scale Armor{/#5} (170), {#6}Mail Hauberk{/#6} (150), {#7}Leather Scale Armor{/#7} (140), {#8}Mail Shirt{/#8} (130), {#9}Basic Mail Shirt{/#9} (115), {#10}Patched Mail Shirt{/#10} (90) or {#11}Padded Leather{/#11} (80).

95% of a {#1}Flat Top with Mail{/#1} (230), {#2}Kettle Hat with Mail{/#2} (215), {#3}Bascinet with Mail{/#3} (210), {#4}Nasal Helmet with Mail{/#4} (200), {#5}Steppe Helmet with Mail{/#5} (200), {#6}Closed Flat Top Helmet{/#6} (170), {#7}Padded Flat Top Helmet{/#7} (150), {#8}Padded Kettle Hat{/#8} (140), {#9}Padded Nasal Helmet{/#9} (130), {#10}Flat Top Helmet{/#10} (125), {#11}Nordic Helmet{/#11} (125), {#12}Kettle Hat{/#12} (115), {#13}Reinforced Mail Coif{/#13} (100), {#14}Closed Mail Coif{/#14} (90), {#15}Mail Coif{/#15} (80) or {#16}Headscarf{/#16} (20).
The list of possible helmets includes a {#1}Nasal Helmet{/#1} but it is never picked because of the bug (verify).
units.zh: 可能装备的头盔列表包含{#1}护鼻盔{/#1}，但由于程序错误，它从未被选中（原文标注：待核实）。

units.source: Lower Mercenaries have exactly same stats as {#1}Brigand Raider{/#1}, but slightly better equipment and {#2}perks{/#2}.
units.zh: 低阶佣兵的属性与{#1}强盗劫掠者{/#1}完全相同，但装备和{#2}特长{/#2}稍好一些。

units.source: Normal Mercenaries are much stronger due to superior stats, extra perks and better equipment. They can be very dangerous in the early game due to heavy armor and weapons.
units.zh: 普通佣兵拥有更高属性、额外特长和更好装备，实力强得多。前期，他们的重甲和武器可能构成严重威胁。

units.source: Normal Mercenaries will {#1}Overwhelm{/#1} you, unless you are faster, use {#2}Adrenaline{/#2}, {#3}nets{/#3}, {#4}daze{/#4} or {#5}stagger{/#5}.
units.zh: 普通佣兵会对你施加{#1}压制{/#1}，除非你行动更快，或使用{#2}肾上腺素{/#2}、{#3}投网{/#3}、{#4}恍惚{/#4}或{#5}踉跄{/#5}来应对。

units.source: Their {#1}armor{/#1} can be heavy. Armor piercing or anti-armor weapons are required to penetrate it.
units.zh: 佣兵的{#1}护甲{/#1}可能很厚重，需要使用穿甲或破甲武器。

units.source: {#1}Mercenary{/#1} • {#2}Mercenary Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Swordmaster{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Hedge Knight{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Master Archer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Wardog{/#9}
Mercenary Marksman is a ranged unit, which appears in {#1}mercenary squads{/#1} and as enemy during some {#2}contracts{/#2}.
units.zh: 佣兵射手是远程单位，会出现在{#1}佣兵队伍{/#1}中，也会在部分{#2}委托{/#2}中作为敌人出现。

units.source: A {#1}Mail Shirt{/#1} (130), {#2}Basic Mail Shirt{/#2} (115), {#3}Padded Leather{/#3} (80), {#4}Rugged Surcoat{/#4} (55), {#5}Padded Surcoat{/#5} (50) or {#6}Thick Tunic{/#6} (35).

75% chance of a {#1}Kettle Hat{/#1} (115), {#2}Mail Coif{/#2} (80), {#3}Full Aketon Cap{/#3} (50), {#4}Full Leather Cap{/#4} (45), {#5}Aketon Cap{/#5} (40), {#6}Hood{/#6} (30) or {#7}Headscarf{/#7} (20).
Mercenary Marksmen don't reposition much, and will instead just shoot. Their allies also don't guard them like {#1}Brigands{/#1} or {#2}Nomads{/#2} do (verify).
units.zh: 佣兵射手不太会调整位置，通常只管射击。他们的同伴也不会像{#1}强盗{/#1}或{#2}游牧民{/#2}那样保护射手（原文标注：待核实）。

units.source: {#1}Nimble{/#1} makes them quite tough. Because of this and the presence of more dangerous or vulnerable {#2}melee Mercenaries{/#2}, sniping them is not recommended.
units.zh: {#1}轻灵{/#1}让佣兵射手相当耐打。考虑到场上还有更危险或更脆弱的{#2}近战佣兵{/#2}，不建议优先远程狙杀射手。

units.source: However, their damage is annoying. Engage them in melee when possible so they will stop shooting.
units.zh: 不过，他们的伤害确实很烦人。条件允许时应贴身接敌，让其无法继续射击。

units.source: They can use {#1}Rotation{/#1} and {#2}Footwork{/#2} to escape melee.
units.zh: 佣兵射手可以用{#1}换位{/#1}和{#2}灵活步法{/#2}脱离近战。

units.source: Despite being ranged, they aren't completely harmless in melee, and can {#1}Overwhelm{/#1} and {#2}Puncture{/#2}.
units.zh: 虽然是远程单位，佣兵射手在近战中也并非毫无威胁；他们能使用{#1}压制{/#1}和{#2}破甲刺击{/#2}。

units.source: {#1}Mercenary{/#1} • {#2}Mercenary Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Swordmaster{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Hedge Knight{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Master Archer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Wardog{/#9}
Hedge Knight is a dangerous, heavily armored elite unit, sometimes encountered in {#1}arena{/#1} fights and among {#2}mercenaries{/#2} and {#3}brigands{/#3}.
units.zh: 流浪骑士是危险的重甲精锐单位，有时会在{#1}竞技场{/#1}战斗，以及{#2}佣兵{/#2}或{#3}强盗{/#3}队伍中出现。

units.source: An {#1}Arming Sword{/#1}, {#2}Noble Sword{/#2}, {#3}Warbrand{/#3}, {#4}Greatsword{/#4}, {#5}Fighting Axe{/#5}, {#6}Bardiche{/#6}, {#7}Greataxe{/#7}, {#8}Two-Handed Flail{/#8}, {#9}Two-Handed Hammer{/#9} or {#10}Two-Handed Flanged Mace{/#10}.
A {#1}Coat of Plates{/#1} (320), {#2}Coat of Scales{/#2} (300), {#3}Heavy Lamellar Armor{/#3} (285) or {#4}Reinforced Mail Hauberk{/#4} (210).
A {#1}Full Helm{/#1} (300) or {#2}Closed Flat Top with Mail{/#2} (280).
If the weapon is one-handed, a {#1}Kite Shield{/#1} or {#2}Heater Shield{/#2}.
units.zh: 若使用单手武器，则装备{#1}鸢形盾{/#1}或{#2}熨斗形盾{/#2}。

units.source: Those who have two-handed weapons deal high damage, and those who have {#1}shields{/#1} are difficult to hit.
units.zh: 持双手武器的流浪骑士伤害很高，持{#1}盾牌{/#1}的则很难命中。

units.source: Breaking their shields isn't hard as they lack {#1}Shield Expert{/#1} and does not require melee skill or Double Grip.
units.zh: 他们没有{#1}盾牌精通{/#1}，因此盾牌不难破坏，而且破盾无需近战命中或双手握持加成。

units.source: {#1}Nets{/#1} make them easier to hit, but {#2}Taunt{/#2} is required to prevent them from breaking free. Also they can't remove a net and attack with a 6 AP weapon on the same turn.
units.zh: {#1}投网{/#1}能让流浪骑士更容易被命中，但需要用{#2}挑衅{/#2}阻止其挣脱。此外，他们无法在同一回合挣脱投网并用耗费6行动点的武器攻击。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor if their {#2}morale{/#2} breaks or if you can reliably stun or disarm them. However, failing to stun can result in casualties: he has {#3}Berserk{/#3} that allows him to attack after a kill and {#4}Killing Frenzy{/#4} makes the following attack even more deadly, whereas the {#5}Battle Flow{/#5} grants enough fatigue to execute this attack.
units.zh: 如果流浪骑士{#2}士气{/#2}崩溃，或你能稳定地将其眩晕、缴械，可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}夺取护甲。但眩晕一旦失败，就可能造成伤亡：{#3}狂战{/#3}让他击杀后再次攻击，{#4}杀戮狂热{/#4}使后续攻击更加致命，而{#5}战斗节奏{/#5}会恢复足够体力，让他能够继续出手。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
{#1}Mercenary{/#1} • {#2}Mercenary Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Swordmaster{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Hedge Knight{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Master Archer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Wardog{/#9}
Swordmaster is a dangerous evasive elite unit, sometimes encountered in {#1}arena{/#1} fights and among {#2}mercenaries{/#2} and {#3}brigands{/#3}.
units.zh: 剑术大师是闪避出色的危险精锐单位，有时会在{#1}竞技场{/#1}战斗，以及{#2}佣兵{/#2}或{#3}强盗{/#3}队伍中出现。

units.source: A {#1}Footman's Armor{/#1} (190), {#2}Light Scale Armor{/#2} (170), {#3}Mail Hauberk{/#3} (150), {#4}Leather Scale Armor{/#4} (140), {#5}Mail Shirt{/#5} (130) or {#6}Basic Mail Shirt{/#6} (115).
90% chance of a {#1}Nasal Helmet with Mail{/#1} (200), {#2}Nasal Helmet{/#2} (105), {#3}Mail Coif{/#3} (80), {#4}Feathered Hat{/#4} (30) or {#5}Headscarf{/#5} (20).
Swordmasters will use {#1}Footwork{/#1} or even just walk in a zone of control to get close to someone vulnerable and attack him. They sometimes use {#2}Riposte{/#2} instead of attacking.
units.zh: 剑术大师会使用{#1}灵活步法{/#1}，甚至直接穿过控制区，接近并攻击脆弱目标。他们有时会选择{#2}还击架势{/#2}，而不是主动攻击。

units.source: They deal high damage, but are also evasive and tough due to {#1}Nimble{/#1}.
units.zh: 剑术大师伤害很高，闪避能力出色，并因{#1}轻灵{/#1}而相当耐打。

units.source: Their melee defense is so high that even nets are not enough to melee them effectively. If their {#1}morale{/#1} happens to break, they will likely escape, dodging your attempts to strike, rallying when no longer threatened.
units.zh: 他们的近战防御极高，即便投网也不足以让近战攻击稳定奏效。就算{#1}士气{/#1}崩溃，他们也很可能躲开你的拦截攻击逃走，并在脱离威胁后恢复士气。

units.source: If you can not use ranged weapons, like when sworn the Oath of Honor, {#1}spears{/#1}, {#2}Backstabber{/#2}, {#3}Fast Adaptation{/#3} and high melee skill can be somewhat useful. Expect the fight to be very difficult.
units.zh: 如果无法使用远程武器，例如已经立下荣誉之誓，那么{#1}矛{/#1}、{#2}背刺者{/#2}、{#3}快速适应{/#3}和较高的近战命中还能起些作用，但这场战斗会非常艰难。

units.source: They lack {#1}Resilient{/#1}, so poisons can be effective. {#2}Nimble{/#2} doesn't reduce poison damage.
units.zh: 他们没有{#1}顽强{/#1}，因此毒药可能有效；{#2}轻灵{/#2}也不会降低毒伤。

units.source: They are sometimes indistinguishable from a regular melee enemy until it's too late.
units.zh: 有时，剑术大师看上去与普通近战敌人无异，等你认出来时已经太迟了。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
{#1}Mercenary{/#1} • {#2}Mercenary Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Swordmaster{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Hedge Knight{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Master Archer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Wardog{/#9}
Master Archer is an elite ranged enemy, sometimes encountered among {#1}mercenaries{/#1} and {#2}brigands{/#2}.
units.zh: 神射手是精锐远程敌人，有时会出现在{#1}佣兵{/#1}和{#2}强盗{/#2}队伍中。

units.source: A {#1}Basic Mail Shirt{/#1} (115) (double chance), {#2}Leather Lamellar Armor{/#2} (95), {#3}Rugged Surcoat{/#3} (55), {#4}Padded Surcoat{/#4} (50) or {#5}Thick Tunic{/#5} (35).
Difficult to hit with {#1}ranged weapons{/#1}, and {#2}Nimble{/#2} makes them quite tough. Sniping them is not recommended.
units.zh: {#1}远程武器{/#1}很难命中神射手，而且{#2}轻灵{/#2}使其相当耐打，因此不推荐远程狙杀。

units.source: Engage them in melee when possible so they will stop shooting.
units.zh: 条件允许时应贴身接敌，让他们停止射击。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
{#1}Mercenary{/#1} • {#2}Mercenary Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Swordmaster{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Hedge Knight{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Master Archer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Wardog{/#9}
Disguised Bandit is a rare enemy, encountered sometimes in a contract where you must hunt beasts that terrorize a settlement.
units.zh: 伪装强盗是罕见敌人，有时会出现在猎杀袭扰定居点野兽的委托中。

units.source: 2/9 chance of a {#1}Billhook{/#1}, {#2}Pike{/#2}, {#3}Warbrand{/#3} or {#4}Woodcutter's Axe{/#4}.
7/9 chance of a {#1}Handaxe{/#1}, {#2}Flail{/#2}, {#3}Morning Star{/#3}, {#4}Boar Spear{/#4}, {#5}Arming Sword{/#5}, {#6}Falchion{/#6} or {#7}Shortsword{/#7}.
33% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#1} or {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2}.

A {#1}Basic Mail Shirt{/#1} (115), {#2}Worn Mail Shirt{/#2} (110), {#3}Leather Lamellar Armor{/#3} (95), {#4}Patched Mail Shirt{/#4} (90), {#5}Padded Leather{/#5} (80) or {#6}Rugged Surcoat{/#6} (55).
75% chance of a {#1}Nasal Helmet with Rusty Mail{/#1} (140), {#2}Padded Dented Nasal Helmet{/#2} (110), {#3}Nasal Helmet{/#3} (105), {#4}Rusty Mail Coif{/#4} (70), {#5}Headscarf{/#5} (20).
75% chance of a {#1}Wooden Shield{/#1} (75% chance) or {#2}Kite Shield{/#2} (25% chance).

On the worldmap they look like {#1}direwolves{/#1}, but their footprints change from beast to human. They are almost identical to {#2}Raiders{/#2}, but have slightly better equipment. Their group consists only of this type of enemy, there are no {#3}Marksmen{/#3} or {#4}Thugs{/#4}.
units.zh: 他们在世界地图上的外观是{#1}恐狼{/#1}，但脚印会从兽足印变成人类脚印。他们与{#2}强盗劫掠者{/#2}几乎相同，只是装备稍好。整支队伍都由这一类敌人组成，没有{#3}强盗射手{/#3}或{#4}强盗打手{/#4}。

units.source: They are similar to {#1}Brigand Raiders{/#1}, so all advice about them also applies here.
units.zh: 他们与{#1}强盗劫掠者{/#1}相似，因此针对劫掠者的建议也适用。

units.source: {#1}Wolf mantles{/#1}' debuffs make {#2}morale{/#2} checks more harsh, and effects stack when they overlap.
units.zh: {#1}恐狼皮披肩{/#1}的减益会让{#2}士气{/#2}检定更难通过，而且多个披肩的效果在范围重叠时可以叠加。

units.source: {#1}Puncture{/#1} them or smash heads with a {#2}flail{/#2} to loot their armor with attachments.
units.zh: 用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}，或用{#2}连枷{/#2}攻击头部，可以获得带有附件的护甲。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
{#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} is a dangerous enemy you sometimes encounter doing {#2}Drive Away Bandits{/#2} contracts. They demand the bandit leader's head and attack if you refuse.
units.zh: {#1}赏金猎人{/#1}是危险的敌人，有时会在{#2}驱逐强盗{/#2}委托中出现。他们索要强盗头目的首级；如果你拒绝，就会发动攻击。

units.source: A {#1}Billhook{/#1}, {#2}Pike{/#2}, {#3}Spetum{/#3}, {#4}Warbrand{/#4}, {#5}Handaxe{/#5}, {#6}Flail{/#6}, {#7}Morning Star{/#7}, {#8}Boar Spear{/#8}, {#9}Arming Sword{/#9}, {#10}Falchion{/#10}, {#11}Battle Whip{/#11} or {#12}Dagger{/#12}.
50% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#1} or {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2}.
A {#1}Mail Hauberk{/#1} (150), {#2}Basic Mail Shirt{/#2} (115), {#3}Leather Lamellar Armor{/#3} (95), {#4}Patched Mail Shirt{/#4} (90), {#5}Padded Leather{/#5} (80) or {#6}Rugged Surcoat{/#6} (55).

90% chance of a {#1}Kettle Hat with Mail{/#1} (215), {#2}Nasal Helmet with Mail{/#2} (200), {#3}Nordic Helmet{/#3} (125), {#4}Kettle Hat{/#4} (115), {#5}Reinforced Mail Coif{/#5} (100), {#6}Mail Coif{/#6} (80) or {#7}Headscarf{/#7} (20).
If the weapon is one-handed and not a Dagger, a {#1}Wooden Shield{/#1}, {#2}Heater Shield{/#2}, {#3}Kite Shield{/#3} or {#4}Throwing Net{/#4}.
units.zh: 若使用匕首以外的单手武器，则装备{#1}木盾{/#1}、{#2}熨斗形盾{/#2}、{#3}鸢形盾{/#3}或{#4}投网{/#4}。

units.source: Expect to see Bounty Hunters in big numbers. This makes the fight very difficult, given their strength.
units.zh: 赏金猎人通常人数众多，再加上实力强劲，战斗会非常困难。

units.source: They are somewhat similar to weaker {#1}Gladiators{/#1}, but will outnumber you greatly.
units.zh: 他们有些像弱化的{#1}角斗士{/#1}，但人数会远多于你。

units.source: {#1}Nimble{/#1} make them quite tough, but its value drops with heavier armor.
units.zh: {#1}轻灵{/#1}使赏金猎人相当耐打，不过装备越重，其效果就越弱。

units.source: Helmet and medium armor may require armor piercing or anti-armor weapons to penetrate.
units.zh: 他们的头盔和中型护甲可能需要穿甲或破甲武器来对付。

units.source: They will {#1}Overwhelm{/#1} you, unless you are faster, use {#2}Adrenaline{/#2}, {#3}nets{/#3}, {#4}daze{/#4} or {#5}stagger{/#5}. {#6}Flash Pots{/#6} should be effective because of area of their effect.
units.zh: 赏金猎人会对你施加{#1}压制{/#1}，除非你行动更快，或使用{#2}肾上腺素{/#2}、{#3}投网{/#3}、{#4}恍惚{/#4}或{#5}踉跄{/#5}来应对。{#6}闪光罐{/#6}能影响一片区域，应该会很有效。

units.source: High melee defense can be useful because of their not so high melee skill and lack of accuracy perks.
units.zh: 赏金猎人的近战命中不算很高，也缺乏命中类特长，因此较高的近战防御很有帮助。

units.source: You need good offense because they have {#1}Dodge{/#1} and {#2}Overwhelm{/#2}.
units.zh: 赏金猎人拥有{#1}闪避{/#1}和{#2}压制{/#2}，你需要有足够强的进攻能力。

units.source: Knowing when their attack can happen, you can prepare for it.
units.zh: 如果知道赏金猎人可能在何时袭击，就能提前做好准备。

units.source: {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} • {#2}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Cultist{/#3} • {#4}Envoy{/#4} • {#5}Firstborn{/#5} • {#6}Gladiator{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Oathbringer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9})
{#1}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#1} is a ranged enemy you sometimes encounter doing {#2}Drive Away Bandits{/#2} contracts. They demand the bandit leader's head and attack if you refuse.
units.zh: {#1}赏金猎人射手{/#1}是远程敌人，有时会在{#2}驱逐强盗{/#2}委托中出现。他们索要强盗头目的首级；如果你拒绝，就会发动攻击。

units.source: 50% chance of a {#1}Full Aketon Cap{/#1} (50), {#2}Full Leather Cap{/#2} (45), {#3}Aketon Cap{/#3} (40), {#4}Hood{/#4} (30) or {#5}Headscarf{/#5} (20).
Vulnerable. If exposed, they are a priority targets for your archers.
units.zh: 他们比较脆弱；一旦暴露，就应成为弓手的优先目标。

units.source: Less accurate at night, but you don't choose when they attack.
units.zh: 夜间他们的命中率较低，但你无法选择他们袭击的时间。

units.source: {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} • {#2}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Cultist{/#3} • {#4}Envoy{/#4} • {#5}Firstborn{/#5} • {#6}Gladiator{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Oathbringer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9})
Firstborn is the character you are protecting in {#1}Pact with Witches{/#1} contracts.
units.zh: 长子是{#1}女巫委托{/#1}中需要你保护的角色。

units.source: You control the Firstborn. Enemies are strongly attracted to him. If he dies, you fail the contract.
units.zh: 长子由你控制，敌人会强烈倾向于攻击他。他一旦死亡，委托就会失败。

units.source: He is immune to {#1}charm{/#1}, you can give him a {#2}weapon{/#2} and even kill {#3}Hexen{/#3} if they are not guarded.
units.zh: 长子免疫{#1}魅惑{/#1}。你可以给他一件{#2}武器{/#2}，甚至让他杀死无人保护的{#3}女巫{/#3}。

units.source: He is so fragile that he can die in one {#1}whip{/#1} hit or {#2}Webknecht{/#2} bite. Keep him away from your own brothers who can be charmed and don't leave your archers unwatched.
units.zh: 长子十分脆弱，一次{#1}鞭击{/#1}或一次{#2}巨蛛{/#2}撕咬就可能杀死他。让他远离可能被魅惑的弟兄，也别让己方弓手无人看管。

units.source: If there are {#1}Webknechts{/#1}, protecting him is more difficult because they hatch from {#2}eggs{/#2} and attack from behind. To deal with them, send a few damage dealers backwards where they can't be charmed.
units.zh: 如果敌人中有{#1}巨蛛{/#1}，保护长子会更加困难，因为巨蛛会从{#2}蛛卵{/#2}孵化并从后方袭来。可派几名输出手去后方、远离魅惑范围的位置应对。

units.source: {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} • {#2}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Cultist{/#3} • {#4}Envoy{/#4} • {#5}Firstborn{/#5} • {#6}Gladiator{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Oathbringer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9})
{#1}Cultist{/#1} is a rare enemy encountered is some {#2}events{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}邪教徒{/#1}是罕见敌人，会在部分{#2}事件{/#2}中出现。

units.source: You can encounter Cultists only in the {#1}Religious Peasants{/#1} and {#2}Come Across Ritual{/#2} events. Both encounters are avoidable. Both feature exactly 25 of them.
units.zh: 你只能在{#1}虔诚的农民{/#1}和{#2}偶遇仪式{/#2}事件中遇到敌对邪教徒。两场遭遇都可以避免；两者都会出现恰好25名邪教徒。

units.source: If not in late game, don't press the "Let's see where they're going" option. This encounter can wipe an entire squad.
units.zh: 如果还没到后期，不要选择“去看看他们要去哪儿。”这场遭遇可能让整支队伍覆灭。

units.source: Prioritize those armed with {#1}daggers{/#1}. {#2}Puncture{/#2} with {#3}Crippling Strikes{/#3} and {#4}Executioner{/#4} can be dangerous without {#5}Nimble{/#5} and even with it.
units.zh: 优先处理持{#1}匕首{/#1}的邪教徒。{#2}破甲刺击{/#2}配合{#3}致残打击{/#3}和{#4}刽子手{/#4}非常危险；没有{#5}轻灵{/#5}尤其如此，即便有也不能大意。

units.source: {#1}Backstabber{/#1} and {#2}Fast Adaptation{/#2} compensate their average melee skill.
units.zh: {#1}背刺者{/#1}和{#2}快速适应{/#2}弥补了他们平平的近战命中。

units.source: {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} • {#2}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Cultist{/#3} • {#4}Envoy{/#4} • {#5}Firstborn{/#5} • {#6}Gladiator{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Oathbringer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9})
Wardog is a small beast used in combat by some Human factions, including your squad.
units.zh: 战犬是某些人类阵营用于战斗的小型野兽，你的战团也可以使用。

units.source: Can be equipped with a {#1}Heavy Wardog Armor{/#1} (85) or {#2}Wardog Armor{/#2} (55).
Noble faction uses Wardogs with Wardog Armor. Heavy Wardog Armor only can be used by the player.
units.zh: 贵族阵营使用装备战犬甲的战犬。重型战犬甲只有玩家能够使用。

units.source: Dogs rush the enemy. If they have a choice, they prioritize fleeing units, ranged units, specialists and those who is not engaged in melee.
units.zh: 犬只会冲向敌人。如果可以选择目标，会优先攻击溃逃单位、远程单位、特殊单位，以及尚未陷入近战的目标。

units.source: When you unleash them, they will act immediately. You can not control Wardogs you release, they act on their own.
units.zh: 放出战犬后，它会立即行动。你无法控制已放出的战犬，它们会自行行动。

units.source: When they flee or die, dogs don't cause {#1}morale{/#1} checks on their allies.
units.zh: 犬只溃逃或死亡时，不会让友军进行{#1}士气{/#1}检定。

units.source: Can be used for distraction, to catch archers, fleeing enemies or even a {#1}Necromancer{/#1}, or to get a surrounding bonus.
units.zh: 犬只可用于分散注意力、追击弓手和溃逃敌人，甚至追上{#1}亡灵法师{/#1}，也可用来增加包围加成。

units.source: A brother can unleash a dog and use {#1}Rotation{/#1} on it to save himself.
units.zh: 弟兄可以先放出战犬，再对它使用{#1}换位{/#1}来脱险。

units.source: Enemies prioritize brothers over dogs, however will still hit dogs with area attacks. So you can use dogs to counter outnumbering by {#1}Wiedergangers{/#1} or {#2}Nachzehrers{/#2}. There are a few exceptions like {#3}Necrosavants{/#3} and {#4}Barbarian Madman{/#4}, who will attack dogs first.
units.zh: 敌人通常优先攻击弟兄而非犬只，但范围攻击仍会波及犬只。因此，可以用犬只抵消{#1}行尸{/#1}或{#2}食尸鬼{/#2}的数量优势。不过，{#3}死灵剑士{/#3}和{#4}蛮族疯汉{/#4}等少数敌人会优先攻击犬只。

units.source: Be careful with timing when using dogs to avoid losing them pointlessly.
units.zh: 使用犬只时要把握时机，避免毫无意义地失去它们。

units.source: Trying to distract enemies with {#1}Berserk{/#1} and/or high resolve can backfire, refunding their AP and/or improving their {#2}morale{/#2} when they kill a dog. {#3}Undead{/#3} don't have morale so they don't benefit from killing a dog.
units.zh: 用犬只分散拥有{#1}狂战{/#1}或高意志的敌人可能适得其反：杀死犬只会让他们恢复行动点，或提高{#2}士气{/#2}。{#3}亡灵{/#3}没有士气，因此不会从杀犬中获得士气收益。

units.source: If attacked by dogs, you may not respect their zone of control if your melee defense is high enough.
units.zh: 如果遭到犬只攻击，而你的近战防御足够高，可以冒险穿过它们的控制区。

units.source: Using dogs against {#1}Hexen{/#1} is extremely risky and not recommended. They can attack {#2}charmed{/#2} brothers and don't care about {#3}Hex{/#3}.
units.zh: 对付{#1}女巫{/#1}时使用犬只极其危险，不推荐这样做。犬只会攻击被{#2}魅惑{/#2}的弟兄，也不会顾忌{#3}咒缚{/#3}。

units.source: Will have confident morale if unleashed by a {#1}Houndmaster{/#1}.
units.zh: 由{#1}驯犬师{/#1}放出时，犬只会处于斗志昂扬状态。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}

{#1}Footman{/#1} • {#2}Billman{/#2} • {#3}Arbalester{/#3} • {#4}Man at Arms{/#4} • {#5}Standard Bearer{/#5} • {#6}Sergeant{/#6} • {#7}Zweihander{/#7} • {#8}Knight{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Wardog{/#10} • {#11}Donkey{/#11}
{#1}Mercenary{/#1} • {#2}Mercenary Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Swordmaster{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Hedge Knight{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Master Archer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Wardog{/#9}
Warhound is a small beast used in combat by {#1}Barbarians{/#1} faction and your squad.
units.zh: 战獒是{#1}蛮族{/#1}阵营和你的战团可以用于战斗的小型野兽。

units.source: When you unleash them, they will act immediately. You can not control Warhounds you release, they act on their own.
units.zh: 放出战獒后，它会立即行动。你无法控制已放出的战獒，它们会自行行动。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
Wolf is a beast you can tame in a {#1}Houndmaster Tames Wolf{/#1} event.
units.zh: 狼是可以在{#1}驯犬师驯狼{/#1}事件中驯服的野兽。

units.source: Just like dogs, it will rush the enemy. If has a choice, it prioritizes fleeing units, ranged units, specialists and those who are not engaged in melee.
units.zh: 与犬只一样，狼会冲向敌人。如果可以选择目标，会优先攻击溃逃单位、远程单位、特殊单位，以及尚未陷入近战的目标。

units.source: When you unleash it, it will act immediately. You can not control the Wolf, it act on its own.
units.zh: 放出狼后，它会立即行动。你无法控制它，它会自行行动。

units.source: When it flees or dies, the Wolf does not cause {#1}morale{/#1} checks on brothers.
units.zh: 狼溃逃或死亡时，不会让弟兄进行{#1}士气{/#1}检定。

units.source: There are two factors that severely limit its combat efficiency. You can't protect it with armor and enemies will not ignore it like they ignore dogs. They instead will prioritize the Wolf over a brother.
units.zh: 狼的战斗效率受到两个严重限制：无法为其装备护甲，而且敌人不会像忽略犬只那样忽略狼，反而会优先攻击狼而非弟兄。

units.source: The event is not repeatable. If you lose your Wolf, you will not get another.
units.zh: 驯狼事件不会重复触发。失去这只狼后，就无法再获得另一只。

units.source: You can still catch archers and fleeing enemies with it.
units.zh: 不过，你仍可以用狼追击弓手和溃逃敌人。

units.source: {#1}Charge{/#1} will move the orc next to your brother and possibly stun him if not repelled (has a range of 3 tiles and the height level difference can't be higher than 1). The chance to stun starts at 100% and is reduced by the amount of Melee Defense from {#2}shields{/#2} and Shieldwall.
units.zh: {#1}冲锋{/#1}会让兽人移动到弟兄身旁；若未被击退，弟兄就可能眩晕。射程为3格，高度差不能超过1。基础眩晕概率为100%，再减去{#2}盾牌{/#2}和盾墙提供的近战防御值。

units.source: Orc Young is an enemy from the {#1}Orcs{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 兽人青年是{#1}兽人{/#1}阵营的敌人。

units.source: 25% chance of a {#1}Cruel Falchion{/#1}, {#2}Hatchet{/#2} or {#3}Morning Star{/#3}.
60% chance of a Hide Armor (80), Hide Armor (60) or Hide Armor (35).
units.zh: 有60%概率装备兽皮甲衣（80）、兽皮甲衣（60）或兽皮甲衣（35）。

units.source: 75% chance of a {#1}Head Splitter{/#1}, {#2}Head Chopper{/#2}, {#3}Tree Limb{/#3} or {#4}Cudgel{/#4}.
80% chance of a Metal Plated Hide Armor (120), Hide Armor (80), Hide Armor (60) or Hide Armor (35).
units.zh: 有80%概率装备覆铁兽皮甲（120）、兽皮甲衣（80）、兽皮甲衣（60）或兽皮甲衣（35）。

units.source: 75% chance of a Metal Plated Helmet (120), Helmet (60) or Helmet (35).
units.zh: 有75%概率装备覆铁盔（120）、头盔（60）或头盔（35）。

units.source: Orc Young are the first to attack. Sometimes they jump onto you, {#1}stunning{/#1} and making a brother unable to attack on the next turn. {#2}Spearwall{/#2} prevents stun if worked. {#3}Shields{/#3} and {#4}Shieldwall{/#4} give a small chance to resist stun.
units.zh: 兽人青年会率先进攻。有时它们会冲到你面前，将弟兄{#1}眩晕{/#1}，使其下回合无法攻击。{#2}矛墙{/#2}成功阻挡时可防止眩晕；{#3}盾牌{/#3}和{#4}盾墙{/#4}也提供少量抵抗眩晕的机会。

units.source: They are not weak at all and can be dangerous in the early game because of their high HP and damage.
units.zh: 兽人青年一点也不弱：生命值和伤害都很高，前期可能十分危险。

units.source: They can deal high damage just like {#1}Warriors{/#1}, but are much easier to kill. Kill them first.
units.zh: 它们能像{#1}兽人战士{/#1}一样造成高伤害，却容易杀得多，因此应优先击杀。

units.source: Running into them may give them an opportunity to strike first, but causes {#1}morale{/#1} checks on them and you will not be stunned.
units.zh: 主动贴近兽人青年可能给它们先手攻击的机会，但会触发它们的{#1}士气{/#1}检定，也能避免被冲锋眩晕。

units.source: {#1}Orc Young{/#1} • {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2} ({#3}Champion{/#3}) • {#4}Orc Berserker{/#4} • {#5}Orc Warlord{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Greenskin Catapult{/#7}
Orc Berserker is a dangerous enemy from the {#1}Orcs{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 兽人狂战士是{#1}兽人{/#1}阵营的危险敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Head Splitter{/#1}, {#2}Head Chopper{/#2}, {#3}Man Splitter{/#3} or {#4}Berserk Chain{/#4}.

{#1}Rage{/#1} builds up rage-stacks, each rage stack grants {#2}+2%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}{#6}+1{/#6} {#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7}{#10}+1-1{/#10} {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11}{#14}+1{/#14} {#15}{#16}{#17/}{/#16}{/#15}, gains 2 rage stacks for each successful attack and 5 for each kill. The user will lose 1 stack on the start of each turn. Maximum damage reduction is 70%.
Berserkers usually prefer to flank your squad while other orcs are distracting it, and try to engage backliners. They sometimes can surprise you with a stunning charge like {#1}Orc Young{/#1}.
units.zh: 兽人狂战士通常趁其他兽人牵制你的队伍时从侧翼迂回，尝试接近后排。它们有时也会像{#1}兽人青年{/#1}一样突然冲锋，将目标眩晕。

units.source: They can receive {#1}injuries{/#1}, but they are not affected by them, except taking bleeding damage. {#2}Executioner{/#2} works on them when they are injured.
units.zh: 它们可以受到{#1}伤势{/#1}，但除流血伤害外，伤势效果对其无效。它们受伤时，{#2}刽子手{/#2}仍会生效。

units.source: They can kill in one head hit with a two-handed weapon even through a heavy helmet. {#1}Steel Brow{/#1} or {#2}Nine Lives{/#2} prevent this. {#3}Nimble{/#3} brothers also survive it, if they have high enough HP and good Nimble value.
units.zh: 它们用双手武器命中头部时，即使隔着重盔也可能一击致命。{#1}钢铁额骨{/#1}或{#2}九命{/#2}可以避免这种情况。{#3}轻灵{/#3}弟兄若生命值足够高、轻灵减伤足够好，也能撑住。

units.source: Shoot them with {#1}ranged weapons{/#1} before they enter melee range.
units.zh: 在它们进入近战范围前，用{#1}远程武器{/#1}射击。

units.source: A {#1}net{/#1} can win time to attack a Berserker before he does. Also they can't remove a net and attack with a 6 AP weapon on the same turn.
units.zh: {#1}投网{/#1}可以争取时间，让你先于狂战士攻击。此外，它们无法在同一回合挣脱投网并用耗费6行动点的武器攻击。

units.source: Don't let them kill anyone, they trigger {#1}Berserk{/#1} and stack {#2}Rage{/#2}, becoming stronger. Don't use {#3}dogs{/#3} or disposable brothers. They will become especially strong and tough in three-way fights where they kill a lot.
units.zh: 不要让狂战士杀死任何单位，否则会触发{#1}狂战{/#1}并积累{#2}怒火{/#2}，变得更强。不要用{#3}犬只{/#3}或准备牺牲的弟兄牵制它们。三方混战中，狂战士大量杀敌后会变得尤其强大、耐打。

units.source: {#1}Orc Young{/#1} • {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2} ({#3}Champion{/#3}) • {#4}Orc Berserker{/#4} • {#5}Orc Warlord{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Greenskin Catapult{/#7}

{#1}Line Breaker{/#1} will knock a target 1 tile back, never misses and the target suffers {#2}10{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}, removes {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}Shieldwall{/#9}, {#10}{#11}{#12/}{/#11}{/#10} {#13}Spearwall{/#13}, {#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} {#17}Riposte{/#17} when applied (has a range of 1 tile)
Orc Warrior is a heavily armored enemy from the {#1}Orcs{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 兽人战士是{#1}兽人{/#1}阵营的重甲敌人。

units.source: Normal version of this unit can become a {#1}champion{/#1} with a 1% chance.
units.zh: 此单位的普通版本有1%概率成为{#1}精英勇士{/#1}。

units.source: A {#1}Looted Reinforced Mail{/#1} (340, -26 Fatigue) or {#2}Looted Scale Armor{/#2} (280, -22 Fatigue).
units.zh: 装备{#1}掠夺来的加固锁甲{/#1}（340、-26疲劳上限）或{#2}掠夺来的鳞甲{/#2}（280、-22疲劳上限）。

units.source: 2/3 chance of a {#1}Looted Kettle Hat{/#1} (300, -18 Fatigue) or {#2}Looted Nasal Helmet{/#2} (240, -13 Fatigue).
units.zh: 2/3概率装备{#1}掠夺来的铁笠盔{/#1}（300、-18疲劳上限）或{#2}掠夺来的护鼻盔{/#2}（240、-13疲劳上限）。

units.source: A {#1}Looted Plate Armor{/#1} (400, -30 Fatigue), {#2}Looted Reinforced Mail{/#2} (340, -26 Fatigue) or {#3}Looted Scale Armor{/#3} (280, -22 Fatigue).
A {#1}Metal Plate Helmet{/#1} (360, -23 Fatigue), {#2}Looted Kettle Hat{/#2} (300, -18 Fatigue) or {#3}Looted Nasal Helmet{/#3} (240, -13 Fatigue).

{#1}Shield Bash{/#1} will cause knock back from shields to also inflict 10-25 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 50% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} in addition to any falling damage and the target gets additional {#8}10{/#8}{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9}

Orc Warriors are slow and heavy. They have the ability to disrupt formations and they use it mostly to get close to vulnerable backliners or to claim the high ground. They often end up surrounded after doing it.
units.zh: 兽人战士沉重而迟缓，能冲散阵型，通常借此接近脆弱的后排或夺取高地。这样做后，它们经常会陷入包围。

units.source: They can't push a brother if there is nowhere to push.
units.zh: 如果目标身后没有可退的位置，兽人战士就无法将其推开。

units.source: Their morale can be broken with {#1}Fearsome{/#1} if you can deal HP damage through armor.
units.zh: 只要能穿透护甲造成生命值伤害，就可以用{#1}威慑{/#1}击溃它们的士气。

units.source: Don't bother breaking their shield, it's too durable and the orc is already easy to hit.
units.zh: 不必费心破坏兽人战士的盾牌：盾太结实，而兽人本身已经很容易命中。

units.source: If you lack appropriate weapons, {#1}puncture{/#1} them with {#2}knives{/#2} as a last resort.
units.zh: 如果缺少合适的武器，最后可以用{#2}小刀{/#2}施展{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}来对付它们。

units.source: Prefer flat terrain as they can take your high ground and you can't take it back.
units.zh: 尽量选择平地作战，因为兽人战士能夺取你的高地，而你很难再抢回来。

units.source: {#1}Orc Young{/#1} • {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2} ({#3}Champion{/#3}) • {#4}Orc Berserker{/#4} • {#5}Orc Warlord{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Greenskin Catapult{/#7}
Orc Warlord is a dangerous, heavily armored elite enemy from the {#1}Orcs{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 兽人军阀是{#1}兽人{/#1}阵营中危险的重甲精锐敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Head Splitter{/#1}, {#2}Head Chopper{/#2} or {#3}Man Splitter{/#3} (double chance).

{#1}Warcry{/#1} bolsters the {#2}Morale{/#2} and reduces the accumulated {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} Fatigue of nearby allies, weakens the {#6}Morale{/#6} of nearby brothers (more likely to work the closer they are to the {#7}Orc Warlord{/#7})
units.zh: {#1}战吼{/#1}提高附近友军的{#2}士气{/#2}并减少其积累的{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}疲劳，同时降低附近弟兄的{#6}士气{/#6}；弟兄离{#7}兽人军阀{/#7}越近，效果越容易生效。

units.source: Warlords are extremely heavily armored orcs who lead other orcs into battle. They will use their {#1}warcry{/#1} if they see somewhere {#2}morale{/#2} below steady. There should be no more than one Warlord per group, but when fighting two groups at once, Warlords can rally each other.
units.zh: 兽人军阀身披极其厚重的护甲，率领其他兽人作战。只要发现有人{#2}士气{/#2}低于镇定，就会使用{#1}战吼{/#1}。每支队伍通常最多一名军阀；但同时对抗两支队伍时，军阀可以互相重振士气。

units.source: They have so much armor that anti-armor weapons are almost essential against them.
units.zh: 军阀的护甲实在太厚，破甲武器几乎是必需品。

units.source: Their {#1}warcry{/#1} scares brothers, so {#2}Rally the Troops{/#2} can be useful to counter it.
units.zh: 军阀的{#1}战吼{/#1}会恐吓弟兄，可用{#2}重振士气{/#2}应对。

units.source: They can kill in one head hit with a {#1}Man Splitter{/#1} even through a heavy helmet. {#2}Steel Brow{/#2} or {#3}Nine Lives{/#3} prevent this. {#4}Nimble{/#4} brothers also survive it, if they have high enough HP and good Nimble value.
units.zh: 军阀用{#1}劈人巨斧{/#1}命中头部时，即使隔着重盔也可能一击致命。{#2}钢铁额骨{/#2}或{#3}九命{/#3}可以避免这种情况。{#4}轻灵{/#4}弟兄若生命值足够高、轻灵减伤足够好，也能撑住。

units.source: Can lose {#1}morale{/#1} seeing other orcs flee multiple times. Engaging a fleeing Warlord in melee and not letting him escape will prevent him from rallying.
units.zh: 反复目睹其他兽人溃逃，也会使军阀失去{#1}士气{/#1}。贴住溃逃的军阀，不让它脱离近战，即可阻止其恢复士气。

units.source: {#1}Orc Young{/#1} • {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2} ({#3}Champion{/#3}) • {#4}Orc Berserker{/#4} • {#5}Orc Warlord{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Greenskin Catapult{/#7}
Goblin Skirmisher is an enemy from the {#1}Goblins{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 地精游击兵是{#1}地精{/#1}阵营的敌人。

units.source: Normal version of this unit can become a {#1}champion{/#1} with a 1% chance.
units.zh: 此单位的普通版本有1%概率成为{#1}精英勇士{/#1}。

units.source: If the weapon is not a spear, 66% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Spiked Bolas{/#1}.
units.zh: 若武器不是矛，则有66%概率携带{#1}尖刺投球束{/#1}。

units.source: 66% chance of a {#1}Throwing Net{/#1} or {#2}Wooden Skirmisher Shield{/#2}.
A {#1}Goblin Skewer{/#1}, {#2}Jagged Pike{/#2}, {#3}Notched Blade{/#3} or {#4}Cruel Falchion{/#4}.
If the weapon is not a spear, a {#1}Bundle of Spiked Bolas{/#1}.
units.zh: 若武器不是矛，则携带{#1}尖刺投球束{/#1}。

units.source: If the weapon is one-handed, a {#1}Throwing Net{/#1} (50% chance), {#2}Wooden Skirmisher Shield{/#2} (25% chance) or {#3}Reinforced Skirmisher Shield{/#3} (25% chance).
Skirmishers like to use {#1}throwing weapons{/#1} and {#2}nets{/#2}, and will {#3}Footwork{/#3} often, sometimes even into worse position.
units.zh: 游击兵喜欢使用{#1}投掷武器{/#1}和{#2}投网{/#2}，也经常使用{#3}灵活步法{/#3}，有时甚至会移动到更糟的位置。

units.source: High melee skill is good to have because it increases both accuracy and the chance to break free from their {#1}nets{/#1}.
units.zh: 较高的近战命中很有帮助，既提高攻击命中率，也提高挣脱{#1}投网{/#1}的概率。

units.source: Their weapons are ineffective against heavy {#1}armor{/#1}, except {#2}Notched Blades{/#2} that {#3}Puncture{/#3} and {#4}Jagged Pikes{/#4} that can cause {#5}bleeding{/#5} early because of extra 25% direct damage.
units.zh: 它们的武器很难对付重型{#1}护甲{/#1}，但有两个例外：{#2}缺口短刃{/#2}可以使用{#3}破甲刺击{/#3}；{#4}锯齿长枪{/#4}具有额外25%的直接伤害，可以较早造成{#5}流血{/#5}。

units.source: {#1}Heavy Crossbow{/#1} with {#2}Crossbow Mastery{/#2} often one-shots them. Some one-handed weapons with {#3}Duelist{/#3} and {#4}Killing Frenzy{/#4} also do.
units.zh: {#1}重弩{/#1}配合{#2}弩精通{/#2}经常能一击杀死游击兵。部分单手武器配合{#3}决斗家{/#3}和{#4}杀戮狂热{/#4}也能做到。

units.source: {#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1} ({#2}Champion{/#2}) • {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Goblin Wolfrider{/#5} • {#6}Goblin Wolf{/#6} • {#7}Goblin Shaman{/#7} • {#8}Goblin Overseer{/#8} • {#9}Greenskin Catapult{/#9}
Goblin Ambusher is a ranged enemy from the {#1}Goblins{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 地精伏击手是{#1}地精{/#1}阵营的远程敌人。

units.source: Normal version of this unit can become a {#1}champion{/#1} with a 1% chance.
units.zh: 此单位的普通版本有1%概率成为{#1}精英勇士{/#1}。

units.source: A {#1}Reinforced Boondock Bow{/#1} or {#2}Boondock Bow{/#2} (before day 60).
units.zh: 装备{#1}强化荒野短弓{/#1}，或{#2}荒野短弓{/#2}（第60天前）。

units.source: {#1}Poison{/#1} will poison you if you lose at least 6 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} from any of his attacks, the poison lasts 3 turns, you lose 1 {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, 10 {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} and 1 {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} for every turn of poison left, can be removed or prevented by {#14}Antidote{/#14}
Accurate and numerous, they can focus fire and kill a brother in the early game.
units.zh: 伏击手命中高、数量多，前期可以通过集火杀死弟兄。

units.source: Their {#1}Notched Blades{/#1} can {#2}Puncture{/#2} and also apply poison.
units.zh: 它们的{#1}缺口短刃{/#1}可以使用{#2}破甲刺击{/#2}，也能施毒。

units.source: {#1}Nimble{/#1} or heavy {#2}armor{/#2} are important, because they protect from damage and being poisoned early. Armor protects better against ranged damage, while Nimble allows to fight in melee safely.
units.zh: {#1}轻灵{/#1}或重型{#2}护甲{/#2}很重要，可以减少伤害，并避免过早中毒。护甲更适合抵挡远程伤害，而轻灵能让弟兄更安全地近战。

units.source: Prefer nighttime when they are less accurate. Be careful if there is a {#1}Shaman{/#1}, he can give night vision to some of them, and they will be even more accurate due to Nighttime reducing your ranged defense.
units.zh: 优先选择夜间作战，此时伏击手命中较低。但如果敌人有{#1}萨满{/#1}，就要小心：它能给部分伏击手提供夜视，而夜间仍会降低你的远程防御，反而让它们更加容易命中。

units.source: {#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1} ({#2}Champion{/#2}) • {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Goblin Wolfrider{/#5} • {#6}Goblin Wolf{/#6} • {#7}Goblin Shaman{/#7} • {#8}Goblin Overseer{/#8} • {#9}Greenskin Catapult{/#9}
Goblin Wolfrider is a fast enemy from the {#1}Goblins{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 地精狼骑兵是{#1}地精{/#1}阵营中行动迅速的敌人。

units.source: {#1}Wolf Bite{/#1} does 20-40 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 40% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 15% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} ({#11}Goblin Wolfriders{/#11} can use it only once per turn and it costs 0 AP for them)

Wolfriders are fast enemies that avoid direct combat if they see backliners unguarded from the rear. They will circle around you, trying to get to them. However, when everyone is guarded properly, Wolfriders simply charge like regular enemies. They will use {#1}Footwork{/#1} to get close to someone vulnerable and attack him.
units.zh: 狼骑兵速度很快。如果发现后排缺乏后方保护，就会避开正面交战，绕到后面尝试攻击后排。但如果所有人都受到妥善保护，它们就会像普通敌人一样直接冲锋。它们也会用{#1}灵活步法{/#1}接近并攻击脆弱目标。

units.source: When they die, either a {#1}Skirmisher{/#1} or a {#2}Wolf{/#2} spawns, depending on where the last hit landed. Head hit spawns a Wolf, which then acts immediately, and body hit spawns a normal variant of Skirmisher. The enemy will always have 45% of its HP and the same {#3}morale{/#3} as the Wolfrider, however fleeing is replaced with breaking. Skirmishers also retain the armor. If the Wolfrider was the last enemy, nobody spawns and the battle immediately ends.
units.zh: 狼骑兵死亡时，会根据最后一击命中的部位生成{#1}游击兵{/#1}或{#2}狼{/#2}。头部致命一击会留下狼，且狼立即行动；躯干致命一击会留下普通版本的游击兵。留下的单位始终有45%生命值，并继承狼骑兵的{#3}士气{/#3}，但溃逃会改为濒临崩溃。游击兵还会保留护甲。如果狼骑兵是最后一个敌人，就不会生成其他单位，战斗会立即结束。

units.source: Bring less backliners and protect them from all sides. Wolfriders will immediately attack the frontline.
units.zh: 少带后排单位，并保护好他们的各个方向，这样狼骑兵就会直接攻击前排。

units.source: {#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1} ({#2}Champion{/#2}) • {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Goblin Wolfrider{/#5} • {#6}Goblin Wolf{/#6} • {#7}Goblin Shaman{/#7} • {#8}Goblin Overseer{/#8} • {#9}Greenskin Catapult{/#9}
Goblin Wolf is the result of a {#1}Wolfrider{/#1} receiving a fatal blow to the head.
units.zh: {#1}狼骑兵{/#1}头部受到致命一击后，会留下地精坐骑狼。

units.source: Goblin Wolves always spawn wounded, having 18 HP, and act immediately after spawning.
units.zh: 地精坐骑狼生成时总是受伤状态，只有18点生命值，并会立即行动。

units.source: They are weaker than the {#1}Wolf{/#1} the player can get in the {#2}Houndmaster Tames Wolf{/#2} event.
units.zh: 它们比玩家在{#2}驯犬师驯狼{/#2}事件中获得的{#1}狼{/#1}更弱。

units.source: They die easily. Kill them with someone who has {#1}Berserk{/#1} or {#2}Frenzy{/#2} to trigger their effects.
units.zh: 坐骑狼很容易杀死。可让拥有{#1}狂战{/#1}或{#2}杀戮狂热{/#2}的弟兄击杀，以触发相应效果。

units.source: {#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1} ({#2}Champion{/#2}) • {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Goblin Wolfrider{/#5} • {#6}Goblin Wolf{/#6} • {#7}Goblin Shaman{/#7} • {#8}Goblin Overseer{/#8} • {#9}Greenskin Catapult{/#9}

{#1}Root{/#1} will root up to 7 targets, a rooted target can't move, has {#2}-35%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}, {#6}-35%{/#6} {#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7}, {#10}-35%{/#10} {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} and your chance to break free is your {#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} -10 points with + 10 for each failed attempt (has a range of 8 tiles)
Goblin Shaman is a spellcaster from the {#1}Goblins{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 地精萨满是{#1}地精{/#1}阵营的施法者。

units.source: {#1}Grant Night Vision{/#1} grants night vision to up to 7 targets that are allied with the {#2}shaman{/#2} until the end of battle (has a range of 7 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}赋予夜视{/#1}使最多7名{#2}萨满{/#2}的友军获得夜视，持续到战斗结束。射程为7格。

units.source: Sometimes goblin squads have a Shaman. Shamans are enemies that use their magic to slow and hinder your attempts to close distance, and reduce your evasion. They seem to prioritize Root over Swarm of Insects.
units.zh: 地精队伍有时会配备萨满。萨满施法拖慢并阻碍你接近敌人，还会降低你的闪避能力。它们似乎优先使用根须缠缚，而不是虫群。

units.source: They can give night vision to other goblins. The spell works by permanently removing Nighttime debuff. They can cast it every turn, so eventually all goblins will be able to shoot without penalty.
units.zh: 萨满可以赋予其他地精夜视，效果是永久移除夜间减益。它们每回合都能施放，因此最终所有地精都能不受惩罚地射击。

units.source: Both Root and Grant Night Vision have a hexagon-shaped area of 7 tiles.
units.zh: 根须缠缚和赋予夜视的作用范围都是包含7格的六边形区域。

units.source: Their {#1}Gnarly Staff{/#1} is a light {#2}mace{/#2} and can stun.
units.zh: 萨满的{#1}盘根木杖{/#1}是一种轻型{#2}锤{/#2}，能够造成眩晕。

units.source: Removing vines is not always the best option because you spend AP on them instead of fighting, only to become entangled again on the next turn. If you are in melee, just fight. If you only have 4 AP left, remove vines from a brother who didn't act yet.
units.zh: 挣脱藤蔓不一定是最佳选择：你花行动点挣脱，就无法作战，而下回合可能又被缠住。如果已在近战中，可以直接继续战斗。如果只剩4行动点，则可帮助尚未行动的弟兄解除藤蔓。

units.source: However, removing vines makes Shamans cast them again instead of more nasty Swarm of Insects that makes you unable to land hits.
units.zh: 不过，解除藤蔓会诱使萨满再次施放根须缠缚，而不是更麻烦的虫群；后者会让你很难命中敌人。

units.source: Prefer daytime if a Shaman is present, because Nighttime reduces your ranged defense and goblins will have night vision.
units.zh: 敌人有萨满时应优先选择白天作战，因为夜间会降低你的远程防御，而地精却能获得夜视。

units.source: {#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1} ({#2}Champion{/#2}) • {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Goblin Wolfrider{/#5} • {#6}Goblin Wolf{/#6} • {#7}Goblin Shaman{/#7} • {#8}Goblin Overseer{/#8} • {#9}Greenskin Catapult{/#9}
{#1}Whip{/#1} will set the morale of one goblin to "confident", if the goblin was fleeing it will only be set to "steady" (has a range of 5 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}鞭击{/#1}使一名地精的士气变为“斗志昂扬”；如果目标正在溃逃，则只会恢复为“镇定”。射程为5格。

units.source: Goblin Overseer is an elite ranged enemy from the {#1}Goblins{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 地精监工是{#1}地精{/#1}阵营的精锐远程敌人。

units.source: The armor has an empty string as a name, what results in log entries like "Goblin Overseer's is hit for 4 damage".
units.zh: 其护甲名称为空字符串，因此战斗日志会出现缺少名称的句子，例如“地精监工的受到4点伤害”。

units.source: Sometimes a squad of goblins has an Overseer. Sometimes he will shoot heavy bolts with his {#1}Spiked Impaler{/#1}, but most of the time he is busy whipping goblins, improving their {#2}morale{/#2} to confident. If multiple Overseers happen to be in the same battle, such as in the {#3}Goblin City{/#3}, they can rally each other.
units.zh: 地精队伍有时会配备监工。它偶尔用{#1}刺桩重弩{/#1}发射重弩箭，但大部分时间忙于鞭策地精，将其{#2}士气{/#2}提高至斗志昂扬。如果同一场战斗中有多名监工，例如在{#3}地精城{/#3}，它们还能互相重振士气。

units.source: Their {#1}crossbows{/#1} deal armor-piercing damage, causing {#2}injuries{/#2} and even instant death without defensive {#3}perks{/#3}.
units.zh: 监工的{#1}弩{/#1}能造成穿甲伤害，导致{#2}伤势{/#2}；缺乏防御{#3}特长{/#3}时甚至可能被一击杀死。

units.source: Prefer nighttime when they are less accurate. Be careful if there is a {#1}Shaman{/#1}, he can give night vision to them, and they will be even more accurate due to Nighttime reducing your ranged defense.
units.zh: 优先选择夜间作战，此时监工命中较低。但如果敌人有{#1}萨满{/#1}，就要小心：它能给监工提供夜视，而夜间仍会降低你的远程防御，反而让监工更加容易命中。

units.source: {#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1} ({#2}Champion{/#2}) • {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Goblin Wolfrider{/#5} • {#6}Goblin Wolf{/#6} • {#7}Goblin Shaman{/#7} • {#8}Goblin Overseer{/#8} • {#9}Greenskin Catapult{/#9}

{#1}Gore{/#1} does 100-130 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 75% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}, 40% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, has knockback and {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}staggers{/#14} the target on hit (has a range of 3 to 6 tiles (except on turn 1 it has a range of 3 to 10 tiles))
{#1}Spirit Walk{/#1} teleports the ijirok, turns surrounding tiles to snow tiles and {#2}chills{/#2} the brothers next to the teleport (has a range of 1 to 30 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}灵体漫步{/#1}传送伊吉罗克，将周围格子变为雪地，并使传送点旁的弟兄陷入{#2}冻寒{/#2}。射程为1至30格。

units.source: Ijirok is the boss of the {#1}Hunting Ground{/#1} {#2}legendary location{/#2}.
units.zh: 伊吉罗克是{#2}传奇地点{/#2}{#1}狩猎场{/#1}的首领。

units.source: Every turn Ijirok will teleport away, freezing the space around it, and then ram into your squad from different directions. On the first turn it just rams. It is not affected by {#1}morale{/#1} and has no zone of control.
units.zh: 每回合，伊吉罗克都会传送离开，冻结周围区域，再从不同方向撞入你的队伍。首回合只会冲撞。它不受{#1}士气{/#1}影响，也没有控制区。

units.source: It can kill early game brothers with one head hit, and will easily inflict {#1}injuries{/#1} even in late game, unless brothers use {#2}Indomitable{/#2} or have extremely high HP.
units.zh: 伊吉罗克命中头部时可以一击杀死前期弟兄；即便后期也很容易造成{#1}伤势{/#1}，除非弟兄启用了{#2}不屈{/#2}，或拥有极高生命值。

units.source: Use {#1}polearms{/#1} and {#2}whips{/#2} for range and mobility they allow. Being able to reach and hit Ijirok is important in this fight.
units.zh: 使用{#1}长柄武器{/#1}和{#2}鞭子{/#2}，发挥其射程与机动优势。这场战斗中，能够追上并攻击伊吉罗克十分重要。

units.source: 6 AP two-handed weapons leave you vulnerable to {#1}Chilled{/#1} unless you {#2}daze{/#2} or {#3}stagger{/#3} the Ijirok to outspeed it or use {#4}Adrenaline{/#4}.
units.zh: 耗费6行动点的双手武器容易受到{#1}冻寒{/#1}影响；除非你使伊吉罗克{#2}恍惚{/#2}或{#3}踉跄{/#3}，从而先于它行动，或使用{#4}肾上腺素{/#4}。

units.source: {#1}Heavily armored{/#1} {#2}dogs{/#2} distract Ijirok and usually survive one body hit. If they die, Ijirok does not gain confidence.
units.zh: 装备{#1}重型护甲{/#1}的{#2}犬只{/#2}可以分散伊吉罗克的注意力，通常能承受一次躯干命中。即使犬只死去，伊吉罗克也不会因此变得斗志昂扬。

units.source: Assassin is a dangerous evasive elite unit from the {#1}Southern{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 刺客是{#1}南方{/#1}阵营中闪避出色的危险精锐单位。

units.source: Assassins often choose to wait instead of acting immediately when it's their turn. They will use {#1}Adrenaline{/#1} to get ahead of the enemy if not already faster than them. They will use {#2}Footwork{/#2} to get close to someone vulnerable and attack him.
units.zh: 轮到刺客时，他们经常选择等待，而非立即行动。如果原本行动顺序不比敌人早，就会使用{#1}肾上腺素{/#1}抢先行动。他们还会用{#2}灵活步法{/#2}接近并攻击脆弱目标。

units.source: They can throw {#1}Fire Pots{/#1} and {#2}Flash Pots{/#2}, but no more than two in total per Assassin. They don't actually have bombs in the inventory, but create them when they want to throw. If you manage to defeat an Assassin with a bomb in hand, it will even drop as loot!
units.zh: 刺客能投掷{#1}燃烧罐{/#1}和{#2}闪光罐{/#2}，但每名刺客合计最多投掷两次。他们的物品栏中其实没有这些投掷物，而是在准备投掷时才生成。如果能在刺客手持投掷罐时将其击败，罐子甚至会成为战利品！

units.source: {#1}Nets{/#1} make them easier to hit, but {#2}Taunt{/#2} is required to prevent them from breaking free. Alternatively, let them waste AP on nets instead of attacks.
units.zh: {#1}投网{/#1}能让刺客更容易被命中，但需要用{#2}挑衅{/#2}阻止其挣脱。也可以放任他们把行动点花在挣脱上，从而减少攻击。

units.source: {#1}Flash Pots{/#1} {#2}daze{/#2} you, so you will tire faster and their {#3}Deathblow{/#3} will deal extra damage.
units.zh: {#1}闪光罐{/#1}会让你{#2}恍惚{/#2}，更快耗尽体力，并使刺客的{#3}致命一击{/#3}造成额外伤害。

units.source: {#1}Fire Pots'{/#1} damage is not reduced by {#2}Nimble{/#2} and can't be dodged. Body armor protects from it, taking minor damage.
units.zh: {#1}燃烧罐{/#1}的伤害无法闪避，也不受{#2}轻灵{/#2}减免。躯干护甲可以抵挡这种伤害，自身仅承受少量损耗。

units.source: Their light {#1}Assassin's Head Wrap{/#1} offers little protection from {#2}flails{/#2}, this is also an opportunity to loot their armor.
units.zh: 轻便的{#1}刺客头巾{/#1}很难抵御{#2}连枷{/#2}，这也是夺取其护甲的机会。

units.source: They are especially deadly in the early or middle game, when you don't have {#1}Nimble{/#1} or heavy {#2}armor{/#2}.
units.zh: 前中期尚未获得{#1}轻灵{/#1}或重型{#2}护甲{/#2}时，刺客尤其致命。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor if their {#2}morale{/#2} breaks or the risk is not too high.
units.zh: 如果刺客{#2}士气{/#2}崩溃，或风险不高，可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}夺取护甲。

units.source: {#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}
Nomad Cutthroat is a weak enemy from the {#1}Nomads{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 游牧割喉者是{#1}游牧民{/#1}阵营中较弱的敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Saif{/#1} (double chance), {#2}Nomad Mace{/#2} (double chance), {#3}Wooden Stick{/#3}, {#4}Militia Spear{/#4} (double chance), {#5}Bludgeon{/#5} or {#6}Butcher's Cleaver{/#6}.
A {#1}Thick Nomad Robe{/#1} (50), {#2}Nomad Robe{/#2} (30), {#3}Cloth Sash{/#3} (20) or {#4}Leather Wraps{/#4} (20) (half chance).
A {#1}Nomad Leather Cap{/#1} (50), {#2}Leather Head Wrap{/#2} (40) or {#3}Nomad Head Wrap{/#3} (30) (double chance).
They {#1}Throw Dirt{/#1} to reduce your damage and dodge when they have not enough AP for an attack, and sometimes even instead of it.
units.zh: 行动点不足以攻击时，他们会用{#1}扬沙{/#1}降低你的伤害和闪避能力；有时即便能够攻击，也会选择扬沙。

units.source: They are a slightly stronger southern counterpart of {#1}Brigand Thugs{/#1}. They have {#2}Backstabber{/#2} and more defense, head protection and higher chance of having accurate weapons.
units.zh: 他们相当于南方版的{#1}强盗打手{/#1}，但稍强一些：拥有{#2}背刺者{/#2}，防御和头部防护更高，也更可能装备命中较好的武器。

units.source: They become more difficult to fight when then gain {#1}Dodge{/#1}, however they aren't much of a threat by this time.
units.zh: 获得{#1}闪避{/#1}后，他们会更难对付，不过到那时通常已不构成太大威胁。

units.source: {#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
Nomad Slinger is a ranged enemy from the {#1}Nomads{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 游牧投石手是{#1}游牧民{/#1}阵营的远程敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Thick Nomad Robe{/#1} (50), {#2}Nomad Robe{/#2} (30) or {#3}Cloth Sash{/#3} (20).

{#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
Nomad Archer is a ranged enemy from the {#1}Nomads{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 游牧弓手是{#1}游牧民{/#1}阵营的远程敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Nomad Leather Cap{/#1} (50) or {#2}Nomad Head Wrap{/#2} (30) (double chance).
They usually position themselves directly behind advancing melee allies. But they also were seen standing, shooting and being guarded by spearwalling nomads.
units.zh: 弓手通常紧跟在推进中的近战同伴后方。不过，也有弓手站在原地射击、由游牧民展开矛墙保护的情况。

units.source: Dangerous because of their numbers, high damage and ability to focus fire.
units.zh: 他们人数多、伤害高，还会集火，因此很危险。

units.source: In late game many Archers will hunt recruits you are trying to level-up, and are capable of killing them. Rookies should wear heavy {#1}armor{/#1} to reduce damage or not be in this fight at all.
units.zh: 后期的大量弓手会专门攻击你正在培养的新兵，而且足以将其杀死。新兵应穿戴重型{#1}护甲{/#1}减伤，或干脆不参加这场战斗。

units.source: They can hit backline often due to {#1}Bullseye{/#1} perk.
units.zh: 凭借{#1}鹰眼{/#1}特长，他们经常能够命中后排。

units.source: Flanking can be effective if there are too few {#1}Outlaws{/#1} to interfere.
units.zh: 如果{#1}游牧亡命徒{/#1}数量不足以阻拦，包抄侧翼会很有效。

units.source: {#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
Nomad Outlaw is an enemy from the {#1}Nomads{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 游牧亡命徒是{#1}游牧民{/#1}阵营的敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Scimitar{/#1} (double chance), {#2}Nomad Mace{/#2}, {#3}Boar Spear{/#3}, {#4}Polemace{/#4}, {#5}Light Southern Mace{/#5}, {#6}Two-Handed Saif{/#6}, {#7}Two-Handed Mallet{/#7}, {#8}Woodcutter's Axe{/#8}, {#9}Battle Whip{/#9} or {#10}Three-Headed Flail{/#10} (after day 10).
A {#1}Plated Nomad Mail{/#1} (105), {#2}Stitched Nomad Armor{/#2} (80) or {#3}Leather Nomad Robe{/#3} (65).
A {#1}Nomad Reinforced Helmet{/#1} (125), {#2}Nomad Light Helmet{/#2} (70), {#3}Nomad Leather Cap{/#3} (50) or {#4}Leather Head Wrap{/#4} (40).

They {#1}Throw Dirt{/#1} to reduce your damage and dodge when they have not enough AP for an attack, and sometimes even instead of it. If armed with a {#2}Polemace{/#2} and there are no enemies nearby, they wait to not get ahead of their melee allies.
units.zh: 行动点不足以攻击时，他们会用{#1}扬沙{/#1}降低你的伤害和闪避能力；有时即便能够攻击，也会选择扬沙。若装备{#2}长柄钉锤{/#2}且附近没有敌人，他们会等待，以免走到近战同伴前面。

units.source: They are a stronger southern counterpart of {#1}Brigand Raiders{/#1}.
units.zh: 他们相当于更强的南方版{#1}强盗劫掠者{/#1}。

units.source: They become more difficult to fight after day 40 when then gain {#1}Dodge{/#1}, but are dangerous even without it.
units.zh: 第40天后获得{#1}闪避{/#1}时，他们会更难对付，但没有闪避时也已经很危险。

units.source: Wear {#1}helmets{/#1} to avoid a quick death from their {#2}flails{/#2} and two-handed weapons.
units.zh: 应佩戴{#1}头盔{/#1}，避免被他们的{#2}连枷{/#2}或双手武器迅速杀死。

units.source: Take {#1}Nine Lives{/#1} to survive a heavy hit and remove {#2}Bleeding{/#2}.
units.zh: 学习{#1}九命{/#1}可以撑过致命重击，并移除{#2}流血{/#2}。

units.source: {#1}Whip{/#1} nomads mostly can be ignored as they can't destroy armor or hurt through it. However they try to use {#2}Disarm{/#2} or attack someone whose armor got destroyed in a range of 3 tiles.
units.zh: 持{#1}鞭子{/#1}的游牧民通常可以暂时忽略，因为他们无法破坏护甲或穿透护甲造成伤害。不过，他们会尝试对3格范围内的目标使用{#2}缴械{/#2}，或攻击护甲已被摧毁的人。

units.source: When they are mixed with {#1}Cutthroats{/#1}, killing Cutthroats can break their morale and hinder their {#2}Backstabber{/#2}.
units.zh: 如果敌人中混有{#1}割喉者{/#1}，杀死割喉者可以击溃他们的士气，也能削弱{#2}背刺者{/#2}的效果。

units.source: {#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
Nomad Leader is an elite enemy from the {#1}Nomads{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 游牧首领是{#1}游牧民{/#1}阵营的精锐敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Shamshir{/#1}, {#2}Heavy Southern Mace{/#2}, {#3}Fighting Spear{/#3} or {#4}Two-Handed Scimitar{/#4}.
35% chance of a {#1}Throwing Spear{/#1} or {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2}.
A {#1}Southern Long Mail Shirt with Padding{/#1} (200) or {#2}Plated Nomad Mail{/#2} (105).
A {#1}Southern Helmet with Coif{/#1} (200) or {#2}Nomad Reinforced Helmet{/#2} (125) (double chance).
If the weapon is one-handed, 66% chance of a {#1}Sipar Shield{/#1}.
units.zh: 若使用单手武器，则有66%概率装备{#1}西帕尔圆盾{/#1}。

units.source: Nomad Leaders start appearing in the middle game. Late game nomad groups usually have a Leader. It's rare to see simultaneously more than one. The Leader spawns in the very back and usually does not hurry to enter battle.
units.zh: 游牧首领从中期开始出现；后期的游牧民队伍通常都会有一名首领，同时出现多名首领的情况很少见。首领生成在队伍最后方，通常不急于参战。

units.source: Don't puncture them if they wear 125/105 set, you can get this from {#1}Nomad Outlaws{/#1}.
units.zh: 如果首领穿的是125/105护具组合，就不必用破甲刺击留甲了：{#1}游牧亡命徒{/#1}也能提供这些装备。
