units.source: {#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
Desert Stalker is an elite ranged enemy from the {#1}Nomads{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 沙漠潜猎者是{#1}游牧民{/#1}阵营的精锐远程敌人。

units.source: {#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
Nomad Executioner is a dangerous, heavily armored elite enemy from the {#1}Nomads{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 游牧刽子手是{#1}游牧民{/#1}阵营中危险的重甲精锐敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Two-Handed Scimitar{/#1} (double chance), {#2}Two-Handed Flanged Mace{/#2}, {#3}Two-Handed Flail{/#3}, {#4}Bardiche{/#4} or {#5}Two-Handed Hammer{/#5}.
A {#1}Turban Helmet{/#1} (290), {#2}Southern Helmet with Coif{/#2} (200) or {#3}Nomad Reinforced Helmet{/#3} (125).
{#1}Nets{/#1} make them easier to hit, but {#2}Taunt{/#2} is required to prevent them from breaking free. Also they can't remove a net and attack with a 6 AP weapon on the same turn.
units.zh: {#1}投网{/#1}能让刽子手更容易被命中，但需要用{#2}挑衅{/#2}阻止其挣脱。此外，他们无法在同一回合挣脱投网并用耗费6行动点的武器攻击。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor if their {#2}morale{/#2} breaks or if you can reliably stun or disarm them. Failing to stun can result in casualties, and he has {#3}Berserk{/#3} that allows him to attack even more.
units.zh: 如果刽子手{#2}士气{/#2}崩溃，或你能稳定地将其眩晕、缴械，可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}夺取护甲。但眩晕一旦失败，就可能造成伤亡，而{#3}狂战{/#3}还会让他获得更多攻击机会。

units.source: {#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
Blade Dancer is a dangerous evasive elite enemy from the {#1}Nomads{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 剑舞者是{#1}游牧民{/#1}阵营中闪避出色的危险精锐敌人。

units.source: Blade Dancers with {#1}Swordlances{/#1} will {#2}Footwork{/#2} away from you. Those who have {#3}Shamshirs{/#3} will use it to get close to someone vulnerable and attack him.
units.zh: 持{#1}长柄剑刃{/#1}的剑舞者会用{#2}灵活步法{/#2}远离你；持{#3}舍施尔弯刀{/#3}的则会借此接近并攻击脆弱目标。

units.source: Attack them with {#1}ranged weapons{/#1}, preferably {#2}throwing{/#2}. {#3}Anticipation{/#3} with decent ranged defense makes them difficult to hit from long range.
units.zh: 用{#1}远程武器{/#1}攻击剑舞者，最好是{#2}投掷武器{/#2}。他们的{#3}预判{/#3}配合不错的远程防御，使远距离攻击很难命中。

units.source: If you can not use ranged weapons, like when sworn the Oath of Honor, {#1}spears{/#1}, {#2}Backstabber{/#2}, {#3}Fast Adaptation{/#3} and high melee skill can be somewhat useful.
units.zh: 如果无法使用远程武器，例如已经立下荣誉之誓，那么{#1}矛{/#1}、{#2}背刺者{/#2}、{#3}快速适应{/#3}和较高的近战命中还能起些作用。

units.source: They lack {#1}Resilient{/#1}, so poisons and {#2}Daze{/#2} can be effective. {#3}Nimble{/#3} doesn't reduce poison damage.
units.zh: 剑舞者没有{#1}顽强{/#1}，因此毒药和{#2}恍惚{/#2}可能有效；{#3}轻灵{/#3}也不会降低毒伤。

units.source: {#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
Serpents spawn in deserts and oasises. They also can be encountered in {#1}Hunting Beasts{/#1} contracts that appear in southern cities, but only after day 15.
units.zh: 巨蛇会出现在沙漠和绿洲。南方城邦提供的{#1}猎杀野兽{/#1}委托中也可能遇到它们，但要到第15天后。

units.source: {#1}Snake{/#1} causes the {#2}Serpent{/#2} to take 34% less damage from {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} {#6}Fire Handgonne (5 fatigue){/#6} and {#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7} {#10}Ignite (5 fatigue){/#10}, the {#11}Serpent{/#11} has +15 {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} towards its turn order if there are enemies in its zone of control

{#1}Drag{/#1} pulls the target closer to the {#2}serpent{/#2}, ends {#3}Shieldwall{/#3}, {#4}Spearwall{/#4} and {#5}Riposte{/#5}, can cause falling damage that also adds fatigue, will {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}Stagger{/#9} for 2 turns (can be used on equal elevation level or if the serpent has the higher elevation level and has a range of 3 tiles)
units.zh: {#1}拖拽{/#1}将目标拉近{#2}巨蛇{/#2}，终止{#3}盾墙{/#3}、{#4}矛墙{/#4}和{#5}还击架势{/#5}。可能造成坠落伤害并增加疲劳，还会施加{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6}{#9}踉跄{/#9}，持续2回合。只能在双方高度相同，或巨蛇处于更高位置时使用，射程为3格。

units.source: A {#1}Serpent Skin{/#1} (60% chance) or {#2}Glistening Scales{/#2} (40% chance). 50% chance of another, rolling separately.
units.zh: 掉落{#1}巨蛇皮{/#1}（60%概率）或{#2}闪亮鳞片{/#2}（40%概率）。另有50%概率额外掉落一件，种类独立判定。

units.source: Serpents take only 66% damage from {#1}Fire Pots{/#1} and {#2}firearms{/#2}.
units.zh: 巨蛇受到的{#1}燃烧罐{/#1}和{#2}火器{/#2}伤害只有66%。

units.source: Serpents' strategy is based on {#1}dragging{/#1} enemies into surrounding and killing them with multiple attacks. They approach carefully, often waiting with enough AP for an attack. They prefer to drag more vulnerable units, units that are not engaded in melee, and especially they like to drag someone with {#2}Shieldwall{/#2}, {#3}Spearwall{/#3} or {#4}Riposte{/#4} active, canceling these skills. They are also more likely to drag if they aren't in melee themselves. {#5}Taunt{/#5} has little effect and only affects their melee attack.
units.zh: 巨蛇的战术是将敌人{#1}拖入{/#1}包围，再通过多次攻击将其杀死。它们接近时很谨慎，经常保留足够攻击的行动点等待。它们偏好拖拽脆弱单位、尚未进入近战的单位，尤其偏好正在使用{#2}盾墙{/#2}、{#3}矛墙{/#3}或{#4}还击架势{/#4}的目标，以打断这些技能。自身尚未陷入近战时，它们也更倾向于拖拽。{#5}挑衅{/#5}作用有限，只影响它们的近战攻击。

units.source: Use {#1}Shieldwall{/#1} to provoke them to drag your tanks.
units.zh: 让坦克使用{#1}盾墙{/#1}，可以诱使巨蛇优先拖拽他们。

units.source: {#1}Footwork{/#1} and {#2}Smoke Pots{/#2} can be useful to escape from partial surrounding.
units.zh: {#1}灵活步法{/#1}和{#2}烟雾罐{/#2}可以帮助脱离尚未完全合拢的包围。

units.source: +5 initiative if there is a same sized Ifrit adjacent, +10 if two or more
units.zh: 与一只同体型沙魔相邻时获得+5先攻；与两只或更多相邻时获得+10先攻。

units.source: Ifrit is a creature of sand and stone from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction. They come in three sizes, larger being formed when smaller merge together.
units.zh: 沙魔是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营中由沙石构成的生物，共有三种体型；较大的沙魔由较小的沙魔融合而成。

units.source: Ifrits spawn in deserts and oases. They also can be encountered in {#1}Shifting Sands{/#1} contracts that appear in southern cities.
units.zh: 沙魔会出现在沙漠和绿洲，也可能在南方城邦提供的{#1}流沙之变{/#1}委托中遇到。

units.source: They will be either all small or small and medium.
units.zh: 初始队伍要么全部是小型沙魔，要么由小型和中型沙魔组成。

units.source: {#1}Sand Golem{/#1} takes only 10% damage from bows and fire lances' ignite, 25% damage from javelins and handgonne, 33% damage from crossbows and slings, 50% damage from other piercing weapons; doesn't take damage if hit by another {#2}Ifrit's{/#2} living sand throw.
units.zh: {#1}沙魔像{/#1}受到的弓箭和火矛点燃伤害只有10%，标枪和手铳伤害为25%，弩和投石索伤害为33%，其他穿刺武器伤害为50%；被另一只{#2}沙魔{/#2}的投掷活沙命中时不会受伤。

units.source: {#1}Merge Living Sands{/#1} will combine three size 1 {#2}Ifrits{/#2} to one size 2 {#3}Ifrit{/#3} or three size 2 {#4}Ifrits{/#4} to one size 3 {#5}Ifrit{/#5}, the newly assembled {#6}Ifrit{/#6} will have full health and armor no matter how damaged the three {#7}Ifrits{/#7} it's made of were, the three {#8}Ifrits{/#8} need to be adjacent to use this skill, this skill can be used with an elevation difference of 4
units.zh: {#1}流沙融合{/#1}将三只体型1的{#2}沙魔{/#2}合为一只体型2的{#3}沙魔{/#3}，或将三只体型2的{#4}沙魔{/#4}合为一只体型3的{#5}沙魔{/#5}。无论原先三只{#7}沙魔{/#7}受损多重，新形成的{#6}沙魔{/#6}都会拥有满生命值和满护甲。使用技能的三只{#8}沙魔{/#8}必须彼此相邻，允许的高度差为4。

units.source: {#1}Size 2 Throw Living Sand{/#1} does 70-90 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 65% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 40% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, the {#11}Ifrit{/#11} will break down into three {#12}Ifrits{/#12} with a lower size, one will be right next to the target of the throw and the other one next to the original {#13}Ifrit{/#13}, the newly created {#14}Ifrits{/#14} will have full health and armor no matter how damaged the original {#15}Ifrit{/#15} was (Has a range of 2 - 5 tiles, can be used when engaged in melee, but the target has to be at least 2 tiles away, can be used over 3 elevation levels)

{#1}Size 3 Throw Living Sand{/#1} does 105-135 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 70% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 40% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, the {#11}Ifrit{/#11} will break down into two size 2 {#12}Ifrits{/#12} and three size 1 {#13}Ifrits{/#13}, one will be right next to the target of the throw and the other 4 next to the original {#14}Ifrit{/#14}, the newly created {#15}Ifrits{/#15} will have full health and armor no matter how damaged the original {#16}Ifrit{/#16} was (Has a range of 2 - 5 tiles, can be used when engaged in melee, but the target has to be at least 2 tiles away, can be used over 3 elevation levels)
Loot is the same for all sizes, because killing an Ifrit always destroys one small part, breaking larger Ifrits apart.
units.zh: 各种体型的战利品相同，因为每次击杀沙魔都只会摧毁一块小型组成部分；较大的沙魔则会随之散开。

units.source: Ifrits can merge together and break apart. When they do it, all damage they had is repaired. Larger ones are tougher and hit harder.
units.zh: 沙魔能够融合和分裂，每次都会完全恢复此前受到的伤害。体型越大，越耐打，伤害也越高。

units.source: Three adjacent Ifrits of the same size can combine into a larger Ifrit, except when they are large already. They prioritize assembling above anything else.
units.zh: 三只相邻、体型相同的沙魔可以融合成更大的沙魔，最大型的除外。融合的优先级高于其他所有行动。

units.source: Medium and large Ifrits can throw a part of themselves, breaking apart in the process. Medium Ifrits break into three small ones, one of which is thrown. Large Ifrits break into two medium and three small ones, one of which is thrown. They can't throw if there is not enough space for all parts, medium Ifrits need one tile near them and large need three.
units.zh: 中型和大型沙魔能将身体的一部分投掷出去，并在过程中分裂。中型会分裂为三只小型沙魔，其中一只被投出；大型会分裂为两只中型和三只小型沙魔，其中一只小型被投出。如果没有足够空间容纳分裂部分，就无法投掷：中型沙魔身边需要一个空格，大型则需要三个。

units.source: If killed, they also break apart, but without one small part, and more parts are lost if there are no free adjacent tiles for them.
units.zh: 被击杀时，沙魔同样会分裂，但会少一块小型组成部分。如果相邻空格不足，还会损失更多部分。

units.source: They all have no heads, all head hits are redirected to the body.
units.zh: 沙魔没有头部，所有头部命中都会转为躯干命中。

units.source: Medium and large Ifrits have a unique mechanic that affects armor. They have ArmorMult values modified, set to 2 and 4 respectively. It multiplies the armor value, but only in HP damage calculations. Armor damage is not affected. Mods that show exact armor value usually show it multiplied.
units.zh: 中型和大型沙魔有一种特殊的护甲机制：护甲倍率（ArmorMult）分别被设为2和4。该倍率只在计算生命值伤害时放大护甲值，不影响护甲所受伤害。显示精确护甲数值的模组通常会显示乘以倍率后的值。

units.source: In early game, medium Ifrits inflict {#1}injuries{/#1} on the first hits, and large ones can kill if they hit the head without defensive {#2}perks{/#2}.
units.zh: 前期，中型沙魔初次命中就可能造成{#1}伤势{/#1}；缺乏防御{#2}特长{/#2}时，大型沙魔命中头部甚至能直接杀死弟兄。

units.source: In late game, large Ifrits still can injure brothers with the first hit, unless they use {#1}Indomitable{/#1} or have extremely high HP.
units.zh: 即便后期，大型沙魔首次命中仍可能造成伤势，除非弟兄启用了{#1}不屈{/#1}，或拥有极高生命值。

units.source: Surround them to prevent throwing and make them lose more parts when killed. However you will receive less loot and XP.
units.zh: 包围沙魔可以阻止它们投掷，也能使其死亡时损失更多组成部分，但这样获得的战利品和经验也会减少。

units.source: They resist {#1}ranged weapons{/#1}, and ranged brothers will be engaged in melee by small Ifrits thrown at them.
units.zh: 沙魔对{#1}远程武器{/#1}有抗性，而且投出的沙魔会贴住远程弟兄，迫使其近战。

units.source: Baiting their shots requires a few brothers with extremely high ranged defense and HP, and good damage output from the backline.
units.zh: 若要诱导沙魔投掷，需要几名远程防御和生命值都极高的弟兄，并让后排提供足够伤害。

units.source: Indebted is a weak unit from the {#1}Southern{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 负债者是{#1}南方{/#1}阵营中较弱的单位。

units.source: A {#1}Pitchfork{/#1}, {#2}Militia Spear{/#2}, {#3}Wooden Stick{/#3}, {#4}Butcher's Cleaver{/#4}, {#5}Pickaxe{/#5} or {#6}Knife{/#6}.
When Indebted flee or die, non-Indebted allies do not lose morale. Southern soldiers often {#1}rotate{/#1} Indebted into melee, where they quickly die.
units.zh: 负债者溃逃或死亡时，不会降低非负债者友军的士气。南方士兵经常通过{#1}换位{/#1}把负债者送进近战，使他们很快丧命。

units.source: Aren't much of a threat themselves, but provide surrounding for {#1}Backstabber{/#1} to work. All southern troops have Backstabber.
units.zh: 负债者本身威胁不大，却能形成包围，让{#1}背刺者{/#1}发挥作用。所有南方部队都拥有背刺者。

units.source: Because of all this, they should be killed first, preferably with brothers who have Berserk and Frenzy.
units.zh: 因此应优先杀死负债者，最好由拥有狂战和杀戮狂热的弟兄负责。

units.source: {#1}Pickaxes{/#1} and {#2}spears{/#2} are most dangerous weapons they can have, having damage or accuracy.
units.zh: 他们可能装备的武器中，{#1}镐{/#1}伤害高，{#2}矛{/#2}命中高，最为危险。

units.source: {#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}
Bonus stats from shields, weapons, skills and perks are increased as well
units.zh: 盾牌、武器、技能和特长提供的属性加成也会提高。

units.source: This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of a {#2}Desert Stalker{/#2}.
Regular items (skipped if conflicting with the named one):
units.zh: 常规装备（若与名贵装备冲突，则跳过）：

units.source: He is a ranged champion and much less dangerous in melee.
units.zh: 这是远程精英勇士，进入近战后威胁会小得多。

units.source: Can inflict {#1}injuries{/#1} through heavy armor with above average named weapon rolls.
units.zh: 若名贵武器属性高于平均水平，就能穿透重甲造成{#1}伤势{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Head Hunter{/#1} allows him to land double headshots, deadly with above average named weapon rolls.
units.zh: {#1}猎首者{/#1}能让他连续两次命中头部；若名贵武器属性高于平均水平，尤其致命。

units.source: Nighttime reduces his accuracy, but he will still hit a lot.
units.zh: 夜间会降低他的命中率，但他仍然经常能命中。

units.source: {#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
Hyenas spawn in deserts and oasises. They also can be encountered in {#1}Hunting Beasts{/#1} contracts that appear in southern cities, especially before day 15.
units.zh: 鬣狗会出现在沙漠和绿洲，也可能在南方城邦提供的{#1}猎杀野兽{/#1}委托中遇到，尤其是第15天之前。

units.source: {#1}Hyena Bite{/#1} does 20-35 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 100% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 35% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, causes {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}Bleeding{/#14} for 5 dmg per turn on {#15}Hyenas{/#15} and 10 dmg per turn on {#16}Frenzied Hyenas{/#16} if at least 6 hitpoints were lost from the attack. {#17}Bleeding{/#17} lasts 2 turns.
A {#1}Raging Hyena Fur{/#1} (30% chance), {#2}Acidic Saliva{/#2} (20% chance) or {#3}Strange Meat{/#3} (16.5% chance).
A {#1}Raging Hyena Fur{/#1} (30% chance), {#2}Acidic Saliva{/#2} (20% chance) or {#3}Strange Meat{/#3} (16.5% chance). 50% chance of another, rolling separately.
units.zh: 掉落{#1}狂暴鬣狗皮{/#1}（30%概率）、{#2}酸性唾液{/#2}（20%概率）或{#3}不明兽肉{/#3}（16.5%概率）。另有50%概率额外掉落一件，种类独立判定。

units.source: Hyena is the {#1}Direwolf{/#1}'s southern counterpart. Hyenas are less tough, have more AP but less initiative, and their bites cause {#2}bleeding{/#2}. Unlike Direwolves, sometimes they can wait.
units.zh: 鬣狗相当于南方的{#1}恐狼{/#1}。它们没有恐狼耐打，行动点更多但先攻更低，撕咬还会造成{#2}流血{/#2}。与恐狼不同，鬣狗有时会选择等待。

units.source: Be careful when attacking a pack of them, they can be much stronger {#1}Frenzied{/#1} ones.
units.zh: 攻击鬣狗群时要小心，其中可能是强得多的{#1}狂暴鬣狗{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Bleeding{/#1} can be removed with {#2}Bandages{/#2}, but {#3}Nimble{/#3} does not reduce its damage.
Frenzied Hyena is an enemy from the {#1}Beasts{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 狂暴鬣狗是{#1}野兽{/#1}阵营的敌人。

units.source: Hyenas spawn in deserts and oasises. They also can be encountered in {#1}Hunting Beasts{/#1} contracts that appear in southern cities, especially before day 15, but will likely not be frenzied in that early game.
units.zh: 鬣狗会出现在沙漠和绿洲，也可能在南方城邦提供的{#1}猎杀野兽{/#1}委托中遇到，尤其是第15天之前；不过，在这么早的阶段，它们通常不是狂暴版本。

units.source: {#1}Hyena Bite{/#1} does 20-35 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 100% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 35% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}, causes {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}Bleeding{/#14} for 5 dmg per turn on {#15}Hyenas{/#15} and 10 dmg per turn on {#16}Frenzied Hyenas{/#16} if at least 6 hitpoints were lost from the attack. {#17}Bleeding{/#17} lasts 2 turns.
Frenzied Hyenas are like {#1}Hyenas{/#1}, but stronger. Some of them rush you, and some will wait.
units.zh: 狂暴鬣狗与{#1}普通鬣狗{/#1}相似，但更强。有些会直接冲锋，有些则会等待。

units.source: High melee defense with a {#1}shield{/#1} or {#2}Dodge{/#2} makes them almost harmless, because they have low melee skill.
units.zh: 鬣狗的近战命中较低，因此较高的近战防御配合{#1}盾牌{/#1}或{#2}闪避{/#2}，几乎能使其失去威胁。

units.source: Conscript is a melee unit from the {#1}Southern{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 征召兵是{#1}南方{/#1}阵营的近战单位。

units.source: A {#1}Light Southern Mace{/#1}, {#2}Saif{/#2}, {#3}Scimitar{/#3} or {#4}Fire Lance{/#4}.
A {#1}Spiked Skull Cap with Mail{/#1} (125), {#2}Wrapped Southern Helmet{/#2} (105) or {#3}Southern Head Wrap{/#3} (30).

Frontline Conscripts are dedicated to defending {#1}polearm Conscripts{/#1} and {#2}Gunners{/#2}. They often use Shieldwall to improve their own survivability, and can {#3}rotate{/#3} with allies to save them from danger.
units.zh: 前排征召兵专门保护{#1}长柄武器征召兵{/#1}和{#2}火铳手{/#2}。他们经常展开盾墙提高生存能力，也能与友军{#3}换位{/#3}，将其救出险境。

units.source: The color of their {#1}Linothoraxes{/#1} and style of {#2}Head Wraps{/#2} depends on the banner of their city state.
units.zh: {#1}亚麻胸甲{/#1}的颜色和{#2}头巾{/#2}的样式取决于所属城邦的旗帜。

units.source: {#1}Handgonnes{/#1} deal good damage to them because they lack heavy armor and fight in a tight formation. {#2}Adarga Shields{/#2} will reduce your hit chance, especially in {#3}Shieldwall{/#3}.
units.zh: 征召兵没有重甲，又习惯密集阵型，因此{#1}手铳{/#1}能造成不错的伤害。不过，{#2}阿达尔加盾{/#2}会降低你的命中率，展开{#3}盾墙{/#3}时尤其如此。

units.source: Breaking their Adarga Shields is easy and does not require melee skill or Double Grip. {#1}Axe Mastery{/#1} allows to break a shield in one hit. {#2}Throwing Spears{/#2} can destroy shields from range.
units.zh: 阿达尔加盾很容易破坏，破盾无需近战命中或双手握持加成。{#1}斧术精通{/#1}能让你一击破盾；{#2}投矛{/#2}则能远距离破盾。

units.source: {#1}Cleavers{/#1} require {#2}Duelist{/#2} or being two-handed to work. {#3}Rusty Warblade{/#3} showed the best result.
units.zh: 使用{#1}斩刀{/#1}时，需要搭配{#2}决斗家{/#2}或改用双手斩刀才能奏效。其中{#3}锈蚀战刃{/#3}表现最好。

units.source: {#1}Greataxes'{/#1} {#2}Split Man{/#2} kills them in two hits. Other two-handed weapons need to hit the same body part, but may be more optimal with area attacks.
units.zh: {#1}巨斧{/#1}的{#2}劈身{/#2}两击即可杀死征召兵。其他双手武器需要命中同一部位，不过凭借范围攻击，整体效果可能更好。

units.source: {#1}Flails{/#1} bypass shields, can target the head and Conscripts don't have {#2}Steel Brow{/#2}. But it requires {#3}Flail Mastery{/#3}, is fatiguing, and Conscripts often have helmets.
units.zh: {#1}连枷{/#1}可以绕过盾牌并瞄准头部，而征召兵没有{#2}钢铁额骨{/#2}。不过，这需要{#3}连枷精通{/#3}，消耗体力较多，而且征召兵经常戴着头盔。

units.source: One-handed {#1}hammers'{/#1} damage minimum of 10 isn't affected by {#2}Nimble{/#2}, and they destroy armor quickly, allowing other weapons to deal full damage.
units.zh: 单手{#1}战锤{/#1}最低10点的伤害不受{#2}轻灵{/#2}影响，而且能迅速摧毁护甲，让其他武器打出完整伤害。

units.source: Being {#1}Nimble{/#1}, they are more vulnerable to {#2}Fearsome{/#2}, and have no rallying units. However they will often resist due to their high resolve.
units.zh: 征召兵依靠{#1}轻灵{/#1}防御，因此更容易受到{#2}威慑{/#2}影响；他们也没有能重振士气的单位。不过，较高的意志仍让他们经常抵抗成功。

units.source: {#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}
Conscript with polearm is a backline melee unit from the {#1}Southern{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 持长柄武器的征召兵是{#1}南方{/#1}阵营的后排近战单位。

units.source: Polearm Conscripts often spend a whole turn to take a position two tiles away from the enemy, preventing allies from attacking from there. Those armed with {#1}Swordlances{/#1} can hit an ally when attacking two enemies.
units.zh: 长柄武器征召兵经常花费整个回合移动到距敌人两格的位置，反而占住了友军可以攻击的位置。持{#1}长柄剑刃{/#1}的征召兵在攻击两个敌人时，可能误伤友军。

units.source: Priority targets because of their threat, but less than {#1}Gunners{/#1}.
units.zh: 他们威胁很大，应优先处理，但优先级低于{#1}火铳手{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Swordlances{/#1} will do more damage if your formation is tight.
units.zh: 你的阵型越密集，{#1}长柄剑刃{/#1}造成的伤害就越多。

units.source: {#1}Polemace{/#1} Conscripts can be controlled with {#2}Taunt{/#2} and {#3}Disarm{/#3}. {#4}Swordlance{/#4} ones can use {#5}Reap{/#5} if taunted, and {#6}Quick Hands{/#6} with {#7}Polearm Mastery{/#7} allows them to still attack if disarmed.
units.zh: 持{#1}长柄钉锤{/#1}的征召兵可用{#2}挑衅{/#2}和{#3}缴械{/#3}控制。持{#4}长柄剑刃{/#4}的被挑衅后仍能使用{#5}收割{/#5}；而{#6}快手{/#6}配合{#7}长柄武器精通{/#7}，使他们被缴械后也仍能攻击。

units.source: {#1}Flails{/#1} bypass shields, can target the head and Conscripts don't have {#2}Steel Brow{/#2}, but the {#3}special attack{/#3} is fatiguing to use.
units.zh: {#1}连枷{/#1}可以绕过盾牌并瞄准头部，而征召兵没有{#2}钢铁额骨{/#2}，不过{#3}特殊攻击{/#3}很消耗体力。

units.source: When fighting on your side, they can {#1}rotate{/#1} you into dangerous positions and even hit you with {#2}Swordlances{/#2}.
units.zh: 作为友军作战时，他们可能通过{#1}换位{/#1}把你送到危险位置，甚至用{#2}长柄剑刃{/#2}误伤你。

units.source: {#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}
Gunner is a short-ranged unit from the {#1}Southern{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 火铳手是{#1}南方{/#1}阵营的短射程远程单位。

units.source: Gunners don't plan their actions well. Then can sometimes shoot at a single target, reload on the next turn and not catch up with {#1}Conscripts{/#1}. They also often shoot with a risk of friendly fire, and can even shoot if there are more allies than enemies.
units.zh: 火铳手的行动规划不太好：有时只对单个目标射击，下回合再装填，因而跟不上{#1}征召兵{/#1}。他们也经常冒着误伤风险开火，甚至在射程内友军多于敌人时仍会射击。

units.source: They will {#1}Overwhelm{/#1} you, unless you are faster, use {#2}Adrenaline{/#2}, {#3}nets{/#3}, {#4}daze{/#4} or {#5}stagger{/#5}. This includes their melee attacks.
units.zh: 火铳手会对你施加{#1}压制{/#1}，除非你行动更快，或使用{#2}肾上腺素{/#2}、{#3}投网{/#3}、{#4}恍惚{/#4}或{#5}踉跄{/#5}来应对。他们的近战攻击也能施加压制。

units.source: They do more damage and apply more debuffs if your formation is tight.
units.zh: 你的阵型越密集，火铳手造成的伤害和施加的减益就越多。

units.source: When fighting on your side, they can {#1}rotate{/#1} you into dangerous positions and even fire at you.
units.zh: 作为友军作战时，火铳手可能通过{#1}换位{/#1}把你送到危险位置，甚至向你开火。

units.source: Heavy {#1}armor{/#1} with {#2}Battle Forged{/#2} is recommended because {#3}Handgonnes{/#3} are weak against armor.
units.zh: 推荐重型{#1}护甲{/#1}搭配{#2}久经战阵{/#2}，因为{#3}手铳{/#3}对护甲的伤害较低。

units.source: {#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}
Officer is a heavily armored elite unit from the {#1}Southern{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 军官是{#1}南方{/#1}阵营中身披重甲的精锐单位。

units.source: A {#1}Padded Mail and Lamellar Hauberk{/#1} (290), {#2}Southern Long Mail Shirt with Padding{/#2} (200) or {#3}Mail with Lamellar Plating{/#3} (135).
A {#1}Turban Helmet{/#1} (290), {#2}Heavy Lamellar Helmet{/#2} (255) or {#3}Southern Helmet with Coif{/#3} (200).
If his armor is heavy, he will be able to survive a lot of damage.
units.zh: 如果军官穿着重甲，就能承受大量伤害。

units.source: If his armor is medium, armor piercing damage can kill him quickly.
units.zh: 如果穿的是中型护甲，穿甲伤害就能迅速杀死他。

units.source: His {#1}Sipar Shield{/#1} is really hard to break and he can be hard to hit with it.
units.zh: 军官的{#1}西帕尔圆盾{/#1}很难破坏，也会让他变得难以命中。

units.source: {#1}Two-Handed Scimitar{/#1} can deal high damage, but then you can use {#2}stun{/#2} and {#3}disarm{/#3}.
units.zh: {#1}双手弯刀{/#1}能造成高伤害，不过此时你可以用{#2}眩晕{/#2}或{#3}缴械{/#3}控制他。

units.source: Can be {#1}punctured{/#1} for their armor if their {#2}morale{/#2} breaks or if you can reliably stun or disarm them.
units.zh: 如果军官{#2}士气{/#2}崩溃，或你能稳定地将其眩晕、缴械，可以用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}夺取护甲。

units.source: {#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}

A {#1}Shamshir{/#1} (double chance), {#2}Heavy Southern Mace{/#2} (double chance), {#3}Fighting Spear{/#3}, {#4}Fighting Axe{/#4} (double chance), {#5}Swordlance{/#5}, {#6}Polemace{/#6}, {#7}Two-Handed Hammer{/#7}, {#8}Greataxe{/#8}, {#9}Two-Handed Flail{/#9}, {#10}Two-Handed Flanged Mace{/#10}, {#11}Bardiche{/#11} or {#12}Two-Handed Scimitar{/#12}.
If the weapon's range is 1, 50% chance of a {#1}Throwing Spear{/#1}, {#2}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#2} or {#3}Bundle of Javelins{/#3}.
A {#1}Gladiator Harness{/#1} (40) with {#2}Padded Armor Pieces{/#2} (60) or {#3}Metal Armor Pieces{/#3} (115) armor attachment.
If the weapon is one-handed, a {#1}Sipar Shield{/#1} or {#2}Throwing Net{/#2}.
units.zh: 若使用单手武器，则装备{#1}西帕尔圆盾{/#1}或{#2}投网{/#2}。

units.source: Gladiators often choose to wait instead of acting immediately when it's their turn. They will use {#1}Footwork{/#1} to get close to someone vulnerable and attack him.
units.zh: 轮到角斗士时，他们经常选择等待，而非立即行动。他们会用{#1}灵活步法{/#1}接近并攻击脆弱目标。

units.source: In the early game the arena offers you a fight with two Gladiators. Don't take it unless you know what you are doing. They are not early game enemies.
units.zh: 前期竞技场可能让你对付两名角斗士。除非有把握，否则不要接受：他们不是适合前期对付的敌人。

units.source: They can have a wide variety of equipment. Be ready for everything.
units.zh: 角斗士的装备种类很多，要做好应对各种情况的准备。

units.source: With two-handed weapons they can deal high damage, and with a {#1}shield{/#1} can be hard to hit.
units.zh: 持双手武器的角斗士伤害很高，持{#1}盾牌{/#1}的则很难命中。

units.source: {#1}Nets{/#1} make them easier to hit, but {#2}Taunt{/#2} is required to prevent them from breaking free. Also they can't remove a net and attack with a 6 AP weapon on the same turn. Nets also let you strike first and do not let them {#3}Overwhelm{/#3} you.
units.zh: {#1}投网{/#1}能让角斗士更容易被命中，但需要用{#2}挑衅{/#2}阻止其挣脱。他们也无法在同一回合挣脱投网并用耗费6行动点的武器攻击。投网还能让你抢先出手，避免受到他们的{#3}压制{/#3}。

units.source: You need good offense because they have {#1}Dodge{/#1} and Overwhelm and their {#2}Fast Adaptation{/#2} punishes defensive strategies.
units.zh: 角斗士拥有{#1}闪避{/#1}和压制，需要以强大的进攻应对；他们的{#2}快速适应{/#2}也会惩罚一味防守的战术。

units.source: {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} • {#2}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Cultist{/#3} • {#4}Envoy{/#4} • {#5}Firstborn{/#5} • {#6}Gladiator{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Oathbringer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9})
Engineer is a specialist from {#1}Southern{/#1} faction, who operates {#2}Mortars{/#2}.
units.zh: 工程师是{#1}南方{/#1}阵营中操作{#2}臼炮{/#2}的特殊单位。

units.source: {#1}Load Mortar{/#1} enables allied {#2}Mortars{/#2} right next to the {#3}Engineer{/#3} to use their {#4}Fire Mortar{/#4} skill, can't be used when engaged in melee
units.zh: {#1}装填臼炮{/#1}使紧邻{#3}工程师{/#3}的友方{#2}臼炮{/#2}能够使用{#4}发射臼炮{/#4}。陷入近战时无法使用。

units.source: Engineers are required for {#1}Mortars{/#1} to fire. However they don't always spawn next to them and will waste time moving. They are often left unguarded. They can not load mortars if engaged in melee.
units.zh: {#1}臼炮{/#1}必须由工程师装填才能开火。不过，工程师并不总是生成在臼炮旁，因此会花时间移动，也经常缺乏保护。陷入近战后，工程师就无法装填。

units.source: Snipe them if you don't want Mortars to fire.
units.zh: 如果不想让臼炮开火，可以远程狙杀工程师。

units.source: {#1}Footwork{/#1} allows brothers to escape explosions even if engaged in melee.
units.zh: 即使已被近战缠住，弟兄也可以用{#1}灵活步法{/#1}逃离爆炸范围。

units.source: {#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}

{#1}Fire Mortar{/#1} marks an area of 7 tiles for impact and 1 turn later does 20-40{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 70% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 20% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} in that area, anyone hit becomes {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}Shellshocked{/#14}, never misses, causes a morale check and can fire every 2 turns if reloaded by an {#15}Engineer{/#15} (has a range of 3-999 tiles)
Mortar is a {#1}southern{/#1} war machine, operated by {#2}Engineers{/#2}.
units.zh: 臼炮是由{#2}工程师{/#2}操作的{#1}南方{/#1}战争机器。

units.source: Mortars only fire if loaded by an Engineer. If a Mortar has no mark yet, an area is marked, otherwise a shell hits the marked area. The explosion ignores {#1}Nimble{/#1} and causes two {#2}morale{/#2} checks, and an extra third check if deals enough HP damage.
units.zh: 臼炮只有经工程师装填后才会开火。如果尚未标记目标区域，就先进行标记；否则，炮弹会命中已标记区域。爆炸无视{#1}轻灵{/#1}，并触发两次{#2}士气{/#2}检定；若造成足够生命值伤害，还会额外触发第三次检定。

units.source: You can path through allied Mortars, but enemy ones block your movement.
units.zh: 你可以穿过友军臼炮所在格，但敌军臼炮会阻挡移动。

units.source: Extremely deadly to {#1}Nimble{/#1} units with broken armor, including their own {#2}Conscripts{/#2}, because explosions can not be dodged nor resisted.
units.zh: 对护甲已损毁、依赖{#1}轻灵{/#1}的单位极其致命，包括臼炮己方的{#2}征召兵{/#2}，因为爆炸无法闪避，也无法抵抗。

units.source: {#1}Footwork{/#1} can be useful to escape explosions, and even can make southerners chase you and get hit by them.
units.zh: {#1}灵活步法{/#1}可以帮助逃离爆炸范围，甚至能诱使南方士兵追过来，被自己的炮火击中。

units.source: Kill or engage {#1}Engineers{/#1} in melee, and Mortars will stop firing.
units.zh: 杀死{#1}工程师{/#1}，或贴住他们进行近战，臼炮就会停止开火。

units.source: {#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}
A {#1}Named Dagger{/#1} (double chance) or {#2}Named Qatal Dagger{/#2}.
units.zh: 装备{#1}名贵匕首{/#1} （双倍概率）或{#2}名贵卡塔尔匕首{/#2}。

units.source: The difference with regular version is 9 AP instead of 7, so he can cast an extra spell per turn or make an extra melee attack. However, that spell always will be Raise Undead, because he can Possess one undead at a time, and two with waiting, but no more.
units.zh: 与普通版本相比，精英拥有9行动点而非7，因此每回合能多施放一次法术或多作一次近战攻击。不过，额外法术总是唤醒亡者：亡灵法师同时只能附身一个亡灵，借助等待可以维持两个，但无法更多。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}

{#1}Warcry{/#1} bolsters the {#2}Morale{/#2} and reduces the accumulated {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} Fatigue of nearby allies, weakens the {#6}Morale{/#6} of nearby brothers (more likely to work the closer they are to the {#7}Orc Warlord{/#7})
units.zh: {#1}战吼{/#1}提高附近友军的{#2}士气{/#2}并减少其积累的{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}疲劳，同时降低附近弟兄的{#6}士气{/#6}；弟兄离{#7}兽人军阀{/#7}越近，效果越容易生效。

units.source: This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of an {#2}Orc Warlord{/#2}.
50% chance of a {#1}Named Orc Cleaver{/#1} or {#2}Named Orc Axe{/#2}.
units.zh: 50%概率装备{#1}名贵兽人斩刀{/#1}或{#2}名贵兽人斧{/#2}。

units.source: Never spawns with a {#1}Man Splitter{/#1}, and sometimes can spawn with a {#2}shield{/#2}, making him less dangerous than his non-champion version.
units.zh: 精英军阀从不携带{#1}劈人巨斧{/#1}，有时还会拿{#2}盾牌{/#2}，因此威胁可能比普通版本还小。

units.source: But don't underestimate him if he has a {#1}named weapon{/#1} and no shield. With it he can hit harder than a {#2}champion Barbarian King{/#2} with his {#3}Named Rusty Warblade{/#3}.
units.zh: 但如果军阀携带{#1}名贵武器{/#1}又不拿盾，就不要低估它。其伤害甚至能超过手持{#3}名贵锈蚀战刃{/#3}的{#2}蛮族之王（精英）{/#2}。

units.source: {#1}Disarm{/#1} him, he is easy to hit. This prevents him from swinging a weapon, but his bare fists are still as powerful as a human's armed attacks.
units.zh: 对军阀使用{#1}缴械{/#1}，它很容易被命中。这能阻止它挥动武器，但其赤手空拳的伤害仍相当于人类持械攻击。

units.source: {#1}Orc Young{/#1} • {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2} ({#3}Champion{/#3}) • {#4}Orc Berserker{/#4} • {#5}Orc Warlord{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Greenskin Catapult{/#7}
This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of an {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2}.
He is similar to his regular version, and his danger also is not much higher.
units.zh: 它与普通版本相似，危险程度也没有高出太多。

units.source: His increased resolve makes {#1}Fearsome{/#1} much less likely to work.
units.zh: 提高后的意志使{#1}威慑{/#1}更难生效。

units.source: {#1}Orc Young{/#1} • {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2} ({#3}Champion{/#3}) • {#4}Orc Berserker{/#4} • {#5}Orc Warlord{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Greenskin Catapult{/#7}
This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of an {#2}Ancient Honor Guard{/#2}.
units.zh: 这是{#2}古代荣誉卫士{/#2}的{#1}精英{/#1}版本。

units.source: A {#1}Named Bladed Pike{/#1}, {#2}Named Crypt Cleaver{/#2}, {#3}Named Warscythe{/#3} or {#4}Named Khopesh{/#4}.
Isn't as fragile as a regular Honor Guard and deals more damage with a {#1}named weapon{/#1} and damage modifier. Otherwise similar to a non-champion version, wears the same armor and is easy to hit.
units.zh: 精英荣誉卫士没有普通版本那么脆弱，{#1}名贵武器{/#1}和伤害修正也会提高其伤害。其他方面与普通版本相似，穿相同的护甲，也很容易被命中。

units.source: {#1}Named Crypt Cleaver{/#1} can be very deadly to {#2}Nimble{/#2} brothers and even to {#3}Battle Forged{/#3}, if generates with very good stats.
units.zh: {#1}名贵墓穴斩刀{/#1}对{#2}轻灵{/#2}弟兄可能极其致命；若生成属性很好，连{#3}久经战阵{/#3}弟兄也同样危险。

units.source: If has a {#1}Khopesh{/#1} and shield, isn't much of a threat.
units.zh: 如果它携带{#1}镰形剑{/#1}和盾牌，威胁就不算大。

units.source: Usually you don't want to {#1}stun{/#1} or {#2}disarm{/#2} {#3}Ancient Dead{/#3} because killing them is easier, but against this enemy it sometimes may be worthwhile.
units.zh: 通常不必费力{#1}眩晕{/#1}或{#2}缴械{/#2}{#3}古代亡灵{/#3}，因为直接杀死更容易；但对这个敌人，控制有时值得考虑。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}
70% chance of a {#1}Named Sword{/#1} (double chance) or {#2}Named Shamshir{/#2}.
units.zh: 70%概率装备{#1}名贵剑{/#1} （双倍概率）或{#2}名贵舍施尔弯刀{/#2}。

units.source: 30% chance of a {#1}Named Noble Mail Armor{/#1} (176-200), {#2}Studded Mail Armor{/#2} (143-162) or {#3}Hardened Leather Armor{/#3} (126-143).
Very evasive. When attacking him, your accuracy is reduced:
units.zh: 闪避极高。攻击他时，你的命中会降低：

units.source: melee by 62 and ranged by 27, if you use a {#1}net{/#1}.
units.zh: 使用{#1}投网{/#1}后，近战命中仍降低62，远程命中仍降低27。

units.source: He walks through zones of control and dodges attacks of opportunity.
units.zh: 他能穿过控制区，躲开借机攻击。

units.source: The optimal tactic against him is using multiple nets and {#1}throwing weapons{/#1}, with {#2}Duelist{/#2} and {#3}Throwing Mastery{/#3}. He has less ranged defense than {#4}Blade Dancer{/#4}, so you can use {#5}bows{/#5} and {#6}crossbows{/#6} as well.
units.zh: 最合适的战术是准备多张投网，并用{#1}投掷武器{/#1}搭配{#2}决斗家{/#2}和{#3}投掷精通{/#3}。他的远程防御低于{#4}剑舞者{/#4}，因此也可以用{#5}弓{/#5}和{#6}弩{/#6}。

units.source: He lacks {#1}Resilient{/#1}, so poisons and {#2}Daze{/#2} can be effective. {#3}Nimble{/#3} doesn't reduce poison damage.
units.zh: 他没有{#1}顽强{/#1}，因此毒药和{#2}恍惚{/#2}可能有效；{#3}轻灵{/#3}也不会降低毒伤。

units.source: He can appear among {#1}mercenaries{/#1} wanting to take a {#2}package you must deliver{/#2}.
units.zh: 前来抢夺{#2}你需递送的包裹{/#2}的{#1}佣兵{/#1}队伍中，可能出现此单位。

units.source: If you play {#1}Oathtakers{/#1} origin and have sworn the Oath of Honor, you may be unable to defeat him at all.
units.zh: 如果选择{#1}立誓者{/#1}起源，并已立下荣誉之誓，你可能根本无法击败他。

units.source: {#1}Named weapons{/#1} can do high damage even to {#2}Battle Forged{/#2} brothers.
units.zh: {#1}名贵武器{/#1}即使对{#2}久经战阵{/#2}弟兄也能造成高伤害。

units.source: If this is an {#1}arena{/#1} fight, drink an {#2}Iron Will Potion{/#2} to avoid debuffs from {#3}injuries{/#3}.
units.zh: 如果是{#1}竞技场{/#1}战斗，可喝下{#2}钢铁意志药剂{/#2}，避免{#3}伤势{/#3}带来的减益。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
{#1}Mercenary{/#1} • {#2}Mercenary Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Swordmaster{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Hedge Knight{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Master Archer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Wardog{/#9}
This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of a {#2}Barbarian Chosen{/#2}.
units.zh: 这是{#2}蛮族神选战士{/#2}的{#1}精英{/#1}版本。

units.source: 1/3 chance of a {#1}Named Rusty Warblade{/#1}, {#2}Named Two-Handed Skull Hammer{/#2}, {#3}Named Heavy Rusty Axe{/#3} or {#4}Named Two-Handed Spiked Mace{/#4}.
units.zh: 1/3概率装备{#1}名贵锈蚀战刃{/#1}、{#2}名贵双手颅骨锤{/#2}、{#3}名贵锈蚀重斧{/#3}或{#4}名贵双手尖刺钉锤{/#4}。

units.source: 1/3 chance of an {#1}Alloy Plate Armor{/#1} (308-350), {#2}Skull and Chain Armor{/#2} (209-237) or {#3}Plated Fur Armor{/#3} (143-162).
1/3 chance of a {#1}Bull Helmet{/#1} (330-375), {#2}Nose Horned Helmet{/#2} (253-287) or {#3}Skull Helmet{/#3} (231-262).
Tougher, more brave and accurate and deals more damage than a regular Chosen, especially with a {#1}named weapon{/#1}, otherwise similar.
units.zh: 比普通神选战士更耐打、意志更高、命中更准、伤害更高，尤其在携带{#1}名贵武器{/#1}时。其他方面相似。

units.source: Usually you see him among many other Chosen. These are numerous but easier to kill, so deal with them first.
units.zh: 精英通常与许多普通神选战士一起出现。后者人数多，却更容易杀死，因此应先处理他们。

units.source: A named weapon makes him more dangerous. Control him by {#1}stunning{/#1} or {#2}disarming{/#2}. He counters it by acting ahead of you and waiting, and uses {#3}Adrenaline{/#3} to get ahead. If he does it, you can only stun to prevent Adrenaline.
units.zh: 名贵武器会让精英更加危险，可用{#1}眩晕{/#1}或{#2}缴械{/#2}控制他。他会抢先行动再等待来应对，并用{#3}肾上腺素{/#3}保持先手。如果他这样做，就只能靠眩晕阻止肾上腺素。

units.source: {#1}Battle Forged{/#1} brothers must have {#2}Steel Brow{/#2} to avoid death in one hit.
units.zh: {#1}久经战阵{/#1}弟兄必须拥有{#2}钢铁额骨{/#2}，才能避免被一击杀死。

units.source: {#1}Named Rusty Warblade{/#1} is deadly to {#2}Nimble{/#2} brothers and even to Battle Forged, if generates with very good stats.
units.zh: {#1}名贵锈蚀战刃{/#1}对{#2}轻灵{/#2}弟兄非常致命；若生成属性很好，久经战阵弟兄也同样危险。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
There are two undead factions: {#1}Zombies{/#1} and {#2}Ancient Dead{/#2}, and they unite during the Undead Scourge. Flesh Golems from two certain {#3}legendary locations{/#3} also Undead.
units.zh: 亡灵分为两个阵营：{#1}行尸{/#1}和{#2}古代亡灵{/#2}，亡灵灾祸期间会联合行动。两个特定{#3}传奇地点{/#3}中的血肉魔像也属于亡灵。

units.source: Undead are not affected by morale and accumulate no fatigue. Poisons have no effect, but {#1}Flasks of Blessed Water{/#1} can harm them. Some units like {#2}Necromancers{/#2} are the exception, because they only belong to Undead faction and aren't true undead.
units.zh: 亡灵不受士气影响，也不积累疲劳。毒药对其无效，但{#1}圣水瓶{/#1}能够造成伤害。{#2}亡灵法师{/#2}等少数单位属于例外：它们只是在亡灵阵营中，并非真正的亡灵。

units.source: This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of a {#2}Fallen Hero{/#2}.

50% chance of a {#1}Named Axe{/#1}, {#2}Named Cleaver{/#2}, {#3}Named Flail{/#3}, {#4}Named Greataxe{/#4}, {#5}Named Greatsword{/#5}, {#6}Named Mace{/#6}, {#7}Named Two-Handed Hammer{/#7}, {#8}Named Two-Handed Mace{/#8} or {#9}Named Two-Handed Flail{/#9}.
50% chance of a {#1}Named Undead Heater Shield{/#1} or {#2}Named Undead Kite Shield{/#2}.
units.zh: 50%概率装备{#1}名贵亡灵熨斗形盾{/#1}或{#2}名贵亡灵鸢形盾{/#2}。

units.source: Most of the time has a {#1}shield{/#1} and poses little threat.
units.zh: 精英陨落英雄大多持有{#1}盾牌{/#1}，威胁不大。

units.source: {#1}Named{/#1} two-handed weapons can kill a {#2}Battle Forged{/#2} brother in one hit even if he has {#3}Steel Brow{/#3} if the named weapon is above average.
units.zh: 若{#1}名贵{/#1}双手武器的属性高于平均水平，即使{#2}久经战阵{/#2}弟兄拥有{#3}钢铁额骨{/#3}，也可能被一击杀死。

units.source: His weakness to pushback remains the same, and he is easy to {#1}stun{/#1} and {#2}disarm{/#2}.
units.zh: 它仍然怕击退，也很容易被{#1}眩晕{/#1}或{#2}缴械{/#2}。

units.source: When he is dead, step on his body and take his named weapon before he revives.
units.zh: 精英陨落英雄倒下后，站到尸体上，在它复活前拿走名贵武器。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
{#1}Oathbringers{/#1} are {#2}Oathtakers{/#2}' enemies, coming to fight for the {#3}Young Anselm's Skull{/#3}.
units.zh: {#1}誓约使者{/#1}是{#2}立誓者{/#2}的敌人，会前来争夺{#3}小安塞尔姆的头骨{/#3}。

units.source: A {#1}Noble Sword{/#1}, {#2}Warhammer{/#2}, {#3}Winged Mace{/#3}, {#4}Fighting Axe{/#4}, {#5}Greatsword{/#5}, {#6}Greataxe{/#6}, {#7}Two-Handed Hammer{/#7}, {#8}Two-Handed Mace{/#8}, {#9}Two-Handed Flail{/#9} or {#10}Bardiche{/#10}.
An {#1}Adorned Closed Flat Top{/#1} (250), {#2}Full Helm{/#2} (300) or {#3}Adorned Full Helm{/#3} (300).
If the weapon is one-handed, 60% chance of a {#1}Heater Shield{/#1}.
units.zh: 若使用单手武器，则有60%概率装备{#1}熨斗形盾{/#1}。

units.source: They only appear if you play {#1}Oathtakers{/#1} origin. There are always two of them, and you pick up to three brothers to fight them.
units.zh: 只有选择{#1}立誓者{/#1}起源才会出现誓约使者。敌人始终有两名，你最多可以挑选三名弟兄应战。

units.source: They are somewhat similar to weaker {#1}Hedge Knights{/#1}, but with unbreakable resolve.
units.zh: 誓约使者有些像弱化的{#1}流浪骑士{/#1}，但其意志不会崩溃。

units.source: When one of them dies, the other will become more dangerous because of {#1}Lone Wolf{/#1}.
units.zh: 一名誓约使者死后，另一名会因{#1}孤狼{/#1}而更加危险。

units.source: {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} • {#2}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Cultist{/#3} • {#4}Envoy{/#4} • {#5}Firstborn{/#5} • {#6}Gladiator{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Oathbringer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9})
This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of a {#2}Goblin Skirmisher{/#2}.
A {#1}Named Cruel Falchion{/#1}, {#2}Named Jagged Pike{/#2} or {#3}Named Goblin Skewer{/#3}.
units.zh: 装备{#1}名贵凶刃弯刀{/#1}、{#2}名贵锯齿长枪{/#2}或{#3}名贵地精尖矛{/#3}。

units.source: Not too dangerous. A late game squad should not have any problems with him.
units.zh: 威胁不算大，后期队伍应能轻松应对。

units.source: Evasive because of {#1}Dodge{/#1} and increased stats, but does not have {#2}Underdog{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}闪避{/#1}和提高后的属性使其很擅长闪避，不过它没有{#2}以少敌多{/#2}。

units.source: He never has a {#1}Notched Blade{/#1} that can {#2}Puncture{/#2}.
units.zh: 它绝不会携带能使用{#2}破甲刺击{/#2}的{#1}缺口短刃{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1} ({#2}Champion{/#2}) • {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Goblin Wolfrider{/#5} • {#6}Goblin Wolf{/#6} • {#7}Goblin Shaman{/#7} • {#8}Goblin Overseer{/#8} • {#9}Greenskin Catapult{/#9}
This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of a {#2}Blade Dancer{/#2}.
75% chance of a {#1}Named Swordlance{/#1} (double chance) or a {#2}Named Shamshir{/#2}.
units.zh: 75%概率装备{#1}名贵长柄剑刃{/#1} （双倍概率）或{#2}名贵舍施尔弯刀{/#2}。

units.source: melee by 50 and ranged by 40, if you use a {#1}net{/#1}.
units.zh: 使用{#1}投网{/#1}后，近战命中仍降低50，远程命中仍降低40。

units.source: {#1}Polearm Mastery{/#1} allows him to remove a net and attack on the same turn.
units.zh: {#1}长柄武器精通{/#1}使他能够在同一回合挣脱投网并攻击。

units.source: The optimal tactic against him is using multiple nets and {#1}throwing weapons{/#1}, even better if they are {#2}named{/#2} and have extra accuracy, with {#3}Duelist{/#3} and {#4}Throwing Mastery{/#4}.
units.zh: 最合适的战术是准备多张投网，并用{#1}投掷武器{/#1}搭配{#3}决斗家{/#3}和{#4}投掷精通{/#4}；若是带有额外命中加成的{#2}名贵{/#2}投掷武器就更好。

units.source: Named weapons can do high damage even to {#1}Battle Forged{/#1} brothers. {#2}Shamshir{/#2} is more dangerous, deals same damage but has more attacks on a single target.
units.zh: 名贵武器即使对{#1}久经战阵{/#1}弟兄也能造成高伤害。{#2}舍施尔弯刀{/#2}更危险：单次伤害相同，但对单个目标的攻击次数更多。

units.source: {#1}Nomad Cutthroat{/#1} • {#2}Nomad Outlaw{/#2} • {#3}Nomad Slinger{/#3} • {#4}Nomad Archer{/#4} • {#5}Nomad Leader{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Blade Dancer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Nomad Executioner{/#9} ({#10}Champion{/#10}) • {#11}Desert Stalker{/#11} ({#12}Champion{/#12})
This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of a {#2}Brigand Leader{/#2}.

25% chance of a {#1}Named Axe{/#1}, {#2}Named Billhook{/#2}, {#3}Named Cleaver{/#3}, {#4}Named Dagger{/#4}, {#5}Named Flail{/#5}, {#6}Named Greataxe{/#6}, {#7}Named Greatsword{/#7}, {#8}Named Longaxe{/#8}, {#9}Named Mace{/#9}, {#10}Named Spear{/#10}, {#11}Named Sword{/#11}, {#12}Named Two-Handed Hammer{/#12}, {#13}Named Warbrand{/#13}, {#14}Named Warhammer{/#14}, {#15}Named Pike{/#15}, {#16}Named Polehammer{/#16}, {#17}Named Fencing Sword{/#17}, {#18}Named Two-Handed Mace{/#18}, {#19}Named Two-Handed Flail{/#19}, {#20}Named Three-Headed Flail{/#20}, {#21}Named Spetum{/#21}, {#22}Named Bardiche{/#22}, {#23}Named Shamshir{/#23}, {#24}Named Battle Whip{/#24}, {#25}Named Qatal Dagger{/#25}, {#26}Named Swordlance{/#26}, {#27}Named Polemace{/#27}, {#28}Named Two-Handed Scimitar{/#28}, {#29}Named Estoc{/#29}, {#30}Named Pollaxe{/#30} or {#31}Named Executioner's Sword{/#31}.

25% chance of an {#1}Enhanced Coat of Plates{/#1} (352-400), {#2}Plated Mail Hauberk{/#2} (330-375), {#3}Leopard Armor{/#3} (319-362), {#4}Golden Lamellar Armor{/#4} (313-356), {#5}Named Sellsword's Armor{/#5} (286-325), {#6}Golden Scale Armor{/#6} (264-300), {#7}Heraldic Mail Hauberk{/#7} (231-262), {#8}Black and Gold Armor{/#8} (231-262), {#9}Named Noble Mail Armor{/#9} (176-200), {#10}Studded Mail Armor{/#10} (154-175) or {#11}Hardened Leather Armor{/#11} (126-143).

25% chance of a {#1}Gold and Black Turban{/#1} (319-362), {#2}Named Conic Helmet{/#2} (308-350), {#3}Heraldic Bascinet{/#3} (308-350), {#4}Sallet{/#4} (291-331), {#5}Named Nordic Helmet{/#5} (291-331), {#6}Lindwurm Helmet{/#6} (291-331), {#7}Feathered Nasal Helmet{/#7} (291-331), {#8}Red and Gold Band Helmet{/#8} (280-318), {#9}Golden Feathered Helmet{/#9} (264-300), {#10}Named Steppe Helmet{/#10} (220-250), {#11}Wolf Helmet{/#11} (154-175) or {#12}Norse Helmet{/#12} (137-156).

25% chance of a {#1}Dragon Kite Shield{/#1}, {#2}Metal Heater Shield{/#2}, {#3}Golden Round Shield{/#3}, {#4}Pavise Shield{/#4}, {#5}Relic Heater Shield{/#5}, {#6}Winged Shield{/#6}, {#7}Named Sipar Shield{/#7}, {#8}Bandit Heater Shield{/#8} or {#9}Bandit Kite Shield{/#9}.
This champion is among the easiest, but can be dangerous in the early game.
units.zh: 这是最容易对付的精英勇士之一，但前期仍可能很危险。

units.source: He is similar to a regular {#1}Hedge Knight{/#1}, even weaker.
units.zh: 他与普通{#1}流浪骑士{/#1}相似，甚至更弱。

units.source: But don't underestimate him if he has a {#1}named{/#1} two-handed weapon, its single hit can be fatal to a {#2}Battle Forged{/#2} brother, and more likely if he does not have {#3}Steel Brow{/#3}. Control him by {#4}stunning{/#4} or {#5}disarming{/#5}.
units.zh: 但如果携带{#1}名贵{/#1}双手武器，就不要低估他：一次命中就可能杀死{#2}久经战阵{/#2}弟兄，没有{#3}钢铁额骨{/#3}时更是如此。应使用{#4}眩晕{/#4}或{#5}缴械{/#5}控制他。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of a {#2}Goblin Ambusher{/#2}.
Evasive because of {#1}Dodge{/#1} and increased stats, especially against ranged attacks.
units.zh: {#1}闪避{/#1}和提高后的属性使其很擅长闪避，尤其难以被远程攻击命中。

units.source: When engaging him in melee, remember that he can {#1}Puncture{/#1}.
units.zh: 贴身近战时，要记得它可以使用{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}。

units.source: He is so fragile that he can die from one headshot.
units.zh: 它十分脆弱，一次头部命中就可能将其杀死。

units.source: {#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1} ({#2}Champion{/#2}) • {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Goblin Wolfrider{/#5} • {#6}Goblin Wolf{/#6} • {#7}Goblin Shaman{/#7} • {#8}Goblin Overseer{/#8} • {#9}Greenskin Catapult{/#9}
Citizen is a weak unit that travels between {#1}settlements{/#1} in small groups.
units.zh: 市民是较弱的单位，会成群结队地往来于{#1}定居点{/#1}之间。

units.source: An {#1}Apron{/#1} (25), {#2}Cloth Sash{/#2} (20) (7 times more probable), {#3}Sackcloth{/#3} (10) or {#4}Tattered Sackcloth{/#4} (5).
50% chance of a {#1}Southern Head Wrap{/#1} (30) (double chance) or {#2}Nomad Head Wrap{/#2} (30).

{#1}Indebted{/#1} • {#2}Conscript{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Gunner{/#4} • {#5}Engineer{/#5} • {#6}Assassin{/#6} • {#7}Officer{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Mortar{/#9} • {#10}Donkey{/#10} • {#11}Citizen{/#11}
Envoy is the character you are protecting in {#1}Escort Envoy{/#1} contracts.
units.zh: 使者是{#1}护送使者{/#1}委托中需要你保护的角色。

units.source: You control the Envoy. Enemies are attracted to him. If he dies, you fail the contract.
units.zh: 使者由你控制，敌人倾向于攻击他。他一旦死亡，委托就会失败。

units.source: He is so fragile that he can die in one headshot. Keep him where no one can reach or shoot him, in the back or in a bush.
units.zh: 使者十分脆弱，一次头部命中就可能将其杀死。应让他留在后方或灌木丛中，确保敌人无法接近或射击。

units.source: You can give him a {#1}weapon{/#1}, but leaving him in the range of enemy attacks is extremely risky.
units.zh: 你可以给使者一件{#1}武器{/#1}，但让他停留在敌人攻击范围内极其危险。

units.source: {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} • {#2}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Cultist{/#3} • {#4}Envoy{/#4} • {#5}Firstborn{/#5} • {#6}Gladiator{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Oathbringer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9})
Wiederganger Nomad is a rare enemy from the {#1}Zombies{/#1} faction, sometimes encountered in {#2}Drive Off Nomads{/#2} contracts.
units.zh: 游牧民行尸是{#1}行尸{/#1}阵营的罕见敌人，有时会出现在{#2}驱逐游牧民{/#2}委托中。

units.source: A {#1}Saif{/#1}, {#2}Scimitar{/#2}, {#3}Nomad Mace{/#3}, {#4}Boar Spear{/#4}, {#5}Bludgeon{/#5}, {#6}Butcher's Cleaver{/#6}, {#7}Light Southern Mace{/#7}, {#8}Two-Handed Saif{/#8}, {#9}Two-Handed Mallet{/#9} or {#10}Woodcutter's Axe{/#10}.
A {#1}Plated Nomad Mail{/#1} (105), {#2}Stitched Nomad Armor{/#2} (80), {#3}Leather Nomad Robe{/#3} (65), {#4}Thick Nomad Robe{/#4} (50) or {#5}Nomad Robe{/#5} (30).
A {#1}Nomad Reinforced Helmet{/#1} (125), {#2}Nomad Light Helmet{/#2} (70), {#3}Nomad Leather Cap{/#3} (50), {#4}Leather Head Wrap{/#4} (40) or {#5}Nomad Head Wrap{/#5} (30) (double chance).
If the weapon is one-handed, 50% chance of an {#1}Adarga Shield{/#1}.
units.zh: 若使用单手武器，则有50%概率装备{#1}阿达尔加盾{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
Ancient Legionary is a backline enemy from the {#1}Ancient Dead{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 古代军团兵是{#1}古代亡灵{/#1}阵营的后排敌人。

units.source: An {#1}Ancient Bladed Pike{/#1} or {#2}Broken Ancient Bladed Pike{/#2}.
units.zh: 装备{#1}古代刃枪{/#1}或{#2}断裂的古代刃枪{/#2}。

units.source: Chances start as 40/60, and each day changes them by +1/-1, until they are 90/10.
units.zh: 两者初始概率比为40/60，此后每天按+1/-1变化，直到90/10。

units.source: An {#1}Ancient Scale Harness{/#1} (125), {#2}Ancient Double Layer Mail{/#2} (120) or {#3}Ancient Mail{/#3} (100).
If engaged in melee, they can {#1}Rotate{/#1} to backline if possible. However, if your squad's formation is wide, they often come into frontline.
units.zh: 被近战接敌后，如果条件允许，它们会通过{#1}换位{/#1}退到后排。不过，如果你的阵型较宽，它们经常会直接走到前排。

units.source: Reach weapons and {#1}Split{/#1} skill can take them out early.
units.zh: 长柄武器和{#1}劈开{/#1}技能可以尽早击杀它们。

units.source: Use wide formation to provoke them to walk into exposure.
units.zh: 采用较宽的阵型，诱使它们走到暴露的位置。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}
Ancient Honor Guard with polearm is a heavily armored backline enemy from the {#1}Ancient Dead{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 持长柄武器的古代荣誉卫士是{#1}古代亡灵{/#1}阵营的重甲后排敌人。

units.source: They never become {#1}champions{/#1} despite being {#2}Honor Guards{/#2} just with different weapons.
units.zh: 虽然只是换了武器的{#2}荣誉卫士{/#2}，它们却永远不会成为{#1}精英勇士{/#1}。

units.source: They are similar to regular Honor Guards, so all advice about them also applies here.
units.zh: 它们与普通荣誉卫士相似，因此针对普通版本的建议也适用。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}

{#1}Miasma{/#1} does direct 5-10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} damage each turn to a living unit that finishes its turn standing in it (targets an area of 7 tiles, has a range of 99 tiles and lasts for 3 turns on the ground)
units.zh: {#1}瘴气{/#1}每回合对在其中结束回合的活物直接造成5-10{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}伤害。作用区域为7格，射程为99格，在地面持续3回合。

units.source: {#1}Horror{/#1} will cause separate resolve checks that can lower the morale (with {#2}-15{/#2}{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}) and {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}Horrify{/#9} targets for one turn, making them unable to act (with {#10}-5{/#10}{#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11}) (targets an area of 7 tiles and has a range of 99 tiles)

{#1}Lightning Storm{/#1} marks a vertical area of tiles from the top of the map to the bottom for impact and 1 turn later does 20-50{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 100% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 75% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} to any enemies in that area (has a range of 1-999 tiles)
{#1}Geomancy (Once){/#1} raises the ground level under all {#2}Phylacteries{/#2} to 3
units.zh: {#1}地术（单次）{/#1}将所有{#2}命匣{/#2}脚下的地面抬高至高度3。

units.source: {#1}The Black Book{/#1} raises all resurrectable corpses on the map
units.zh: {#1}黑书{/#1}使地图上所有能够复活的尸体重新起身。

units.source: Lorekeeper is the boss of the {#1}Sunken Library{/#1} {#2}legendary location{/#2}.
units.zh: 典籍守护者是{#2}传奇地点{/#2}{#1}沉没图书馆{/#1}的首领。

units.source: {#1}Geomancy{/#1} changes the ground level under {#2}The Lorekeeper{/#2} and {#3}Phylacteries{/#3} from 0 to 3 and from 3 to 0
units.zh: {#1}地术{/#1}将{#2}典籍守护者{/#2}和{#3}命匣{/#3}脚下的地面高度从0变为3，或从3变为0。

units.source: Lorekeeper has a very complex behavior. The most important things are that he can't die if any {#1}Phylacteries{/#1} remain intact and will respawn from them, and the fight gets harder when you destroy more Phylacteries.
units.zh: 典籍守护者的行为非常复杂。最关键的是：只要还有{#1}命匣{/#1}完好，它就不会真正死亡，而会借助命匣重生；命匣摧毁得越多，战斗也越困难。

units.source: Some {#1}Ancient Honor Guards{/#1} will guard him, not actively attacking you and making the battle easier.
units.zh: 部分{#1}古代荣誉卫士{/#1}会留在典籍守护者身边警戒，不主动进攻，让战斗稍容易一些。

units.source: His Miasma and Horror have to range limit. He has no zone of control. He can traverse steep cliffs (verify).
units.zh: 典籍守护者的瘴气和恐怖威慑没有射程限制。它没有控制区，也能穿越陡峭的悬崖（原文标注：待核实）。

units.source: Raise Screaming Skulls, Mirror Image, Lightning Strike, Geomancy, The Black Book
units.zh: 唤起尖啸骷髅、镜像、落雷、地术、黑书

units.source: Miasma, Mirror Image, Lightning Strike, Geomancy, The Black Book
units.zh: 瘴气、镜像、落雷、地术、黑书

units.source: Lorekeeper can summon {#1}Screaming Skulls{/#1} once per turn. Skulls spawn 5-6 tiles away from your brothers. To simplify, he summons 4-12 skulls per turn to a limit of 12-30 on the map, depending on how many Phylacteries were destroyed.
units.zh: 典籍守护者每回合能召唤一次{#1}尖啸骷髅{/#1}，生成在距弟兄5-6格的位置。概括来说，每回合召唤4-12个，场上数量上限为12-30个，具体取决于已摧毁多少命匣。

units.source: In the middle of battle Lorekeeper starts summoning {#1}Apparitions{/#1}, ghostly copies of himself. They spawn far away from you and will cast spells too. To simplify, there will be four of them as it's not worth spending time hunting them.
units.zh: 战斗中段，典籍守护者会开始召唤{#1}幻影{/#1}，即自身的幽灵复制体。它们生成在远离你的位置，也能施法。概括来说，通常会有四个幻影，因为不值得花时间追杀。

units.source: Lorekeeper can mark a vertical line on the ground to strike it with lightnings on the next turn. Apparitions also do it, but with one turn of cooldown after the actual strike. There can't be more than 3 simultaneous lightning strikes. Brothers in zones of control, {#1}horrified{/#1} brothers and lines with many brothers are prioritized. Lightnings have no friendly fire.
units.zh: 典籍守护者能在地面标记一条纵线，下回合以落雷轰击。幻影也能这样做，但实际落雷后有一个回合冷却。同一时间最多存在3道落雷。目标优先选择控制区内的弟兄、{#1}惊恐{/#1}的弟兄，以及聚集多名弟兄的直线。落雷不会误伤友军。

units.source: It is the Lorekeeper's ability to raise and lower earth to protect Phylacteries and himself from melee, and comes in two forms. One-time version is used earlier and does not affect the Lorekeeper himself. Normal version affects him and has two turns of cooldown, so he casts it on every third turn, even if it's disadvantageous for him. If he dies, all raised ground lowers.
units.zh: 地术是典籍守护者升降地面的能力，可以保护命匣和自身免遭近战，分为两种。单次版本在较早阶段使用，不影响典籍守护者自身；普通版本会影响自身，冷却两个回合，因此每第三个回合都会施放，即便这样对它不利。典籍守护者死亡时，所有抬升的地面都会下降。

units.source: In the middle of battle Lorekeeper will read {#1}the Black Book{/#1} he carries, raising all resurrectable undead. {#2}Lost Treasure Hunters{/#2} are always resurrectable, and Honor Guards are resurrectable if not {#3}decapitated{/#3}. A {#4}Warscythe{/#4} or, if there is an item in the off-hand, {#5}Khopesh{/#5} also will be created if the undead has no weapon. Armor won't be repaired. Apparitions will cast Raise Dead like {#6}Necromancers{/#6} and will not create any weapons.
units.zh: 战斗中段，典籍守护者会阅读随身的{#1}黑书{/#1}，使所有能复活的亡灵重新起身。{#2}迷失的寻宝者{/#2}始终可以复活，荣誉卫士则在未被{#3}斩首{/#3}时可以复活。若亡灵没有武器，还会生成一把{#4}战镰{/#4}；若副手已有物品，则生成{#5}镰形剑{/#5}。护甲不会修复。幻影会像{#6}亡灵法师{/#6}一样施放唤醒亡者，但不会生成武器。

units.source: The Black Book condition: {#1}{#2/}{/#1}and at least 6 corpses on the map.
units.zh: 黑书施放条件：{#1}{#2/}{/#1}，且地图上至少有6具尸体。

units.source: Don't hurry to destroy Phylacteries as soon as you can, you will only make the fight harder. Try to destroy all Phylacteries at once or at least quickly to reduce the time of Lorekeeper being the most powerful.
units.zh: 不要一有机会就急着摧毁命匣，这只会增加战斗难度。尽量同时摧毁所有命匣，至少也要连续快速处理，缩短典籍守护者处于最强阶段的时间。

units.source: Bringing him to low HP and {#1}staggering{/#1} allows to skip the difficult phase entirely, if you destroy all Phylacteries on that turn and kill him.
units.zh: 如果能在同一回合摧毁全部命匣并杀死典籍守护者，就可先将其打至低生命值并施加{#1}踉跄{/#1}，从而完全跳过最困难阶段。

units.source: Killing him may seem pointless, but it lowers Phylacteries to the ground to destroy easily.
units.zh: 杀死典籍守护者看似无用，却能让命匣降回地面，更容易摧毁。

units.source: {#1}Decapitate{/#1} Honor Guards with {#2}cleavers{/#2} to prevent reanimation, or replace their weapons with weak ones.
units.zh: 用{#2}斩刀{/#2}的{#1}斩首{/#1}杀死荣誉卫士以阻止复活，或把它们的武器换成弱武器。

units.source: {#1}Spiked Impaler{/#1} can knock him down from a pillar, however his high ground gives you a penalty of -30 to hit.
units.zh: {#1}刺桩重弩{/#1}能将典籍守护者从高柱上击落，不过它身处高地，会让你的命中受到-30惩罚。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}
Lost Treasure Hunter is an enemy found in the {#1}Sunken Library{/#1} {#2}legendary location{/#2}.
units.zh: 迷失的寻宝者是{#2}传奇地点{/#2}{#1}沉没图书馆{/#1}中的敌人。

units.source: A {#1}Stitched Nomad Armor{/#1} (80), {#2}Leather Nomad Robe{/#2} (65), {#3}Thick Nomad Robe{/#3} (50) or {#4}Nomad Robe{/#4} (30).

They are based on the {#1}Fallen Hero{/#1}'s template, but have better stats, similarly to {#2}Fallen Betrayers{/#2}, and different equipment. They don't know any idea about careful approach and instead simply walk towards you, getting hit by {#3}spearwalls{/#3}.
units.zh: 它们以{#1}陨落英雄{/#1}为模板，像{#2}陨落叛徒{/#2}一样拥有更高属性，但装备不同。它们完全不懂谨慎接近，只会直接走向你，撞上{#3}矛墙{/#3}。

units.source: When they are dead, give them a weak weapon. If you just take their weapon, {#1}Lorekeeper{/#1} will create a new {#2}Warscythe{/#2} for them when {#3}raising all undead{/#3}. Standing on their corpses also prevents this.
units.zh: 寻宝者倒下后，应给尸体换上一件弱武器。如果只是拿走武器，{#1}典籍守护者{/#1}在{#3}复活全部亡灵{/#3}时会为它们生成新的{#2}战镰{/#2}。站在尸体上也能阻止这种情况。

units.source: {#1}Wiederganger{/#1} • {#2}Armored Wiederganger{/#2} • {#3}Wiederganger Nomad{/#3} • {#4}Wiederganger Brother{/#4} • {#5}Fallen Hero{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Geist{/#7} • {#8}Necromancer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10} • {#11}Lost Treasure Hunter{/#11} • {#12}Fallen Betrayer{/#12} • {#13}Rachegeist{/#13}
Screaming Skull is an enemy, summoned by the {#1}Lorekeeper{/#1} in huge numbers.
units.zh: 尖啸骷髅是由{#1}典籍守护者{/#1}大量召唤的敌人。

units.source: {#1}Explode{/#1} destroys the {#2}Screaming Skull{/#2} and does 20-40{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} to the body with 75% {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} and 30% {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9}, ignoring Nimble. Allies take half damage. Skulls also explode when killed.

Screaming Skulls are spawned 5-6 tiles away from brothers, and will try to reach them and explode. Their explosion always hits body, does not miss and {#1}Nimble{/#1} does not reduce it. Friendly fire does half damage. They can not explode if spent all AP on movement.
units.zh: 尖啸骷髅生成在距弟兄5-6格的位置，会尝试接近并自爆。爆炸总是命中躯干，不会落空，也不受{#1}轻灵{/#1}减免；误伤友军时伤害减半。如果行动点全部用于移动，就无法自爆。

units.source: They lack resistance to {#1}ranged weapons{/#1}. They can traverse steep cliffs (verify).
units.zh: 它们没有{#1}远程武器{/#1}抗性，能够穿越陡峭悬崖（原文标注：待核实）。

units.source: They are slower than you, but will come from all directions.
units.zh: 尖啸骷髅比你慢，但会从各个方向涌来。

units.source: Consider wearing heavy {#1}body armor{/#1} on your {#2}phylactery{/#2} busters even if they are {#3}Nimble{/#3}.
units.zh: 负责破坏{#2}命匣{/#2}的弟兄即使拥有{#3}轻灵{/#3}，也可考虑穿上重型{#1}躯干护甲{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Armored{/#1} {#2}dogs{/#2} can take a lot of damage from them before dying.
units.zh: {#1}披甲{/#1}{#2}犬只{/#2}能承受尖啸骷髅的大量伤害才会死去。

units.source: Low priority targets, because they are summoned faster than killed, and there is a cap on their number.
units.zh: 尖啸骷髅的优先级较低：召唤速度超过击杀速度，而且数量本身有上限。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}

{#1}Wither{/#1} weakens one of your brothers for 2 turns, inflicting {#2}Withered{/#2} effect, you lose 25%{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}, 25%{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6}, 25%{#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} and 5{#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} for every turn of effect duration left (has a range of 7 tiles)
Lorekeeper's Apparition is a ghost-like spellcaster summoned by the {#1}Lorekeeper{/#1}.
units.zh: 典籍守护者的幻影是由{#1}典籍守护者{/#1}召唤的幽灵般施法者。

units.source: Apparitions are ghostly copies of Lorekeeper that can cast Raise Undead, Wither and Lightning Strike. Lightning Strike has one turn of cooldown after the actual strike. Brothers in zones of control, {#1}horrified{/#1} brothers and lines with many brothers are prioritized. Lightnings have no friendly fire. Lightning is canceled if they die.
units.zh: 幻影是典籍守护者的幽灵复制体，能施放唤醒亡者、凋萎和落雷。实际落雷后有一个回合冷却。目标优先选择控制区内的弟兄、{#1}惊恐{/#1}的弟兄，以及聚集多名弟兄的直线。落雷不会误伤友军；幻影死后，尚未落下的雷击会取消。

units.source: They are hard to reach and quick to respawn, usually not worth hunting.
units.zh: 幻影很难接近，重生又快，通常不值得追杀。

units.source: Entering their zone of control can backfire when you need to evade a lightning.
units.zh: 进入幻影的控制区可能适得其反，尤其是需要躲避落雷时。

units.source: They can be killed by exploding a {#1}Screaming Skull{/#1} near them.
units.zh: 让{#1}尖啸骷髅{/#1}在幻影附近爆炸，也能将其杀死。

units.source: Unlike other ghostly enemies, they have somewhat low ranged defense. {#1}Ranged weapons{/#1} can have a good probability of hitting them, however it rapidly decreases with range due to the {#2}Incorporeal{/#2} racial perk.
units.zh: 与其他幽灵敌人不同，幻影的远程防御较低，{#1}远程武器{/#1}有不错的命中机会。不过，由于{#2}无实体{/#2}种族特长，距离越远，命中率下降越快。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}
Webknecht Eggs appear in fights with {#1}Webknechts{/#1} and spawn more of them.
units.zh: 蛛卵出现在与{#1}巨蛛{/#1}的战斗中，会孵化出更多巨蛛。

units.source: The number of eggs is 5 times less than spiders, but a group of 5 spiders don't spawn eggs. They are placed on tiles where they are not seen by the player, and are never {#1}hidden{/#1} in vegetation.
units.zh: 每5只巨蛛对应一枚蛛卵，不过只有5只巨蛛的队伍不会生成蛛卵。它们被放在玩家看不到的格子上，但绝不会{#1}藏在{/#1}植被中。

units.source: Eggs are stationary and aren't in turn order. However, they can spawn a {#1}Webknecht{/#1} at round start. Webknechts hatch with a delay of 1 or 2 turns randomly, can't act on the round they hatched, drop no loot and their XP reward is halved. After spawning 4 spiders Eggs self-destruct.
units.zh: 蛛卵不会移动，也不进入行动顺序，但能在整轮开始时孵化一只{#1}巨蛛{/#1}。每次孵化随机间隔1或2回合；新生巨蛛在孵化当轮无法行动，不掉落战利品，经验奖励减半。孵化4只巨蛛后，蛛卵会自行销毁。

units.source: They all instantly die if there are no more spiders on the map.
units.zh: 如果地图上已经没有巨蛛，所有蛛卵都会立刻死亡。

units.source: Low priority target. Difficult to reach, and some spiders will be on the way, stalling you. Only attack them on opportunity.
units.zh: 蛛卵优先级较低：它们难以接近，沿路的巨蛛也会拖住你。只有顺手能打到时才值得攻击。

units.source: You will fight almost two times more spiders because of these. However they attack with a delay, instead of in a one wave.
units.zh: 因为蛛卵，实际要对付的巨蛛数量接近最初的两倍。不过，孵化出的巨蛛会稍晚加入战斗，不会一次全部涌上来。

units.source: Can be sniped with {#1}Heavy Crossbow{/#1} (1-2 shots), {#2}Nomad Sling{/#2} (2 shots) or a single {#3}Throwing Axe{/#3}.
units.zh: 可以用{#1}重弩{/#1}射击1-2次、{#2}游牧投石杖{/#2}射击2次，或投出一把{#3}投斧{/#3}来摧毁蛛卵。

units.source: If you kill initial wave of spiders quickly, you can get a little extra XP killing spiders hatching from eggs, leaving eggs intact.
units.zh: 如果迅速杀死初始巨蛛群，可以暂留蛛卵不打，击杀新孵化的巨蛛来多赚一点经验。

units.source: Phylactery is a magical object for the {#1}Lorekeeper{/#1} to resurrect from.
units.zh: 命匣是供{#1}典籍守护者{/#1}复活的魔法物体。

units.source: There are always 10 phylacteries, spaced evenly on the map. Some of them spawn on elevated ground, and the Lorekeeper can use {#1}Geomancy{/#1} to elevate it when he wants.
units.zh: 地图上始终有10个命匣，均匀分布。部分命匣生成在高地上，典籍守护者也能用{#1}地术{/#1}将其脚下地面抬高。

units.source: When the Lorekeeper dies, one of them is destroyed and he is placed on its tile, fully healed. Also when it happens, the ground under Phylacteries lowers.
units.zh: 典籍守护者死亡时，会消耗并摧毁一个命匣，在该格以满生命值重生。同时，命匣脚下的地面会下降。

units.source: The more of them are destroyed, the harder the fight gets.
units.zh: 被摧毁的命匣越多，战斗就越困难。

units.source: Killing the Lorekeeper may seem pointless, but it lowers Phylacteries to the ground to destroy easily.
units.zh: 杀死典籍守护者看似无用，却能让命匣降回地面，更容易摧毁。

units.source: You must walk the entire map to destroy them all, and some of them are out of melee reach. Use ranged brothers with {#1}Throwing Axes{/#1}.
units.zh: 要摧毁全部命匣，必须走遍整张地图，而且有些命匣不在近战攻击范围内。可让远程弟兄使用{#1}投斧{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Ancient Auxiliary{/#1} • {#2}Ancient Legionary{/#2} ({#3}with Polearm{/#3}) • {#4}Ancient Honor Guard{/#4} ({#5}with Polearm{/#5} • {#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Ancient Priest{/#7} • {#8}Necrosavant{/#8} • {#9}The Lorekeeper{/#9} • {#10}Phylactery{/#10} • {#11}Screaming Skull{/#11} • {#12}Lorekeeper's Apparition{/#12} • {#13}The Conqueror{/#13}
{#1}Orcs{/#1} and {#2}Goblins{/#2} build and deploy the catapults during {#3}Greenskin Invasion{/#3} to siege human settlements.
units.zh: {#1}兽人{/#1}和{#2}地精{/#2}会在{#3}绿皮入侵{/#3}期间建造并部署投石机，围攻人类定居点。

units.source: Catapults are stationary, have no skills, and are not in the turn order. They do however accumulate fatigue when hit, but don't reduce it. If no Greenskins remain, the Catapults are automatically destroyed.
units.zh: 投石机固定不动，没有技能，也不进入行动顺序。受到攻击时会积累疲劳，却不会消减疲劳。如果场上已没有绿皮，投石机会自动被摧毁。

units.source: You can still attack them to trigger perk effects and cause {#1}morale{/#1} checks on enemies.
units.zh: 你仍可攻击投石机，以触发特长效果，或让敌人进行{#1}士气{/#1}检定。

units.source: {#1}Orc Young{/#1} • {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2} ({#3}Champion{/#3}) • {#4}Orc Berserker{/#4} • {#5}Orc Warlord{/#5} ({#6}Champion{/#6}) • {#7}Greenskin Catapult{/#7}

{#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1} ({#2}Champion{/#2}) • {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Goblin Wolfrider{/#5} • {#6}Goblin Wolf{/#6} • {#7}Goblin Shaman{/#7} • {#8}Goblin Overseer{/#8} • {#9}Greenskin Catapult{/#9}
This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of a {#2}Barbarian King{/#2}.
A {#1}Named Rusty Warblade{/#1}, {#2}Named Two-Handed Skull Hammer{/#2}, {#3}Named Heavy Rusty Axe{/#3} or {#4}Named Two-Handed Spiked Mace{/#4}.
units.zh: 装备{#1}名贵锈蚀战刃{/#1}、{#2}名贵双手颅骨锤{/#2}、{#3}名贵锈蚀重斧{/#3}或{#4}名贵双手尖刺钉锤{/#4}。

units.source: Always has a {#1}named weapon{/#1}, and is extremely deadly with it. Can kill a {#2}Battle Forged{/#2} brother in one hit even if he has {#3}Steel Brow{/#3} if the named weapon is above average. {#4}Rusty Warblade{/#4} needs two hits.
units.zh: 精英蛮族之王始终携带{#1}名贵武器{/#1}，极其致命。若武器属性高于平均水平，即便{#2}久经战阵{/#2}弟兄拥有{#3}钢铁额骨{/#3}，也可能被一击杀死；{#4}锈蚀战刃{/#4}则需要两击。

units.source: If he kills someone, he will gain {#1}Berserk{/#1}, {#2}Frenzy{/#2} and {#3}confidence{/#3}.
units.zh: 他击杀目标后，会触发{#1}狂战{/#1}和{#2}杀戮狂热{/#2}，并变得{#3}斗志昂扬{/#3}。

units.source: So your tactics should be all about not even letting him attack.
units.zh: 因此，战术的核心应是根本不给他攻击机会。

units.source: Control him by {#1}stunning{/#1} or {#2}disarming{/#2}. He counters it by acting ahead of you and waiting, and uses {#3}Adrenaline{/#3} to get ahead. If he does it, you can only stun to prevent Adrenaline.
units.zh: 用{#1}眩晕{/#1}或{#2}缴械{/#2}控制他。他会抢先行动再等待来应对，并用{#3}肾上腺素{/#3}保持先手。如果他这样做，就只能靠眩晕阻止肾上腺素。

units.source: {#1}Barbarian Thrall{/#1} • {#2}Barbarian Reaver{/#2} • {#3}Barbarian Chosen{/#3} ({#4}Champion{/#4}) • {#5}Barbarian Drummer{/#5} • {#6}Barbarian Beastmaster{/#6} • {#7}Barbarian King{/#7} ({#8}Champion{/#8}) • {#9}Barbarian Madman{/#9} • {#10}Warhound{/#10} • {#11}Armored Unhold{/#11}
1/8 chance of a {#1}Named Shamshir{/#1}, {#2}Named Qatal Dagger{/#2}, {#3}Named Swordlance{/#3}, {#4}Named Polemace{/#4}, {#5}Named Two-Handed Scimitar{/#5} or {#6}Named Spear{/#6}.

1/8 chance of a {#1}Named Axe{/#1}, {#2}Named Billhook{/#2}, {#3}Named Cleaver{/#3}, {#4}Named Dagger{/#4}, {#5}Named Flail{/#5}, {#6}Named Greataxe{/#6}, {#7}Named Greatsword{/#7}, {#8}Named Longaxe{/#8}, {#9}Named Mace{/#9}, {#10}Named Spear{/#10}, {#11}Named Sword{/#11}, {#12}Named Two-Handed Hammer{/#12}, {#13}Named Warbrand{/#13}, {#14}Named Warhammer{/#14}, {#15}Named Pike{/#15}, {#16}Named Polehammer{/#16}, {#17}Named Fencing Sword{/#17}, {#18}Named Two-Handed Mace{/#18}, {#19}Named Two-Handed Flail{/#19}, {#20}Named Three-Headed Flail{/#20}, {#21}Named Spetum{/#21}, {#22}Named Bardiche{/#22}, {#23}Named Shamshir{/#23}, {#24}Named Battle Whip{/#24}, {#25}Named Qatal Dagger{/#25}, {#26}Named Swordlance{/#26}, {#27}Named Polemace{/#27} or {#28}Named Two-Handed Scimitar{/#28}.
1/8 chance of a {#1}Leopard Armor{/#1} (319-362), {#2}Golden Lamellar Armor{/#2} (313-356) or {#3}Black and Gold Armor{/#3} (231-262).

1/8 chance of an {#1}Enhanced Coat of Plates{/#1} (352-400), {#2}Plated Mail Hauberk{/#2} (330-375), {#3}Leopard Armor{/#3} (319-362), {#4}Golden Lamellar Armor{/#4} (313-356), {#5}Named Sellsword's Armor{/#5} (286-325), {#6}Golden Scale Armor{/#6} (264-300), {#7}Heraldic Mail Hauberk{/#7} (231-262), {#8}Black and Gold Armor{/#8} (231-262), {#9}Named Noble Mail Armor{/#9} (176-200), {#10}Studded Mail Armor{/#10} (154-175) or {#11}Hardened Leather Armor{/#11} (126-143).
1/8 chance of a {#1}Gold and Black Turban{/#1} (319-362), {#2}Red and Gold Band Helmet{/#2} (280-318) or {#3}Named Steppe Helmet{/#3} (220-250).

1/8 chance of a {#1}Gold and Black Turban{/#1} (319-362), {#2}Named Conic Helmet{/#2} (308-350), {#3}Heraldic Bascinet{/#3} (308-350), {#4}Sallet{/#4} (291-331), {#5}Named Nordic Helmet{/#5} (291-331), {#6}Lindwurm Helmet{/#6} (291-331), {#7}Feathered Nasal Helmet{/#7} (291-331), {#8}Red and Gold Band Helmet{/#8} (280-318), {#9}Golden Feathered Helmet{/#9} (264-300), {#10}Named Steppe Helmet{/#10} (220-250), {#11}Wolf Helmet{/#11} (154-175) or {#12}Norse Helmet{/#12} (137-156).

1/8 chance of a {#1}Dragon Kite Shield{/#1}, {#2}Metal Heater Shield{/#2}, {#3}Golden Round Shield{/#3}, {#4}Pavise Shield{/#4}, {#5}Relic Heater Shield{/#5}, {#6}Winged Shield{/#6} or {#7}Named Sipar Shield{/#7}.

If he has a {#1}named{/#1} two-handed weapon, its single hit can be fatal to a {#2}Battle Forged{/#2} brother, and more likely if he does not have {#3}Steel Brow{/#3}. The weapon must be very good to do it.
units.zh: 如果携带{#1}名贵{/#1}双手武器，一次命中就可能杀死{#2}久经战阵{/#2}弟兄，没有{#3}钢铁额骨{/#3}时更容易发生。不过，武器属性必须非常好才能做到。

units.source: Use {#1}nets{/#1} to make him easier to hit. Also he can't remove a net and attack with a 6 AP weapon on the same turn.
units.zh: 用{#1}投网{/#1}提高命中机会。他也无法在同一回合挣脱投网并用耗费6行动点的武器攻击。

units.source: He can have an armor piece so heavy that Nimble stops working.
units.zh: 他可能穿着过于沉重的护甲，使轻灵完全失效。

units.source: {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} • {#2}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Cultist{/#3} • {#4}Envoy{/#4} • {#5}Firstborn{/#5} • {#6}Gladiator{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Oathbringer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9})
This is a {#1}Champion{/#1} version of a {#2}Hedge Knight{/#2}.

1/3 chance of a {#1}Named Axe{/#1}, {#2}Named Cleaver{/#2}, {#3}Named Greataxe{/#3}, {#4}Named Greatsword{/#4}, {#5}Named Mace{/#5}, {#6}Named Sword{/#6}, {#7}Named Two-Handed Hammer{/#7}, {#8}Named Warbrand{/#8}, {#9}Named Two-Handed Mace{/#9}, {#10}Named Two-Handed Flail{/#10} or {#11}Named Bardiche{/#11}.
1/3 chance of an {#1}Enhanced Coat of Plates{/#1} (352-400), {#2}Plated Mail Hauberk{/#2} (330-375) or {#3}Golden Scale Armor{/#3} (264-300).

1/3 chance of a {#1}Dragon Kite Shield{/#1}, {#2}Metal Heater Shield{/#2}, {#3}Golden Round Shield{/#3}, {#4}Pavise Shield{/#4}, {#5}Relic Heater Shield{/#5}, {#6}Winged Shield{/#6}, {#7}Named Sipar Shield{/#7}, {#8}Bandit Heater Shield{/#8} or {#9}Bandit Kite Shield{/#9}.
With a two-handed weapon he is similar to a {#1}Nomad Executioner{/#1}, and with a shield he is similar to a {#2}Knight{/#2}.
units.zh: 持双手武器时，他类似{#1}游牧刽子手{/#1}；持盾时则类似{#2}骑士{/#2}。

units.source: Use {#1}nets{/#1} to make him easier to hit, and breaking free makes him unable to attack with a 6 AP weapon.
units.zh: 用{#1}投网{/#1}提高命中机会。挣脱投网后，他就没有足够行动点使用耗费6行动点的武器。

units.source: If he has a two-handed {#1}named weapon{/#1} with above average stats, he can kill a {#2}Battle Forged{/#2} brother in one hit even if he has {#3}Steel Brow{/#3}. Control him by {#4}stunning{/#4} and {#5}disarming{/#5}, don't let him attack at all. Use {#6}Indomitable{/#6} if he is about to attack. {#7}Bone Plating{/#7} and {#8}Nine Lives{/#8} can be useful.
units.zh: 如果持有属性高于平均水平的双手{#1}名贵武器{/#1}，即便{#2}久经战阵{/#2}弟兄拥有{#3}钢铁额骨{/#3}，也可能被一击杀死。应通过{#4}眩晕{/#4}和{#5}缴械{/#5}控制他，根本不给攻击机会。如果他即将出手，就使用{#6}不屈{/#6}。{#7}骨板护层{/#7}和{#8}九命{/#8}也有帮助。

units.source: If he has a {#1}shield{/#1}, a {#2}Two-Handed Flail{/#2} with {#3}Flail Mastery{/#3} and {#4}Head Hunter{/#4} can be useful.

{#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}

units.source: He is very hard to hit when has a {#1}shield{/#1}. Your accuracy will be reduced:

units.source: melee by 55 and ranged by 56 if he has a {#1}Kite Shield{/#1} (defense values are 60 and 63).
units.zh: 若持{#1}鸢形盾{/#1}，近战命中降低55，远程命中降低56（对应防御值为60和63）。

units.source: The shield can be {#1}named{/#1}, giving higher bonus and you may want to loot it and not destroy.
units.zh: 盾牌可能是加成更高的{#1}名贵装备{/#1}，你也许希望将其缴获，而非摧毁。

units.source: Use a {#1}Two-Handed Flail{/#1}, preferably with {#2}Flail Mastery{/#2} and {#3}Head Hunter{/#3}. It has bonus accuracy against shields, penetrates heavy helmets and this enemy does not have {#4}Steel Brow{/#4}. This way you can beat him without destroying a named shield.
units.zh: 使用{#1}双手连枷{/#1}，最好搭配{#2}连枷精通{/#2}和{#3}猎首者{/#3}。连枷对持盾目标有命中加成，能穿透重盔，而此敌人又没有{#4}钢铁额骨{/#4}。这样可以在不破坏名贵盾牌的情况下击败他。

units.source: After the flail accuracy rework, your accuracy will be reduced by only 45 for Heater Shield and 41 for Kite Shield. If a net is on him, it's 13 and 14 (better shields protect him worse).
units.zh: 原文按连枷命中机制调整后的计算：对熨斗形盾，命中仅降低45；对鸢形盾，仅降低41。若目标被网投住，则分别只降低13和14（更好的盾牌反而提供更差的保护）。

units.source: He can spawn with a {#1}Named Greatsword{/#1}, and then should be controlled with nets, {#2}stunning{/#2} and {#3}disarming{/#3}.
units.zh: 他可能携带{#1}名贵巨剑{/#1}，此时应通过投网、{#2}眩晕{/#2}和{#3}缴械{/#3}控制。

units.source: He gains {#1}confidence{/#1} if he sees his enemy die, and it increases his stats even further.
units.zh: 目睹敌人死亡后，他会变得{#1}斗志昂扬{/#1}，属性进一步提高。

Named one-handed weapons are dangerous too if he is a {#4}Duelist{/#4}. Control him by {#5}stunning{/#5} or {#6}disarming{/#6}.
units.zh: 持{#1}名贵{/#1}双手武器时，他十分致命，一次命中就可能杀死{#2}久经战阵{/#2}弟兄，没有{#3}钢铁额骨{/#3}时更容易发生。若拥有{#4}决斗家{/#4}，名贵单手武器也很危险。应通过{#5}眩晕{/#5}或{#6}缴械{/#6}控制他。
