units.zh: 他没有{#1}以少敌多{/#1}，不过这场战斗中你只有三名弟兄。

units.source: Oathbringers can come {#1}at any moment{/#1}, and you must be ready that one of them will be a champion. Both champions are unlikely to come.
units.zh: 誓约使者可能{#1}随时{/#1}出现，要做好其中一名是精英的准备。两名同时为精英的概率不高。

units.source: {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1} • {#2}Bounty Hunter Marksman{/#2} • {#3}Cultist{/#3} • {#4}Envoy{/#4} • {#5}Firstborn{/#5} • {#6}Gladiator{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Oathbringer{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9})

In the early game Brigand groups usually consist of {#1}Thugs{/#1} and sometimes {#2}Raiders{/#2}. Later, Raiders become more common, ranged attackers appear and their numbers increase, and armored {#3}Marauders{/#3} can spawn. In the late game you will usually see a {#4}Brigand Leader{/#4} and other elite enemies among them.
units.zh: 前期强盗队伍通常由{#1}打手{/#1}组成，有时混有{#2}劫掠者{/#2}。之后，劫掠者会越来越常见，远程敌人开始出现，整体人数增加，也可能生成重甲{#3}悍匪{/#3}。后期通常还会有{#4}强盗头目{/#4}和其他精锐敌人。

units.source: Their backline usually consists of {#1}Marksmen{/#1} who give Brigands ranged superiority, and if they think they have it, they will stand their ground and shoot at you. It is especially true when you attack their fortified camps. {#2}Crossbow{/#2}men are especially deadly in the middle game. However, Brigands are often too undisciplined to maintain formation. Some of them can run towards you even when they have ranged superiority.
units.zh: 强盗后排通常由{#1}射手{/#1}组成，为其提供远程优势。只要判断自己占据远程优势，强盗就会坚守原地射击，进攻设防营地时尤其如此。{#2}弩{/#2}手在中期特别致命。不过，强盗往往缺乏维持阵型的纪律，即使有远程优势，也可能有人独自冲向你。

units.source: They have {#1}throwing weapons{/#1} and try to use them, but lack of {#2}Quick Hands{/#2} makes them not suited for this strategy.
units.zh: 强盗携带{#1}投掷武器{/#1}并会尝试使用，但缺乏{#2}快手{/#2}，不太适合这种战术。

units.source: Nomads are basically southern {#1}Brigands{/#1}. However they have better stats and gain {#2}Dodge{/#2} in the middle game, becoming even more dangerous. In the late game {#3}Nomad Leaders{/#3} and other elite enemies appear, especially in large Nomad camps.
units.zh: 游牧民基本相当于南方的{#1}强盗{/#1}，但属性更好，中期获得{#2}闪避{/#2}后更加危险。后期会出现{#3}游牧首领{/#3}和其他精锐敌人，大型游牧营地尤其如此。

units.source: {#1}Nomad Archers{/#1} can be numerous, but Nomads still often prefer to approach despite their ranged superiority, and Archers reposition themselves. Their camps have no walls, and their behavior does not change when you are attacking a camp.
units.zh: {#1}游牧弓手{/#1}可能很多，但即便有远程优势，游牧民仍经常选择推进，让弓手调整位置。营地没有围墙，进攻营地时他们的行为也不会改变。

units.source: Nomads don't use {#1}throwing weapons{/#1}, instead they {#2}throw sand in your face{/#2} to lower initiative and damage output.
units.zh: 游牧民不使用{#1}投掷武器{/#1}，而是{#2}向你脸上扬沙{/#2}，降低先攻和伤害。

units.source: Nomads are free people of the south who chose to live outside of the control of any city state. They travel the barren desert from one source of water to the next, hunting and scavenging, and living the freedom that they chose. Faced with surviving in this harsh environment, many nomads turn to banditry. It’s not all of them, of course, but as a mercenary in this world it’s who you’ll be dealing with most of the time. Nomads have a roster of their own, roughly similar to that of northern brigands, but with their own equipment and a unique skill. Home in the desert and experienced in desert warfare, they use the environment to their advantage. Quite literally, in that they may throw sand in the faces of their opponents, inflicting the {#1}‘Distracted’{/#1} status effect. A distracted target will inflict less damage and have less initiative for a single turn. Nomads populate the vast southern deserts surrounding the city states of the Gilders.
units.zh: 游牧民是南方的自由之民，选择生活在任何城邦的控制之外。他们往来于荒漠中的水源之间，靠狩猎与拾荒为生，过着自己选择的自由生活。为了在严酷环境中生存，许多游牧民沦为盗匪。当然，并非人人如此，但身为这个世界的佣兵，你打交道最多的往往就是这一类。游牧民有自己的单位体系，大体类似北方强盗，却拥有独立的装备和一种独特技能。他们以沙漠为家，熟悉沙漠战争，懂得利用环境取得优势——甚至会直接向对手脸上扬沙，施加{#1}“分心”{/#1}状态。分心目标在一个回合内伤害降低、先攻下降。游牧民生活在南方广袤的沙漠中，围绕着信奉镀金者的城邦。

units.source: Barbarians' strategy is simply running towards their enemy and attacking with everything they have. Even their weakest units, {#1}Thralls{/#1}, often have {#2}throwing weapons{/#2}. {#3}Reavers{/#3} bring many two-handed weapons that can hit hard. In the late game you will encounter armored {#4}Chosen{/#4}, and entire warbands consisting only of them. Also their {#5}Armored Unholds{/#5} will appear, and {#6}Beastmasters{/#6} to control them.
units.zh: 蛮族的战术就是冲向敌人，倾尽一切攻击。即便最弱的{#1}奴兵{/#1}也经常携带{#2}投掷武器{/#2}，而{#3}掠夺者{/#3}则带来大量重击武器。后期会遭遇身披重甲的{#4}神选战士{/#4}，甚至整支战团都由他们组成。{#5}披甲巨魔{/#5}以及负责控制它们的{#6}驯兽师{/#6}也会出现。

units.source: Don't believe the tip on the loading screen that says they quickly become fatigued. It only happens if they use {#1}Adrenaline{/#1} every turn to outspeed you, and it's not going to happen quickly. Barbarians have high max fatigue and are often supported by hard to reach {#2}Drummers{/#2}, who reduce fatigue they accumulate. Their {#3}Barbarian Fury{/#3} is a variant of {#4}Rotation{/#4}, but costs much less fatigue.
units.zh: 不要轻信载入提示中“蛮族很快会疲劳”的说法。只有当他们每回合都用{#1}肾上腺素{/#1}抢先行动时才容易积累疲劳，而且仍不会很快耗尽体力。蛮族疲劳上限很高，常有难以接近的{#2}鼓手{/#2}支援，减少其积累的疲劳。{#3}蛮族狂怒{/#3}类似{#4}换位{/#4}，但疲劳消耗低得多。

units.source: In combat, a barbarian warband doesn’t bother with formations, and they have no backline with polearms or dedicated archers. They are a horde of ferocious warriors in a constant shuffle of everyone trying to bring their weapons to bear against the enemy. They’ll shower you with throwing weapons, they run towards your line, and they make ample use of the ‘Adrenaline’ perk to overwhelm you before you can even strike back. They don’t fear death the same as other humans do, so they are not easy to break. They populate the far northen part of the map.
units.zh: 战斗中，蛮族战团不讲究阵型，也没有长柄武器后排或专职弓手。他们是一群凶猛的战士，始终相互换位，争着把武器砸向敌人。他们会投掷武器倾泻火力，冲向你的战线，大量使用“肾上腺素”特长，在你来得及反击前就发动猛攻。他们不像其他人类那样畏惧死亡，士气不易崩溃。蛮族生活在地图极北地区。

units.source: Noble Houses have dedicated frontline, polearms and ranged units. {#1}Standard Bearers{/#1} help to maintain high {#2}morale{/#2} among soldiers. Elite units try to make a breakthrough where they are fighting. Some squads use {#3}Wardogs{/#3}, which usually pointlessly die at the beginning of a fight.
units.zh: 贵族家族拥有专职前排、长柄武器兵和远程单位。{#1}旗手{/#1}帮助士兵维持较高{#2}士气{/#2}，精锐单位则尝试突破自己所在的战线。部分队伍使用{#3}战犬{/#3}，但这些犬只通常在开战初期就白白死去。

units.source: The weakness of Noble squads is their suboptimal use of the {#1}Battle Forged{/#1} perk. Medium armor is too light to work well with it, and {#2}Billmen{/#2} wear even lighter armor like {#3}Gambesons{/#3} and {#4}Aketon Caps{/#4}, becoming very vulnerable for those who can attack them.
units.zh: 贵族队伍的弱点是未能充分发挥{#1}久经战阵{/#1}。中型护甲太轻，与该特长配合不佳；{#2}钩镰枪兵{/#2}甚至只穿{#3}厚衬软甲{/#3}和{#4}厚衬布帽{/#4}之类更轻的防具，能打到他们的单位很容易将其击倒。

units.source: Professional soldiers working on the payroll of one of the three Northern noble houses. Their patrols are a common sight and they protect supply caravans and the more well fortified towns and castles. Can be encountered through the Noble War, Holy War or by just being hostile to one of the houses through one of several ways.
units.zh: 这些职业士兵受雇于北方三大贵族家族之一。巡逻队随处可见，负责保护补给商队以及防御更完善的城镇和城堡。贵族战争、圣战期间，或通过其他途径与某个家族敌对时，都可能与他们交战。

units.source: Civilian faction isn't really combat-oriented. Its units are weak and can only rely on their numbers, even then only distracting the enemy or worse, making enemies confident, giving {#1}Nachzehrers{/#1} many corpses to eat, and giving {#2}Orc Berserkers{/#2} huge amount of {#3}Rage{/#3} stacks.
units.zh: 平民阵营并不擅长战斗。单位实力很弱，只能依靠人数；即便如此，往往也只是分散敌人注意力，甚至让敌人变得斗志昂扬，为{#1}食尸鬼{/#1}留下大量尸体，或让{#2}兽人狂战士{/#2}积累海量{#3}怒火{/#3}层数。

units.source: Mercenaries don't have complicated tactics or gameplan. They attack and hope their {#1}Overwhelm{/#1} will work and their {#2}armor{/#2} will save them. They bring different weapons, sometimes {#3}nets{/#3} and {#4}throwing weapons{/#4}. Their armor can vary from very light to very heavy, so it is better to kill those who wear light armor, and hit poorly protected heads if you can target them.
units.zh: 佣兵没有复杂的战术规划，只管进攻，寄望于{#1}压制{/#1}生效、{#2}护甲{/#2}保命。他们使用各种武器，有时还带{#3}投网{/#3}和{#4}投掷武器{/#4}。护甲从极轻到极重都有，因此最好先杀护甲较轻的目标；若能瞄准部位，则攻击防护差的头部。

units.source: Elite enemies that are among them can be problematic by themselves.
units.zh: 队伍中的精锐敌人即便单独出现，也可能很难对付。

units.source: Target gets decapitated when killed with this skill (if possible), has a damage bonus that scales with lost health, {#1}25%{/#1} {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} ({#5}35%{/#5} {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} for Barbarian cleavers)
Flesh Golem is an undead enemy, found in the {#1}Abandoned Village{/#1} and the {#2}Artifact Reliquary{/#2} legendary locations.
units.zh: 血肉魔像是亡灵敌人，出现在{#1}废弃村庄{/#1}和{#2}圣物宝库{/#2}两个传奇地点。

units.source: A set of dual weapons: {#1}Butcher's Cleaver{/#1}/{#2}Pickaxe{/#2}, {#3}Bludgeon{/#3}/{#4}Reinforced Wooden Flail{/#4}, {#5}Bludgeon{/#5}/{#6}Pickaxe{/#6} or {#7}Militia Spear{/#7}/{#8}Shortsword{/#8}.
For some reason their skills have a fatigue cost, but flesh golems don't accumulate fatigue. Golems use skills depending on their weapons, and use Grapple and Smack when unarmed.
units.zh: 不知为何，技能写有疲劳消耗，血肉魔像却不会积累疲劳。魔像会按所持武器使用相应技能；空手时则使用擒抱和拍击。

units.source: Note: as of 1.5.1.7, some attacks differ from those of regular weapons, likely due to a bug:
units.zh: 注意：原文记录在1.5.1.7版本中，部分攻击与普通武器存在以下差异，可能是程序错误：

units.source: Batter, instead of dealing 10 minimum damage like a hammer, inflicts 10 extra fatigue like a mace.
units.zh: 猛击没有像战锤那样造成最低10点伤害，而是像锤类武器一样额外施加10点疲劳。

units.source: Knock Out has 50% armor ignoring damage instead of 40%, and damage is not halved.
units.zh: 击晕的无视护甲伤害比例为50%而非40%，且伤害不会减半。

units.source: Flesh Golems have a simple behavior which is to approach and attack you in melee. Those armed with dual weapons will use their corresponding weapon skills. Unarmed golems use Grapple and Smack.
units.zh: 血肉魔像的行为很简单：靠近你并近战攻击。双持武器的会使用对应武器技能，空手的则使用擒抱和拍击。

units.source: Some of them are bodyguards of {#1}Fault Finders{/#1} and will stay near them.
units.zh: 部分魔像是{#1}寻隙者{/#1}的护卫，会留在其身旁。

units.source: High melee defense counters their low accuracy. If it's high enough, you can even stop respecting their zone of control.
units.zh: 较高的近战防御可以克制魔像较低的命中。如果防御足够高，甚至可以冒险穿过其控制区。

units.source: {#1}Overwhelm{/#1} and {#2}Dodge{/#2} will work, but Fault Finders will stagger and Flesh Golems will daze you, lowering your initiative.
units.zh: {#1}压制{/#1}和{#2}闪避{/#2}有效，但寻隙者会让你踉跄，血肉魔像会让你恍惚，从而降低先攻。

units.source: Low priority enemies. Killing them gives Fault Finders more corpses to explode.
units.zh: 优先级较低。杀死血肉魔像，只会给寻隙者留下更多可供引爆的尸体。

units.source: {#1}Flesh Golem{/#1} • {#2}Greater Flesh Golem{/#2} • {#3}Fault Finder{/#3} • {#4}Grand Diviner{/#4} • {#5}Flesh Cradle{/#5}

{#1}Corpse Hurl{/#1} is a ranged attack. Does 55-65 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 110% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 40% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} if hits. Additionally does 20-40 {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} with 50% {#14}{#15}{#16/}{/#15}{/#14} and 25% {#17}{#18}{#19/}{/#18}{/#17}, ignoring Nimble, in a 7 tiles area where the corpse landed, even if the attack misses. Creates a corpse and can be used without any corpses nearby. Range is 4 tiles, 5 with height advantage.

{#1}Flurry{/#1} hits adjacent enemies, starting from the tile to the north and then going clockwise. It can loop and hit same enemies again. After a total of 6 attacks it ends. Each hit does 40-65 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} with 65% {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} and 20% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}.
Greater Flesh Golem is a dangerous undead enemy, found in the {#1}Artifact Reliquary{/#1} legendary location.
units.zh: 巨型血肉魔像是危险的亡灵敌人，出现在传奇地点{#1}圣物宝库{/#1}。

units.source: A Silk Toga (80) and a Mask of the Scholar (140).
units.zh: 装备丝绸托加袍（80）和学者面具（140）。

units.source: A Gilded Toga (300) and a Head of the Court (210).
units.zh: 装备金饰托加袍（300）和宫廷之首（210）。

units.source: For some reason their skills have a fatigue cost, but flesh golems don't accumulate fatigue.
units.zh: 不知为何，技能写有疲劳消耗，血肉魔像却不会积累疲劳。

units.source: There will be three Greater Flesh Golems, each wearing its own determined set of armor.
units.zh: 共有三只巨型血肉魔像，每只都穿着预设的独立护甲组合。

units.source: Their zone of control attack skill is Clout, and receiving a stun from it ends your turn.
units.zh: 它们的控制区攻击使用重殴；因此受到眩晕时，你的回合会立即结束。

units.source: Corpse Hurl can't be used in melee, but does not require corpses or {#1}Flesh Cradles{/#1}. They can use it anytime, unless engaged with melee units. They rarely use this ability though.
units.zh: 投掷尸体无法在近战中使用，但无需现成尸体或{#1}血肉摇篮{/#1}。只要未被近战单位缠住，随时都能使用，不过它们很少施展此技能。

units.source: They seem to not prefer one attack or another, but if brothers stand in a straight line, they will likely try to hit them with Spike.
units.zh: 魔像似乎不特别偏好某种攻击，但如果弟兄站成直线，就很可能尝试使用尖刺。

units.source: They have decent accuracy, but it's still quite low by late game standards. Brothers with good melee defense can tank them for many turns.
units.zh: 它们的命中尚可，但按后期标准仍然偏低。近战防御出色的弟兄能抵挡它们很多回合。

units.source: {#1}Overwhelm{/#1} and {#2}Dodge{/#2} will work, but {#3}Fault Finders{/#3} will stagger and {#4}Flesh Golems{/#4} will daze you, lowering your initiative.
units.zh: {#1}压制{/#1}和{#2}闪避{/#2}有效，但{#3}寻隙者{/#3}会让你踉跄，{#4}血肉魔像{/#4}会让你恍惚，从而降低先攻。

units.source: Inflicting an {#1}injury{/#1} requires dealing 113 damage, 82 with {#2}Crippling Strikes{/#2}. {#3}Gash{/#3} also lowers the threshold depending on {#4}Sword Mastery{/#4}.
units.zh: 造成{#1}伤势{/#1}需要单次113点伤害；拥有{#2}致残打击{/#2}时为82点。{#3}撕裂{/#3}也能降低门槛，具体取决于是否有{#4}剑术精通{/#4}。

units.source: Can be annoying if they stay near the {#1}Grand Diviner{/#1} because they will attack the brother who is trying to stunlock him.
units.zh: 如果巨型魔像守在{#1}大先知{/#1}身边会很烦人，因为它们会攻击负责连续眩晕首领的弟兄。

units.source: {#1}Flesh Golem{/#1} • {#2}Greater Flesh Golem{/#2} • {#3}Fault Finder{/#3} • {#4}Grand Diviner{/#4} • {#5}Flesh Cradle{/#5}

{#1}Corpse Explosion{/#1} makes a corpse or a {#2}Flesh Cradle{/#2} explode, dealing 25-50{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} to anyone adjacent and 30-60{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} to the entity standing on the corpse. Damage is dealt to the body with 75% {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} and 20% {#12}{#13}{#14/}{/#13}{/#12} and ignores Nimble. Creates miasma on affected tiles. Spell range is 1-99 tiles.
{#1}Flesh Pull{/#1} moves a brother 2 tiles towards a corpse, a {#2}Flesh Cradle{/#2} or any {#3}Flesh Golem{/#3}, and {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}staggers{/#7} him. Spell range is 1-99 tiles.
Fault Finder is a spellcaster, found in the {#1}Abandoned Village{/#1} and the {#2}Artifact Reliquary{/#2} legendary locations.
units.zh: 寻隙者是施法者，出现在{#1}废弃村庄{/#1}和{#2}圣物宝库{/#2}两个传奇地点。

units.source: A Leather Facewrap (30) (1/3 chance), Occult Eye Mask (30) (1/2 chance) or Temple of Knowledge (10) (1/6 chance).
units.zh: 装备皮革裹面（30，1/3概率）、秘仪眼纹面具（30，1/2概率）或知识之殿（10，1/6概率）。

units.source: Fault Finders will not cast Flesh Pull if there are no golems or corpses ({#1}Flesh Cradles{/#1} don't count as targets) near brothers within range of 3 tiles. They can't cast at all when engaged in melee and will instead attack with a weapon.
units.zh: 若弟兄周围3格内没有魔像或尸体，寻隙者就不会施放血肉拖拽；判断这一条件时，{#1}血肉摇篮{/#1}不算目标。寻隙者陷入近战后完全无法施法，会改用武器攻击。

units.source: They have {#1}Flesh Golems{/#1} bodyguards, which stand near them.
units.zh: 寻隙者有{#1}血肉魔像{/#1}护卫，留在其身旁。

units.source: In the Abandoned Village they spawn on elevated terrain.
units.zh: 在废弃村庄，寻隙者会生成在高地上。

units.source: In the Artifact Reliquary, when the {#1}Grand Diviner{/#1} dies and any Fault Finders are still present, he will resurrect, replacing one of them.
units.zh: 在圣物宝库，如果{#1}大先知{/#1}死亡时仍有寻隙者存活，就会取代其中一名寻隙者复活。

units.source: Top priority targets, because of their nasty spells and the fact you must kill them before the boss to prevent his respawn.
units.zh: 寻隙者是最高优先级目标：法术十分棘手，而且必须先杀光它们，再杀首领，才能阻止首领重生。

units.source: Corpse explosions ignore {#1}Nimble{/#1}, dealing high damage if the armor is broken.
units.zh: 尸爆无视{#1}轻灵{/#1}，护甲被破坏后会造成很高伤害。

units.source: If you are in melee with some but not all Fault Finders, the others will use Flesh Pull to free them from melee.
units.zh: 如果你只贴住部分寻隙者，其他寻隙者会用血肉拖拽把弟兄拉开，让同伴脱离近战。

units.source: Dogs are fast and will prioritize them, but are somewhat unreliable.
units.zh: 犬只速度快，也会优先攻击寻隙者，但不太可靠。

units.source: {#1}Flesh Golem{/#1} • {#2}Greater Flesh Golem{/#2} • {#3}Fault Finder{/#3} • {#4}Grand Diviner{/#4} • {#5}Flesh Cradle{/#5}
Brigand Marauder is an armored unit from the {#1}Brigands{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 强盗悍匪是{#1}强盗{/#1}阵营的重甲单位。

units.source: 55% chance of a {#1}Longaxe{/#1} (double chance), {#2}Pike{/#2}, {#3}Executioner's Sword{/#3}, {#4}Warbrand{/#4}, {#5}Two-Handed Flail{/#5}, {#6}Two-Handed Mace{/#6} or {#7}Longsword{/#7}.
50% chance of a {#1}Bundle of Throwing Axes{/#1}, {#2}Bundle of Javelins{/#2} or {#3}Throwing Spear{/#3}.
A {#1}Pillaged Heavy Lamellar Armor{/#1} (255) (only after day 60), {#2}Patchwork Scale Armor{/#2} (220) or {#3}Rusted Mail Hauberk{/#3} (140).
The armor has a 33% chance of a {#1}Rusted Mail Patch{/#1} (15) (80% chance) or {#2}Metal Plates and Rivets{/#2} (30) (20% chance) on it.
units.zh: 护甲有33%概率带有附件：{#1}生锈锁甲补片{/#1}（15，80%概率）或{#2}金属甲板与铆钉{/#2}（30，20%概率）。

units.source: 90% chance of a {#1}Flat Top with Rusty Mail{/#1} (245) (only after day 60), {#2}Marauder Helmet with Closed Mail{/#2} (245) (only after day 60, double chance), {#3}Kettle Hat with Rusty Mail{/#3} (230), {#4}Marauder Helmet with Rusty Mail{/#4} (180) (double chance) or {#5}Nasal Helmet with Rusty Mail{/#5} (140).
10% chance of a {#1}Rusty Mail Coif{/#1} (70) or a {#2}Headscarf{/#2} (20) (double chance). These Marauders have {#3}Steel Brow{/#3}.
units.zh: 有10%概率装备{#1}锈蚀锁甲头巾{/#1}（70）或{#2}头巾{/#2}（20，双倍概率）。这些悍匪拥有{#3}钢铁额骨{/#3}。

units.source: Brigand Marauders start appearing in the middle game, one or more among weaker brigands. Later, brigand parties can sometimes entirely consist of Marauders.
units.zh: 强盗悍匪从中期开始出现，较弱强盗队伍中会混入一名或多名。后期有时会出现整支队伍都由悍匪组成的情况。

units.source: They resemble {#1}Barbarian Chosen{/#1} because of similar stats, heavy armor and lack of shields, but have weaker weapons, stats and perk set.
units.zh: 他们的属性、重甲和不持盾的特点类似{#1}蛮族神选战士{/#1}，但武器、属性和特长配置都更弱。

units.source: They often have weapons with extra head hit chance or damage, the most dangerous of which is {#1}Two-Handed Flail{/#1}, and {#2}Head Hunter{/#2}. Protect heads accordingly and take defensive {#3}perks{/#3}.
units.zh: 他们经常使用提高头部命中率或头部伤害的武器，其中最危险的是{#1}双手连枷{/#1}，并拥有{#2}猎首者{/#2}。应保护好头部，选择防御{#3}特长{/#3}。

units.source: Have some means of escape before the guaranteed second head hit finishes you. The simplest is to {#1}Knock Back{/#1} with a {#2}shield{/#2}.
units.zh: 在必定命中头部的第二击致命之前，应准备好脱身手段。最简单的方法是用{#2}盾牌{/#2}施展{#1}击退{/#1}。

units.source: Control them by {#1}stunning{/#1}. {#2}Disarming{/#2} only works against 6 AP weapons because they have {#3}Quick Hands{/#3}. Unarmed attacks interfere with Head Hunter.
units.zh: 用{#1}眩晕{/#1}控制悍匪。由于他们拥有{#3}快手{/#3}，{#2}缴械{/#2}只对使用6行动点武器的目标有效。徒手攻击会干扰猎首者的效果。

units.source: Their lack of {#1}Resilient{/#1} makes them more vulnerable to poisons and {#2}Daze{/#2}.
units.zh: 他们没有{#1}顽强{/#1}，因此更容易受毒药和{#2}恍惚{/#2}影响。

units.source: Letting them spend turns using {#1}throwing weapons{/#1} seems a better option than walking into melee range of a scary {#2}Executioner's Sword{/#2} with all these {#3}Raiders{/#3} still present on the battlefield.
units.zh: 当战场上还有大量{#3}劫掠者{/#3}时，与其主动走进可怕的{#2}行刑剑{/#2}近战范围，不如让悍匪把回合花在{#1}投掷武器{/#1}上。

units.source: {#1}Brigand Thug{/#1} • {#2}Brigand Raider{/#2} • {#3}Brigand Poacher{/#3} • {#4}Brigand Marksman{/#4} • {#5}Brigand Marauder{/#5} • {#6}Brigand Leader{/#6} ({#7}Champion{/#7}) • {#8}Swordmaster{/#8} ({#9}Champion{/#9}) • {#10}Hedge Knight{/#10} ({#11}Champion{/#11}) • {#12}Master Archer{/#12} ({#13}Champion{/#13}) • {#14}Disguised Bandit{/#14} • {#15}Wardog{/#15}
{#1}Underdog{/#1} if has a one-handed weapon and a shield
units.zh: 装备单手武器和盾牌时拥有{#1}以少敌多{/#1}。

units.source: Man at Arms is an armored melee unit from the {#1}Noble{/#1} faction.
units.zh: 重装军士是{#1}贵族{/#1}阵营的重甲近战单位。

units.source: 60% chance of a {#1}Pollaxe{/#1}, {#2}Billhook{/#2}, {#3}Pike{/#3}, {#4}Polehammer{/#4} or {#5}Longsword{/#5}.
40% chance of a {#1}Military Pick{/#1} (double chance), {#2}Arming Sword{/#2} (double chance), {#3}Morning Star{/#3}, {#4}Winged Mace{/#4} or {#5}Flail{/#5}.

A {#1}Reinforced Mail Hauberk{/#1} (210), {#2}Footman's Armor{/#2} (190), {#3}Light Scale Armor{/#3} (170) (only houses with certain banners), {#4}Mail Hauberk{/#4} (150), {#5}Mail Shirt{/#5} (130) or {#6}Basic Mail Shirt{/#6} (115).
The armor has a 75% chance of {#1}Metal Joint Covers{/#1} (30) (4/7 chance) or a {#2}Mail Patch{/#2} (20) (3/7 chance) on it.

67% chance of a {#1}Closed Flat Top with Mail{/#1} (280), {#2}Bascinet with Mail{/#2} (210) (double chance), {#3}Barbute Helmet{/#3} (190), {#4}Closed and Padded Flat Top{/#4} (180), {#5}Closed Flat Top Helmet{/#5} (170), or, with triple chance, depending on their noble house, {#6}Flat Top with Closed Mail{/#6} (265), {#7}Kettle Hat with Closed Mail{/#7} (250) or {#8}Nasal Helmet with Closed Mail{/#8} (240).
If the weapon is one-handed, a {#1}Kite Shield{/#1} (40% chance) or {#2}Heater Shield{/#2} (60% chance).
units.zh: 若使用单手武器，则装备{#1}鸢形盾{/#1}（40%概率）或{#2}熨斗形盾{/#2}（60%概率）。

units.source: Depending on what equipment they have, Men at Arms' role and behavior are similar to those of {#1}Footmen{/#1} or {#2}Billmen{/#2}.
units.zh: 根据装备不同，重装军士的职责和行为类似{#1}步兵{/#1}或{#2}钩镰枪兵{/#2}。

units.source: They can use {#1}Shieldwall{/#1} if they have a shield, and can {#2}Rotate{/#2} with allies to save them from danger.
units.zh: 持盾时，他们可以使用{#1}盾墙{/#1}，也能与友军{#2}换位{/#2}，将其救出险境。

units.source: Prioritize those armed with two-handed weapons, if there are no weaker targets. Control them with {#1}stun{/#1} or {#2}disarm{/#2}.
units.zh: 如果没有更脆弱的目标，应优先对付持双手武器的重装军士，用{#1}眩晕{/#1}或{#2}缴械{/#2}控制。

units.source: Their relatively low hitpoints hint at their vulnerability to armor piercing damage and {#1}Puncture{/#1}. If killed this way, they drop their armor.
units.zh: 他们的生命值相对较低，因此更怕穿甲伤害和{#1}破甲刺击{/#1}。这样杀死他们，还能保留下护甲作为战利品。

units.source: {#1}Two-Handed Flails{/#1} bypass their shields and inflict more damage on headshots, because Men at Arms don't have {#2}Steel Brow{/#2}.
units.zh: {#1}双手连枷{/#1}可以绕过盾牌；重装军士没有{#2}钢铁额骨{/#2}，命中头部还会造成更多伤害。
